jobs.excerpt: About BJAK The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

  • Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

  • Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

  • Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

  • Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

  • Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

  • Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

  • Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

  • Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

  • Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

  • Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

  • Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Description:

JOB SUMMARY

This position is responsible for implementing Vertex’s Cloud and On-Premise products with host applications such as SAP, Oracle, JD Edwards, and other strategic partner applications, as well as implementing Vertex tax technology solutions.


The role focuses on delivering consulting services and project deliverables that support the deployment of Vertex tax technology products. It requires knowledge of Vertex products and familiarity with how Vertex applications integrate with host applications. The position may also require the ability to identify and deliver tax process solutions and other value-added services that contribute to Vertex’s revenue and profitability objectives.


ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate with experienced Senior Consultants on implementation projects while executing against client Statements of Work (SOWs).
  • Continually develop knowledge of consulting methodologies and the Vertex market and ecosystem through the delivery of consulting services and participation in formal and informal learning opportunities.
  • Continue developing consulting, industry, and project implementation knowledge while taking guidance from senior Vertex Consultants and contributing to projects as needed.
  • Participate in all phases of Vertex software implementations while adhering to Vertex best-practice methodology.
  • Assist with all phases of Vertex projects, including reviewing and analyzing client requirements, solution design and build, testing, and providing client support as needed.
  • Conduct solution design, Vertex application configuration, and solution documentation to support successful implementations.
  • Exercise sound judgment in managing day-to-day client relationships and expectations.
  • Maintain a high degree of customer satisfaction throughout project engagements.
  • When appropriate, assist Consulting Business Development with the development of Statements of Work.
  • Assist with the training and development of new team members as needed.
  • Participate in other projects and perform additional duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  • Knowledge of implementation and consulting practices, customer service, and vendor practices.
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies and implementation and testing techniques appropriate for Windows, legacy, and/or client-server database applications.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks, work effectively in a team environment, and remain responsive to project and customer needs.
  • Ability to adapt and function effectively in a fast-paced and changing environment while working under deadlines.
  • Solid analytical, presentation, troubleshooting, and solution-design skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • ERP knowledge is a plus.
  • Ability to maintain expected attendance at work.
  • Effective time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage job-related and personal stress effectively.
  • Knowledge and understanding of Vertex’s business, industry, and marketplace.
  • Willingness to work overtime, holidays, and weekends based on business needs.

EDUCATION AND TRAINING

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • Four or more years of experience in a corporate environment through internships and/or professional work experience.
  • Prior experience involving client or customer interaction is a plus.
  • An equivalent combination of education and experience may also be considered.

COMMENTS:

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in this position. Other functions may be assigned, and management retains the right to add or change the duties at any time.



Vertex Values: Together We Win


We're building a team of people who are passionate about making an impact for our customers and committed to how that impact is achieved. Our values define the behaviors, mindset, and culture that make Vertex a great place to grow and do meaningful work.


Play to Win or We Don't Play — If we choose to do something, we're choosing to do it because we plan to win. That mindset raises our bar on product quality, customer outcomes, and how we show up for one another.


Work As a Team, Putting the Customer At the Core — Our customers are our true north. Whatever your role, ask: how will this help a customer succeed today? We earn trust through outcomes, not promises.


Achieve Excellence With Integrity, Speed, and Agility — The market isn't slowing down. We'll move faster, adapt quickly, and never compromise on doing things the right way — for teammates, customers, and partners.


Innovate Boldly With a Growth Mindset — Progress demands smart risk. We'll try new approaches, learn fast, and keep pushing the boundaries — especially where AI can remove friction and unlock value.


Communicate with Care, Candor and Transparency — Honest, constructive conversations make us better. Let's speak plainly about what's working and what isn't and help each other improve.

Pay Transparency Statement:

Annual Salary Range: ₹1,016,400.00 - ₹1,321,320.00

Pay Basis: Monthly

The posted range reflects the anticipated hiring range for successful candidates at the time of hire, based on relevant job‑related skills, experience, geographic location, and business needs. jobs.excerpt: Why this role and why now?  Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster.
jobs.description:
Why this role and why now?

Organizations worldwide are under pressure to get more value from their assets, faster. Ultimo is growing rapidly, both globally and in the US, and our North American customers are increasingly multi-site manufacturers and distribution networks moving off legacy CMMS platforms such as MainSaver. Getting their data and technical foundation right is what makes or breaks a go‑live.

This is not a back-office data role. You are the technical lead our customers work with, from the first scoping call to cutover weekend, and the person their IT team trusts on data, environments, and technical design.

If you enjoy solving technical problems with customers, getting hands-on with data, and seeing a go‑live land cleanly, this is your moment.

Your impact

As Technical Consultant, Data Migration, you own the technical side of Ultimo implementations: moving customers’ asset, maintenance, and inventory data into Ultimo, and making sure the platform is set up to run reliably in their environment. You work directly with customer maintenance and IT teams, alongside our consultants, project manager, Solution Architect, and Integration Specialist.

You are trusted to lead the technical workstream, not just to support it.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Act as the technical lead on North American implementations, from estimate through go‑live and handover to support
  • Run technical workshops with customer IT teams covering environments, security, user access, data, and the systems Ultimo will connect to
  • Turn business and technical requirements into a sound technical design, working with the Solution Architect and functional consultants
  • Handle the technical side of configuration, including user roles and permissions, advanced configuration, and custom reports and queries
  • Scope and estimate data migration work before proposals go out, using standard discovery questions and validating assumptions with the customer’s IT team
  • Lead data workshops, source-system analysis, field mapping, and data cleansing guidance
  • Run trial loads, reconciliation, and validation cycles, and secure customer sign-off on migrated data before go‑live
  • Build and run the cutover plan with the project manager, and be on site for cutover and early go‑live support where needed
  • Work with the Integration Specialist to define data requirements for integrations and test them end to end
  • Troubleshoot technical issues through testing, go‑live, and early life support, and raise scope changes early through the change order process
  • Cross-train consultants on data migration and technical work so that no project depends on a single person
  • Build a North American data migration toolkit with our European practice, applying AI‑assisted methods to mapping, cleansing, and validation
  • Support sales on qualified opportunities where data or technical complexity is a material risk
  • Document technical and data decisions so that support can take over cleanly after go‑live

This role is a great fit if you:

  • Bring 5+ years of hands‑on experience as a technical consultant on EAM / CMMS / ERP implementations, including leading data migrations (MainSaver, IBM Maximo, SAP PM, Infor, or similar)
  • Have strong SQL and data-transformation skills, and are comfortable with ETL tooling, data profiling, and large spreadsheets
  • Understand enterprise SaaS environments, including security and user access, single sign-on, and how systems exchange data through APIs and files
  • Have carried a cutover through to go‑live and know how to keep a migration on track when the source data is worse than expected
  • Can turn a short discovery conversation into a defensible estimate and explain the assumptions behind it
  • Can build reports and queries that help customers trust and use their data
  • Communicate confidently and clearly with maintenance managers and IT directors, including when the news is not good
  • Enjoy sharing what you know and helping teammates build their technical skills
  • Have an affinity with AI and emerging technologies, and are curious about applying them to mapping, cleansing, and testing
  • Take ownership and act proactively, with a genuine commitment to customer success

Ready to step up?

If you want to be the person customers trust with their data and the technical health of their implementation, and help make data migration a strength of how Ultimo delivers, this is the opportunity.

This role is remote within the US, ideally based in the Eastern or Central time zone, with regular travel to customer sites around technical workshops, trial loads, and cutover.

Apply now and help organizations get more out of their assets faster.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. VEVRAA Federal Contractor, Equal Opportunity Employer

Why Ultimo?

  • You work on high‑impact transformation projects, not long, abstract programs
  • You deliver visible value fast, customers see results within months
  • You join a fast‑growing international SaaS company where growth unlocks new opportunities
  • You work in a pragmatic, result-driven culture with experienced professionals
  • You get strong onboarding, continuous learning, and real career progression

jobs.title: Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments
jobs.excerpt: Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Digital Transformation Director is responsible for defining and leading the organization's digital transformation strategy to modernize business operations, enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation through technology.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide digital initiatives involving technology modernization, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud adoption, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and system integration.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, IT teams, business unit heads, and external technology partners to translate business objectives into digital transformation roadmaps, manage strategic technology investments, and ensure successful implementation of digital solutions that deliver measurable business value.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Digital Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital transformation strategy, vision, and implementation roadmap.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies and digital opportunities that can improve business performance and competitiveness.
  • Lead enterprise-wide digital modernization initiatives across insurance, investment, finance, and customer service functions.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, digital innovation, and transformation priorities.

B. Technology Modernization & Enterprise Architecture

  • Lead modernization of legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and digital platforms.
  • Oversee the implementation and integration of core business systems, CRM, ERP, policy administration, and investment management platforms.
  • Establish technology architecture standards and ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Drive cloud migration, application modernization, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure digital solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business requirements.

C. Automation, AI & Digital Innovation

  • Identify and implement opportunities for robotic process automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, machine learning, and workflow automation.
  • Drive innovation through digital products, intelligent process automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote the use of data-driven insights to improve business decisions and operational performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their potential business impact.
  • Lead digital initiatives to automate claims processing, underwriting, customer onboarding, investment reporting, and other business operations.

D. Digital Customer Experience & Business Transformation

  • Lead digital initiatives to improve customer journeys, engagement, and service delivery.
  • Oversee development and enhancement of digital customer platforms, mobile applications, self-service portals, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital distribution strategies and technology-enabled business models.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to redesign processes and improve customer experience.
  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and retention.

E. Data, Analytics & Information Management

  • Establish data-driven transformation strategies and enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee implementation of business intelligence, reporting, and data analytics platforms.
  • Promote data governance, data quality, and responsible data management practices.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and business intelligence to improve risk assessment, investment decisions, and operational forecasting.
  • Ensure data management practices comply with relevant privacy and regulatory requirements.

F. Cybersecurity, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate cybersecurity and information security controls.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and IT teams to manage technology-related risks.
  • Ensure digital platforms meet applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and data protection requirements.
  • Oversee technology governance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resilience considerations.
  • Monitor emerging technology risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.

G. Programme Governance & Financial Management

  • Oversee the organization's digital transformation portfolio, programmes, and strategic technology projects.
  • Develop digital transformation budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor project milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic implementation partners.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance dashboards, and benefits realization mechanisms.

H. Change Management & Digital Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management strategies associated with digital transformation.
  • Build digital capabilities through employee training, engagement, and technology adoption programmes.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop digital skills and transformation readiness.
  • Address resistance to technology adoption and promote a digital-first organizational culture.
  • Ensure new digital platforms and processes are effectively embedded into daily operations.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Digital Transformation, Technology Management, or Business Strategy is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or enterprise technology management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior technology or digital transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data analytics, AI, automation, and digital platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale technology budgets, transformation portfolios, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, regulatory compliance, data protection, and operational resilience.
  • Certifications such as TOGAF, PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Prosci, AWS, Azure, or relevant digital transformation qualifications are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of digital transformation strategy and roadmap milestones.
  • Percentage of digital initiatives delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Digital adoption and utilization rates across business functions.
  • Reduction in manual processes through automation and technology implementation.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and process turnaround times.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from digital transformation initiatives.
  • Customer experience and digital channel satisfaction improvements.
  • Legacy system modernization and integration success rates.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity, technology risk, and regulatory compliance performance.
  • Employee digital capability and change adoption rates.

jobs.title: Principal DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About the Role: We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Principal DevSecOps Developer to join Upgrade's Security team. In this role, you'll focus on building and improving security automation, strengthening our SaaS environment, and developing scalable solutions that enhance security operations across the organization.

You'll leverage your programming and scripting skills, hands-on operations experience, and understanding of APIs, IAM permissions, and security best practices to solve complex technical challenges. You'll analyze code, troubleshoot technical issues, and apply risk-based thinking to identify vulnerabilities and implement effective security controls.

This is a highly autonomous, engineering-focused role where you'll have the opportunity to build security automations from the ground up, leverage AI to improve workflows, and solve challenging security problems. You'll work closely with Security, Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to streamline processes.

Our Core Technologies:AWS (IAM, Security Services), Terraform, Python, Bash, REST APIs, AI/LLM Tools (Claude, AI Agents, MCP), Tines/SOAR, Sumo Logic, CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, Sublime Security, SIGMA/YARA, Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, FleetDM/osquery, GCP, Google Workspace, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365.

What You’ll Do:

  • Build and maintain security automation workflows to reduce manual processes.
  • Develop and manage infrastructure as code using Terraform.
  • Implement AWS security controls, including IAM policies and least-privilege access.
  • Build secure integrations between systems using APIs and scripting.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve security risks across cloud infrastructure and internal systems.
  • Use AI tools, agents, and MCP integrations to improve security workflows.
  • Troubleshoot issues across infrastructure, networking, and security tools.
  • Develop and improve security monitoring, detection, and response capabilities.
  • Partner with Engineering, DevOps, and IT teams to implement security improvements.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to strengthen security and automate processes.

What We Look For:

  • Strong programming, scripting, and automation skills across one or more languages.
  • Hands-on AWS security experience, including IAM permissions and least-privilege principles.
  • Strong Terraform skills, including independently writing and maintaining modules.
  • Solid understanding of APIs, authentication, and secure integrations.
  • Knowledge of security fundamentals, risk analysis, and cloud security best practices.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, networking, and technical operations.
  • Experience using AI development tools while independently validating generated code.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, automation frameworks, or MCP integrations.
  • Ability to work independently and solve complex technical problems.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Tines or other SOAR platforms.
  • Familiarity with CrowdStrike, Okta, Akamai, or Sublime Security.
  • Experience with Sumo Logic or similar monitoring tools.
  • Experience writing SIGMA or YARA detection rules.
  • Understanding of event-driven architecture and enterprise IT systems.
  • Experience with Kubernetes and container security.
  • Knowledge of OWASP principles, including LLM/AI security.
  • Experience with FleetDM, osquery, or endpoint security tools.
  • Familiarity with GCP, Google Workspace, or Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipeline security or software supply chain security.
  • Threat hunting or security investigation experience.
  • Exposure to security compliance frameworks.

What Will Make You Successful:

  • You take ownership and work independently with minimal direction.
  • You identify problems and proactively develop solutions.
  • You are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn new technologies.
  • You use AI effectively without relying on it for every task, and are able to leverage your own knowledge and experience to challenge its assertions.
  • You communicate openly and collaborate well across teams.
  • You enjoy improving processes and making a measurable impact.

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary ($170k-230k) and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

jobs.description:
Change Management Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Change Management Director is responsible for developing and leading the organization's change management strategy to ensure successful adoption of business transformation, organizational restructuring, digital initiatives, process improvements, and strategic transformation programmes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide change initiatives involving operating model redesign, technology implementation, regulatory changes, organizational culture, workforce transformation, and business process modernization.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to minimize resistance to change, strengthen organizational readiness, engage stakeholders, and ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable business outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide change management strategies, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate organizational transformation objectives into structured change management plans.
  • Lead change management activities across strategic programmes, projects, and business units.
  • Establish change governance structures, standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Advise executive leadership on organizational readiness, change impacts, and adoption strategies.

B. Organizational Transformation & Change Implementation

  • Lead organizational change initiatives involving restructuring, operating model redesign, and business transformation.
  • Assess the impact of strategic changes on employees, processes, systems, and organizational structures.
  • Develop change implementation roadmaps, communication plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate change activities across business functions to ensure consistent implementation.
  • Ensure new processes, systems, and organizational structures are effectively embedded into daily operations.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Work closely with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners to build commitment to change.
  • Lead executive communication, employee engagement, and organizational awareness initiatives.
  • Address stakeholder concerns and manage resistance to organizational changes.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to monitor employee sentiment and change readiness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Management

  • Lead change management activities associated with digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and new business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT and technology teams to assess the organizational impact of system implementations.
  • Develop training programmes, user adoption strategies, and technology transition plans.
  • Monitor technology adoption and ensure employees effectively transition to new digital working practices.

E. Culture, People & Workforce Transformation

  • Partner with HR leadership to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to promote cultural transformation, leadership alignment, and employee engagement.
  • Identify capability gaps and develop workforce training and development strategies.
  • Support leadership teams in managing organizational transitions and behavioral changes.
  • Promote a culture of adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify potential risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to minimize disruption.
  • Monitor change adoption, employee engagement, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure change initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Benefits Realization & Performance Monitoring

  • Define change management KPIs and adoption metrics.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of change communication, training, and implementation activities.
  • Measure employee adoption, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness.
  • Evaluate whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for executive leadership and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational transformation, business transformation, or organizational development.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide change initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and benefits realization.
  • Experience managing change associated with digital transformation, technology implementation, restructuring, and operating model redesign.
  • Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Professional certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of enterprise-wide change management strategies.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Effectiveness of change communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive feedback.
  • Compliance with change governance and reporting requirements.

jobs.description:
About Us

Abacus Insights is transforming how data and AI work for health plans. Our mission is simple: make healthcare data usable, so the people responsible for care and cost decisions can act faster, with confidence.

As the AI and Data Platform for Payer Intelligence, we help health plans break down data silos to create a single, trusted data foundation. That foundation powers better decisions—so plans can improve outcomes, reduce waste, and deliver better experiences for members and providers alike. Backed by $100M from top investors, we're tackling big challenges in an industry that's ready for change. Our platform enables GenAI use cases by delivering clean, connected, and reliable healthcare data to support automation, prioritization, and decision workflows—and it's why we are leading the way.

Our innovation begins with people. We are bold, curious, and collaborative—because the best ideas come from working together. We embrace the thoughtful use of AI and automation to drive innovation and efficiency, and we look for individuals who are curious and adaptable—those excited to leverage emerging technologies to enhance how we work—while keeping human insight, connection, and our clients at the center of every decision.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and let's build the future together.

About the Role

Our Solution Architecture team is looking to bring on an experienced Solution Architect to support both ongoing and new implementations. We see significant growth in our future and would love for you to be a part of it! You will partner with customers and numerous internal teams to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures that provide solutions to solve customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of Abacus’ offerings. As a Solutions Architect, you will demonstrate best practices around advanced cloud solutions and healthcare payer systems including claims processing (i.e., Medical, Vision, Prescription claims), clinical informatics (e.g., Lab Results), provider systems such as EHR, and CMS Interoperability mandate solutions. As a trusted customer advocate, you will have the opportunity to guide a client’s successful adoption of Abacus’ core data management offerings.

Your day to day

  • Author the project architecture design documents, including data flows, sequence diagrams and overall system architecture, that will drive the technical implementation of the solutions. This role will primarily focus on defining solutions associated with CMS Interoperability, but may also work on other data solutions.
  • Work across business and IT teams to understand the current business and system capabilities and determine the desired state to define the overall technology strategy roadmap
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams, including business experts, technical business analysts, project managers, sales / account executives and data engineers to successfully implement client projects which reduce technology costs and solution redundancy.
  • Collaborate with Product Management to identify client-specific requirements that may translate into an existing standard product feature or a future feature on the Abacus product roadmap.
  • Define the solution architecture visions for designated components that describe the long-term goals as well as near-term needs of the client.
  • Provide mentorship to internal teams on business needs and use cases for seamless client implementation. Provide ongoing support to address questions and issues raised by the implementation team.

What you bring to the team

  • Understanding and passion for healthcare data and systems – including payer, provider, and integration partners. Strong working knowledge of US healthcare data, including but not limited to Medical Claims, Pharmacy Claims, Membership / Enrollment, Provider and Clinical.
  • Domain expertise in CMS Interoperability Mandate (9115 / 0057) - including the technology used to serve the mandated APIs as well as the data structures (FHIR) required to be compliant.
  • Ability to define the solution architecture vision in architecture design documents
  • Broad and general technical knowledge as well as competencies in infrastructure, data models, databases, service orientation, programming, frameworks, standards, and technical modeling. Strong experience with one or more cloud vendors (AWS / Azure / GCP) and data platforms (Databricks / Snowflake) desired.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare industry trends, regulations, and customer needs with preference for previous payer / Interoperability vendor experience
  • Experience translating business needs into technology solutions that enable delivery of the Abacus platform.
  • Strong communicator who can leverage their domain and technical expertise effectively with the client and build working relationships with internal and external team members. Ability to communicate succinctly and clearly, both verbally and written, across technical and non-technical audiences at multiple levels, including business leaders.
  • Experience working in the payer / healthcare data space and understanding of the historical data architecture needs of our clients.
  • Understanding of client services or experience working for a cloud-based data management provider to large clients.

What we would like to see, but not required:

  • Working knowledge of Provider (EHR) Data formats and topics – including FHIR, X-12, HL-7 V2.3, and CCDA/CDA - as well as the general system architecture required to consume and make use of this data.
  • Working knowledge of Utilization Management / Care Management / Disease Management.

What you’ll get in return

  • Competitive Leave & Benefits
  • Comprehensive health coverage
  • Equity for every employee – share in our success
  • Growth-focused environment – your development matters here

Work arrangements

  • Standard hours: 9 hours/day, 5 days/week (5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST)
  • Location: Remote
  • Shift: Your standard working hours will be nine (9) hours per day within the Company’s standard working hours. Specific working hours may vary based on business needs.

Our Commitment as an Equal Opportunity Employer

As a mission-led technology company helping to drive better healthcare outcomes, Abacus Insights believes that the best innovation and value we can bring to our customers comes from diverse ideas, thoughts, experiences, and perspectives. Therefore, we dedicate resources to building diverse teams and providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants. Abacus prohibits discrimination and harassment regarding race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At the heart of who we are is a commitment to continuously and intentionally building an inclusive culture—one that empowers every team member across the globe to do their best work and bring their authentic selves. We carry that same commitment into our hiring process, aiming to create an interview experience where you feel comfortable and confident showcasing your strengths. If there’s anything we can do to support that—big or small—please let us know.

AI Use in Recruitment

We use AI-powered tools throughout our recruitment process. This includes Greenhouse's Real Talent Matching Technology, which helps prioritize applications based on job-related criteria, as well as additional AI tools used to support sourcing, interview preparation, and other recruiting tasks. We do not remove the human element—our recruiters and hiring teams review all applications and make all decisions related to candidate progression and hiring, regardless of which tools are used to support that process.

Identity and Location Verification

To protect the integrity of our hiring process, all interviews are conducted by live video with your camera on. Virtual or blurred backgrounds and headsets are not permitted absent an approved accommodation, and you should be in a well-lit, private space where your face and surroundings are clearly visible. Candidates who advance may also be asked to complete identity and location verification, which may include verifying your identity, work history, and confirming that you are located where your application states. Applications containing knowingly false or materially misrepresented information, including identity, location, or credentials, may be disqualified, and any offer may be rescinded if a material misrepresentation is discovered at any point in the process.
If you need an accommodation for any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know in advance.

The opportunity


Reporting to the Senior Director, SOX Compliance & Finance Risk, we are hiring a SOX IT General Controls (ITGC) & Change Management Manager. As our new Manager, you will bring the technical expertise and hands-on leadership needed to build, implement, and operationalize the ITGC framework. Working across approximately 15–20 applications, you will own moving controls from design into practice, identifying and resolving gaps, strengthening access and change management, and driving testing readiness. Collaborating with IT, Finance, Internal Audit, and external advisors, you will establish clear accountability, improve the quality and consistency of evidence, and create sustainable control practices as the organization transitions from building its SOX program to operating it.


This is a remote role based in the United States, preferably in the Eastern or Central time zones.


What’s in it for you


Build and shape a SOX program from the ground up. You will join Altus Group at a pivotal stage in its journey to build the IT general controls framework rather than inherit an established program. Working across approximately 15–20 applications, you will see the impact of your work as controls move from design into operation, ownership becomes clearer, and the organization advances toward testing readiness. You will have meaningful input into how the framework is established and how it evolves.


Take ownership and make a tangible impact. You will bring the ITGC expertise needed to turn complex technical and compliance requirements into practical solutions. From investigating privileged access and identifying control gaps to supporting remediation and helping control owners build confidence in their responsibilities, you will take work from discovery through execution. Your contribution will be visible in stronger controls, more reliable evidence, and resolved issues that affect the organization’s readiness.


Help create a sustainable approach to controls. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, consultants, and cross-functional project teams as the organization builds and tests its SOX framework. You will have the opportunity to challenge existing approaches, introduce improvements, and explore ways to make controls more effective and easier to maintain. As the initial implementation transitions into ongoing operations, you will help shape a framework that teams can consistently operate, demonstrate, and improve.


As our new SOX IT General Controls (ITGC) & Change Management Manager, you will


  • Build and operationalize IT general controls. You will work with the SOX compliance team, IT stakeholders, and consultants to design and implement controls across approximately 15–20 applications. You will establish clear documentation, evidence requirements, and control ownership, helping move the program from its initial build through testing and into ongoing operation.
  • Lead technical control discovery. You will independently investigate systems, access permissions, integrations, and technology processes to identify risks and determine required controls. You will review information such as privileged access listings, assess potential weaknesses, and translate your findings into practical recommendations and implementation activities.
  • Strengthen change management and access controls. You will work directly with technology teams to implement and improve controls governing user access, privileged access, system changes, approvals, and deployment. You will help establish practices that are consistently performed, properly documented, and ready for evaluation through testing.
  • Drive remediation and testing readiness. You will partner with control owners, Internal Audit, and consultants to prepare controls and evidence for the planned SOX dry run. As deficiencies are identified, you will investigate underlying causes, work with the responsible teams to implement corrective actions, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Build capability and accountability among control owners. You will help stakeholders understand their control responsibilities through practical training, walkthroughs, and hands-on support. You will clarify what needs to be performed, documented, and reviewed, helping teams take greater ownership of their controls.
  • Take ownership of complex work from beginning to end. You will identify what needs attention, carry out discovery, engage the right stakeholders, and recommend next steps without waiting for detailed direction. You will keep work moving, communicate risks and progress, and adapt your approach as priorities, systems, and requirements evolve.
  • Improve and sustain the control environment. You will identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen evidence quality, and introduce more effective ways of working. As the organization moves from implementation into ongoing SOX operations, you will help establish a framework that is reliable, practical, and sustainable.

You bring


  • The SOX and ITGC expertise. You have deep practical knowledge of SOX requirements and IT general controls, including access management, privileged access, change management, and IT operations. You can assess technical risks, evaluate control design, and determine what is needed to establish effective, testable controls.
  • The hands-on implementation experience. You have personally built, implemented, operated, or remediated IT general controls, ideally within an organization developing or transforming its SOX program. You understand the day-to-day challenges of working with control owners, resolving deficiencies, and making controls work in practice—not just assessing them or recommending improvements.
  • The technical confidence. You can engage directly with IT teams to understand systems, integrations, access permissions, and technology workflows. You know how to investigate unfamiliar processes, ask the right questions, and translate technical findings into practical control requirements.
  • The ownership and initiative. You are comfortable taking responsibility for work from initial discovery through implementation and resolution. You can establish a plan, engage stakeholders, anticipate what needs attention, and make progress without requiring frequent direction.
  • The adaptability and judgement. You have worked in environments where processes are evolving, priorities shift, and control practices are still being established. You can bring structure to ambiguity, focus on the most important risks, and adapt your approach while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
  • The communication and relationship-building skills. You can clearly explain technical and compliance requirements, work productively with stakeholders across IT and Finance, and help control owners understand and fulfil their responsibilities. You are comfortable providing training, challenging existing practices, and constructively working through resistance.

The Lead, Global Product Information & Digital Asset Management is responsible for defining platform strategy, governance, standards, and operational excellence across all Watts business units, brands, and regions.


The role operates as a global shared service supporting Product Management, Marketing, Sales, Customer Service, eCommerce, Information Technology, and Regional organizations.   • Lead product information and digital asset components of acquisition integrations, including platform assessments, migration strategies, data governance, and onboarding of acquired businesses.

  • Support global product launches by ensuring product content, technical documentation, digital assets, and syndication requirements are completed accurately and on schedule.

  • Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment.

Preferred Qualifications

General Applicable Company Competencies

Working Conditions

Pay Range

This role may be a fit for you if:

  • You know insurance compliance inside and out: You've investigated and answered DOI complaints, worked carrier audits, and know how expectations shift from state to state.

  • You're a tinkerer: When you see a broken process, you can't leave it alone. You take it apart, figure out why it breaks, and rebuild it better.

What you'll actually do:

  • Own Regulatory & Complaint Response: Lead the investigation and response for every DOI, Attorney General, BBB and carrier-escalated complaint, and hand Legal a clean, complete packet for final review.

  • Build Complaint Intelligence: Create the taxonomy, logging and trend reporting that show us root causes and size our exposure.

  • Automate the Heavy Lifting: Partner with our Ops automation team to build and keep improving AI agents that classify complaints, research accounts across our CRM and carrier portals, and draft responses for human review.

  • Run a QA Program: Set the quality bar for complaint handling and coach the team to it.

  • Turn Findings into Fixes: Bring together the teams involved to find the root cause of each issue, drive the fix through training, process or product changes, and confirm the same issue doesn't come back.

  • Carrier Compliance Partnership: Serve as the operational point of contact for carrier audits, information requests and complaint investigations.

  • Coach our Complaint Specialist: Manage and coach the specialist on our team, setting the quality bar for complaint handling.

What we're looking for:

  • Active Property & Casualty (P&C) license, or the ability to obtain one quickly.

  • 3+ years of experience in insurance compliance, complaints, regulatory affairs or claims. Experience leading or coaching others is a plus; formal management experience isn't required.

  • Hands-on experience owning DOI complaint responses, whether you wrote them or reviewed and finalized them, plus supporting carrier audits. P&C experience strongly preferred.

  • Regular use of AI tools in your own work, and examples of processes you've improved with technology, from spreadsheet automation to no-code tools to AI. Experience building automations or AI agents is a big plus.

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort turning messy data into clear trends and decisions.

  • Exceptional written communication with an eye for legal and compliance detail.

  • Bachelor's degree preferred (or equivalent practical experience).

What's in it for you?

  • Build It Your Way: Design a modern, AI-powered compliance program from the ground up, partnering with our Ops automation team.

  • Strategic Leadership & Impact: Work directly with Legal, Product, and Ops leadership to shape how Jerry earns and keeps the trust of customers, carriers and regulators, including a real say in product features and design.

  • 100% Remote Work: Work from home with all equipment provided.

Six full stack squads build and run these areas.

Senior Software Engineer, Go Core Platform

As a Senior Software Engineer, you’ll be a technical anchor in one of the six squads: designing and shipping significant features in TypeScript and React on AWS and Kubernetes, setting your squad’s quality bar, and helping all six squads build one coherent platform. You will also help prove out AI enabled engineering at GBG; this group is where new ways of building get tested before they scale, and senior engineers shape what good looks like.   • Design, build and operate features across services and front end, from first sketch to running in production.
  • Lead technical design for substantial pieces of work: API design and versioning, journey runtime behaviour, configuration modelling and the boundaries between them.

  • Push for shared patterns, components and contracts across the six squads, and resist drift into “six dialects” of the same platform.
  • Treat technical debt as planned investment: identify it, size it and make the case for paying it down.
  • Use AI assisted development daily (coding agents, review assistance, test generation, documentation) and help define the practices, review expectations and guardrails that keep quality and security non-negotiable.

  • Fluency with modern engineering practice: CI/CD, trunk based development, feature flagging, progressive delivery and layered testing, including end to end tests in Playwright.

  • A security minded approach to building software that handles sensitive personal data.

UX/UI Designer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a UX/UI Designer to create polished, user-centered experiences for Venveo's digital products.

This role combines strong visual design with UX thinking, research, prototyping, and design system work. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into high-quality designs and ensure those designs are implemented accurately.

What You’ll Own

Interface Design

  • Create polished, user-centered UI designs for Venveo's digital products.
  • Translate briefs and wireframes into high-quality, production-ready visuals.
  • Ensure designs align with established design systems and brand standards.

UX Research & Validation

  • Conduct or support user research activities, including usability testing and heuristic reviews.
  • Synthesize research findings to inform design decisions.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the user experience.

Prototyping & Iteration

  • Build interactive prototypes at the appropriate level of fidelity.
  • Use prototypes to communicate concepts and gather stakeholder feedback.
  • Iterate quickly toward validated design solutions.

Design System Stewardship

  • Contribute to and maintain Venveo's component library and design system.
  • Ensure consistency across product surfaces.
  • Help reduce design debt over time.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders.
  • Align on requirements and define appropriate scope.
  • Ensure designs are technically feasible and accurately implemented.

Handoff & Developer Support

  • Prepare precise design specifications and assets for engineering handoff.
  • Remain available during development to answer design-related questions.
  • Review implementations and provide feedback on design fidelity.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated professional experience in UX/UI design.
  • Portfolio showing end-to-end product thinking and strong visual craft.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including component creation, auto-layout, prototyping, and design system management.
  • Solid understanding of UX fundamentals, including information architecture, user flows, interaction design, and accessibility best practices.
  • Experience working in cross-functional product teams alongside engineers and product managers.
  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate asynchronously and clearly present design rationale.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership when requirements are incomplete or ambiguous.
  • You ask the right questions, make reasonable assumptions explicit, and keep work moving forward.
  • You maintain a high standard for visual quality while remaining open to feedback.
  • You treat critique as useful input and separate feedback on the work from personal judgment.
  • You communicate proactively across time zones and surface blockers early.
  • You balance speed and craft, knowing when to move quickly and when a design decision requires deeper exploration.
  • You keep collaborators informed without needing to be prompted.

What Success Looks Like

  • Digital product interfaces are polished, user-centered, and aligned with established design standards.
  • User flows and interaction patterns are clear and thoughtfully designed.
  • Prototypes effectively communicate concepts and support validation.
  • Design system components remain consistent and well maintained.
  • Engineering teams receive clear, accurate specifications and assets.
  • Implemented designs closely match approved designs.
  • Collaboration remains proactive, clear, and effective across product and engineering teams.

Typical Day

Your day will likely begin with a review of async feedback from Venveo teammates on current design files, responding with annotations or updated iterations in Figma.

Mid-morning may involve a short sync with a product manager or engineer to align on requirements for an upcoming feature. From there, you may move into focused design work, refining user flows, producing high-fidelity screens, or building new components for the design system.

Later in the day, you might hand off a completed specification to the development team, run a quick usability check on a prototype, or review a developer implementation and flag any discrepancies.

The role is predominantly async, so clear written communication in every deliverable matters as much as the designs themselves.

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screening
  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection

GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. General Description

GuidePoint Security is seeking a DevSecOps Engineer with deep AWS expertise to join the DevSecOps practice, supporting clients and internal teams with AWS cloud engineering, security, and operations, including infrastructure automation and web application firewall (WAF) deployment. This role will engage in the design, automation, and operation of secure AWS environments while providing “Wow Them” service to clients and internal stakeholders.

The DevSecOps Engineer will be required to demonstrate strong AWS architecture, infrastructure automation, and cloud security skills, lead by example, and apply technical rigor to every phase of an engagement, from discovery and planning through implementation, validation, and documentation.

About the DevSecOps practice

The DevSecOps practice helps client organizations build, run, and protect software and cloud infrastructure with security built into the way they work. Our engagements span application security, cloud engineering and operations, and edge protection, and we use automation and AI-assisted tooling to deliver faster.

Our team of application security engineers, cloud engineers, and DevSecOps engineers focuses on AWS and multi-cloud architecture, infrastructure as code, cloud security configuration, and CI/CD automation. We partner with client cloud, platform, and security teams to deliver changes carefully and leave behind documentation and automation the client can operate.

  • AWS architecture and operations delivered as version-controlled infrastructure as code
  • Cloud security configuration and web application firewall engineering, including platform migrations and rule tuning
  • CI/CD automation that provisions and validates cloud infrastructure and security controls

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Design, deploy, and operate secure, multi-account AWS environments for client engagements, including networking, identity, and logging foundations
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using tools such as Terraform, OpenTofu, or CloudFormation, with reusable modules, managed state, and reviewed plans
  • Deploy, tune, and migrate web application firewalls and edge protection (e.g., AWS WAF, Cloudflare, Azure WAF) in client environments
  • Assess AWS configurations for security risk, including IAM, network exposure, encryption, and logging, and guide or implement remediation
  • Implement and operate AWS security and monitoring services (e.g., Security Hub, GuardDuty, Config) and route their findings into client workflows
  • Perform cloud operations including change execution, access management, and troubleshooting across client cloud environments
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions) that provision, change, and validate cloud infrastructure and security controls
  • Author architecture documents, migration plans, runbooks, and status reports, and contribute reusable modules to the DevSecOps practice
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems faster, and drive better outcomes for clients and the team

Required Experience and Education:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating AWS environments, with deep knowledge of compute, networking, storage, identity, and multi-account design
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform, OpenTofu, or CloudFormation, including writing and maintaining reusable modules and managing state at scale
  • Hands-on experience operating web application firewalls, preferably AWS WAF, including managed and custom rules, log analysis, and false-positive tuning
  • Strong understanding of AWS security, including least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, encryption with KMS, and logging and monitoring with CloudTrail and CloudWatch
  • Working knowledge of networking and edge fundamentals, including DNS, TLS, load balancing, and routing
  • Strong scripting and automation experience in Python, Bash, or a comparable language, and proficiency with Git and CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical changes and explain risk and rollback plans to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Ability to work standard Eastern Time business hours (8 AM – 5 PM EST); candidates must be located in the Eastern or Central Time Zone

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Experience with additional WAF and edge platforms such as Cloudflare, Akamai, F5, or Azure, including migrations between platforms
  • Experience with Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools and with securing AI/ML workloads on AWS (e.g., Amazon Bedrock)
  • Experience in a consulting, professional services, or client-facing delivery role
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source tooling, automation frameworks, or public GitHub repositories

Travel Requirements:

Physical Requirements:

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Transformation Director is responsible for leading and driving enterprise-wide transformation initiatives to improve organizational performance, operational efficiency, business growth, customer experience, and long-term competitiveness.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees strategic transformation programmes involving digital innovation, business process reengineering, operating model redesign, technology modernization, organizational restructuring, regulatory compliance, and cultural change.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, business unit heads, technology teams, and external partners to translate corporate strategy into actionable transformation initiatives, ensuring measurable business outcomes, sustainable change adoption, and improved organizational performance.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Enterprise Transformation Strategy

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide transformation strategy and roadmap.
  • Translate corporate objectives into strategic transformation initiatives, programmes, and measurable outcomes.
  • Identify opportunities for business model innovation, operational improvement, digitalization, and organizational growth.
  • Align transformation priorities with business strategy, market developments, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise the CEO and executive leadership on transformation priorities, investment decisions, and strategic opportunities.

B. Business Process & Operating Model Transformation

  • Lead business process reengineering initiatives to improve productivity, efficiency, and service delivery.
  • Evaluate existing operating models and recommend organizational, structural, and operational improvements.
  • Drive simplification, standardization, and automation of business processes.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks, cost inefficiencies, and opportunities for performance improvement.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable improvements across business functions.

C. Digital & Technology Transformation

  • Lead digital transformation initiatives involving automation, cloud adoption, data analytics, artificial intelligence, and enterprise technology modernization.
  • Oversee the implementation of digital platforms, business applications, and technology-enabled operating models.
  • Collaborate with IT leadership to ensure technology investments support business priorities.
  • Promote digital innovation across insurance operations, investment management, customer services, and distribution channels.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives improve data quality, system integration, security, and operational resilience.

D. Programme & Portfolio Leadership

  • Oversee the organization's strategic transformation portfolio and major change programmes.
  • Establish transformation governance frameworks, delivery structures, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Monitor programme milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Coordinate programme directors, project managers, business leaders, and external consultants.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, and quality expectations.

E. Financial Performance & Value Creation

  • Develop transformation business cases, investment proposals, and financial impact assessments.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operating costs, improve profitability, and optimize resource utilization.
  • Monitor transformation expenditure, financial benefits, and return on investment.
  • Establish benefits realization frameworks to measure the financial and operational impact of transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation investments generate measurable and sustainable business value.

F. Organizational Change & Culture Management

  • Lead enterprise-wide change management strategies to support transformation adoption.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop change communication, training, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Build organizational readiness and address resistance to change.
  • Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Ensure new processes, technologies, and operating models are effectively adopted across the organization.

G. Stakeholder, Risk & Regulatory Management

  • Engage executive leadership, board members, regulators, business partners, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure transformation initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and corporate governance requirements.
  • Identify and manage strategic, operational, financial, technology, and regulatory risks.
  • Present transformation progress, performance metrics, challenges, and recommendations to executive committees and the board.
  • Ensure effective governance, transparency, and accountability throughout the transformation lifecycle.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA is strongly preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in business transformation, corporate strategy, organizational development, consulting, or enterprise programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior transformation leadership or director-level position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide transformation initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of digital transformation, business process reengineering, operating model design, and organizational change management.
  • Proven track record of managing large-scale transformation portfolios, budgets, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong financial analysis, strategic planning, stakeholder management, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Certifications such as Prosci Change Management, PMP, PgMP, Lean Six Sigma, Agile, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of enterprise transformation objectives and strategic milestones.
  • Percentage of transformation initiatives delivered within approved timelines and budgets.
  • Financial benefits realized through cost reduction, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from transformation initiatives.
  • Improvement in business process efficiency and productivity.
  • Digital adoption and technology implementation success rates.
  • Employee engagement, change readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Customer experience and service delivery improvements.
  • Reduction in operational risks and process inefficiencies.
  • Executive stakeholder satisfaction and transformation governance effectiveness.
