jobs.excerpt: Who is USP?  The U. S.  Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients.
jobs.description:
Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

USP is seeking a Digital Product Marketing Manager to own and scale the email and lifecycle marketing engine behind our online subscription products, including USP–NF. You will set strategy and execute hands-on across the full email lifecycle, from audience segmentation and journey design through copywriting, A/B testing, deliverability, and performance reporting. Using marketing automation (Marketo or equivalent) and digital campaign expertise, you will drive subscription acquisition, activation, retention, and renewal. This is a high-visibility role that partners directly with Product, Customer Success, and senior leadership.

USP–NF is the most widely referenced source of drug quality standards worldwide, relied on by pharmaceutical manufacturers, quality control labs, regulatory affairs teams, and generic drug developers. This position will shape how USP–NF shows up across digital channels — the email programs, campaigns, and product-marketing content that connect scientists, regulators, and manufacturers with the standards they rely on. You will translate complex technical and regulatory content into clear, compelling narratives for a technical audience.

Remote employees must reside in one of the following states: MD, VA, DC, PA, WV, CA, MI, IL, KS, FL, NC, or MN.

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.

The Digital Product Marketing Manager has the following responsibilities:

Email & lifecycle

  • Own the email strategy and roadmap for USP–NF, including nurture, onboarding, activation, renewal, win-back, product announcement, release-cycle, and monthly newsletter programs, and decide what gets built, tested, and retired.
  • Design and build multi-step journeys and dynamic-content programs in Marketo, applying behavioral and lifecycle-stage segmentation to reach the right audience at the right time.
  • Write and edit email copy end to end, including subject lines, messaging architecture, and calls-to-action, adapting technical content to different personas.
  • Run a disciplined testing program (A/B and multivariate) with documented hypotheses, results, and learnings that shape future campaigns.
  • Own list health, deliverability, suppression logic, and database hygiene.
  • Define and track KPIs (engagement, conversion, pipeline influence, renewal contribution), build reporting and dashboards, and turn findings into clear recommendations for leadership.

Digital campaign & product marketing

  • Plan and execute integrated digital campaigns across email, web, landing pages, organic social, and paid media to drive subscription acquisition, activation, retention, and renewal.
  • Apply established USP–NF messaging and positioning to audience-specific assets for pharmaceutical, biotech, and regulatory segments.
  • Support persona development, audience segmentation, and market research for USP–NF customer segments (e.g., QC/QA, regulatory affairs, R&D, pharmacopeia specialists).
  • Contribute to sales enablement (landing pages, one-pagers, renewal collateral, and email sequences for the field team) and thought-leadership assets.

Cross-functional leadership

  • Serve as the marketing lead for USP–NF with Product Management and Customer Success, driving alignment on messaging, timing, audience, and priorities.
  • Lead the email and lifecycle program independently, setting priorities, the testing roadmap, and the reporting cadence with minimal day-to-day direction.
  • Manage content reviews and approvals across subject-matter experts and stakeholders in a matrixed environment, and escalate and resolve conflicts proactively.
  • Mentor and guide junior team members, contractors, and agency partners on email best practices.

Success will be measured by growth in USP–NF audience engagement and marketing-influenced pipeline — including email program performance, subscription acquisition and renewal contribution, campaign-driven awareness, and qualified leads generated.

This role is remote, with an expected travel commitment of up to 10% for conference support.

Who is USP Looking For?

The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of progressive experience in digital, product, or lifecycle email marketing in a B2B or subscription environment.
  • At least 4 years of hands-on experience owning lifecycle email programs end to end in Marketo or a comparable platform (strategy, journey design, copywriting, build, deployment, A/B testing, and measurement), with examples of results you drove.
  • Hands-on expertise in marketing automation platforms (Marketo preferred; HubSpot, Pardot, Eloqua, or similar considered), including list segmentation, dynamic content, journey building, and deliverability management.
  • Working knowledge of B2B funnel metrics, attribution, and CRM/marketing automation integrations (e.g., Salesforce + Marketo).
  • Demonstrated experience marketing a subscription or renewable product, including renewal campaigns, retention motions, and lifecycle analytics.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into decisions and recommendations.
  • Exceptional writing skills, with the ability to translate complex technical or regulatory topics into clear, benefit-oriented marketing narratives.
  • Experience in a customer-facing or customer-outreach role and in a matrixed organization, managing multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

Additional Desired Preferences

  • Experience with genAI tools like ChatGPT, Microsoft CoPilot, etc for workflow improvements and automation.
  • Demonstrable commitment to public health, patient safety, or consumer protection.
  • Demonstrated ability to problem solve, prioritize, and get things done in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None, this is an individual contributor role.

Benefits

USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.

Compensation

Base Salary Range: USD $101,042.00 – $142,429.50 annually.

Target Annual Bonus: % Varies based on level of role.

Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate’s skill set, experience, qualifications, equity, and other job-related reasons.

Note: As part of the recruitment process, USP's Global Talent Acquisition team may contact candidates through a variety of communication channels, including Microsoft Teams, telephone, email, and WhatsApp (voice calls and text messages). These communications may be used to schedule interviews, provide updates on application status, discuss career opportunities, and answer questions about employment with USP.

To help ensure timely communication, candidates are encouraged to keep their contact information current and to engage only with individuals who clearly identify themselves as authorized USP representatives. USP will never request payment, banking details, or other financial information as part of the hiring process.

jobs.description:
About Synapticure

Synapticure is the largest, most comprehensive specialty care and life sciences company in the country for those living with neurodegenerative diseases. Founded by patients and caregivers living with these diseases, we are redefining the care and the research paradigm for conditions like Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS in all 50 states.

Our business is powered by two connected engines.

The CARES Engine (Clinical Operations)

A scalable, 50-state virtualized clinical network providing timely access to expert neurologists and cutting edge treatments with wraparound care coordination and behavioral health support. Our team creates personalized care plans focused on education and empowerment, connecting patients with a multidisciplinary team of subspecialty neurologists, geriatricians, psychologists, and care coordinators who collaborate to deliver comprehensive care.

The CURES Engine (Research & Innovation)

Leveraging our deeply engaged, well characterized national patient cohort, CURES partners with life science, pharma, biotech, and medical device companies to accelerate the development of neurodegenerative treatments, spanning discovery stage lab services, clinical trial services, and real world evidence data and analytics.

Partnering with providers, health plans, and life sciences companies, including CMS' GUIDE dementia care model, Synapticure is dedicated to transforming the lives of millions of individuals and their families living with neurodegenerative diseases.

About the Role

Synapticure is seeking a Cognitive Neurologist to provide expert clinical care for patients living with Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, and related cognitive disorders. In this role, you will conduct comprehensive virtual evaluations, diagnose and manage complex neurodegenerative conditions, and collaborate closely with interdisciplinary team members - including advanced practice providers (APPs), behavioral health specialists, and care coordinators, to ensure a seamless and supportive patient experience.

As a Cognitive Neurologist, you will play a critical leadership role in both direct patient care and clinical oversight, supervising APPs across multiple states and ensuring adherence to clinical standards and telehealth regulations. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise in cognitive neurology including memory disorders and amyloid targeting therapies, thrives in a virtual care environment, and is passionate about expanding access to specialized neurological care for patients and families across the country.

The Day to Day

  • Conduct virtual consultations, cognitive assessments, and diagnostic evaluations for patients with Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, mild cognitive impairment (MCI), and related conditions
  • Supervise and collaborate with Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) across multiple states, providing clinical guidance and ensuring adherence to practice standards and state regulatory requirements
  • Develop individualized, evidence-based care plans that incorporate pharmacologic management, cognitive therapy recommendations, and supportive care strategies
  • Oversee the prescription of medications, ordering of diagnostic tests, and interpretation of results as part of comprehensive patient care
  • Collaborate with behavioral health clinicians, care coordinators, and other interdisciplinary team members to optimize care continuity and quality outcomes
  • Participate in case conferences and team meetings to review complex cases and contribute to clinical decision-making
  • Stay current with emerging therapies, including disease-modifying treatments for dementia, and support patient education regarding these options
  • Support caregiver engagement and education, helping families understand disease progression, treatment plans, and available resources
  • Document all encounters accurately and promptly in the electronic health record (EHR), ensuring compliance with telehealth and regulatory standards
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Synapticure’s cognitive care protocols, leveraging technology to streamline care delivery and enhance patient experience

    • Research, Innovation, and Clinical Trials

    At Synapticure, we believe that advancing dementia care requires not only excellence in clinical practice but also active participation in research and innovation. As part of our Cognitive Care program, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with leading research organizations and industry partners to bring cutting-edge therapies to patients through clinical trials and real-world evidence initiatives. Our clinicians contribute to the design and implementation of studies evaluating new diagnostic tools, biomarkers, and disease-modifying treatments for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias. Physicians interested in academic engagement will also have opportunities to lead or co-author research publications, present findings at conferences, and mentor team members in evidence-based practice development—all while working in a forward-thinking, mission-driven healthcare environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • MD or DO from an accredited institution
  • Completion of a residency in Neurology, with fellowship training in Behavioral/Cognitive Neurology or equivalent experience strongly preferred
  • Board certification in Neurology (ABPN) required
  • Active, unrestricted medical license in at least one U.S. state; multi-state or IMLC eligibility preferred
  • 3+ years of clinical experience managing patients with memory or cognitive disorders
  • Demonstrated proficiency in telemedicine platforms and digital tools for conducting virtual neurological evaluations
  • Strong clinical expertise in cognitive assessment, dementia management, and interdisciplinary collaboration
  • Excellent communication skills for patient, family, and team interactions across virtual channels
  • Commitment to patient-centered, empathetic care and continuous learning in neurodegenerative disease management

Preferred Qualifications

  • Fellowship-trained in Cognitive and Behavioral Neurology or substantial experience treating Alzheimer’s and dementia-related conditions
  • Prior experience supervising Advanced Practice Providers (APPs) in a multi-state or telehealth environment
  • Familiarity with amyloid targeting therapies and other emerging therapies for Alzheimer’s disease
  • Experience within an integrated, interdisciplinary care model or value-based care environment

Compensation

Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Our Values

We are a remote-first company. While our team is located all across the United States, these core principles tie us together around a common identity:

  • Relentless focus on patients and caregivers: We are determined to provide an exceptional experience for every patient we have the privilege to serve, and we put our patients first in everything we do.
  • Embody the spirit and humanity of those living with neurodegenerative disease: Inspired by our founders, families, and personal experiences, we recognize the seriousness of our patients' circumstances and meet that challenge every day with empathy, compassion, kindness, joy, and hope.
  • Seek to understand, and stay curious: We start by listening to one another, our partners, our patients, and their caregivers. We communicate with authenticity and humility, prioritizing honesty and directness while recognizing we always have something to learn.
  • Embrace the opportunity: We are energized by the importance of our mission and maintain a strong bias toward action.

Benefits & Perks

Full time employees are eligible for:

  • Remote First: Work from anywhere in the 50 United States, with home office technology provided.
  • Comprehensive Healthcare: Medical, dental, and vision insurance options for you and your family.
  • Financial & Retirement Support: 401(k) plan with employer matching, plus short and long-term disability, and basic and supplemental life insurance.
  • Time Off & Leave: 15 vacation days, 5 sick days, 12 paid holidays, and 2 floating holidays, plus a fully paid end-of-year company holiday break (typically Christmas through New Year's).
  • Wellness & Family Growth: Comprehensive family-building and fertility services through Kindbody (where available) at a 20% discount, 24/7 mental health support via Health Advocate and Talkspace (including 12 free on-demand sessions per year), and access to One Medical.

Travel Requirements & Remote Workplace Setup

We're a remote-first company and provide the necessary technology to work from home. Most roles involve only occasional travel, such as for team meetings or professional collaboration events, unless otherwise specified in the job-specific details above.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Synapticure is an equal opportunity employer and a remote-first workplace. We believe that embedding equity, inclusion, compliance, and operational excellence across all aspects of our employee lifecycle directly reflects our core values. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications.

At this time, Synapticure is unable to provide work visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Demand Generation Manager
jobs.excerpt: About Kestra Kestra is a unified orchestration platform.
jobs.description:
About Kestra

Kestra is a unified orchestration platform. One engine runs data pipelines, infrastructure operations, the scheduled scripts scattered across a company that nobody wants to touch, business processes that pause for a human decision, and now agents choosing their next move — all as executions in the same place, with one history to search when something breaks and one set of rules deciding who may run what.

More than four billion workflows a year run on Kestra, and more than ten Fortune 500 companies are customers. The open-source project has more than 27,000 GitHub stars and 2,000+ plugins, and the engine, interface, editor, and plugins stay open source under Apache 2.0.

In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo. Enterprises run Kestra in production because it delivers what legacy schedulers and point automation tools can't: unified governance, hybrid execution, and engineering-grade reliability.

The Role

Kestra is hiring a Senior Demand Generation Manager to own the program layer that turns product and market signals into enterprise pipeline.

You own the demand-generation plan, the multi-channel programs, and marketing’s contribution to the enterprise pipeline, with shared accountability alongside Sales. You translate Kestra's go-to-market strategy into campaigns that create and progress qualified enterprise opportunities.

This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Marketing. You partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Developer Advocacy, and Growth Engineering.

Growth Engineering owns the outbound automation engine, data enrichment, and attribution instrumentation, and hands you a signal layer built from product usage, community activity, web and GitHub activity, and enrichment data. You take that layer and build the named target-account list and the programs that turn it into enterprise pipeline. You are not building that infrastructure and you are not maintaining it. We don't buy, we build, and this role is for a marketer who works the same way: automating and experimenting on modern, AI-native tooling.

You'll join a small, senior enterprise marketing team where each person owns a function rather than a product line: this role owns demand and campaigns, a peer owns positioning and competitive, another owns customer evidence and content, and another owns technical proof and demos.

Kestra's advantage is converting one of the strongest open-source communities in orchestration into enterprise pipeline. That motion doesn't look like standard top-down demand generation, and you'll help define it.

What You'll Own

The demand plan and the number

  • Build and own the demand-generation plan against Kestra's enterprise go-to-market strategy, establishing program and pipeline targets in partnership with the Head of Marketing and Sales.

  • Build Kestra's enterprise account-tiering model, translating product, community, and firmographic signals into target segments and account priorities, and align with Sales on the accounts that matter most.

  • Bring today’s outbound campaigns under one coordinated demand strategy, so programs running across Marketing, Growth Engineering, and Business Development share target accounts, a common thesis, and measurable outcomes.

  • Partner with Growth Engineering to identify open-source deployments showing production-scale, multi-user, enterprise-shaped usage, and build the programs that turn those signals into enterprise conversations.

  • Build multi-threaded account programs that engage multiple members of the buying group across technical, operational, and economic roles, moving accounts from initial technical interest toward qualified enterprise opportunities.

Multi-channel programs

  • Design and run integrated campaigns across paid media, content, email, webinars, and events, coordinated toward pipeline rather than run as one-offs.

  • Build and run paid acquisition directly in the platforms. You will be hands-on in LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, owning targeting, creative testing, and spend pacing. This is a lean budget you are expected to make work, not an agency retainer you supervise.

  • Shape account-based and competitive-displacement strategy for market-shift moments, briefing the outbound automation engine and wrapping it with multi-channel air cover.

  • Own the program execution behind our flagship legacy-displacement campaign: targeting, channels, sequencing, budget, and cadence. Product Marketing owns the campaign brief and customer proof; you own how the program reaches and progresses target accounts, against a shared pipeline number.

  • Own the campaign assets that carry your programs: landing pages, nurture copy, and conversion paths. Content marketing and customer evidence sit with a peer — you brief them, they supply the story.

  • Coordinate with business development on contact-level outreach so account-level programs and individual outreach reinforce each other.

Nurture and conversion

  • Build the nurture and lifecycle programs that move prospects and self-serve users toward enterprise conversations.

  • Improve conversion across the funnel, from first touch to qualified opportunity.

Measurement

  • We measure at the account level, not the lead level. A qualified account means at least three people across two or more buying roles engaged within a defined window. If your instinct is to drive MQL volume, this role will frustrate you.

  • Instrument every program so you can tie its contribution to pipeline, working from the attribution and data foundation Growth Engineering maintains.

  • Report in the terms the business runs on — qualified accounts created, pipeline generated and progressed, and program efficiency — for quarterly business reviews.

  • Own demand-generation program budget and channel allocation, moving investment toward what is producing pipeline.

  • Manage agencies and partners where they extend your reach.

What We're Looking For

  • Typically 6+ years in demand generation, growth, or account-based marketing in B2B SaaS, with direct ownership of pipeline targets and outcomes.

  • Proven across the demand stack: multi-channel campaigns (paid, content, email, events), lifecycle and nurture, ABM strategy, and the marketing-to-sales handoff.

  • Hands-on paid media experience. You have built and run campaigns yourself in LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, and you can explain what you changed, why you changed it, and how it affected acquisition efficiency, account engagement, or pipeline.

  • A builder who automates and treats every campaign as an experiment — comfortable partnering with a technical growth-engineering function rather than owning the tooling end to end.

  • Analytically rigorous. You pull your own data, build your own views, and interrogate a pipeline report rather than forward it.

  • You work with AI the way a senior marketer works with a capable junior: brief it, review what comes back, ship what's good, fix what isn't. You verify every claim against a primary source before it reaches a prospect. We are not measuring volume of documents.

  • Familiarity with developer-led, open-source, or product-led motions — or the curiosity and adaptability to master one fast.

  • You operate independently with urgency and ownership in fast-scaling environments where the process is still being defined.

  • Genuine respect for the open-source community. Kestra's open-source users are not a lead list, and the credibility of the open-source project is the foundation the enterprise business is built on. Nothing you build gates or diminishes the free product.

We know strong candidates often hold back unless they match every line. If you meet most of this, we'd like to hear from you.

What Makes This Role Worth Your Time

  • Real ownership from day one: enterprise demand programs, ABM, nurture, and campaign performance, with direct access to leadership and real influence on go-to-market.

  • A signal and enrichment layer already built and maintained for you, drawn from product usage, community activity, web and GitHub activity, and enrichment data. Most companies our size do not have it. You build the target-account list and the programs on top of it.

  • A build-not-buy culture where you're expected to automate and experiment on modern, AI-native tooling.

  • A genuinely differentiated go-to-market: converting one of the strongest open-source communities in orchestration into enterprise revenue.

  • A platform in production at enterprises that cannot afford downtime.

  • A senior IC seat that stays one. Scope grows with the company, and at our size we are not building management layers.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, performance bonus, and equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

  • 401(k)

  • Fully remote, with home-office and equipment budget

  • Learning and conference budget

  • Paid time off, company holidays, and parental leave

Location

United States — Remote, with overlap with European working hours, as Product, Engineering, and the founders are based in Europe. Some travel to customer and industry events and company off-sites.

A Note on AI in Our Hiring Process

We use AI-assisted tools to help prepare for candidate conversations. They do not screen applications or make hiring decisions. Every decision about your candidacy is made by a person.

Equal Opportunity

Kestra is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to an inclusive environment for everyone, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

IAM Engineer III – Google | USA | Remote


Pax8 is hiring an IAM Engineer III – Google in the USA to engineer secure, scalable identity architecture across Google and Microsoft environments as our AI-powered technology ecosystem continues to evolve.


🚀 Build Identity That Works as One Ecosystem

This is more than administering Google Workspace. You’ll help shape how Google fits securely into Pax8’s broader identity strategy, with Microsoft Entra ID serving as our enterprise identity foundation.

You’ll have the autonomy to tackle complex federation, access, lifecycle, and automation challenges while strengthening an identity environment built for scale. As AI changes how technology is used across the business, you’ll grow alongside that change, exploring new ways to automate operations, reduce risk, and make access simpler and more secure.


🌎 Join Pax8

Pax8 is building the technology marketplace of the future, connecting partners, vendors, and small to midsized businesses through AI-powered insights and technology.

Our culture values curiosity, learning, collaboration and people who are comfortable challenging how things work today to make them better tomorrow.


🛠️ What You’ll Be Doing

You’ll become a senior technical contributor for identity engineering, helping create one cohesive identity experience across Microsoft and Google. Your work will include:

  • Connect Microsoft and Google identity: Design secure federation between Microsoft Entra ID, Google Workspace and Google Cloud Identity, creating a consistent approach to sign-in, user lifecycle management and access.
  • Engineer identity lifecycle automation: Build reliable provisioning, deprovisioning and group-management workflows that keep access aligned as people join, move within, or leave Pax8.
  • Strengthen privileged access: Build least-privilege approaches to Google administration, service accounts, elevated identities, emergency access and delegated permissions.
  • Protect authentication: Strengthen multifactor authentication, security-key and passkey adoption, session controls, Context-Aware Access and account-recovery practices.
  • Govern applications and access: Help control OAuth application access, consent, scopes, Google Groups and domain-wide delegation so access remains intentional and auditable.
  • Automate at scale: Build reusable solutions using Google Admin SDK, Directory API, Cloud Identity APIs, Terraform, Python, PowerShell and Bash rather than relying on repetitive manual administration.
  • Engineer for resilience: Prepare for certificate rotation, federation failures, tenant lockouts and other high-impact identity incidents with tested recovery paths and clear operational controls.
  • Make identity observable: Use Google audit data, Alert Center, Security Center and enterprise security monitoring to spot unexpected access or configuration changes.
  • Solve the hard problems: Take ownership of complex federation, authentication, synchronization and lifecycle incidents, then turn root-cause findings into lasting improvements.
  • Raise the technical bar: Create runbooks and technical documentation, share knowledge, mentor other engineers and help shape better identity engineering practices across the team.


🎯 The Impact You’ll Make

Great identity engineering should be nearly invisible to the people it protects. You’ll help employees get the access they need without creating unnecessary friction, while ensuring Google doesn’t become a disconnected second identity ecosystem.

Your work will reduce standing privilege, orphaned access and manual administration while giving Pax8 stronger, more resilient identity controls as our technology footprint grows.


💡 You’ll Be Ideal for Us If You

  • Bring substantial experience (5+ years) working with identity and access management in complex production environments.
  • Have proven hands-on expertise (2+ years) administering Google Workspace, Google Cloud Identity and Google Admin Console.
  • Have successfully integrated Google identity services with Microsoft Entra ID in a production environment.
  • Understand modern authentication and federation standards, including Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0 and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM).
  • Can confidently troubleshoot complex federation, sign-in, token, provisioning, deprovisioning and synchronization issues across Microsoft and Google.
  • Understand how to engineer secure joiner, mover and leaver workflows instead of treating lifecycle management as purely an administrative process.
  • Know how to protect privileged Google access, service accounts, OAuth applications, groups and domain-wide delegation using least-privilege principles and strong monitoring.
  • Have hands-on experience automating Google identity administration through Google Admin SDK, Directory API, Cloud Identity APIs and Terraform.
  • Can build reliable automation using Python, PowerShell or Bash with appropriate testing, logging and error handling.
  • Understand Google identity logging and how administrator, authentication, OAuth, token, group and lifecycle events can feed security monitoring and incident response.
  • Can design for identity resilience, including certificate lifecycle management, emergency access, controlled recovery and federation-failure scenarios.
  • Are comfortable owning complex technical problems with ambiguity and coordinating across teams to reach a durable solution.
  • Can explain complicated identity concepts clearly and turn technical knowledge into useful runbooks, diagrams and operational guidance.
  • Enjoy mentoring other engineers while continuing to deepen your own technical expertise.

jobs.description:
Robust.ai builds Carter, a collaborative robot that works alongside warehouse associates in order picking at third-party logistics and manufacturing sites. As a Customer Success Manager, you own a portfolio of customer accounts from go-live to renewal. You make sure each customer gets the uptime and throughput they bought, you prove that value in numbers, and you find where the next robots and sites should go.

You are the customer's single point of contact once a site is live. Our Deployment team launches the sites, our Fleet team fixes the robots, and our CS Operations & Insights team provides the data. You make all of it add up to a customer who renews and expands. Commercial owns pricing and contracts; you work alongside them on every renewal and expansion.

What you'll own

  • The relationship. Become the named owner for your accounts at SAT sign-off. Build ties from the floor supervisor to the site GM and the customer's executive sponsor.
  • Account health. Track uptime, adoption, and throughput for every site in your portfolio. Grade each site weekly (Navigation, Uptime, Adoption, Customer Sentiment) and act on the gaps before the customer raises them.
  • Business reviews. Run QBRs that show the customer what Carter delivered, in their numbers (orders, lines per hour, labor hours), and agree what improves next quarter.
  • Escalations. When a site is down or a customer is unhappy, own the customer conversation while Fleet (Support) restores service. Keep Commercial and leadership informed the same day on anything that threatens an account.
  • Voice of the customer. Turn what you hear on site into ranked feature requests and repeat-fault reports for Product and Engineering.
  • Renewals. Deliver a renewal brief to Commercial 120 days before each term ends: value delivered, open risks, sentiment and the recommended path.
  • Expansion. Spot more volume, new workflows, and new sites in your accounts. Qualify them and bring in Commercial, who prices and closes.
  • Customer-facing programs. Help shape and deliver premium support, references, and case studies.

How we'll measure success

  • Net revenue retention across your portfolio: customers renew and grow.
  • Contract uptime per account (shared with Fleet): customers get the robots they pay for.
  • Site health grades, trend quarter over quarter: problems are found and fixed before the customer escalates.
  • Renewal briefs delivered 120 days out: no renewal is a surprise.
  • QBRs held on cadence, with customer-agreed goals: customers see the value in their own numbers.
  • Expansion opportunities sourced and handed to Commercial: you find the next robots and sites.

Your first 90 days

  • Days 1–30: visit every site in your portfolio. Meet the floor leads, the GM, and the executive sponsor. Learn how Carter works on the floor, how a ticket moves from the customer to a fix, and where each account's health stands.
  • Days 31–60: publish a one-page account plan for each customer: goals, health, risks, renewal date, and expansion potential. Agree on the plan with Commercial.
  • Days 61–90: run your first QBRs, deliver any renewal brief that is due, and hand at least one qualified expansion opportunity to Commercial.

What you bring

  • 5+ years in customer success, account management, or operations in warehousing, logistics, or industrial automation.
  • A record of owning renewals and growing accounts, ideally in B2B hardware, robotics, or SaaS sold to operations teams.
  • Comfort on a warehouse floor: you can read a pick operation, talk throughput with a shift lead, and present results to a GM.
  • You work from data: you build your own view from dashboards and spreadsheets and turn it into a clear story.
  • Calm, direct communication when a site is down and the customer is upset.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites.

Nice to have

  • Experience with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), WMS platforms such as Manhattan, or 3PL operations.
  • Experience with large 3PL customers that run many sites under one relationship.
  • Spanish (one customer site is in Mexico City).
  • Familiarity with Jira, Slack, and Grafana or similar monitoring tools.

Reports to: VP, Customer Success.

Team: Customer Success lane, alongside one other CSM. Works daily with Deployment, Fleet (Support), CS Operations & Insights, and Commercial.

Full-Cycle Recruiter (Mid-Career)
Location: Remote (U.S.-based, East Coast hours required)
Compensation: $110K to $160K OTE (50% base / 50% bonus)

About Sitreps Talent

Sitreps Talent is the largest community of veterans in business in the United States and a boutique recruiting firm specializing in "Business Operators": high-intellect, high-energy leaders for two sectors: Defense Technology and Private Equity (Home Services & Industrial).

Since 2019, we've built a platform reaching nearly 200,000 followers and subscribers, generating tens of millions of impressions monthly, and maintaining a resume database of 5,000+ veterans who have expressed interest in private-sector careers. Our clients include defense technology startups and unicorns as well as PE-backed blue-collar roll-ups.

We don't recruit entry-level talent. Our placements are mid-career professionals, typically former military officers with MBAs from top business schools and 2–3 years of post-MBA experience at firms like McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte, or in investment banking and high-growth tech operations.

Our founding team will continue to own client relationships, intake, candidate coaching, and closing. Your job is everything in between: sourcing, screening, and qualifying candidates so we can maintain our speed and quality as we scale.

Responsibilities

  • Screen and vet inbound candidates via phone and video, assessing them against specific profile requirements for each search
  • Run outbound sourcing campaigns as needed for searches with specific geographic or professional requirements
  • Apply our filtering criteria to evaluate candidates, assessing career trajectory, education, post-MBA rigor, leadership indicators, and cultural fit for each role
  • Manage the candidate pipeline in Greenhouse, keeping data clean and statuses current
  • Present qualified candidates to the founding team with clear, concise written assessments
  • Coordinate candidate communication: scheduling, follow-ups, and status updates throughout the process

    The Searches You'll Support

  • Defense Tech & National Security. We place candidates who bridge the gap between complex software products and military missions. The typical role is an Engagement Manager or similar consultative sales and operations position. These candidates usually have 2–3 years of post-MBA experience in consulting or tech, can explain AI or software to a General, and are comfortable with 30–50% travel to military installations or the Pentagon. Other defense tech roles include Account Executives, Mission Success Leads, Mission Operators, and Implementation Engineers.
  • Private Equity (Home Services & Industrial). We place General Managers and operational leaders who run businesses like HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and construction companies owned by PE firms. These candidates typically have MBAs with backgrounds in operations or management consulting and have held P&L responsibility. They need to manage large blue-collar workforces while reporting financial performance to investors. Other PE roles include Regional Directors of Operations, Presidents-in-Training, and VPs of Sales.
  • We also place candidates in finance roles (investment banking, PE, FP&A backgrounds) and GTM roles (SDRs through VPs of Sales) across SaaS, industrial, and real estate sectors.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 3–5 years of recruiting experience at a staffing or recruiting agency, boutique agency experience strongly preferred; you need to have worked in an environment similar to ours, not exclusively at a large corporate or in-house recruiting function
  • Defense tech recruiting experience, strong knowledge of the U.S. armed forces, or U.S. military veteran status (at least one is required)
  • Proven ability to source and find talent for defense roles, including former military officers moving into the private sector
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple searches across different clients and industries simultaneously
  • Strong outbound sourcing skills: Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, creative candidate identification
  • Comfortable independently conducting high-volume initial phone and virtual screens
  • Experience recruiting for operational, sales, and go-to-market roles (not primarily technical or IT recruiting)
  • Self-directed and low-maintenance: you thrive in a remote environment and produce results without someone looking over your shoulder
  • Genuine enthusiasm for helping U.S. military veterans and respect for the defense community and its mission
  • Available to work East Coast U.S. business hours, Monday through Friday
  • Familiarity with recruiting for defense, aerospace, management consulting, or PE-backed companies
  • Understanding of MBA-level career trajectories and post-military career paths
  • Understanding of the defense/military industry and/or private equity operations; candidates who can speak this language will ramp faster and screen more credibly

Compensation & Benefits

$110,000 – $160,000 OTE (50% base / 50% bonus), consisting of a competitive base salary plus performance-based bonuses tied to qualified candidates submitted and successful placements.

  • Automation first, everything versioned and repeatable

  • A team that builds rather than firefights

  • Product mindset: start from the user and the business outcome, not the tool

Probably not a fit if your experience is mainly managing vendors and tickets rather than building.

  • Family-friendly policies and flexible working arrangements

  • Connected 📱: 2.5 million first-time smartphone users connected to the mobile internet

jobs.excerpt: Company Overview hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
jobs.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

You will own what the platform’s research is worth: prove it, make it worth more, and build the research function that keeps it honest.

hermeneutic Research Labs is the firm’s applied research and engineering unit. Its first product is a research intelligence platform for digital-asset markets, built with our researchers and traders and used by them every day. The platform turns market, on-chain, macro and news data into event-driven research that trading decisions rely on. The platform is held to the standard we apply to our own trading: rigorous, falsifiable and measured on outcomes.

The Labs is making a multi-year investment to turn the platform into production infrastructure that a growing set of internal users can depend on. As part of that investment, it is hiring a founding Lead Quantitative Researcher.

You will own the methodology behind the platform’s outputs end to end: how events are defined and detected, how forecasts are formed and calibrated, how performance is measured against an honest baseline, and what ships at what weight. You will have authority over what the platform claims about its own skill.

You start by doing the research yourself. As the function grows, you will hire and lead its researchers. The role is built to grow into Head of Quantitative Research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the outcome loop: point-in-time correct realised performance for each family of signals against an honest baseline with proper scoring rules, declared exclusions, and a scoreboard the whole organisation reads.
  • Make confidence mean what it says: reliability measurement, market-relative thresholds, regime-conditioned and recency-weighted lookbacks, and hierarchical methods for thin samples.
  • Set the research standards: pre-registration, derived minimum sample sizes, multiplicity control, edge net of fees, slippage and funding, a trials ledger that makes every attempt visible, and a promotion rule that decides what ships at full weight, reduced weight or not at all.
  • Own the event stack: the taxonomy of scheduled and realised events, detector design, cross-source confirmation, reference distributions for each type of event, and a coverage roadmap ranked by capital impact.
  • Develop forecasting and scenario methodology: probabilistic forecasts, scenario trees with kill criteria, market-implied information as the baseline, and calibration of model-generated confidence from the LLM layer before it reaches a decision.
  • Build research infrastructure with engineering: backtesting and replay that another researcher can reproduce, a research doctrine kept current, and executable specifications so the method survives implementation.
  • Sign off every parameter set and served confidence before it reaches a product.
  • Build the team: review and mentor researchers now, and hire and lead a research group as the function grows.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 6+ years of systematic or quantitative research in crypto or cross-asset markets, on the buy side or at a proprietary trading firm, including signals that ran live, a P&L you were accountable for, and 3+ years setting research standards that others followed.
  • A track record of owning a method: a research process you designed, a promotion rule or trials ledger that others ran, and a function you built from nothing.
  • Statistical rigour you apply rather than cite: you can tell a real edge from noise with a procedure, using proper scoring rules, calibration and discrimination, multiplicity control, bootstrap and sequential testing, regime conditioning, and Bayesian or hierarchical methods for thin samples.
  • Market structure depth: how spot, perpetuals, funding, basis, liquidity and crowding shape what an edge is worth after costs. You know what an unlock, a listing or a macro print does to a book.
  • Fluent Python for research and SQL on large time-series tables: you write production-quality research code and read the production code that implements your method.
  • A live failure, owned: a signal that failed in production, the mechanism explained precisely, and the change it made to your process.

Technologies named here are what we run today, not a filter. We hire for depth and judgement.

Desired Attributes

  • Authority with evidence: you tell the person who built it that it does not work, with the numbers, and offer the reduced-weight version instead of a lecture.

  5. Risk Scenarios – A scenario discussion with peers from trading or risk.

  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.

jobs.excerpt: States considered: All, globally Role Description: The Manager – Companion Animals Global On-market Clinical Studies & Outcomes Research will serve as a key research and subject matter expert for the Zoetis Pet Care business globally.
jobs.description:
States considered: All, globally


Role Description:

The Manager – Companion Animals Global On-market Clinical Studies & Outcomes Research will serve as a key research and subject matter expert for the Zoetis Pet Care business globally. This scientist will plan and execute research studies that demonstrate the technical, emotional, and economic value of Zoetis products and services for companion animal customers worldwide. The role will ensure alignment of research with the Global Pet Care Strategy and foster close collaboration with regional colleagues, Technical Services, Marketing, Veterinary Medical Research & Development (VMRD), Regulatory Affairs, Global Medical Portfolio Support (GMPS) and Global Portfolio Marketing (GPM).


Research will be conducted in partnership with global customers (veterinary partners and pet owners), contract research organizations, universities, and internal facilities. The focus will be on product performance, differentiation, and delivering customer value across diverse markets.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute clinical studies and outcomes research strategies that support the objectives of multiple Companion Animals brands across markets.
  • Design and implement pharmacoeconomic and outcomes research models to quantify the value proposition of Zoetis Companion Animals products globally.
  • Work with regional teams, Marketing, Technical Services, GMPS and GPM to ensure alignment of research with customer and market needs.
  • Support global lifecycle planning, ensuring Phase 4/OR principles are integrated into product development and post-launch strategies.
  • Publish and present research outputs internally (Sales, Marketing, Technical Services, Global teams) and externally (customers, industry meetings, publications).
  • Ensure dissemination of research results across markets, facilitating knowledge transfer and synergies.
  • Engage with global Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), universities, and contract research organizations to expand the scientific evidence base

Education and Experience:

  • PhD, DVM, or MS in Veterinary Medicine, Animal Science, Outcomes Research, Epidemiology, Health Economics, Public Health, or a related quantitative field; companion animal focus strongly preferred
  • Advanced training in epidemiology and biostatistics (e.g., causal inference, longitudinal/mixed models, survival analysis) is strongly preferred
  • Proven track record designing and executing outcomes and real world evidence studies in companion animals (e.g., comparative effectiveness, PRO/HRQoL, adherence, utilization), including economic analyses and decision modeling
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in companion animal health or outcomes research, ideally with multi market or global exposure and collaboration with clinics, referral centers, or practice networks
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex scientific and economic findings into clear, customer focused insights for veterinarians, practice owners, payers/insurers, and internal stakeholders
  • Strong oral and written communication skills with experience presenting to diverse audiences (clinical, medical, commercial, regulatory), including publication and conference presentations
  • Experience working with companion animal data sources (EMR/PIMS, insurance claims, registries), data quality assessment, and privacy/ethics compliance preferred
  • Proficiency in study design, principles of statistical analysis and reproducible analytics; familiarity with survey design and patient (owner) reported outcomes is a plus
  • Proven expertise in scientific writing, including the ability to synthesize complex information and collaborate on the development of research papers, protocols, and project summaries.
  • Proven cross functional collaboration with Medical/VMRD, Commercial, and Regulatory teams to align evidence with value messages and decision needs

Technical Skills Requirements:

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Word, Excel) for executive-ready deliverables and data summaries
  • Broad knowledge of companion animal health across species (canine, feline), clinical practice workflows (general practice vs referral), and prevalent conditions impacting outcomes and quality of life
  • Statistical analysis expertise (R, Python, SAS, or other softwares) strongly preferred, including design and analysis of observational studies and pragmatic trials
  • Health economics and outcomes research methods (cost effectiveness/budget impact modeling, PRO/HRQoL measurement, utility elicitation, causal inference) with application to companion animal contexts
  • Experience with companion animal data sources (PIMS/EMR from veterinary practices, insurance claims, registries) and data engineering basics for cohort building and data quality assessment
  • Advanced modeling skills: generalized linear/mixed models, survival/time to event analyses, longitudinal/clustered data methods (e.g., mixed effects), and sensitivity analyses
  • Data visualization and communication: ability to build clear, persuasive charts/dashboards (e.g., ggplot, matplotlib, Power BI/Tableau) and translate statistical results for clinical and business audiences
  • Reproducible analytics and governance: version control, documentation and audit ready outputs; familiarity with privacy/ethical standards for veterinary data.

Physical Position Requirements:

  • Ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed environment across functions and geographies
  • Flexibility to manage research projects with variable timelines and regional needs
  • International travel (20–30%, variable)
  • Ability to work in a home office environment with reliable high speed internet and a confidential workspace suitable for handling sensitive data

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the base pay target range for new hire salaries for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

jobs.title: SAP Manufacturing Systems Coordinator
jobs.excerpt: The SAP Manufacturing Systems Analyst is an essential role that supports SAP-based manufacturing, engineering change, BOM, and material data processes.
jobs.description:
The SAP Manufacturing Systems Analyst is an essential role that supports SAP-based manufacturing, engineering change, BOM, and material data processes. This is a fully remote position that supports accurate and consistent manufacturing data across SAP ERP (ECC) and related business processes, with a focus on engineering change execution, BOM maintenance, data validation, reporting, automation, and process improvement. You will also work within a team environment supporting engineering, manufacturing, purchasing, sales, finance, and other support functions to resolve issues, improve workflow reliability, and support operational continuity.

Your responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:
• Support and execute SAP ECC manufacturing and engineering change processes.
• Create, change, and validate BOMs, material master-related data, and related manufacturing records using established SAP transactions and business rules.
• Support ECR workflows, including status checks, BOM comparisons, SAP updates, validation, and documentation.
• Use SAP reports, data extracts, Excel, and related tools to analyze BOM, material, order, and operational data.
• Support new product family launches through SAP variant configuration activities, including development and validation of selection conditions, preconditions, configuration constraints, and related BOM structure requirements.
• Troubleshoot processes, data, and SAP issues impacting engineering, manufacturing, purchasing, sales, finance, and related teams.
• Maintain data integrity across SAP and related business files by identifying inconsistencies, validating changes, and supporting corrective action.
• Develop and support automation workflows for ECR processing, BOM maintenance, production hold processes, production data validation, and other manufacturing process controls to improve accuracy, repeatability, workflow reliability, and reduce manual effort.
• Support structured data mapping, transformation, comparison, and validation activities for BOM and manufacturing data.
• Create and maintain process documentation, checklists, and work instructions for recurring SAP/ECR/BOM workflows.
• Participate in continuous improvement efforts to improve accuracy, cycle time, and standard work.
• Communicate status, issues, and required follow-up clearly with technical and non-technical users

  • High School Diploma/GED with 5+ years of relevant SAP experience focused on Variant Configuration, Material Master setup, Engineering Change Requests, and Bill of Material creation.
  • Experience in process automation and Python programming is a plus.
  • Experience working with SAP ECC in a manufacturing or operational environment.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel skills for data review, comparison, validation, and reporting.
  • Ability to troubleshoot SAP, process, and data issues with accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently as well as in a team setting, collaborating effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting ECR, BOM, material master, or similar data-driven manufacturing workflows.
  • Experience developing or supporting Excel macros, Python scripts, or other automation for workflow improvement.
  • Experience comparing multi-level BOMs and identifying SAP data inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with SAP manufacturing-related transactions, including BOM, material, change master, and reporting transactions.
  • Ability to document repeatable work processes and support standard work.
  • Manufacturing, engineering support, logistics, or product data experience.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability / veterans.

FHP Manufacturing, located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, is a joint venture between Robert Bosch (BOSCH Group) and Carrier Corporation.

FHP Manufacturing is a leader in the production of geothermal and water source heat pumps, providing some of the most efficient heating and cooling comfort solutions in the industry.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.

You work with the information security team as a competent and experienced information security and compliance specialist.

How you will contribute

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

You work with the information security team as a competent and experienced information security and compliance specialist.

You will also provide information security training to appropriate teams.

What you will bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • Information security, compliance and risk management
  • Security solutions and their applicability to Mondelēz International
  • Security strategies, awareness campaigns, policies/standards and governance
  • Communicating effectively with technical specialists, leaders and peers
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Being a team player by supporting and leading to achieve common goals

Position Description

We are looking for a Senior SAP / S4 Security Platform Engineer with extensive experience to support our transformation to SAP S/4HANA and establish a modern, scalable, risk-based SAP security model in a complex environment with multiple operating companies.

This position will be responsible for the design, engineering, governance, and ongoing optimisation of security and access controls in SAP, with a strong focus on S/4HANA role architecture, business process alignment, automation, SAP GRC, Segregation of Duties (SoD), vulnerability management, regulatory compliance, and integration with enterprise Identity and Access Management (IAM) capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical knowledge of SAP Security and S/4HANA with a solid understanding of business processes, internal controls, IAM, and large-scale transformation programmes. This person will work closely with SAP Basis teams, functional teams, IAM, Cybersecurity, Internal Audit, Compliance, and business stakeholders to build secure and sustainable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute SAP Security activities supporting the S/4HANA transformation and modernisation.
  • Design and implement a scalable SAP security architecture for a multi-company, multi-region environment.
  • Lead the redesign and rationalisation of SAP roles, including business role architecture, composite/single roles, derived roles, organisational values, and authorisation objects.
  • Translate business process requirements into secure, properly segregated SAP access models.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, and harmonise security roles across operating companies while respecting legitimate local requirements.
  • Support security activities during SAP cutover, migration, testing, UAT, and go-live.
  • Design and implement SAP roles based on least-privilege, business-need, and risk-based access principles.
  • Perform analysis, remediation, rationalisation, and optimisation of roles in existing SAP environments.
  • Establish and maintain role design standards, naming conventions, ownership models, and approval processes.
  • Identify and eliminate excessive, conflicting, inactive, and unnecessary access.
  • Design controls for privileged and sensitive access in SAP, including emergency/firefighter access.
  • Collaborate with IAM teams to integrate SAP access with enterprise IGA, SSO, MFA, PAM/PIM platforms, and identity lifecycle processes.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience in SAP Security, with significant hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA.
  • Advanced English proficiency.
  • Solid experience in the design and implementation of SAP roles and authorisation models.
  • Demonstrated experience in S/4HANA transformation, role redesign, and security modernisation.
  • Experience in large, global environments with multiple operating companies.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing AI-based automation for operational efficiency.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelez India Foods Private Limited (formerly Cadbury India Ltd.) has been in India for over 70 years, making sure our mouth-watering and well-loved local and global brands such as Cadbury chocolates, Bournvita and Tang powdered beverages, Oreo and Cadbury Bournvita biscuits, and Halls and Cadbury Choclairs Gold candies get safely into our customers hands—and mouths. Headquartered in Mumbai, the company has more than 3,300 employees proudly working across sales offices in New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata and Chennai and in manufacturing facilities at Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Andhra Pradesh, at our global Research & Development Technical Centre and Global Business Hub in Maharashtra and in a vast distribution network across the country. jobs.description:
Le conseiller principal ou la conseillère principale, Relations avec l'industrie et les écosystèmes – Ontario, au CTIC contribuera à accroître la participation des employeurs et à développer des partenariats avec l'industrie partout en Ontario. La personne titulaire du poste dirigera les démarches régionales auprès des employeurs, du repérage de nouveaux prospects à l'obtention d'engagements, jusqu'au développement de relations à long terme. Le portefeuille comprend notamment l'AIT numérique (apprentissage intégré au travail), les camps de formation intensive en IA industrielle et en innovation, ainsi que d'autres initiatives liées à la main-d'œuvre et à l'innovation.

Ce poste consiste à repérer de nouvelles occasions d'affaires, à établir des relations solides avec des entreprises de l'Ontario et à atteindre les objectifs de croissance et de revenus des programmes. La personne titulaire jouera un rôle déterminant dans l'expansion de notre présence sur le marché ontarien.

La personne titulaire relèvera de la direction principale, Relations avec l’industrie et les écosystèmes, et travaillera avec les équipes nationales de programme, de recherche et de spécialistes afin d’orienter les employeurs vers le soutien approprié.

Responsabilités principales :

  • Diriger la prospection régionale. Fixer les priorités avec le directeur principal, repérer et qualifier de nouveaux employeurs et nouer des liens avec des associations sectorielles, des organismes d’innovation, des cégeps et des universités.
  • Recruter des employeurs pour les programmes et services du CTIC. Cerner, avec les décideurs, les besoins en recrutement, en compétences et en adoption de technologies. Proposer un programme ou un service adapté, obtenir un engagement et accompagner l’employeur avec l’équipe de programme.
  • Développer des partenariats et des occasions d’affaires. Préparer des propositions et des ententes, négocier les modalités avec l’appui des équipes internes et mener les dossiers à terme. Développer les relations existantes et repérer de nouveaux débouchés pour les services du CTIC.
  • Assurer le suivi des démarches et des résultats. Tenir le CRM à jour, prévoir la participation des employeurs et suivre les engagements obtenus par rapport aux objectifs. Ajuster les priorités de prospection en fonction des résultats.
  • Représenter le CTIC et éclairer les décisions de programme. Développer des liens lors de rencontres et d’événements sectoriels. Communiquer les besoins des employeurs et les tendances du marché aux équipes de CTIC programme et de recherche.

Ce que vous apportez au poste :

  • Maîtrise ou l’équivalent, avec au moins 3 ans d’expérience pertinente ou d’expertise dans le secteur des technologies
  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience à responsabilités croissantes en développement des affaires auprès des employeurs, en partenariats avec l’industrie, en développement économique, en vente-conseil B2B ou en gestion de comptes
  • Résultats démontrés dans l’atteinte ou le dépassement d’objectifs de développement des affaires et de programmes
  • Un réseau solide et bien établi dans l’industrie en Ontario, ainsi qu’une connaissance approfondie du milieu des affaires, du marché et de la culture de l’Ontario
  • Capacité démontrée à établir et à entretenir des relations stratégiques avec des parties prenantes de haut niveau et des personnes influentes clés de l’industrie en Ontario
  • Expérience dans la présentation de propositions auprès des instances décisionnelles et dans la négociation de modalités ou l’obtention d’engagements auprès d’employeurs ou de partenaires
  • Une compréhension du milieu des affaires et de l’innovation en Ontario et la capacité de transformer les besoins d’un employeur en matière de recrutement, de compétences ou d’adoption du numérique en occasions concrètes
  • Solides compétences interpersonnelles et en négociation, avec la capacité d’établir un lien de confiance avec une clientèle diversifiée
  • Excellentes capacités d’analyse, avec l’aptitude à synthétiser des informations complexes pour en dégager des pistes d’action concrètes
  • Compétences exceptionnelles en communication écrite et orale, avec la capacité d’interagir efficacement à tous les niveaux de l’organisation
  • Pensée stratégique et capacité pratique à mener des initiatives de la conception à la réalisation
  • Expérience en gestion de projets et en coordination des parties prenantes
  • Maîtrise des systèmes de GRC (CRM) et de la suite Microsoft Office

Ce qui vous distingue :

  • Succès démontré dans le repérage, le développement et la gestion de partenariats complexes réunissant plusieurs parties prenantes
  • Expérience avérée en transformation numérique, en développement de la main-d’œuvre ou en renforcement des capacités technologiques
  • Contribution reconnue à des initiatives stratégiques allant au-delà des responsabilités courantes
  • Capacité d’adaptation et aptitude à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement en évolution rapide

Êtes-vous?

  • Motivé et déterminé – Êtes-vous très motivé, autonome et prêt à aller au-delà des attentes, avec la volonté de vous améliorer et de dépasser les objectifs?
  • Optimiste, avec un esprit d'initiative et une orientation vers les résultats - Êtes-vous capable de faire preuve de créativité et de franchir avec succès les barrières et les obstacles? Restez-vous concentré sur la réalisation des objectifs et des résultats prioritaires?
  • Dynamique, résilient et flexible - Êtes-vous capable de suivre et d'accepter le rythme rapide du changement, les avancées technologiques, la concurrence intense et les niveaux d'incertitude sans précédent? Êtes-vous ouvert au changement, à l'évolution des besoins, au retour d'information continu, et avez-vous la capacité de travailler avec des équipes éloignées partout au Canada?
  • Un penseur stratégique et créatif - Êtes-vous capable d'analyser des situations et des relations complexes? Êtes-vous capable de canaliser votre curiosité pour relever des défis complexes et stimuler l'innovation? Identifiez-vous les interrelations, les modèles et les tendances tout en remarquant des configurations à travers des événements apparemment sans rapport?   • Un champion de la diversité et de l'inclusion - Êtes-vous engagé en faveur de la diversité et de l'inclusion, et comprenez-vous les problèmes et les défis auxquels sont confrontés les différents groupes?
