jobs.excerpt: Location Designation: Fully Remote Business Unit Overview Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-size and large companies.
jobs.description:
Location Designation: Fully Remote

Business Unit Overview

Group Benefit Solutions delivers comprehensive insurance and absence management solutions for mid-size and large companies. Our work fosters a healthier, happier and more secure workforce, contributing to New York Life’s legacy of being there when we’re needed most. Here, you’ll design, implement and support these solutions directly impacting customers’ lives. At our core, we provide financial security and peace of mind to people through our absence, accident, disability, voluntary benefits and life insurance solutions.

Role Overview

The Client Data Health and Optimization Consultant is responsible for ensuring client data, file feeds, configuration, and downstream processing remain healthy after implementation and transition to production. The role serves as a bridge across Implementation, Operations, Account Management, Product, Data, and Technology to identify production friction, determine root cause, and drive sustainable remediation that improves the experience for clients, internal teams, and claimants.

As a Corporate Vice President, Client Data Health and Optimization Consultant, you will lead the post-production health and optimization of assigned clients from a file-feed, configuration, and end-to-end data perspective. This role will combine technical problem solving, client consultation, operational analysis, and program management to distinguish client-side data gaps from internal defects; initiate the appropriate triage; and drive issues through resolution. The role will also use production insights to strengthen implementation standards, configuration decisions, and upstream/downstream processes so recurring issues are prevented rather than repeatedly managed.

What You'll Do

Lead post-production client data health and readiness:

  • Own ongoing assessment of client file-feed, configuration, and data health following implementation and production launch to identify larger root issues.

  • Identify gaps, friction points, missing or inconsistent data elements, configuration issues, and downstream processing impacts that create unnecessary operational work or client/claimant friction.

  • Perform root-cause analysis to determine whether issues originate with client-provided data, internal configuration, ingestion/transformation processes, system behavior, or other upstream/downstream dependencies.

  • Establish clear health indicators, remediation plans, ownership, and timelines for identified issues and monitor progress through closure.

Drive triage, remediation, and client accountability:

  • Initiate and coordinate triage with Technology, DET/data teams, Implementation, Operations, Product, Account Management, or the client based on identified root cause.

  • Present findings, data-quality concerns, downstream impacts, and recommended actions directly to clients and internal stakeholders in a clear, consultative manner.

  • Project manage client and internal remediation activities, ensuring actions, owners, dependencies, and target dates are documented and advanced in a timely and productive way.

  • Escalate systemic or high-impact issues and provide leadership with clear visibility into risk, business impact, and resolution status.

Audit configuration and downstream claims impact:

  • Conduct end-to-end audits of client configuration and data flows to understand how configuration decisions affect downstream processing in FINEOS and related operational workflows.

  • Identify configuration choices that may create avoidable claim-processing friction, manual work, validation activity, or additional client outreach, and recommend corrective action.

  • Serve, when needed, as an Absence subject-matter consultant to help ensure planned FINEOS configurations support efficient eligibility, entitlement, claims, and absence processes.

Provide deep file-feed and data infrastructure expertise:

  • Develop deep working knowledge of LADE, LDEx, GDE, and related client-data/file-feed infrastructure to understand how data is received, transformed, configured, and made available downstream.

  • Validate that required data elements are passing through the end-to-end ecosystem as intended and partner with the appropriate teams to remediate gaps, exclusions, mapping issues, or configuration defects.

  • Assess inbound and outbound file feeds holistically to ensure data structures and processes are efficient, fit for purpose, and reduce administrative burden for clients and internal teams.

Drive continuous improvement and prevention:

  • Synthesize recurring production issues and translate them into actionable insights for Implementation, Product, Technology, Operations, and Data teams.

  • Ensure root-cause findings result in sustainable remediation, including implementation controls, configuration standards, monitoring, process changes, technology fixes, and appropriate interim stopgaps.

  • Identify patterns across clients and recommend scalable solutions that prevent known issues from recurring after production launch.

  • Partner with upstream teams to incorporate production learnings into future client implementations, readiness reviews, standard work, and quality controls.

Optimize the end-to-end client data experience:

  • Evaluate the full lifecycle of inbound and outbound client data to identify opportunities to simplify exchanges, improve data completeness and usability, and reduce administrative burden.

  • Partner with clients and internal teams to improve how data is structured, exchanged, consumed, and operationalized across the absence and claims ecosystem.

  • Define and monitor measures of client-data health, remediation effectiveness, recurring defects, downstream operational impact, and sustained improvement.

What You'll Bring

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required; preferred fields include business, information systems, data/analytics, computer science, engineering, operations, or a related discipline.

  • 7+ years of demonstrated business results in implementation, client data integration, production support, operations, technology, consulting, or a related capacity; group benefits or absence experience strongly preferred.

  • Demonstrated experience diagnosing complex data, file-feed, configuration, or system issues and translating findings into executable remediation plans.

  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives across business, operations, technology, product, implementation, and client-facing teams.

  • Strong client-facing consultation, executive communication, presentation, influencing, and project/program management skills.

  • Working knowledge of FINEOS, eligibility/entitlement, absence and claims processes, and client file-feed concepts preferred.

  • Experience with LADE, LDEx, GDE, or comparable data-ingestion/file-feed infrastructure strongly preferred.

  • Ability to work with data and technical teams to validate mappings, transformations, configuration, data completeness, and downstream impacts; SQL/data analysis experience is a plus.

Required Competencies

  • Client and Operational Focus: Understand client objectives and operational realities and translate data and configuration findings into solutions that reduce friction for clients, internal teams, and claimants.

  • Root-Cause Problem Solving: Navigate complex end-to-end processes, distinguish symptoms from root causes, and determine whether issues originate with client data, internal configuration, technology, or process.

  • Technical and Data Acumen: Understand file-feed architecture, data elements, mappings, transformations, configuration, and downstream system behavior sufficiently to lead diagnosis and remediation.

  • Consultative Communication: Explain complex technical and operational issues in clear business terms and confidently present findings, impacts, recommendations, and remediation plans to clients and senior leaders.

  • Program and Project Leadership: Drive multiple remediation efforts from identification through closure, establishing ownership, milestones, dependencies, escalation paths, and measurable outcomes.

  • Ability to Collaborate: Partner effectively across Implementation, Account Management, Claims, Absence, Validation, Product, Technology, Data/DET, Operations, and other stakeholders.

  • Continuous Improvement: Convert individual production issues into systemic learning, sustainable controls, and upstream improvements that prevent recurrence.

  • Organization Influencing: Influence client and internal decisions without relying solely on direct authority, building alignment around data quality, configuration, remediation priorities, and future-state standards.

Pay Transparency

Salary Range: $100,000-$135,000

Overtime eligible: Exempt

Discretionary bonus eligible: Yes

Sales bonus eligible: No

Actual base salary will be determined based on several factors but not limited to individual’s experience, skills, qualifications, and job location. Additionally, employees are eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible to participate in an incentive program.

Company Overview

At New York Life, our 180-year legacy of purpose and integrity fuels our future. As we evolve into a more technology-, data-, and AI-enabled organization, we remain grounded in the values that drive lasting impact.

Our diverse business portfolio creates opportunities to make a difference across industries and communities—inviting bold thinking, collaborative problem-solving, and purpose-driven innovation. As a Fortune 100 mutual company, we offer a place to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and deliver solutions that matter. Your ideas drive what’s next, and your growth powers it.

Our Benefits

We provide a full package of benefits for employees – and have unique offerings for a modern workforce, including leave programs, adoption assistance, and student loan repayment programs. Based on feedback from our employees, we continue to refine and add benefits to our offering, so that you can flourish both inside and outside of work.Click hereto discover more about our comprehensive benefit options or visit our NYL Benefits Site.

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At New York Life, fostering an inclusive workplace is fundamental to who we are and how we serve our communities. This foundation is rooted in our core values of humanity and integrity, ensuring that every employee feels valued and supported. Compensation:

As vCluster’s AI Infrastructure Specialist, you will work directly with customers at the earliest and most critical stage of their journey: from bare metal GPU nodes through to a production-ready deployment. This is not a traditional professional services role; you operate pre-sale as part of a proof of value engagement scoped to reach production. You will be one of the first team members a neocloud or AI Factory engages with at a technical depth, and the playbooks you develop will scale the motion for the next hire and customer.

vCluster is gaining rapid traction with GPU AI Clouds and enterprises building AI Factories: organizations that need to offer Kubernetes as a managed service on bare metal GPU infrastructure, and need to do it fast. This role exists to make that happen.

As an AI Infrastructure Engineer, your role will include:

  • Lead Technical Deployments: Drive end-to-end technical deployments for GPU neocloud and AI Factory customers, from initial bare metal configuration to a validated vCluster environment.

  • Infrastructure Optimization: Configure and troubleshoot bare metal GPU node infrastructure, including CNI configuration, GPU Operator setup, distributed storage backends, and RDMA/InfiniBand.

  • Validation: Deploy and validate Kubernetes and vCluster to provide GPU-powered managed K8s.

  • Knowledge Transfer: Work alongside customer teams to build self-sufficiency, ensuring they can operate and grow the platform independently.

  • Scaling through Documentation: Document reusable playbooks and deployment architectures so your learnings become the next customer's head start.

  • Feedback Loop: Collaborate with Engineering and Product to surface recurring infrastructure challenges, acting as a direct feedback loop from the field into the roadmap.

  • Strategic Partnering: Join Sales in the pre-sales process where deep infrastructure work is required to achieve a meaningful proof of value.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Production K8s Mastery: 5+ years of experience deploying and operating Kubernetes in production, ideally on bare metal or in high-complexity environments.

  • GPU Fluency: Practical knowledge of NVIDIA GPU Operators, CUDA tooling, and systems-level configuration for GPU nodes.

  • Networking Fundamentals: Deep understanding of CNI plugins, overlay networks, load balancing, and connectivity diagnosis in layered environments.

  • Storage Expertise: Experience with persistent volume configuration, CSI drivers, and distributed systems like Ceph, Rook, Weka, or Longhorn.

  • Operational Agility: Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where you are often writing the playbook in real time.

  • Modern Tech Mindset: You thrive in environments that reject legacy tech and prefer a modern stack where you can solve a variety of problems from pipelines to internal services.

Bonus points for:

  • Automation Skills: Experience writing automation scripts with Bash, Python, or Go.

  • Kubernetes Depth: Relevant certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator) or experience writing Kubernetes Operators.

  • AI/ML Familiarity: Experience with inference serving, GPU scheduling, and the tooling around LLM deployment.

  • Documentation: Experience building AI Automation in documentation to contribute to a shared knowledge base.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

About Kojo

It's time to build. Whether it's creating more housing, upgrading our infrastructure, or adapting to climate change, one thing is clear: the construction industry is at the center of solving our biggest problems. We’re making buildings cheaper and easier to build by transforming the way commercial construction companies buy their materials. Join us.

Founded in 2018, Kojo is now one of the fastest-growing construction technology companies in the world. Construction accounts for $10 trillion in global spend annually and we can’t live without its output - our roads, schools, hospitals, and offices. Despite this, there’s been very little innovation over the past 70 years in how materials - which constitute up to 40% of project costs - are bought and sold. This is our opportunity.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives on solving complex problems, building high-quality software, and taking ownership from idea to production.

At Kojo, engineers don't simply implement tickets, they partner closely with Product, Design, and Customer teams to define solutions, make technical decisions, and deliver meaningful customer impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys working across the stack, embraces ambiguity, and wants to help shape both our product and our engineering culture.

What You'll Do

Build

  • Design, build, and operate reliable, scalable, and maintainable software.

  • Own features and systems from technical design through production.

  • Improve system performance, reliability, and developer experience.

  • Continuously raise the quality of our codebase through thoughtful engineering practices.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead complex technical initiatives from ambiguous problem to successful delivery.

  • Make architectural decisions by balancing short-term execution with long-term sustainability.

  • Drive technical discussions and help establish engineering best practices.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing, and technical guidance.

Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Product, Design, Customer Success, and fellow engineers to solve customer problems.

  • Contribute to engineering and product roadmap discussions.

  • Collaborate across teams as priorities evolve.

Ownership

  • Take responsibility for production systems and customer outcomes.

  • Identify opportunities to improve our systems, tooling, and engineering processes.

  • Own problems, not just tickets, and help create clarity in ambiguous situations.

What You've Accomplished

We're more interested in the impact you've had than the number of years you've worked.

We're excited to meet candidates who have:

  • Significant experience designing, building, and shipping high-quality production software.

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and an understanding of systems from application code through infrastructure.

  • Experience taking products or major features from concept to production.

  • Led technical projects involving multiple engineers and stakeholders.

  • Made architectural decisions and can clearly explain the trade-offs behind them.

  • Strong backend engineering experience, including APIs (REST and/or GraphQL), databases (PostgreSQL or similar), authentication, and distributed systems concepts.

  • Experience working across modern web technologies and willingness to contribute across the stack when needed.

  • Experience with technologies similar to ours. Our stack includes TypeScript, Node.js, React, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS, but we care far more about strong engineering fundamentals than prior experience with any specific framework.

Nice to Have

Experience with one or more of the following:

  • AWS services (EC2, RDS, S3, Lambda)

  • Docker

  • Elasticsearch

  • Observability tools such as Datadog or Sentry

What Success Looks Like

Successful Senior Software Engineers at Kojo:

  • Own problems, not just tickets.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into simple, maintainable solutions.

  • Deliver consistently while maintaining a high quality bar.

  • Know when to move quickly and when to invest in long-term engineering quality.

  • Help other engineers succeed through collaboration and mentorship.

  • Leave systems and codebases better than they found them.

  • Continuously improve how we build software, not just what we build.

What You Care About

Customer Obsession

You care deeply about solving real customer problems and delivering meaningful value.

Ownership

You take responsibility for outcomes, proactively identify opportunities for improvement, and follow through.

Craftsmanship

You value clean, maintainable software and thoughtful technical decisions.

Pragmatism

You balance speed with quality and know how to make thoughtful trade-offs.

Growth

You actively seek feedback, continuously learn, and help those around you grow.

How We Use AI

AI is part of how we build at Kojo.

Engineers are expected to thoughtfully incorporate AI tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar into their daily workflow whenever they meaningfully improve productivity and software quality.

We use AI for tasks like scaffolding, debugging, documentation, testing, and accelerating repetitive work, but AI never replaces engineering judgment.

You remain accountable for the architecture, trade-offs, correctness, security, and quality of everything that ships. AI is a force multiplier for great engineers, not a substitute for them.

4. Administration, Tracking & Reporting

  • Update call records, communication notes and intake progress in Monday.com daily.
  • Maintain accurate daily spreadsheets tracking calls, intake forms sent, follow-ups and related activity.

5. Communication & Team Support

  • Communicate questions, challenges and progress updates directly to Eliana.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Previous customer service, client support, patient services, intake or administrative experience is preferred.

Preferred Experience

Previous ABA or autism services experience is not required. Training will be provided.

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Quick-thinking, resourceful and comfortable asking questions when needed.
  • Highly organised and consistent with daily administration.

IT Manager

Position Title: IT Manager

Department: Global Resource Team

The IT Manager plays a key role in managing and advancing the organization’s technology infrastructure, systems, and security posture. This position oversees IT operations, drives the integration, evaluation and implementation of new platforms and systems, and ensures that all technology solutions align with organizational goals and compliance standards. The IT Manager also serves as the primary point of contact for cybersecurity, system performance, data storage/backup and technology risk management while providing guidance and technology support to staff across all departments.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Launch Global is both an equal opportunity employer and a Christian organization. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, age, or disability of a qualified individual in accordance with applicable federal and state law.

Pursuant to Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended (42 U.S.C. § 2000e-1(a)), Launch Global hires individuals who affirm and adhere to our Statement of Faith and agree to conduct themselves in accordance with our sincerely held religious beliefs.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Systems & Platform Management

    • Lead the evaluation, selection, and implementation of new systems, platforms, and tools to improve efficiency and scalability.
    • Own system lifecycle management; including integration, updates, vendor coordination, and documentation.
    • Partner with leadership and department heads to identify technology needs and recommend solutions aligned with organization objectives.

Cybersecurity & Risk Management

    • Develop, implement, and maintain cybersecurity policies, procedures, and best practices.
    • Monitor and respond to potential security threats, vulnerabilities, and incidents.
    • Conduct regular system audits, data protection reviews, and compliance assessments.
    • Manage backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity processes.

Website & Digital Systems Maintenance

    • Maintain and oversee organizational external website(s) as well as internal staff intranet, ensuring functionality, security, and alignment with brand and communication goals.
    • Coordinate with the Communications team to implement web updates, integrations, and performance improvements.
    • Provide internal IT oversight for externally sourced website development.
    • Monitor web hosting, analytics, and domain management.

Support & Training

    • Provide advanced technical support to staff and manage escalation of IT issues.
    • Train employees on cybersecurity awareness and efficient use of systems.
    • Champion and train on secure AI solutions for the operations team and other departments.
    • Develop and maintain IT documentation, guides, and asset inventories.

Strategic & Administrative

    • Partner with leadership on IT budgeting, procurement, and technology roadmapping.
    • Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend strategic initiatives for digital transformation.
    • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations and organizational policies.
    • Proactively identify and execute technology improvements.

General Characteristics and Skills

    • Displays a track record of achieving results by relying on God in prayer and humility exercised in bold faith.

    • Solid judgment and decision-making skills.
    • Interpersonal skills on par with the ability to meet and exceed these particular job expectations.
    • Ability to foster team development and healthy team culture.

    • Ability to assess and implement improvements.
    • Ability to think critically and resourcefully.

jobs.description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly – zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě – platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Hledáme obchodníka do terénu, který se připojí k našemu rychle rostoucímu obchodnímu týmu. Je to skvělá příležitost pro každého, kdo chce nastartovat kariéru v obchodu, rozvíjet reálné komerční dovednosti a růst v dynamicky se rozvíjející firmě.

  • Akce v terénu: Tvým úkolem je aktivně oslovovat majitele obchodů, restaurací nebo kaváren. Ukážeš jim, jak jim Teya usnadní život, a že jsme pro ně ta nejlepší volba.

  • Přímý kontakt: Osobní setkání s majiteli firem, pochopení jejich potřeb, výzev a cílů a doporučení těch správných produktů a řešení od Teyy.

  • Budování vztahů: Prodejem to u nás nekončí. S klienty zůstáváš v kontaktu, pomáháš jim s nastavením a staráš se o to, aby byli dlouhodobě spokojení.

  • Učení a aplikace: Znalost našich produktů a řešení, kterou získáš díky našemu strukturovanému tréninkovému programu.

  • Týmová podpora: Nejsi na to sám. V týmu si radíme a sdílíme tipy. Navíc se inspirujeme od kolegů z Velké Británie, Maďarska, Chorvatska nebo Islandu.

  • Zpětná vazba: Sdílení zpětné vazby z terénu, která nám pomáhá zlepšovat naše produkty a zákaznickou zkušenost.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Jazyky:Češtinu/slovenštinu (C1) a angličtinu na plynulé úrovni (B2) – budeš v kontaktu s českými klienty i kolegy ze zahraničí.

  • Drive: Zkušenost s obchodem alespoň 1 rok, práce s klienty, vedení obchodních jednání, plánování, reportování a doručování cílů.

  • Komunikace: Musíš si umět s lidmi povídat, vysvětlit jim složité věci jednoduše a umět je přesvědčit.

  • Týmový duch: I když jsi v terénu sólo, pořád jsi součástí party, která táhne za jeden provaz. Mrkni na náš Instagram @, ať vidíš, s kým do toho jdeš!

  • Odolnost: Fintech roste raketově. Musíš umět reagovat na změny a nebát se dynamického prostředí.

Co za to?💰

  • Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy – tvoje snaha se cení!

  • Flexibilita – nemáme pevnou pracovní dobu a na home office se vždy domluvíme

  • 26 dní volna + 3 sick days – protože odpočinek je základ

  • BenefitPlus karta, Stravenky a Příspěvek na Dopravu (Lítačka) – vše, co potřebuješ pro pohodlný pracovní život, od Multisportky přes obědy až pocestování po městě.

  • Péče o duševní zdraví s Hedepy – abychom ti pomohli udržet si psychickou pohodu a balanc.

  • Pravidelné týmové meetingy a školení – dny plné inspirace, sdílení zkušeností, skvělé atmosféry i příběhů našich zákazníků

Chceš do toho jít?

Celý proces se snažíme držet svižný a přátelský – stejně jako naše kultura. Žádná zbytečná kola navíc, ale férový a otevřený přístup.

💥 Přihlas se hned teď a do pár dnů se ti ozveme! 🚀

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services, APIs and workflows for the AI Neobank app.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, wallet, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Design reliable systems for user accounts, transactions, partner integrations, reconciliation, notifications and operations.

  • Work with product and mobile teams to ship customer-facing journeys quickly.

  • Integrate with banks, payment gateways, insurers, data providers and other partners.

  • Improve system reliability, observability, security and performance.

  • Build systems that are practical, auditable and ready for regulated financial products.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience.

  • Strong fundamentals in APIs, databases, system design and production debugging.

  • Experience building scalable services and integrating third-party systems.

  • Good understanding of security, reliability, data quality and operational edge cases.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, quality and risk.

  • Comfortable working with product, mobile, operations and business teams.

  • Experience in fintech, payments, insurance, lending, banking or regulated products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Builds systems that work in the real world, not just on diagrams.

  • Thinks through edge cases, failure modes and operational impact.

  • Can move fast without creating fragile foundations.

  • Takes ownership of production issues and long-term reliability.

  • Explains clearly what they personally built versus what the team delivered.

This Role Is Not For

Location

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Head of Change Management – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Change Management is responsible for developing, leading, and implementing the organization's change management framework to support business transformation, organizational development, digital adoption, and operational improvement initiatives.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role manages organizational change activities associated with technology implementation, business process redesign, operating model changes, regulatory initiatives, restructuring, and cultural transformation.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to assess organizational impacts, improve change readiness, manage resistance, and ensure employees successfully adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement the organization's change management strategy, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate transformation objectives into structured change management plans and implementation roadmaps.
  • Establish change management standards, governance structures, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Assess organizational readiness and identify potential challenges associated with planned changes.
  • Align change management activities with corporate strategy and transformation priorities.

B. Organizational Change & Transformation

  • Lead change initiatives involving organizational restructuring, operating model redesign, business process improvement, and operational transformation.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify effects on employees, departments, workflows, and systems.
  • Develop implementation plans to support smooth transitions across business functions.
  • Coordinate change activities across multiple projects and transformation programmes.
  • Ensure new organizational structures, processes, and procedures are effectively adopted.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop appropriate engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners.
  • Develop and deliver change communication plans, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Address employee concerns, manage resistance, and build commitment to transformation initiatives.
  • Establish feedback channels to monitor stakeholder sentiment and change effectiveness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Adoption

  • Lead change management activities related to digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to assess the organizational impact of technology changes.
  • Develop employee training, awareness, and user adoption programmes.
  • Monitor system adoption and ensure successful transition to new digital working practices.

E. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Partner with HR to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to improve organizational culture, employee engagement, and leadership alignment.
  • Identify employee capability gaps and coordinate training and development activities.
  • Support managers in leading teams through organizational transitions.
  • Promote adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Monitor change readiness, employee adoption, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Ensure change initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Performance Monitoring & Benefits Realization

  • Establish change management KPIs, adoption metrics, and performance dashboards.
  • Track employee engagement, training completion, stakeholder readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Monitor whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for senior management and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational development, business transformation, or programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or organizational transformation leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide or business-unit change initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of change management frameworks, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and organizational readiness.
  • Experience supporting digital transformation, technology adoption, business process redesign, and organizational restructuring.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of the organization's change management strategy.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Effectiveness of stakeholder communication and engagement.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and management feedback.
  • Compliance with change management governance and reporting standards.

Job purpose

The Product & Client Insights Manager leads BELAY's client insights, market research, and product and service innovation initiatives across Assistant and Financial Solutions. This role is responsible for developing actionable insights that inform client retention strategies, enhance the client experience, and identify opportunities for new or improved service offerings, including AI-enabled solutions.

This is a data-driven role built for action. This person connects quantitative performance data with qualitative client feedback to find out why clients stay, why they leave, and where our offerings should improve or expand. That includes tracking how AI is changing what clients expect and what competitors are delivering. Every recommendation must rest on measurable findings, not assumptions or anecdotes. This person then sees each one through: building the business case, getting approval, and leading implementation with Client Success, Delivery, Operations, Finance, Sales, and Marketing until the change is live and its impact is measured.

This role sits in Operations because insight only matters when it changes how we deliver. Success is measured by results, not reports: measurable gains in retention, client-health insights that leaders trust and act on, improvements that launch and get adopted, and new-solution pilots, including AI-enabled ones, that prove or disprove their value with data.

Essential Functions

As a BELAY Corporate Team member, you will professionally represent the company in all virtual and in-person interactions. You are expected to exemplify our mission, vision, and core values while fostering a collaborative and positive team environment.

Voice of the Client & Insights

  • Build and run BELAY’s Voice of the Client program (interviews, focus groups, surveys, and feedback loops) across Assistant and Financial Solutions, giving leadership a direct, recurring view of what clients value, where they struggle, and why they stay or leave.
  • Own the development, accuracy, and ongoing analysis of enterprise client insights, retention reporting, and client health metrics by integrating quantitative data and qualitative feedback from Salesforce, Gong, client surveys, billing, utilization, and churn metrics.
  • Use quantitative analysis, backed by client feedback, to identify trends, root causes, and emerging risks.
  • Own the insight and retention dashboard and present it in the Monthly Operating Review, showing trends, actions taken, and measurable outcomes.
  • Turn findings into prioritized, evidence-based recommendations with expected impact and success criteria, and bring leadership the decisions that need their approval.

Client Experience & Retention Strategy

  • Become BELAY's subject-matter expert on every service we deliver, across Assistant and Financial Solutions, inclusive of all products and services offered by BELAY and BELAY Financial.
  • Lead the development and execution of client retention strategies in partnership with cross-functional leaders, with accountability for measuring and improving retention outcomes.
  • Protect retention of our client base by utilizing cohort and churn analysis to identify root causes of attrition, and execute and implement corrective actions to measurably improve retention.
  • Partner with relevant teams to develop and implement client and talent onboarding enhancements that support new product launches and address identified service gaps.
  • Drive adoption of changes with Client Success, Delivery, and Operations leaders, and report back on whether each change actually moved retention.

Market Research & Competitive Intelligence

  • Track competitors, adjacent providers, and the online communities where our clients gather, including what they offer, how they price, and where they fall short.
  • Identify emerging market trends, unmet client needs, and white space where BELAY can lead.
  • Bring leadership early warning on industry shifts, including AI, with a plan to respond before they become urgent.

Product & Service R&D

  • Turn client insights and market trends into new solution concepts, enhancements, and packaging ideas.
  • Build business cases, run pilots with defined success metrics, and take only data-proven concepts from test to launch.
  • Partner with Finance, Sales, and Marketing on pricing, positioning, and go-to-market for new offerings.

AI Strategy & Service Protection

  • Maintain deep, hands-on knowledge of AI tools in the market, especially tools that automate or compete with Executive Assistant work.
  • Test AI tools continuously against BELAY's services. Know what they can do, what they can't, and where they threaten our model.
  • Serve as the internal advisor on AI risk to the EA business, and bring leadership early warnings with a plan to respond.
  • Partner with BELAY’s AI Automation Engineer & Enablement Lead and pilot AI + human service models where AI makes our Assistants faster and more valuable, so the human relationship stays the core of what clients buy.
  • Train internal teams to use the AI capabilities in Gong, Outreach, and other client and sales systems to extract insights, spot trends, and turn findings into action.

Minimum Qualifications

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience.

About Americans United

Americans United for Separation of Church and State is a nonpartisan educational and advocacy organization dedicated to advancing the constitutional principle of church-state separation as the only way to ensure freedom of religion, including the right to believe or not believe, for all of us. Founded in 1947, Americans United is a diverse and dynamic organization composed of people from all walks of life: lawyers and lobbyists, students and activists, religious leaders and impassioned Americans. AU includes people of faith and people who don’t profess any particular faith. It is a community that welcomes people of all genders, races, ethnicities, religions or beliefs, sexual orientations, ages, socioeconomic backgrounds, and abilities. Because we work on a wide variety of issues with many different communities, we value what diversity and diverse perspectives bring to our work. 

Position Summary

Americans United for Separation of Church and State (AU) seeks a Development Intern to assist the Development Department in its national fundraising efforts. The Development Intern will report to the Sr. Manager of Prospect Research and work primarily to support the organization’s development department.

Interns have the opportunity to meet and learn from staff across the Development Department and organization, including communications, policy, and legal departments. All interns also have the opportunity to be published on AU’s Wall of Separation blog.

The Development Intern will be responsible for a variety of tasks in support of the department, including but not limited to:

  • Updating AU’s database as needed
  • Ensure contact information and other critical donor data is entered in donor’s database record in a timely manner and adheres to consistent formatting and entry standards
  • Review responses to “month in review", facilitate follow-up as needed
  • Assist with screening new donors and other sources
  • Oversee Call Time process: send reminders, create bios for GO’s and/or repeat donors.
  • Prepare brief event bios, if needed
  • Once established, assist with prospect research metrics measuring the scope efficiency, and impact of prospect research efforts.
  • Assisting with grants management, including tracking, deadlines, and data organization
  • Assisting with reporting and proposal preparation
  • Conducting foundation research (Google search, Wealth Engine, Foundation Directory Online, and EveryAction, etc.)
  • Assisting with meeting preparation and events as needed
  • Drafting letters and emails
  • Assisting other department tasks as needed

The strongest candidates will be able to demonstrate a commitment to the separation of religion and government, be responsible and hard-working on a remote and virtual environment, and be excited to work with diverse staff and supporters, and have some or all of these skills:

  • Writing concisely and persuasively
  • Meeting deadlines and communicating about progress
  • Organized and eager to learn new skills
    Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Microsoft Excel, and Google Drive

Americans United is an equal-opportunity employer and places strong emphasis on a diverse environment in which individuals are valued regardless of their gender, race, ethnicity, cultural background, religion, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

Time Commitment

The internship is 25 hours/week from January 11, 2027 - April 30, 2027 (with some flexibility to accommodate the intern’s academic or other scheduling needs). The organization will also consider candidates for the remaining academic year. Interns will attend weekly all-staff meetings, team meetings and 1:1 meetings with their supervisor.

How to Apply

Submit as attached Word documents or PDFs:

  • A resume (one page) outlining your relevant academic, campus, and professional experience
  • A cover letter (one page) describing how your experience relates to the Development Internship and explaining why AU’s mission is important to you

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis with priority given to applications received by November 30, 2026. Interviews will begin being scheduled December 7, 2026, and hiring decisions made by December 18, 2026. No calls, please.

Benefits

The Development Intern will be paid a stipend of $7,360. Interns receive substantive experience with in-depth exposure to some of the most important issues facing the country. Interns are encouraged and provided time to learn across the organization.

AU can provide documentation for academic credit upon successful conclusion of the internship.

Salary: Stipend: $7,360

This opportunity is with a growing, science-led consumer products company focused on high-performance formulations, product quality, and innovation. This position is not an internal role with A La Carte Solutions.

The organization is expanding its technical capabilities, developing new technologies and products, and strengthening its network of external research and manufacturing partners.

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Director, Technical Development & Innovation to lead the technical development of new products, formulations, and technologies.

Reporting to the VP, Product Development & Manufacturing, this individual will translate approved product and commercial requirements into technically sound, scalable, and production-ready solutions.

This is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone with strong technical expertise, practical manufacturing experience, and the ability to collaborate with external research laboratories, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

The Director will oversee technical development from innovation through feasibility, including formulation, product science, testing and validation, claims substantiation, regulatory readiness, and quality.

A major focus will be advancing early-stage formulas into robust products ready for test-market evaluation and manufacturing scale-up, while also supporting improvements to existing products and potential expansion into new categories.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Development & Product Innovation

  • Lead technical development of new products, product improvements, and formulation changes.
  • Translate product requirements into formulations, specifications, performance targets, and development plans.
  • Oversee formulation development, refinement, and optimization.
  • Advance early-stage formulas into technically feasible, scalable products.
  • Oversee bench and pilot development activities in partnership with external laboratories and engineering teams.
  • Evaluate technical alternatives based on performance, quality, cost, manufacturability, scalability, and risk.
  • Establish technical readiness criteria before products advance toward commercialization.

New Technology & Manufacturing

  • Lead development and validation of new formulations and technologies.
  • Partner with the Process Engineering Manager on pilot-scale development and manufacturing readiness.
  • Evaluate new materials, equipment, processes, and external technical capabilities.
  • Provide technical specifications and documentation needed for successful manufacturing transfers.
  • Identify and resolve formulation, material, and manufacturing challenges.

Product Testing, Validation & Quality

  • Develop and oversee product testing and validation strategies.
  • Lead claims substantiation and support regulatory readiness.
  • Establish product-performance benchmarks and testing standards.
  • Hire and manage the Quality Assurance Manager and oversee the Product Testing & Validation Manager.
  • Lead the development of a quality management system (QMS).
  • Ensure product specifications, quality controls, and regulatory considerations are incorporated throughout development.
  • Support root-cause analysis, corrective actions, and technical risk management.

External Partnerships & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with external R&D partners, testing laboratories, suppliers, and co-manufacturers.
  • Evaluate supplier and manufacturing capabilities.
  • Support domestic and international sourcing initiatives.
  • Collaborate with Product Development, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain, Finance, and other business functions.
  • Provide technical recommendations to leadership and support product commercialization decisions.

Team Leadership & Strategic Execution

  • Build and develop technical capabilities, processes, and teams.
  • Manage technical development, testing, and external-resource budgets.
  • Establish clear technical documentation and development standards.
  • Prioritize multiple development initiatives while maintaining quality and efficiency.
  • Communicate technical findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership.

Position Details

  • Job Title: Director, Technical Development & Innovation
  • Location: Fully Remote, with regular travel to laboratories and manufacturing partners
  • Compensation: $150,000–$165,000 annually, plus bonus potential
  • FLSA Classification: Exempt
  • Reports To: VP, Product Development & Manufacturing

This opportunity is ideal for a technically strong, hands-on leader who enjoys building capabilities, solving complex formulation challenges, and turning innovative concepts into commercially viable products.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in product development, research and development (R&D), engineering, technical operations, or related technical roles within consumer packaged goods (CPG) or manufacturing.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, functions, or complex product development programs.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of formulation-driven product development, manufacturing processes, and scale-up.
  • Experience refining early-stage formulations into robust products, including work with binder systems, durability, friability, powders, minerals, or granulated materials.
  • Proven experience taking products from initial concept or bench development through pilot testing, manufacturing validation, and commercial production.
  • Experience working with external R&D partners, equipment manufacturer laboratories, testing facilities, and contract manufacturers.
  • Experience collaborating directly with co-manufacturers, toll manufacturers, suppliers, and external manufacturing partners.
  • Strong ability to evaluate technical feasibility, product performance, manufacturing capabilities, cost, and risk.
  • Experience with product testing, validation, quality management systems, claims substantiation, or regulatory requirements.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex technical projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Food Science, Process Engineering, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in pet products, consumer packaged goods, food, wellness, household products, consumables, or other formulation-driven industries.
  • Experience working in both established manufacturing environments and smaller, high-growth organizations.
  • Experience building technical processes, systems, and organizational capabilities.
  • Familiarity with global suppliers, international sourcing, and external manufacturing networks.
  • Technical experience with process engineering, agglomeration, coatings, minerals, powders, or tableting.
  • Experience developing products distributed through major retail channels.

Ideal Candidate

The successful candidate will be a technically credible, strategic, and hands-on leader who can:

  • Make informed technical decisions and solve complex formulation challenges.
  • Balance innovation with practical manufacturing requirements.
  • Build processes and capabilities in a growing organization.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Collaborate effectively across departments while maintaining ownership of technical outcomes.
  • Adapt to changing priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrate accountability, sound judgment, curiosity, and a continuous improvement mindset.

jobs.description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

The Account Executive, Commerce Growth owns a new-business revenue number across Darkroom's commerce practice: Amazon (marketplace management and retail media), TikTok Shop and social commerce, Retention Marketing (email, SMS, lifecycle), and Digital Products (GEO / AI-search, SEO, CRO, web builds, and web support).

You lead with the marketplaces. Amazon and TikTok Shop are where your hunt starts - these are a couple of the highest-intent entry points in the market right now, and the fastest route into a brand's commerce P&L. Retention and Digital Products are how you widen the deal: once you are inside a brand's commerce operation, you are the person who sees that their email program is flat, their PDPs do not convert, and they are invisible in AI search - and who scopes and closes that work too.

You are a commercial, closer-minded operator who builds a book through partnerships, industry events, and targeted outreach - and who also fields and closes the inbound that arrives in your practice. You will become the person the market associates with Darkroom's commerce offering: at the conferences, in the platform partner ecosystems, and in the rooms where these deals get done.

You will also own the upsell and cross-sell motion for your departments - working the existing client base alongside our Managing Directors and Will Margaritis (SVP, Strategy) to identify and close expansion into your services.

This is a high-accountability role with clear revenue KPIs and uncapped commission that rewards self-sourced pipeline. If you want to own the commerce practice, build a durable network, and close tech-enabled marketing services you believe in, this is the role for you.

Location: NYC strongly preferred.

Your Practice

You own new business and expansion across four service clusters. The first two lead; the second two attach.

Lead with:

  • Amazon - marketplace strategy and management, catalog and content, Amazon Ads / retail media, and DSP.

  • TikTok Shop & Social Commerce - shop setup and operations, affiliate and creator-led selling, live and Spark Ads-driven commerce, and the adjacent social marketplaces as they mature.

Attach and expand into:

  • Retention Marketing - email, SMS, and lifecycle (Klaviyo and the broader retention stack).

  • Digital Products - GEO / AI-search optimization, SEO, conversion-rate optimization, web builds, and ongoing web support.

You will build deep fluency in all four, the platforms behind them, and the buyer in each - so that when a brand says "we're getting killed on Amazon," "we need to stand up TikTok Shop before Q4," or "our email program is flat," you are already scoping the deal. You will also carry the Shadow story into these conversations, since our AI commerce layer is a material part of why brands choose us over a category specialist.

What You'll Do

Primary - Source and close new business, marketplace-first

  • Own a quarterly new-business number across the commerce practice, led by Amazon and TikTok Shop.

  • Build and work a partner ecosystem as a durable referral engine - Amazon and TikTok Shop partner networks, Shopify Plus, aggregators and brand holdcos, 3PLs and logistics partners, marketplace tooling, plus Klaviyo, retention and CRO tech, and AI-search / SEO platforms for your attach services.

  • Represent Darkroom at industry events and conferences in your practice (Amazon Accelerate, Prosper Show, unBoxed, TikTok Shop and creator-commerce summits, Shoptalk, eTail, K:BOS, BrightonSEO / MozCon, MAICON and emerging GEO/AEO events), and build the local/in-market relationships that surface deals.

  • Develop and pursue a named target ("whale") list of brands that fit the commerce practice, alongside a category focus defined during your first 30 days (subscription, fashion, beauty, CPG, etc.).

  • Field and close inbound that arrives in your practice.

  • Run a deliberate attach motion on every new deal: land the marketplace engagement, then scope retention and digital products into the same relationship rather than leaving it for later.

  • Lead the full commercial process: scoping, pricing, proposal, and close.

  • Work with our marketing team to understand inbound strategy across content creators, SEO, and other deal sources.

Primary - Own the upsell & cross-sell motion

  • Run a standing weekly expansion meeting with the Managing Directors of your departments and Will Margaritis (SVP, Strategy), where you work the client base for upsell and cross-sell opportunities and drive the flagged deals to close.

  • The MDs surface the opportunity from delivery insight; Will clears account health and capacity; you own the commercial motion and the close.

  • Proactively identify expansion through client conversations, performance data, and account signals - you are the person the account team calls when an opportunity emerges.

Secondary - Practice fluency and onboarding

  • Maintain deep, current command of Darkroom's commerce service catalog - marketplaces, social commerce, retention, and digital - and the platforms behind it.

  • Be present on onboarding calls for new clients in your practice to establish the expansion relationship from day one.

  • Maintain clean pipeline documentation in HubSpot and Notion (Sourced By, Closed By, Origination, deal stages) - comp is calculated off these fields.

What You Will Not Do

  • High-volume cold prospecting for net-new logos outside your practice - that is the outbound BDR's function. You source through partnerships, events, and targeted relationships.

  • Deliver QBRs.

  • Execute campaign changes, marketplace operations, or optimizations - that is the account team's responsibility.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 5+ years in a full-cycle Account Executive or equivalent sales role with a documented closing track record. Agency, MarTech, marketplace/commerce, or SaaS experience strongly preferred.

  • Commerce credibility. You can hold your own with an Amazon or e-commerce lead - unit economics, retail media, marketplace mechanics, TikTok Shop and creator-led selling - and you can speak fluently enough about retention/lifecycle, SEO and the shift to AI-search / GEO, CRO, and web builds to earn a technical buyer's trust.

  • Closer DNA. You have carried a quota and closed new-business and expansion deals. You are energized by revenue outcomes, and you source your own pipeline rather than waiting for leads.

  • Multi-service instinct. You do not sell one line item. You see the whole commerce operation and build the deal accordingly.

  • Network-builder. You know how to turn platform partners and conferences into a durable pipeline, not one-off business cards.

  • Commercially instinctive. When you hear "we're launching on TikTok Shop next quarter" or "we're rebuilding our site next year," you are already scoping the deal.

  • Self-directed operator. Highly organized, proactive, fast-moving. You do not need to be managed into motion.

  • Tool-proficient. HubSpot (or equivalent CRM), Notion, Google Workspace, Slack; comfortable reading performance data and dashboards, including marketplace and ads reporting.

  • Polished communicator. Fluent English, strong video presence, comfortable presenting to founders, CMOs, and heads of e-commerce at growth-stage brands.

How You'll Be Measured

  • Quarterly new-business quota attainment (new MRR + variable, per the Sales Quota & Commission Plan).

  • Marketplace-led new business closed (Amazon, TikTok Shop).

  • Attach rate - share of new commerce deals that land with more than one service.

  • Upsell and cross-sell revenue closed.

  • Self-sourced pipeline generated (partnerships, events, outbound relationships).

  • Inbound deals closed in your practice.

  • Pipeline hygiene in HubSpot.

What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership - but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape - just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

  • Unlimited PTO + US holidays: Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.

  • Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

  • Health & Wellness: Company-sponsored medical, dental, and vision coverage.

  • Finances, growth, and retirement: Darkroom offers a robust 401(k) program with company match and profit-sharing opportunities to help you save and grow as the company grows.

  • Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.

  • Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

  • Compensation Structure: The base salary range for this role is $90,000-$100,000 per year, plus uncapped commission on new-business, upsell, cross-sell, and inbound revenue, with accelerators that reward self-sourced pipeline (partnerships, events, and outbound relationships pay a higher origination bracket than inbound). Full mechanics shared during the interview process.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace-we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

jobs.description:
About WRS Health

WRS Health builds an Electronic Health Records (EHR) system that medical practices rely on every day to care for patients. Our platform runs on Linux servers in AWS with a PHP application stack, and it holds some of the most sensitive data there is: protected health information.
We are now investing heavily in AI agents that work alongside clinicians and staff. That shift opens new ground for our product and new attack surfaces for our security program. We are hiring a Security Engineer to help us protect both.

The role

As our Security Engineer, you will find and fix security risks before attackers do, across our AWS infrastructure, our PHP application, and our growing fleet of AI agents. You will look ahead to emerging threats, especially those unique to LLMs and autonomous agents, and build defenses before they are needed.
This is a hands-on, collaborative role. You will work directly with our development and AI teams, helping them understand issues, prioritize fixes, and ship secure code. We want someone who teaches and enables, not someone who only files tickets.

What you'll do

Application security
  • Review PHP code and architecture for vulnerabilities such as injection, broken authentication, insecure deserialization, and access-control flaws.
  • Run and tune SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning (e.g., Composer packages) in our CI/CD pipelines.
  • Lead threat modeling for new features and work with developers to fix findings, with clear guidance and secure code examples.
Cloud and infrastructure security
  • Harden our AWS environment: IAM least privilege, network segmentation, encryption at rest and in transit, and secrets management.
  • Monitor and respond to findings from tools such as GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, and AWS Config.
  • Secure and patch Linux servers, and define hardened baselines for new infrastructure.
AI and agent security
  • Assess AI agents for risks such as prompt injection, data leakage, excessive permissions, insecure tool use, and model supply-chain issues.
  • Define guardrails for what agents can access and do, especially where PHI is involved, including logging, human-in-the-loop controls, and output validation.
  • Partner with the AI team to build security into agent design from the start, using frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
Threat management and response
  • Track emerging threats to healthcare, cloud, and AI systems, and turn that intelligence into concrete defenses.
  • Coordinate penetration tests and vulnerability management, from discovery through verified fix.
  • Help build and run our incident response plan, including tabletop exercises.
Compliance and culture
  • Support HIPAA and HITECH compliance.
  • Run secure-coding training and build security awareness across engineering.

Qualifications

  • 4+ years in security engineering, application security, or a closely related role.
  • Hands-on experience securing AWS environments, including IAM, VPC design, KMS, and AWS security services.
  • Strong Linux administration and hardening skills.
  • Experience with vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and driving findings to resolution.
  • Working knowledge of LLM and AI agent risks, such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, and over-permissioned agents.
  • Scripting or automation skills in Python, Bash, or similar.
  • Clear communication, and the ability to explain risk to developers and leadership in practical terms.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA or other regulated-data environments.

Nice to have

  • Experience in healthcare IT or with EHR systems and standards such as HL7 or FHIR.
  • Prior work securing AI agents, RAG pipelines, or LLM integrations in production.
  • Infrastructure-as-code security (Terraform or CloudFormation) and container security.

What success looks like in your first year

  1. First 90 days: You have assessed our AWS, Linux, and PHP environments and our AI agent designs, and you have a prioritized risk roadmap.
  2. By six months: Automated security scanning runs in every pipeline, and developers fix critical findings quickly with your guidance.
  3. By one year: Every new AI agent passes a security review before launch, our incident response plan has been tested, and security is part of how engineering works day to day.

Details and how to apply

  • Location: Remote
  • Employment type: Full-time - Independent Contractor
  • Reports to: CTO
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
