About the Team

AI is reshaping cybersecurity on both sides. Attackers can use AI to strike at machine speed, and only AI-powered defense can keep up. At the same time, organizations can only adopt AI with confidence if it is secure. Rapid7 sits at the intersection of security and AI, and we are building industry-defining products for this new era.


Rapid7's AI Engineering team builds the AI that powers our security platform. We are AI engineers and applied scientists who take models from research to production, combining open-source and frontier LLMs, AI agents, and fast predictive models with more than 20 years of Rapid7 security expertise. Our work drives core use cases across Detection and Response, such as alert triage, threat investigation, and automated response, and Exposure and Remediation, such as vulnerability prioritization, attack surface risk assessment, and guided remediation. Together, these help customers stop threats faster and fix what matters most.


About the Role

As a Senior Principal AI Engineer, you will set the technical direction for how Rapid7 builds, tunes and serves LLMs and agentic systems across its security products. You understand LLMs from the ground up, from transformer internals and training to fine-tuning and inference optimization, and you stay hands-on with the hardest problems. You know where LLMs shine and where they fall short, and you treat them as one tool in the AI toolbox, alongside predictive AI and classical ML, choosing the right approach for each problem. Specifically your focus will be to:

  • Set the AI technical vision, architecture and multi-year roadmap for LLM and agentic systems across Detection and Response and Exposure and Remediation
  • Define company-wide model strategy, including when to use frontier or open-source models, when to fine-tune, distill or post-train, and where to invest in new capabilities
  • Lead the most complex and highest-risk technical initiatives across multiple teams, including fine-tuning, distillation and post-training of open-source LLMs on security data
  • Establish company-wide standards for context engineering, inference optimization and evaluation, with evals as the release gate for every AI system we ship
  • Lead optimization of LLM inference at scale, balancing quality, latency and cost
  • Lead design reviews, resolve the most complex technical trade-offs, and stay hands-on by prototyping and building critical model, training and inference code
  • Mentor and develop Principal, Staff and Senior engineers, building the depth of AI engineering talent across Rapid7
  • Represent Rapid7’s AI engineering to executives, customers and the external community, influencing product, platform and business strategy

The skills and qualities you’ll bring include:

  • 14+ years of software or ML engineering experience, including 2+ years building production LLM or agentic AI systems. A PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, AI or a related field is preferred, or equivalent depth of expertise demonstrated through industry experience and technical contributions
  • A track record of building scalable, production-grade AI systems and shared platforms adopted across multiple products, with company-wide impact through technical leadership, mentoring and standards
  • Leading-edge expertise in LLMs, including transformer architecture, attention, tokenization and positional encodings, and how models are trained and served, with advanced PyTorch skills spanning custom model code, mixed precision and distributed training (e.g., FSDP, DeepSpeed)
  • Hands-on fine-tuning and post-training of open-weight LLMs, including full and parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA), distillation, and preference or RL-based methods (e.g., DPO, GRPO), ideally including experience training LLMs from scratch
  • Deep experience with context engineering (retrieval, memory, and context management for long-running agent workflows) and with defining evaluation strategy and benchmarks for LLM and agent systems
  • Deep knowledge of inference optimization, including prefill and decode, KV-cache management, continuous batching, speculative decoding and quantization, and serving at scale with vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM, ideally on AWS and including GPU kernel work (CUDA or Triton)
  • Strong predictive AI, classical ML, distributed systems and Python fundamentals, with the judgment to make efficient, transparent decisions between these approaches and LLMs based on accuracy, latency and cost
  • Takes accountability for organisation-wide technical outcomes, proactively addressing systemic risks and removing barriers to delivery while ensuring technical decisions align with strategic priorities
  • An influential communicator who can articulate complex architectural trade-offs, build consensus and influence technical and product decisions across the organisation
  • Builds alignment across Engineering, Product and other functions on technical direction, driving decisions that shape product and platform investments.
  • Anticipates evolving customer needs and shapes AI architecture and technical strategy to maximise customer value, making informed trade-offs between capability, performance, cost and scalability to guide product and platform investment
  • Thrive in ambiguity at the leading edge of AI, driving change and focusing forward as the technology and the threat landscape evolve
  • Recognition as an expert in AI, evidenced by publications, patents, open-source contributions or industry engagement
  • Embody our core values to foster a culture of excellence that drives meaningful impact and collective success.

We know that the best ideas and solutions come from multi-dimensional teams. That’s because these teams reflect a variety of backgrounds and professional experiences. If you are excited about this role and feel your experience can make an impact, please don’t be shy - apply today.


About Rapid7

At Rapid7, our vision is to create a secure digital world for our customers, our industry, and our communities. We do this by harnessing our collective expertise and passion to challenge what’s possible and drive extraordinary impact. We’re building a dynamic and collaborative workplace where new ideas are welcome.


Protecting 11,500+ customers against bad actors and threats means we’re continuing to push the envelope just like we’ ve been doing for the past 20 years. If you ’re ready to solve some of the toughest challenges in cybersecurity, we’re ready to help you take command of your career. Join us.

Performance Marketing Manager

Department: Growth / Marketing
Location: Remote
Employment Type: Independent Contractor

About ImagineArt

We’re redefining how the world creates and designs.

ImagineArt is one of the fastest-growing GenAI companies in the world. We’ve scaled faster than most funded startups, with zero outside funding.

  • $35M+ ARR crossed this year

  • 100M+ social impressions

  • Built and shipped our own image generation model, now ranked #3 globally for photo realism

No funding. No shortcuts. Just a sharp, driven team building one of the strongest GenAI products in the world, and we’re just getting started.

We’re now looking for a senior paid acquisition expert to scale how we acquire paying users on the web.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Paid Acquisition Lead to own and scale paid customer acquisition for ImagineArt’s web product.

Meta is our main channel. You’ll plan, launch, test, and scale campaigns that bring in paying subscribers at a profitable cost. You’ll work closely with our creative, product, and growth teams to turn ad spend into predictable revenue.

This is a high-ownership, hands-on role. You will run the accounts yourself, not just manage an agency.

What You’ll Do

Own Paid Acquisition on Meta

  • Plan, build, launch, and manage Meta campaigns (Facebook & Instagram) for web signups and paid subscriptions

  • Scale spend while keeping CAC, ROAS, and payback within target

  • Structure accounts for fast testing and stable scaling

Creative Testing

  • Run a constant creative testing system covering hooks, formats, angles, UGC, and AI-generated ads

  • Work with the creative team to brief, test, and iterate on ads every week

  • Find winning concepts and scale them fast

Tracking & Measurement

  • Set up and maintain web tracking: Meta Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), UTMs, and attribution

  • Make sure conversion data is clean and trusted

  • Track the full funnel: click → signup → trial → paid → retention

Funnel & Landing Page Optimization

  • Work with product and design to improve landing pages and the web signup and checkout flow

  • Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates

  • Spot drop-off points and fix them

Expand to Other Channels

  • Test and scale Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Performance Max) and other channels like TikTok, Reddit, or X

  • Decide where budget should go based on data

Reporting

  • Share clear weekly reports on spend, CAC, ROAS, LTV, and payback

  • Bring insights back to leadership on pricing, offers, and positioning

What We’re Looking For

We don’t expect candidates to check every box. We care most about ownership, results, and the ability to learn fast.

Must-Haves

  • 4–10 years of hands-on paid acquisition experience

  • Deep Meta Ads experience, with a track record of scaling spend profitably

  • Experience with web-based SaaS subscription products (not mobile app installs)

  • Experience in GenAI SaaS or a close category (AI tools, creative tools, design or video software, consumer SaaS)

  • Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, LTV, payback period, and cohort analysis

  • Hands-on experience with Meta Pixel, CAPI, and web attribution

  • Strong creative testing skills and a good eye for ads that convert

  • Able to work independently and deliver results with little supervision

Nice to Have

  • Google Ads experience (Search, YouTube, Performance Max)

  • Experience with TikTok, Reddit, X, or other paid channels

  • Experience managing large monthly ad budgets

  • Experience with analytics tools such as GA4, Mixpanel, Amplitude, or Triple Whale

  • Experience using AI tools to make or test ad creatives

  • Experience at a fast-growing startup

Why This Role Matters

  • You’ll directly drive ImagineArt’s revenue growth

  • You’ll work directly with founders and company leadership

  • You’ll have real budget and real ownership

  • Your results will be visible across the whole company

  • You’ll help scale one of the fastest-growing GenAI products in the world

Engagement Details

  • Independent contractor engagement

  • Fully remote

  • Competitive contract rate

  • Performance-based incentives

  • Direct access to leadership

Company Culture

Impact: Work on cutting-edge AI products that are shaping the future of creativity, design, and content generation.

Team: Join a fast-moving, highly ambitious team that values speed, ownership, innovation, and execution.

Growth: Be part of a culture where learning, testing, and continuous improvement happen every day.

If you’re excited about AI, paid growth, and scaling a product used by millions, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Gynecologist - IMLC License | Flexible 1099 Remote
jobs.excerpt: Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage.
jobs.description:
Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

We're hiring board-certified Gynecologists who want to focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care to women who have historically been underserved. Applicants must hold an active IMLC (Interstate Medical Licensure Compact) license or be actively in the process of obtaining one. To learn more about our mission and clinical approach, visit .

Location: Fully remote within the U.S.

Your Impact

  • Conduct thorough patient assessments and develop personalized treatment plans via video visits

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary care team to deliver the highest standards of care

  • Complete required training(s) and uphold Allara's clinical policies, standards, and best practices

  • Educate patients on preventative care and wellness using evidence-based strategies

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date patient records and complete charting in a timely manner

  • Respond to patient questions and administrative messages and tasks with clarity and care

  • Dedicate a minimum of 10-20 patient-facing hours per week, depending on hiring needs, including consultations and medical guidance, with prescribing when clinically appropriate

Required Qualifications

  • Degree: MD or DO from an accredited institution

  • Board Certification: Active national board certification in Gynecology

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of consecutive clinical experience as a Gynecologist, with a focus on chronic and complex women's health conditions including PCOS, Endometriosis, Hypothyroidism, Hashimoto's, Metabolic Syndrome, Menopause, Fertility, Postpartum, PMDD, and Obesity

  • IMLC license: Active IMLC license or be actively in the process of obtaining one

  • Clinical Independence: Proven ability to function as an autonomous provider with strong diagnostic judgment and critical thinking skills

  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication, with an emphasis on compassion and clarity

  • Webside Manner: A natural ability to build trust and connection with patients in a virtual setting

  • Evidence-Based Practice: A genuine commitment to delivering care rooted in current clinical research

  • Technical Proficiency: Comfortable working across multiple platforms including EMR systems, text expanders, Gmail, Google Calendar, Zoom, and scheduling tools

  • Telemedicine Experience: Prior telehealth experience is a plus

  • State License Requirements & Hiring Considerations: An active, unrestricted, and unencumbered professional license in at least one U.S. state is required.

IMLC License Requirement & Participating States

An active IMLC license - or active pursuit of one - is required for this role. The IMLC speeds up and simplifies the process of obtaining a medical license in additional states, creating an expedited licensure pathway to multi-state licensing.

To view a map of all current participating states, licensing costs by state, and the IMLC application, please visit the IMLC website.

A note on state licensing: All active and pending licenses held at the time of application are collected and reviewed during our process. Hiring decisions reflect current state-level needs, which evolve over time. Applicants may not move forward immediately if there is no active need in their licensed states. We regularly revisit candidates as needs expand and when experience, licensure, and role requirements align.

What Allara Offers

  • 1099 Contract: The flexibility and autonomy of an independent contractor arrangement

  • 1099 Longevity Recognition Bonus

  • Competitive Compensation: Per-visit rates plus additional pay for charting, administrative tasks, and other patient-related work

  • Fully Remote: Work from anywhere in the U.S.

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set hours that fit your life, not the other way around

  • Malpractice Insurance: Comprehensive coverage provided at no cost to you

  • Mission-Driven Work: Help transform the standard of care for women living with conditions that have historically been underdiagnosed and undertreated

  • Collaborative Provider Network: Connect with and learn from a community of skilled, like-minded Allara clinicians

  • Inclusive Culture: Join a supportive, diverse team that values innovation, equity, and belonging

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.excerpt: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe.
jobs.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence are at the heart of the Airbnb product. From Trust to Payments, and from Customer Service to Marketing we rely on ML to ensure that guests and hosts have the best possible experience with Airbnb.

Our ML team in Assistance Engineering is the team responsible for adopting the Agentic AI technologies to enable an intelligent, scalable and exceptional customer service experience. We are responsible for developing the Chat AI assistant, Voice AI Assistant and Human agent Assistant! The team is constantly exploring the SOTA Agentic architecture, develops and enhances various AI models, ML services and leverages tools including SFT, Reinforcement learning, Distillation, RAG/Search, LLM evaluation and testing automation, feedback-based learning and guardrail for a wide range of applications in Airbnb.

The Difference You Will Make:

We believe our current customer experiences in these domains are only scratching the surface of the innovations that are possible, and that science is at the heart of delivering a step-function change for our Guest and and Host on Airbnb.

You will build and leverage cutting edge AI technologies to transform Airbnb’s customer service by delivering personalized, easy-to-use and proactive customer service experience.

Many of the initiatives you’ll tackle are in their early conceptual stages. You will have the opportunity to shape these ideas from inception to production, turning visionary concepts into impactful realities.

A Typical Day:

  • Champion the development of novel ML systems, product integrations, and performance optimizations to solve real-world problems
  • Work cross-functionally with product, design, and other engineering counterparts to design and build efficient AI solutions for Airbnb CS products
  • Learn and share the latest AI/ML technologies with the team.

Your Expertise:

  • PhD or Master's degree w/ 6+ YOE in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, or a related technical field — or equivalent industry experience
  • Hands-on expertise in LLM, including pretraining, fine-tuning (SFT, RLHF, GRPO), prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and LLM evaluation frameworks
  • Experience building Agentic AI systems — including multi-agent orchestration, tool-use, planning, memory, and autonomous reasoning pipelines (e.g., ReAct, LangGraph, AutoGen, or similar)
  • Experience of shipping production-grade ML/AI systems at scale, with deep understanding of ML infrastructure, model serving, and MLOps best practices
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across Engineering, Product, and Design organizations

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: . Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range
$196,000—$227,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @ or @ email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.

What You'll Own

  • Build customer-facing and internal product features end to end.

  • Develop web flows, backend APIs, admin tools, dashboards and operational systems.

  • Support products across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and financial services.

  • Work with product, design, mobile and operations teams to launch fast.

  • Integrate APIs, handle data flows and improve production reliability.

  • Use analytics, feedback and production issues to improve features after launch.

  • Help build tools that reduce manual work and improve speed across the business.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of full stack software engineering experience.

  • Strong frontend and backend fundamentals.

  • Experience with modern web frameworks, APIs, databases and production systems.

  • Able to build useful products quickly without needing perfect specs.

  • Good product sense, UX awareness and attention to detail.

  • Comfortable debugging across the stack.

  • Experience in fintech, insurtech, marketplace, consumer apps or high-volume platforms is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can turn rough requirements into working product.

  • Thinks about user flow, backend logic and business process together.

  • Moves fast while keeping systems maintainable.

  • Takes ownership from build to launch to post-launch fixes.

  • Clear about what they personally built and what was team-owned.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Head of Strategy & Transformation – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Strategy & Transformation is responsible for developing, coordinating, and executing the organization's strategic initiatives and business transformation programmes. The role translates corporate strategy into actionable plans, drives operational improvements, and ensures that transformation projects deliver measurable business outcomes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the position focuses on strengthening business performance, improving operational efficiency, supporting digital innovation, enhancing customer experience, and ensuring alignment with regulatory and market developments.

The role works closely with senior leadership and departmental heads to ensure that strategic priorities are implemented effectively across the organization.

A. Strategic Planning & Execution

  • Support the development and implementation of corporate strategy and long-term business plans.
  • Translate organizational objectives into strategic initiatives, departmental priorities, and measurable action plans.
  • Conduct market research, competitor analysis, industry benchmarking, and strategic assessments.
  • Identify opportunities for business growth, market expansion, product development, and operational improvement.
  • Coordinate annual strategic planning and business performance reviews.

  • Establish appropriate project governance, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Coordinate with compliance, risk, finance, and internal audit teams.

Education

  • Change management and organizational development.
  • Project governance, risk management, and compliance awareness.

  • Leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.

Leland is building the home for ambition in the age of AI. We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience in design (as a UX/UI designer, product designer, or industry professional), a strong portfolio and track record of shipping thoughtful design work, and a clear, structured approach to coaching clients through both technical and career growth. Coaches set their own hours and rates, host sessions virtually, and partner with our team to deliver a high-quality, supportive experience for every client.

The Opportunity:

We are seeking a Senior Director of Data Analytics & Insights to build and lead our Data & Insights team. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will set the direction for how Caraway uses data, consumer insights to make decisions, and partner with leaders to set the AI roadmap. You will partner with leaders across the company, from Marketing and Growth to Operations, CX, Finance, Retail/Wholesale and Product.

Your impact will reach well beyond that. You will own the data products, dashboards, and standards that help teams across Caraway and our sales channels, including Amazon, retail partners and other marketplaces. You will also stay available for deeper analysis when a question needs it.

This is a leadership role with real hands-on depth. You will set the roadmap and develop the team, while staying hands-on in analysis, technical decisions and problem-solving. You will also help set the direction for how we use AI: where it can help our teams do better work, which tools are worth adopting, and how we use it responsibly with our customer data.

Who You Are:

You are resourceful, curious, and a clear communicator. You are comfortable with ambiguity and know how to turn scattered data into a clear recommendation. You enjoy big questions without obvious answers. You can talk strategy with the executive team in the morning and review a data model with an engineer in the afternoon.

You believe analytics and AI should help people make better decisions and do better work, not replace their judgment or their relationships with customers and each other. You are pragmatic and focused on results.

Responsibilities

Strategy and leadership

  • Set the vision and multi-year roadmap for Data Analytics, Insights and applied AI, tied to Caraway's growth priorities.
  • Lead and develop our Data & Insights team of two. Set clear priorities and help them continue to develop in their careers.
  • Partner with the CMO, the executive team and department heads to bring data into planning, budgeting and long-term strategy, and support leadership-level reporting with Finance.
  • Lead weekly and quarterly analytics planning, prioritizing initiatives, allocating resources based on business impact, strategic objectives, and team capacity.

Insights and analytics

  • Lead the analytics function for Marketing, Acquisition, Operations, CX, Finance and Product, equipping leaders across the business with regular, actionable insight on performance from pricing and promotions to CX feedback and operations metrics.
  • Provide strategic leadership for consumer research, partnering with cross-functional teams to set research priorities and turn consumer insight into recommendations that inform product, marketing and broader business strategy.
  • Partner with leaders across Growth, CX, and Finance to turn customer purchase behavior, retention, LTV and CAC into clear recommendations that shape decisions across the business.
  • Define how the organization measures channel and investment effectiveness through incrementality testing and marketing mix modeling, equipping cross functional leaders to act on the results.
  • Set the standard for omnichannel reporting, including Amazon and retail partners, so leadership has one trusted, comprehensive view of business performance.

Data stack and governance

  • Own and evolve the company's data infrastructure, including architecture, technology investments, vendor relationships, and budget, ensuring the stack is scalable, cost-effective, and aligned with business needs.
  • Set company-wide standards for metric definitions, dashboards, data modeling and analysis, so teams work from one source of truth.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and data products that enable self-service analytics and continue to build the team’s data literacy.
  • Work with technology partners and data engineers to make sure the data we capture is reliable and usable.
  • Partner with Finance to build and refine dashboards for key model inputs and support ad hoc analysis.

AI

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to shape Caraway's AI strategy, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to improve business performance through applications such as forecasting, customer segmentation, marketing optimization, personalization, and operational efficiency.
  • Prioritize use cases by business impact and effort, run pilots, and measure results, so we scale what works and stop what does not.
  • Evaluate org-wide AI platforms and tools, and make build versus buy decisions based on cost, security and long-term flexibility. Support department AI tool evaluation as needed.
  • Help teams across Caraway build AI skills and use new tools well, so AI supports their judgment and their work with customers.
  • Establish responsible AI practices, including how customer data is used, governance for models and tools, human review where it matters, and clear measures of business impact. Partner with the People Team, Legal, Security and Digital Product as needed.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • 10+ years of analytics experience in Consumer, DTC, E-Commerce or a similar industry, across marketing, operations, product, retail/wholesale and finance.
  • Excellent communicator and cross-functional partner, with a keen ability to build trust with stakeholders across the business, translate each function’s priorities into a shared analytics roadmap, and explain complex ideas clearly to executives and non-technical audiences alike, in writing and in person.
  • Track record of building and scaling a data and analytics team, including 5+ years leading analytics teams and of setting standards that other teams adopt.
  • Expert-level SQL skills and strong analytical ability, with a deep understanding of relational databases and how to use a wide variety of data structures to find insight in complex data sets and power customer-facing communications.
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards and reports in BI tools & AI platforms (e.g., Omni, Claude, Looker, Tableau, etc.), using Shopify data and other data sets to power customer-facing insight and communications.
  • Strong background in incrementality tests or marketing mix models to measure marketing channel effectiveness.
  • Knowledge of statistical modeling and experimental design.
  • Familiarity with ETL processes and tools (e.g. Hevo, Snowflake and dbt.) and partnering with data engineering and cloud data platforms to ensure data stays reliable as Caraway scales.
  • Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, such as forecasting, segmentation and propensity models, and how they create business value. Hands-on exposure to generative AI tools in a business setting.
  • Experience evaluating analytics or AI vendors and making build versus buy decisions.
  • Understanding of data privacy and the responsible use of customer data and AI.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Statistics, or a related field preferred.

Final compensation will depend on a variety of factors determining the base pay at offer, including but not limited to: skills, qualifications, experience. This range provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role.

Life at Caraway:

Who We Are:

Caraway is a home goods brand on a mission to craft well-designed, non-toxic essentials that thoughtfully raises the standards of what you cook with. We’re passionate about creating elevated products, made without forever chemicals, that are better for you, your family, and the planet. We prioritize a holistic approach to the creation of Caraway products. We partner with ethical manufacturers where their employees are safe, paid fairly, given benefits, and work regulated hours. Our eco-friendly manufacturing process emits less CO2 than traditional non-stick coatings, and we use sustainable packaging practices and ship in packaging made from recycled materials. We pride ourselves on continuously striving to do and be better—for you and the planet—in every step of the process.

Since launching in November 2019, we’ve become one of the fastest growing digitally-native brands of the last decade and are now sold in retailers including Target, Bloomingdale’s, Crate & Barrel, The Container Store, Costco, Zola, and many more.

We’ve amassed over 200,000+ five-star reviews from more than 2.5M+ happy customers and thousands of press hits from the likes of Vogue, Domino, Good Housekeeping, Food & Wine, Architectural Digest, PureWow, Fortune, and CNN.

Team: You will be joining a passionate and collaborative fully-remote team that prides itself on high-quality work, supporting one another, sharing our successes, and building a brand we truly love, together.

Culture: At Caraway, we value continuous learning and career growth. We strive to continually optimize our processes, ensuring that we’re thoughtful in everything we do, both internally and externally. We listen to our employees, celebrate our wins, and constantly look for ways to be better for our team, and the world.

Workplace: Being a fully-remote company, we have no headquarters and are truly distributed across the country. Our leadership team sits on both the East and West Coast and we have folks in a variety of states. We offer a monthly stipend towards co-working space should folks need to switch up their working environment every now and then.

The Technology First Line Risk and Controls Manager will be responsible for overseeing and managing the first line of defense for technology-related risks and controls. Support the implementation and monitoring of technology regulatory requirements.

  • Collaborate to understand regulatory requirements and align people, policies, procedures, and processes specific to technology-related regulatory requirements.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

We are currently on the hunt for an ambitious and passionate Senior QA Engineer to join our Tech Team.

What’s Oppizi

Oppizi is the first major multi-channel player in offline performance-marketing. We’ve built a technology that enables tracking, scaling, and optimization of flyering campaigns. We offer 3 channels, Hand-to-hand (in people’s hands), Door-to-Door (in people’s mailboxes), and Direct Mail (in people’s mailboxes via national post service). We operate in 10+ countries, the main ones being Australia, New Zealand, France, the UK, the US, and Canada. We are very privileged to work with flagship accounts like UberEats, DoorDash, Getaround, DiDi, Deliveroo, and many others.

Job description

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer who enjoys working in a dynamic and supportive team. You’ll be a key player in making sure our web and mobile applications work smoothly and meet high quality standards. You’ll work closely with developers and product managers to test features both manually and through automation, mostly in JavaScript-based environments. Your goal will be to help the team release faster while keeping our code stable and reliable. You’ll test everything from backend APIs to mobile apps, and help us improve how we build and deliver software. This role is perfect for someone who wants to make a real impact, work across different systems, and help shape our QA processes.

Responsibilities

  • Test web and mobile apps manually and with automated scripts to make sure everything works as expected.
  • Work closely with developers and product managers to understand new features and help plan testing early in the process.
  • Write and maintain test cases to cover new features and existing functionality, making sure we have strong test coverage.
  • Find and report bugs clearly, helping developers understand what went wrong and how to fix it.
  • Keep track of bugs from the moment they are found to when they are fixed and confirmed.
  • Provide test support for the development team throughout all stages of development.
  • Improve our test automation by writing new tests and improving the testing framework (mostly in JavaScript).
  • Participate in code and test reviews, offering suggestions and learning from teammates.
  • Help define and improve QA processes, making sure our testing is efficient and reliable.
  • Take part in release testing, ensuring each new version is high-quality and ready for users.
  • Take full responsibility for the quality of part of the product.
  • Work on backend (API) and frontend testing, mobile apps.
  • Make suggestions for improvements based on your test results and user feedback.
  • Make status and quality reporting in daily meetings. Communicate on any risks from a QA perspective that could affect the future release.

Requirements

Must-have Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in software testing, including at least 1 year in test automation.
  • Strong knowledge of QA processes and testing methods (like manual, automated, regression, end-to-end, smoke testing).
  • Experience manual testing web and mobile applications.
  • Good knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
  • Good understanding of JavaScript-based test tools like Playwright, Cypress or WebdriverIO.
  • Experience with mobile test automation.
  • Experience writing comprehensive automated tests.
  • Knowledge of SQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Comfortable working with tools like Postman, JIRA, Git, and CI/CD platforms like CircleCI.
  • Understanding of Page Object Model and other test design patterns.
  • Experience building or improving test automation frameworks.
  • Confident in reading and writing clear test plans and bug reports.
  • Good writing and oral skills. Advanced English level (for daily communication, writing documentation, and participating in meetings).
  • Detail-oriented and reliable.
  • Able to work independently and take initiative.
  • Curious, proactive, and open to learning new tools and technologies.
  • Good communication skills – you’re not afraid to speak up or ask questions.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile environment with a distributed team.

Nice to have Requirements

  • ISTQB certification or similar.
  • Experience with AWS, Docker.

Benefits

  • Attractive salary package.
  • Possibility to work 1 month per year in one of our offices (Mexico city, Santiago de Chile, NYC, Rotterdam, London, Berlin, Paris, Sidney, Melbourne …)
  • Great culture, human-centered & 17 nationalities.
  • Work in a very successful bootstrapped company, no investors yet!
  • International business: Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, UK, Netherlands, Belgium, and France.

jobs.description:
About Abridge

Founded in 2018, Abridge is the first AI-native clinician intelligence platform organized around the patient, built for clinicians, and designed to help health systems coordinate the clinical, financial, and evidence-based decisions for every moment of care. Powered by purpose-built AI for healthcare, Abridge connects patients, providers, payers, and life sciences companies. This year, the platform will support more than 100 million patient-clinician conversations across more than 300 of the largest and most complex health systems in the U.S. With deep workflow integration, the Abridge clinician intelligence platform has been validated to support encounters in 28+ languages across specialties and care settings.

Abridge is setting the industry standard for the responsible deployment of Al across health systems with continual and transparent Al evaluation. Clinical decision support references and cites gold-standard sources of evidence, and features like Linked Evidence map AI-generated documentation to source data, helping clinicians quickly trust and verify the output.

Abridge was awarded Best in KLAS for Ambient AI in 2025 and 2026, in addition to other accolades, including TIME Best Inventions of 2024 and 2025, CNBC Disruptor 2025, and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies 2025.

We are a growing team of practicing clinicians, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to transform healthcare. We have offices located in San Francisco, New York, and Pittsburgh.

The Role

We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our rapidly growing team and play a vital role in driving sales by communicating a deep understanding of the technical requirements for enterprise health systems and how Abridge technology can be incorporated seamlessly. This individual will operate at the intersection of our Sales, Implementation, Partner Success, and Product Engineering to ensure security reviews are successful and customers are positioned for success. With a deep understanding of EMRs, and the technical landscape of the enterprise healthcare organizations that use them, you will respond to information security questionnaires and RFPs, highlight Abridge’s platform features in the Sales motion, and serve as a trusted resource for our Sales team. You will report to the Director of Sales Engineering.

Our ideal candidate possesses deep technical knowledge, easily builds strong relationships, and prioritizes learning and maintaining trust, taking a consultative approach to our clients and stakeholders. We move quickly and thoughtfully, with a great deal of respect for team members who are results-oriented and who can thrive in a dynamic environment. As a Sales Engineer, we’re looking for someone who is energized by the opportunity to contribute to Abridge’s growth and can thrive in a cross-functional role.

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as the technical resource for the Sales team

  • Respond to RFPs and questionnaires to explain Abridge’s posture and accelerate the sales process

  • Identify and present ideal solution designs for customers by understanding their needs and incorporating Abridge’s recommendations

  • Leverage technical expertise to build relationships and establish credibility with customer technical executives and stakeholders

  • Act in a pre-sales capacity as an expert on integration.

  • Deliver product and technical demonstrations of Abridge’s technology

  • Work cross-functionally with Product Management and Engineering teams to improve Abridge’s technology by providing insight into your experience with customers

  • Support the implementation and partner success processes as needed

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of experience as a sales engineer, solutions consultant, solutions architect, or similar role in a Healthcare SaaS and technology sales environment

  • Solid technical background with deep understanding of and/or hands on experience with multiple EHR systems, enterprise desktop and VDI environments, SSO, identity, APIs, and integration standards.

  • Ability to creatively explain and compellingly present complex concepts in an easy-to-understand manner, across all levels of an organization

  • Excitement to always be learning and growing

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Eagerness to answer questions and solve challenges

  • An innate ability to figure things out, regardless of how complex the problem may be

  • Ability to occasionally travel within the assigned territory to support sales objectives

Bonus Points if:

  • Experience with clinical dictation tools, voice agents, or computer use technology.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Singapore. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Singapore.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About Enlighten

At Enlighten, we believe AI should expand what people can take on. We build teams of AI agents alongside Fortune 500 companies so they can put their best thinking to work across the business. We want the people closest to the work to be able to ask hard questions and get answers they can trust. Our mission is to give every team the intelligence it needs to make decisions that shape the business.

About the role

You’ll own account strategy and executive relationships for some of Enlighten’s most complex enterprise opportunities. You’ll find where Enlighten can help and guide senior sponsors and their teams through evaluation and purchase.

What you'll do

  • Develop strategic opportunities through your own research, prospecting, and SDR collaboration. Build account plans around the customer’s priorities, current initiatives, and how decisions get made.
  • Build relationships with executive sponsors and the teams that influence the decision. Make the case for Enlighten in terms of the decisions and measurement questions the customer wants to improve.
  • Agree on a plan with the buying group that names owners, dependencies, open questions, and decision dates. Surface risks to scope, timing, or sponsorship early and ground commercial discussions in what you’ve validated.
  • Own technical discovery and validation across the account, including data, workflows, integrations, security, and measurement. Bring in executives or delivery leaders for specific expertise.
  • Build and run tailored live demos and proofs of concept yourself with agents. Prototype during or after discovery when it answers a buyer’s question, and document what you demonstrated, assumed, or still need to test.
  • Run multiple AI agents in parallel every day to research industries, prepare executive briefs, and check proposals. Build small tools to track relationships, decision risks, and agreed actions, and review the work before sharing it.

What you bring

  • A strong record leading complex enterprise AI, data platforms, analytics, or measurement sales cycles with senior sponsors and formal evaluation or procurement steps, plus an active enterprise buyer network relevant to Enlighten's work.
  • Strong account strategy skills and the patience to earn alignment across a buying group rather than relying on one enthusiastic contact.
  • Executive presence that is direct, prepared, and credible without overstating the product or the likely outcome.
  • Hands-on AI fluency. You use multiple agents to run parallel research, drafting, and checking work, then apply human judgment before acting.
  • Demonstrated ability to personally build a credible live demo and proof of concept with AI agents, then validate the technical claims it supports.
  • The ability to create small custom apps or workflows with agent assistance to improve account insight and operating discipline.
  • A self-directed working style. You see ambiguity, identify the most useful next move, and bring options rather than waiting for instructions.
  • Experience collaborating with delivery teams while protecting their time and bringing them into the right conversations.
  • Experience with strategic accounts in a complex or regulated industry, and a record of building executive relationships across a long buying process.
  • You work independently. You can take an unclear goal, decide what to do first, find what you need, and carry the work through to a result. You bring people in early when a decision, risk, or dependency needs their input.

How we work

AI agents are core to how we get work done. You'll spend a substantial part of your day running multiple agents in parallel, building tools and workflows with them, and checking what they produce. You own the result. Verify the facts, calculations, code, and claims before they go into a decision, a customer conversation, or a release.

What success looks like

  • Strategic accounts have a clear hypothesis, stakeholder map, decision path, and next action.
  • Senior buyers see Enlighten as prepared, candid, and useful throughout a complex evaluation.
  • Internal experts are coordinated around real buyer needs and arrive with the context required to contribute.
  • Agent-assisted account work is accurate, reviewed, and visibly improves speed and quality.

Compensation

Annual base salary is $155,000 to $185,000 USD. Target total cash compensation is $310,000 to $370,000 USD per year, including base salary and target incentive compensation.

Benefits

Eligible employees can enroll in medical, dental, and vision coverage.

jobs.description:
London, 4x days per week in-office

Vega is looking for an engineer to build features end to end across our platform from Java/Spring Boot services and APIs to React and TypeScript interfaces – using AI tools as a core part of how they work and helping bring AI-powered capabilities into the product.

About Vega

Vega is transforming the way private markets operate. Alternative asset management is one of the most influential forces in the global economy, with over $20TN in assets today. Over the next five years, the industry is set to grow 3x, but GPs are facing challenges around their ability to handle the investment flows that are coming in. GPs have been completely underserved by innovation, particularly on the investor relations side.

Vega built the industry's first AI-native operating system, where all client work gets done – from the start of an investor's journey to its end. We are rethinking how work gets done in private markets from first principles: the opportunity is big, but it's also niche, high-stakes, and difficult to get right.

Who we are

We are still at the beginning of our journey. Vega was founded by former investors at Elliott and KKR, and built by talent from the world's leading technology and financial services firms – including Trade Republic, Revolut, Goldman Sachs, BCG, and more. We have raised $30M so far, with the backing of Apollo, Motive Partners, and 60+ senior executives from the industry. Today, we have over $300B AUM and 30,000 users on the platform, and we have much more left to do.

How we do it

Vega is a fast-growing startup. We want to make this a career-accelerating place for people with the ambition to build something big. If the below sounds appealing, it could be for you:

  1. We do not seek consensus. You will be expected to voice opinions and take initiative. Vega's best people do not wait to be told what to do before finding solutions to problems they have spotted.

  2. We believe bureaucracy is the killer of progress. We are focused on creating the minimum viable process to operate with quality at speed.

  3. We prioritise talent over tenure. There is no promise of progression without performance – we assess and reward people on impact above all else.

  4. We iterate fast. We make decisions amid ambiguity and with imperfect information, and we strive to balance committing to a hypothesis with iterating at low ego.

  5. We play to win. Expectations, intensity and ambition are very high, with every single colleague contributing to Vega's success. This often will not be a 9-5.

We know that this culture won't be for everyone, and we endeavour to make this clear from the beginning of the recruiting process out of respect for your time. Ask yourself whether the above sounds exciting to you in practice every day, and if it does, we would love to hear from you.


Who succeeds in this role

We look for people who match our ambition levels, and then raise it further.

In this role, you will:

  • Own problems from scoping through shipping and iteration, working directly with business and engineering teams to turn ideas into production features across the full stack

  • Use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor as a core part of how you design, build, test and review software – and help shape how the team gets the most from them

  • Work with our AI engineers to integrate AI features into the platform – wiring agents, LLM-powered workflows and MCP integrations into services and user interfaces, including streaming responses and sensible guardrails

  • Build and maintain microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot, contributing to an open architecture that integrates the many players in the private markets ecosystem

  • Define, develop and optimise RESTful APIs, owning the contract between front end and back end with scalability and performance in mind

  • Work closely with designers to turn mockups into responsive, intuitive interfaces using React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, and contribute to the evolution of our design system and theming

  • Ensure seamless integration with third-party systems used by PE firms, distributors, private banks and fund administrators

  • Identify and fix bottlenecks across the stack – from data flow and service efficiency to front-end rendering and UX

  • Champion unit, integration and end-to-end testing, and DevOps best practices

  • Share knowledge and support other engineers, contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous learning

What we look for:

  • Proven professional software engineering experience, with substantial hands-on work across both front end and back end, ideally on fintech applications

  • Fluency with AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) as part of your everyday workflow, with sound judgement on reviewing, testing and owning AI-generated code

  • Practical exposure to building with LLMs – e.g. calling model APIs, integrating an agent or tool-use flow, or shipping a feature on a platform such as AWS Bedrock – and an appetite to go deeper

  • Strong backend experience with Java and Spring Boot, including designing and building microservice architectures with RESTful APIs, and proficiency with SQL and ORMs

  • Proficiency in TypeScript, React and Tailwind CSS, with a strong grasp of responsive and mobile-first design

  • Experience in modern cloud distributed architecture, particularly AWS, Kubernetes and Kafka

  • Solid understanding of unit, integration and end-to-end testing, plus CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks

  • Experience working in an agile environment with cross-functional teams (product, design, engineering)

  • A proactive problem solver who takes initiative and brings high ambition to a fast-moving team

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on scalable solutions

  • Strong communication skills, including explaining complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience

Why join us?

  • You will help define the transformation of one of the most influential industries of our time with AI, working alongside an ambitious and dedicated team

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Benefits including medical insurance, gym membership, learning budget, and more

About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role

As a Provider Success Associate, you’ll play a critical role in helping our Registered Dietitians (RDs) succeed and grow on the Nourish platform. This role sits at the intersection of customer success and sales, focused on building relationships with our providers and helping them increase their impact, earnings, and long-term success with Nourish.

You’ll own a high-touch, consultative outreach motion, working directly with providers to understand their goals, identify opportunities to grow their caseload, and guide them toward actions that improve their experience and productivity. This includes everything from optimizing schedules to supporting transitions into full-time work on the platform.

This work is directly tied to our mission. By helping dietitians take on more patients on Nourish, you’ll help ensure more patients are matched with providers who deliver the best outcomes, improving continuity of care and helping more people live healthier, longer lives.

As one of the first hires in this function, you’ll also help shape how this motion scales. Your day-to-day conversations and insights will feed directly into how we evolve the provider experience, including our compensation and benefits model, ensuring Nourish continues to be an exceptional place for dietitians to work.

This role will report into our Provider Growth Strategy & Operations Lead and partner closely with cross-functional teams across Provider Strategy, Clinical Quality, CX, and Product.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1:1 consultative conversations to understand provider goals, identify barriers, and guide providers toward clear next steps
  • Move providers to full-time and grow their caseloads through proactive outreach and timely follow-ups
  • Manage a high-volume pipeline of providers, ensuring strong organization and follow-through over varying time horizons
  • Track and analyze key metrics related to provider productivity, engagement, and conversion to inform strategy
  • Surface insights from provider conversations to improve messaging, playbooks, and overall provider experience
  • Make process improvements based on provider feedback and internal learnings to strengthen the overall provider success motion

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, recruiting, or sales
  • You are hyper-organized and skilled at managing a high-volume process, handling multiple interactions at once while ensuring no detail is overlooked
  • You have excellent verbal and written communication skills and gain energy from engaging with providers across phone, video, email, and chat
  • You are a strong communicator with consultative instincts, able to guide conversations and influence outcomes
  • You’re a strong problem-solver who can think on your feet and offer creative solutions to optimize processes
  • You are comfortable working in a metrics-driven environment, balancing quality conversations with consistent activity
  • You’re passionate about nutrition and wellness, and motivated to help others improve their health by expanding access to high-quality care
  • You’ve excelled in fast-paced start-ups, particularly in healthcare operations, telehealth, SaaS, or tech
