jobs.excerpt: We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential.
jobs.description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.

The Director, Cybersecurity Operations and Incident Response, is the senior leader accountable for how the firm anticipates, detects, responds to and recovers from cyber threats. This role leads a combined Security Operations (SecOps) and Cyber Incident Response Team (CIRT) and serves as the firm's standing Incident Commander for Severity 1 through 3 incidents, with authority to declare an incident and activate the CIRT and the Incident Response Task Force (IRTF).

This is a leadership role first and a technical role second. The Director sets direction makes sound decisions under pressure, coordinates people and partners during a crisis, and communicates clearly with executives, the General Counsel's Office (GCO), and business leaders. The Director oversees the firm's managed Security Operations Center (SOC) provider and leads the team, including forensic preservation investigations, with a forward-looking approach to emerging threats and a continuous improvement mindset.


Key Responsibilities


Incident Command and Crisis Leadership

  • For applicable incidents, serve as the Incident Commander as depicted in the Incident Response Plan; declare incidents and activate the CIRT and IRTF.
  • Direct incident response from triage through containment, eradication, recovery and post-incident review, making timely decisions with incomplete information.
  • For applicable incidents, act as point of contact for leaders and groups across the firm during incidents, providing clear and timely status, impact and decision updates.
  • Coordinate external incident response forensic resources as needed and provide oversight of their work.
  • Run post-incident reviews and drive lessons learned into playbooks, detections, training and risk decisions.

Security Operations and Managed SOC Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the managed SOC provider, including service levels, escalation paths, quality of detection and response, and performance reporting.
  • Ensure security monitoring, alert handling and escalation are effective, well documented and aligned to the firm's risk priorities.
  • Align SOC, CIRT and IT operations so that handoffs between detection and response are fast and clear.
  • Own operational metrics and reporting that show security posture, response effectiveness and risk trends to the CISO and senior leadership.
  • Responsible for managing all of the above for multiple environments including a CMMC environment.

CIRT, Threat Intelligence, Forensic Preservation and E-Discovery

  • Maintain the strategic partnership with the GCO on legal hold, preservation obligations and e-discovery modernization.
  • Maintain incident response plans, playbooks and escalation procedures, and test them through regular exercises and simulations.
  • Lead and oversee cyber threat intelligence operations, including intelligence requirements, collection, analysis and dissemination, so that strategic, operational intelligence on threat actors, campaigns and vulnerabilities relevant to the Firm informs information security decisions.

Strategy, Governance and Preparedness

  • Set the multi-year vision and roadmap for security operations and incident response, anticipating emerging threats, including AI-enabled attacks, and changes in the regulatory landscape.
  • Align programs to recognized frameworks and standards such as NIST 800-171 and ISO 27001.
  • Partner with the CISO and other security leaders on risk, third-party exposure and enterprise resilience.
  • Brief senior leadership on security posture, major incidents and readiness.

People, Budget and Vendor Management

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of about 12 FTE plus planned growth; build a high-trust, high-accountability culture that holds up under sustained pressure.
  • Manage the budget, vendor contracts and managed service agreements, including retainers and tooling, ensuring value and accountability.
  • Build succession depth by developing deputy incident commanders and a sustainable on-call model.

Qualifications


Required

  • 12+ years of experience in security operations, cyber incident response or a closely related field.
  • 5+ years leading teams, including managers or directors.
  • Proven experience serving as Incident Commander or equivalent lead for major cyber incidents, including executive, legal and external stakeholder engagement.
  • Demonstrated ability to remain decisive and composed in a crisis and to bring structure to ambiguous, fast-moving situations.
  • Experience managing or overseeing outsourced security services, such as a managed SOC or MDR provider, including performance and contract management.
  • Experience owning a budget and managing vendors.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to give executives concise, answer-first briefings.
  • Working knowledge of incident response frameworks and regulatory, legal and notification considerations.
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CISSP or CISM.
  • Experience in a professional services, legal services or other regulated environment with significant client and litigation exposure.
  • Experience working with legal counsel on privilege, preservation, forensic defensibility and e-discovery.
  • Experience leading tabletop exercises and cyber crisis simulations at the executive level.
  • Experience with security transformation, including automation and AI-enabled operations.
  • Graduate degree in related discipline.

Leadership Competencies

  • Crisis leadership: calm, decisive and clear when the stakes are high.
  • Forward thinking: anticipates threats and shapes the program before it is forced to change.
  • Executive presence: earns trust with senior leaders, legal counsel and clients, and communicates risk in business terms.
  • Influence without gatekeeping: seen as a resource and partner across the firm.
  • Talent development: builds leaders, delegates effectively and prepares the team to operate without them.
  • Accountability: manages vendors and outcomes with discipline.

Success Profile

The ideal candidate has commanded real incidents and has the judgment, composure and credibility to lead the firm through its worst day. They are equally comfortable briefing the CISO and General Counsel in the middle of an incident and coaching a team through the aftermath. They look ahead, leave the program stronger after each event, and treat client trust, regulatory standing and legal defensibility as the outcomes that matter.

About Atlys

Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.

Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.

Atlys is changing that.

We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for 1M+ travellers across 127 countries. But we’re still early.

The Role

We’re building a personal AI travel assistant at Atlys and hiring Growth Interns to get it into the hands of people who fly most weeks.

Your job is to find frequent flyers with a trip coming up, invite them to experience the free beta, and help them find something they’d genuinely want to hand off. Afterward, you’ll hear how it went and what they’d want help with on their next trip.

You’ll be paid for each new frequent flyer you bring in who uses the beta on a real trip and shares feedback.

The Job

  • Find frequent flyers through points and miles communities, professional networks, events, and referrals.

  • Test different ways to reach them and see what gets them curious enough to try the beta.

  • Pitch creative ways to get the beta in front of more travelers, like teaming up with a newsletter or getting an event host to share an invite with people flying in.

  • Help interested travelers get started with an upcoming trip. Follow up to learn what they used it for, what worked, and what they’d use again.

The Ideal Candidate

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • You’ve filled an event, grown a community, or gotten people to try something new through a college club, side project, or internship.

  • You’re comfortable reaching out to people you don’t know, following up, and trying a different approach when something falls flat.

  • You’re curious about how people travel and what makes a new product worth trying. Interest in points and miles or online communities is a plus.

We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

Come build the intelligence layer for global travel

Company Overview

Legalist is a tech-enabled, multi-strategy investment platform investing at the intersection of law, finance, and technology. Pairing proprietary sourcing technology with rigorous legal underwriting, Legalist invests in legal assets across a range of strategies, including litigation finance, government receivables, and special situations. Founded out of Y Combinator in 2016, Legalist manages about $2 billion for endowments, foundations, family offices, and other institutional investors.

We are seeking an experienced litigation finance originator to source, structure, and close commercial litigation funding opportunities. The Managing Director will develop relationships with law firms, corporate claimants, and referral partners; build a pipeline of single-case and portfolio investments; and lead discussions through executed term sheets.

The ideal candidate combines an established legal-market network with a demonstrated ability to convert relationships into funded transactions. This individual will understand the economics of commercial litigation and law firms, identify financing needs, and work closely with investment colleagues to develop solutions that meet counterparty needs.

Responsibilities

  • Originate commercial litigation funding opportunities through direct outreach, existing relationships, referrals, and other targeted business development activity.
  • Build and deepen relationships with litigation partners, law firm leaders, inhouse counsel, corporate finance teams, litigation finance brokers, and other referral sources.
  • Identify opportunities for single-case funding, law firm portfolio financing, and monetization of claims, judgments, awards, or contingent fees, consistent with the firm’s investment mandate.
  • Lead initial counterparty discussions and assess strategic fit, capital needs, procedural posture, potential recovery, and commercial viability in collaboration with underwriting.
  • Translate counterparty objectives into financing proposals; prepare and negotiate indicative terms and term sheets within approved investment parameters.
  • Manage opportunities from initial contact through executed term sheets, coordinating diligence materials and maintaining clear communication on requirements, timing, and next steps.
  • Partner with investment colleagues as opportunities progress through approval, documentation, and closing.
  • Maintain an accurate CRM and qualified pipeline; report on expected commitments, transaction timing, conversion rates, and capital deployed attributable to origination efforts.
  • Develop repeat business and referral relationships, represent the firm at industry events, and educate prospects on litigation finance solutions.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across litigation finance, commercial litigation, legal services business development, specialty finance, or private credit, including substantial responsibility for origination or client development.
  • Demonstrated success sourcing and advancing litigation finance or comparable transactions, with a record of converting opportunities into executed term sheets and funded investments.
  • An established network of law firm decisionmakers, corporate legal teams, claimholders, brokers, or other relevant referral sources.
  • Strong understanding of commercial litigation economics, contingency fee arrangements, non-recourse funding, portfolio structures, and claim monetization.
  • Ability to assess opportunities at a preliminary level and work with underwriters to evaluate merits, damages, enforceability, collectability, expected duration, and investment economics.
  • Excellent commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and executive presence, with the ability to explain financing structures clearly to lawyers and business leaders.
  • Disciplined pipeline management, accurate forecasting, and the ability to manage multiple opportunities independently while collaborating across investment teams.
  • Sound professional judgment and discretion when handling sensitive information, with respect for confidentiality, privilege, and counsel’s independent litigation judgment.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, MBA, or a comparable advanced degree preferred. Willingness to travel for meetings and industry events.

Preferred Experience

  • Direct origination experience at a commercial litigation funder, including both single-case and portfolio transactions.
  • Experience developing relationships with litigation boutiques, national law firms, and corporate legal departments.
  • Commercial litigation or arbitration practice experience, or experience structuring legal assets and specialty finance transactions.
  • A track record of building a new market, referral channel, or origination function within an entrepreneurial investment platform.

Compensation includes a base salary of $200,000–$225,000, plus performance-based bonuses and origination incentives.

jobs.description:
Head of Talent
Location: US - Remote

About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our proprietary computer-vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident acuity, and streamline workflows across entire facilities. Our platform delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering healthcare providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

The Role

Care is facing a workforce crisis: the number of people who need care is growing far faster than the number of people available to give it. Teton is building the technology to close that gap, and the people we hire over the next year will decide how fast we get there.

We have grown from a small deep-tech engineering team in Copenhagen into a company of around 100 people with customers across the US and Europe. Now we’re scaling across engineering, hardware, sales, customer success and operations, including several senior leadership hires.

As Head of Talent, you will build the engine behind that growth. You will own how Teton finds, assesses and hires exceptional people, set a bar where every hire makes the team better, and personally lead the searches that shape our leadership.

This is a rare chance to build a talent function from the ground up at a company with real momentum. You will report directly to Mikkel, our CEO, work alongside the founders and leaders in the US and Copenhagen, and partner with People Ops so every new hire gets a strong start from day one.

Key Responsibilities

In this role you will lead and oversee:

Talent strategy and hiring plan

  • Turn Teton's annual and quarterly plans into a clear hiring roadmap by team, location, level and priority.

  • Work with Mikkel and functional leaders to define which roles to hire, when, and what great looks like for each.

  • Forecast recruiting capacity, budget and timelines, and flag early when plans and capacity don't match.

Recruiting function and team

  • Build and lead Teton's talent acquisition team, hiring recruiters and coordinators as volume grows.

  • Decide where to use internal recruiters, agencies and executive search partners, and manage those partners.

  • Own the applicant tracking system, recruiting tools and the data that comes out of them.

Executive and senior hiring

  • Personally lead searches for senior and executive roles across revenue, product, hardware and operations.

  • Build long-term relationships with strong leaders before we need them.

  • Advise the founders on market compensation, candidate quality and closing strategy for senior hires.

Hiring process and quality bar

  • Run a consistent, fast hiring process across countries and functions, building on our existing process and hiring manager playbook.

  • Train hiring managers on structured interviewing, scorecards and fair, compliant assessment in the US, UK and Denmark.

  • Keep decisions moving: clear stages, quick feedback and offers within our SLA.

Sourcing and employer brand

  • Build proactive sourcing for hard-to-fill roles, including AI and computer vision engineers, hardware engineers and enterprise sales leaders.

  • Work with Marketing to shape how Teton presents itself to candidates: careers page, job posts, content and events.

  • Make sure every candidate has a respectful, well-run experience, whether or not they get an offer.

Offers, compensation and metrics

  • Partner with leadership on offers, salary bands and warrant allocations, using market data by location and level.

  • Report on time to hire, pipeline health, offer acceptance, source quality and new-hire performance.

  • Hand new hires off cleanly into Teton's onboarding program.

What We’re Looking For

Minimum qualifications

  • 8+ years in talent acquisition, including 3+ years building and leading recruiting at a venture-backed startup through a period of fast growth (for example, Series A to C).

  • A track record of hiring at scale across technical and commercial roles, ideally both engineering and enterprise sales.

  • Hands-on experience running executive and senior leadership searches from intake to close.

  • Experience setting up recruiting processes, tools and metrics from scratch, not only running an existing system.

Mindset

  • High urgency and ownership. You move fast, follow through and treat hiring outcomes as your own results.

  • A high bar. You believe every hire should make the team better, and you will push back when a candidate doesn't meet it.

  • Direct communication. You give clear, honest feedback to candidates, hiring managers and founders.

  • Builder's attitude. You are comfortable doing the work yourself today while designing the team and systems for tomorrow.

  • Curiosity about the product. You want to understand AI, hardware and care delivery well enough to sell Teton to top candidates.

Time zone / location

  • US-based, with significant overlap with Copenhagen working hours.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience recruiting AI, machine learning, computer vision or hardware engineers.

  • Experience in healthcare technology, senior care or another regulated industry.

  • Familiarity with equity and warrant-based compensation across the US and Europe.

  • Experience working directly with a CEO and board-level stakeholders.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • 401(k) plan, paid time off, health insurance.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

What It’s Like Working at Teton

We’re a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged- it’s expected. It’s a hands-on environment where you’ll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job- jump on board 😊

jobs.description:
About Pair Team

Pair Team is building a new kind of healthcare system across Medicaid, Medicare, and public assistance programs: one that recognizes that access to housing, nutritious food, and reliable transportation are just as critical to health as having the right medications or seeing a doctor.

As a public benefit corporation and AI-enabled medical group, we partner with shelters, food pantries, and community organizations to deliver “whole-person” care to the 115 million Americans who rely on the safety net. We are currently the largest complex care provider in California with over 500 employees and are expanding nationally. Our model replaces fragmented healthcare and social services systems with one trusted relationship for all medical, behavioral, and social needs. We improve access, build trust, and dramatically lower costs (52% fewer ER visits, 26% fewer hospitalizations). Our model is a rare combination of saving tax payer dollars ($150B annually at scale) while putting people on an upward life trajectory. At national scale, this approach would save taxpayers.

These outcomes are driven by the AI-first, whole-person infrastructure we are building — a platform that connects healthcare and social-service organizations into a unified network. Leveraging our vast data and years of operational experience, we are building the agentic infrastructure for the safety net to coordinate care, automate operations, and learn from every patient interaction to continuously improve outcomes.

Read more about the AI-First Medicaid System we are building here.

  • Forbes: For Pair Team, Accessibility Is About Delivering Healthcare To Those Who Need It The Most
  • TechCrunch: Building for Medicaid’s regulatory moment with Neil Batlivala from Pair Team
  • Journal of General Internal Medicine: A Novel Intervention for Medicaid Beneficiaries with Complex Needs

About the Opportunity

As Principal Engineering Manager, AI Care, you’ll lead the team building agentic systems that participate directly in care delivery: coordinating care, engaging patients, and executing meaningful portions of care workflows. You’ll drive the strategy, roadmap and execution for autonomous care management – a new line of business and a strategic investment for the company. This highly collaborative position works closely with leadership, product, clinical, and operations to turn high-impact opportunities into shipped, working products rather than ideas built in a vacuum. You’ll also lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of engineers, and communicate strategy, progress, and tradeoffs across the organization.

This is a fully remote position reporting up to the Senior Vice President, Engineering.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and evolution of agentic systems that participate directly in care delivery, helping coordinate care, engage patients, and execute meaningful portions of care workflows.
  • Own the long-term strategy and roadmap for agentic AI initiatives, partnering closely with cross-functional stakeholders and leadership to identify high-impact opportunities and align technical investments with business goals.
  • Define and build architectural patterns for agent reasoning, tool use, memory, and human-in-the-loop collaboration.
  • Develop both reusable platform capabilities and product-facing implementations, balancing long-term architecture with rapid iteration.
  • Establish standards and best practices for agent evaluation, safety, and operational reliability as these systems evolve toward greater autonomy
  • Drive execution across complex, multi-disciplinary initiatives, establishing clear priorities, coordinating engineering efforts, and ensuring teams deliver high-quality outcomes effectively.
  • Serve as the technical and organizational leader for the team, communicating strategy, progress, and tradeoffs to leadership and cross-functional partners while driving alignment across the broader organization.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of high-performing engineers, fostering a culture of ownership, collaboration, and continuous growth.

Who You'll Need

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership at the Staff or Principal level.
  • 2+ years leading or managing engineers, or record of mentoring engineers and building a culture of ownership, velocity and high standards.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM-powered or agentic systems in production, not just prototypes.
  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, or other regulated domains (HIPAA, PHI handling, clinical workflows).
  • Deep familiarity with agent architecture patterns: planning and reasoning, tool use and orchestration, memory and context management, and human-in-the-loop design.
  • Experience designing evaluation frameworks for non-deterministic systems, including offline evals, regression testing, and production monitoring.
  • Strong grounding in safety, guardrails, and reliability for AI systems operating in high-stakes or regulated environments.
  • Familiarity with voice or multimodal agents.
  • Ability to set technical strategy and translate it into a roadmap, with a record of influencing leadership and cross-functional partners (product, clinical, operations).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining technical tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
  • Strong desire to work in an early stage startup environment that is fast paced and complex
  • Passion for helping individuals experiencing complex chronic needs such as homelessness, severe mental illness, and substance use disorder
  • Strong preference for candidates with proficiency in Ruby on Rails, Langfuse, Mastra, and/or Livekit; plus distributed systems and backend fundamentals (APIs, data pipelines, observability, cloud infrastructure).

Our Values

  • Lead with integrity: We keep our commitments and take responsibility for our actions. We are dependable and choose authenticity over perfection.
  • Embrace challenges: We leave our egos at the door and step forward into discomfort instead of back into safety. We help each other to learn and provide feedback using candor and kindness.
  • Break through walls: We go the extra mile for our patients, partners and one another, and we run toward hard things. We are resilient in our push for consistent improvement and challenge the status quo.
  • Act beyond yourself: We build each other up and respect boundaries. We seek first to understand and assume positive intent.
  • Care comes first: We hold ourselves to the highest standards for our patients. We are relentless in the pursuit of our mission, and ensure that we are taking care of ourselves in order to care for others.

Because We Value You

  • Remote-first with equipment and $100/mo home office stipend

Senior / Principal · Remote in France · CDI

Be our first Field Engineer in France, joining a global field engineering team in Europe, US and India. Help major enterprises adopt Kestra, from the first technical conversation through production and expansion, and shape how we build Field Engineering in France.

You may know this role as Solutions Engineer, Solutions Architect or Pre-Sales Engineer.

Reporting to: Lead Field Engineer
Languages: Fluent French and English
Location: Anywhere in France, with customer visits when needed

Why Kestra

Orchestrate everything, everywhere. From one control plane.

Data, infrastructure, business processes and AI agents. Build, run and govern them all, in the cloud or on your own servers. AI agents follow the same rules as everything else.

We believe orchestration is becoming a shared layer of enterprise architecture: the layer that coordinates what runs across tools, teams and environments. Enterprises have accumulated isolated pockets of automation, each with its own rules and a partial view of dependencies. Hybrid cloud and AI agents make the need for a common foundation more urgent.

Kestra is building that foundation as an open-source platform. For enterprises, unified orchestration means less fragmented automation, consistent governance and the ability to introduce new use cases without rebuilding execution and control mechanisms each time.

Founded in France, we are growing our enterprise business in both France and the United States. In March 2026, we raised a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with Alven, ISAI and Axeleo. Teams at JPMorgan Chase, Apple, TotalEnergies, Crédit Agricole, Leroy Merlin, Bloomberg and T-Systems run Kestra in production.

The opportunity

Our French customers include banks, insurers, industrial groups, energy companies and retailers. Their projects involve critical systems, complex migrations and demanding architecture reviews.

You will be the technical partner who helps them evaluate Kestra, make sound architectural decisions and reach production. You will stay involved as adoption grows, seeing the results of the choices you helped them make.

You will work directly with Product and Engineering, inspect the open-source code, and help shape what we build next. As our first Field Engineer in France, you will also establish methods and reference architectures that future colleagues can build on.

This is a senior individual contributor role, with level and scope matched to your experience.

What you will do

  • Lead technical evaluations with the Account Executive. Understand the customer's environment, agree on use cases and success criteria, build demos and proofs of concept, and design the target architecture.

  • Help customers reach production. Guide onboarding, train teams and review migration plans so customers can operate Kestra confidently.

  • Grow adoption within your accounts. Identify new teams and workloads with your Account Executive, building on your understanding of the customer's systems.

  • Help resolve difficult issues. Work with Support and Engineering on investigations, bringing customer context and clear communication.

  • Turn field experience into better products and practices. Give Product concrete feedback, create reusable blueprints and migration guides, and share useful knowledge with the open-source community.

What you bring

  • Enterprise customer experience. You have independently led technical evaluations or architecture workshops and can challenge and advise experienced technical leaders.

  • Hands-on engineering ability. You write and debug code, troubleshoot deployments and investigate failures across applications, infrastructure and networks.

  • Production orchestration experience. You have operated, integrated or replaced an orchestrator or a substantial automation setup that other teams depend on.

  • Depth in data engineering, platform engineering / infrastructure automation, or AI / MLOps. You bring expertise in one area and can learn across the others.

  • Ownership and communication. You can take an ambiguous project to a working outcome and explain your decisions clearly in French and English.

The work involves Kubernetes, Docker, YAML, Git, CI/CD, Terraform or OpenTofu, and enterprise security requirements. Depending on the account, you may encounter Python, SQL, dbt, Spark or Kafka, and migrations from Control-M, Automic, VMware vRA / Aria, Airflow or similar systems.

Your background may be in a vendor, consultancy, startup or enterprise platform team. We care about the work you have owned and the judgment you bring.

At Principal level, we also look for impact beyond your own projects: mentoring engineers, setting architectural direction or creating methods others adopt.

The demanding parts

Enterprise migrations take patience. Security reviews, legacy constraints and internal decisions can slow progress, and some evaluations will be lost for reasons outside your control.

Customers will expect clear thinking during difficult incidents. You will also balance their immediate needs with building reusable approaches for the team. Part of the playbook will be yours to write.

What we offer

  • Compensation benchmarked against US software vendors hiring for comparable roles in France, discussed in the first conversation.

  • BSPCE equity participation.

  • Remote work across France, with flexibility around customer and team commitments.

  • An annual company offsite.

  • Equipment, conference and training budgets, with time to learn.

How we hire

  1. 45 minutes with our Lead Field Engineer: your experience, a real architecture or project discussed in depth, and your questions.

  2. 45 minutes with Emmanuel, our CEO: Kestra's direction, your ambitions and how we would work together.

Two conversations, no take-home exercise, and a decision within a week of the first call.

Position Title: Global Integrated Campaigns Manager

Location:: Atlanta, GA | Austin, TX | Boston, MA | Charlotte, NC | Chicago, IL | Dallas, TX | Houston, TX | Los Angeles, CA | Miami, FL | New York, NY | Ashburn, VA | Phoenix, AZ | Portland, OR | San Francisco Bay Area, CA | Seattle, WA

Your Role

The Global Integrated Campaigns Manager will play a key role in building and scaling Digital Realty's global campaign engine. This position is responsible for developing and executing integrated, audience-focused marketing campaigns that increase brand awareness, engage priority buying groups, accelerate pipeline development, and support revenue growth across strategic markets and customer segments.

Working closely with Product Marketing, Regional Growth Marketing, Digital, Content, Brand, Sales, and Partner teams, you will deliver coordinated, full-funnel campaigns that connect Digital Realty's solutions to customer needs throughout the buyer journey. You will also help establish scalable campaign processes, measurement frameworks, and best practices to support a growing global marketing function.

What You'll Do

  • Develop, execute, and optimize integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns aligned with Digital Realty's strategic growth priorities, including AI infrastructure, hybrid IT, cloud, colocation, interconnection, sustainability, and industry solutions.
  • Build comprehensive campaign strategies that support brand awareness, audience engagement, demand generation, lead nurturing, pipeline acceleration, and revenue growth.
  • Align campaign messaging, content, and experiences with different stages of the buyer journey, engaging executive, technical, and business decision-makers.
  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Regional Growth Marketing, Digital, Content, Brand, Communications, Sales, Customer Success, and Partner teams to coordinate global campaigns and support regional execution.
  • Develop account-based marketing (ABM) and segment-focused campaigns targeting enterprise customers, buying committees, cloud and network partners, and service providers.
  • Identify and coordinate campaign content and activation opportunities across digital advertising, email, websites, webinars, events, social media, partner programs, and sales enablement initiatives.
  • Partner with Sales and regional marketing teams to develop campaign follow-up strategies, account engagement programs, and enablement materials that support opportunity creation.
  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance, including engagement, lead generation, pipeline contribution, and revenue impact, to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Establish repeatable campaign planning processes, calendars, briefs, reporting frameworks, and governance standards to improve operational efficiency and global consistency.

What You'll Need

  • 6–8+ years of experience in integrated marketing campaigns, demand generation, revenue marketing, growth marketing, or field marketing, preferably within B2B technology or enterprise solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing full-funnel, multi-channel marketing campaigns that deliver measurable business results.
  • Strong understanding of B2B buying journeys, buying committees, audience segmentation, account-based marketing, and demand generation strategies.
  • Experience creating marketing campaigns targeting both business and technical audiences, including IT, infrastructure, cloud, networking, security, data, and AI decision-makers.
  • Ability to translate complex technical solutions and value propositions into compelling campaign messaging, customer experiences, and actionable marketing plans.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with experience coordinating multiple campaigns, stakeholders, timelines, and priorities across global teams.
  • Analytical mindset with experience evaluating campaign performance, measuring pipeline contribution, and using data to guide marketing decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and build strong cross-functional partnerships.
  • Experience with marketing automation, CRM, analytics, and ABM platforms such as Marketo, Salesforce, Demandbase, 6sense, Sprinklr, PathFactory, Google Analytics, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Experience supporting global marketing initiatives with regional activation requirements and building scalable campaign processes within evolving marketing organizations is preferred.

A Bit About Us

Digital Realty brings companies and data together by delivering the full spectrum of data center, colocation and interconnection solutions. PlatformDIGITAL®, the company's global data center platform, provides customers with a secure data meeting place and a proven Pervasive Datacenter Architecture (PDx®) solution methodology for powering innovation and efficiently managing Data Gravity challenges. Digital Realty gives its customers access to the connected data communities that matter to them with a global data center footprint of 300+ facilities in 50+ metros across 25+ countries on six continents.

To learn more about Digital Realty, please visit digitalrealty.com or follow us on LinkedIn and Twitter.

A Bit About Our Team

Our Marketing team works in one of the world's fastest-growing and exciting sectors. We collaborate with the Sales team to develop effective strategies that help build our business and also ensure our corporate strategy meets our local market needs. Our team helps the business keep the world connected and continue to grow by translating our unique offerings into bespoke campaigns, content and propositions for different locations and customer segments.

What We Can Offer You

Our rapidly evolving business sector offers the opportunity to be part of a courageous and passionate team who work together to understand and meet the changing needs of our global customers.

Join us and you'll be part of a supportive and inclusive environment where you can bring your whole self to work. As part of our team, you'll get to work with people from different business areas, challenge the way we do things and put your ideas into action. We'll also give you plenty of development opportunities so you can build a rewarding and successful career with us.

Apply today, take charge of your career and grow your talents with us.

Health and Safety

Safety isn't just a priority here at Digital; it's critical to everything we do. Safeguarding lives, protecting assets, and securing data aren't just ideals - they're essential pillars of our commitment to excellence for our people, our partners and our customers. We have a culture of care where every member of Team Digital embraces a relentless pursuit of working safely across Digital Realty. Together we are Safely Powering Progress.

Our Compensation Philosophy

Digital Realty offers its employees a highly competitive compensation package, excellent benefits, and an environment that recognizes and rewards your contributions. Central to our compensation philosophy is rewarding our employees for achieving the values and objectives aligned to the company's overall goals and values.

Our published pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hire pay for the full-time position determined by role, level, and geographical location. Individual pay is based on additional factors including but not limited to job-related skills, experience, and relevant education and/or training. Moreover, an employee's total compensation package varies by role and may include salary, cash bonus or commissions, and equity awards not quantified below.

Compensation range: $135,000–$165,000 annually. This compensation range represents the Company's good faith belief as to what it will pay as a base salary for this position at the time of this posting.

Benefits: For this role, Benefits include medical, dental, vision, life and AD&D insurance, 401k match, disability benefits, wellness and education benefits, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off, holidays, and more.

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

We're looking for the performance marketer who wants to own profitable growth across Google and Microsoft for our Make & Manage Money business, set the plan, and build the campaigns themselves. Our listicles connect people with offers across personal finance, insurance, banking, credit cards, gaming apps, and more, and winning here means understanding how intent, creative, landing pages, offer selection, partner payouts, and lead quality work together. You'll run an eight-figure annual media portfolio with the freedom to put budget wherever it earns, and the trade is that it's yours: you find what's holding growth back, whether it's in the account or not, and you go get it fixed.

Tip: Only apply if you've directly owned and profitably scaled $10M or more a year in paid media for affiliate or consumer lead generation.

Why This Seat

  • Real ownership. You own the portfolio across Google and Microsoft, set the plan, and make the calls. No layers between you and the result.
  • Partners who can move the levers. Yield, account management, and creative work alongside you on payouts, offers, and landing pages, so you're fixing the whole funnel, not just the account.
  • Room to build. Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included, is early for us, and budget follows what works.
  • A team that gets better together. We share what works, own what didn't, and turn wins into playbooks the whole paid team uses.
  • An AI-forward stack. Claude is in the daily workflow, with room to automate analysis, concepting, and creative iteration.

What You'll Bring

  • Ownership, Accountability & Strategy. You set the plan, prioritize the tests, and make the call, then bring your manager recommendations, not questions about what to do next.
  • A track record of profitably scaling affiliate or consumer lead gen, with direct ownership of $10M or more in annual media spend.
    • Buying traffic to competitive affiliate listicles, comparison pages, or multi-offer marketplaces.
  • Hands-on depth in Google Ads or Microsoft Ads, and the range to own a portfolio across both. If your strongest experience is in Microsoft Ads, audience buying, or native inventory, we want to hear from you.
    • Scaling across Search, Display, Demand Gen, YouTube, and native placements.
  • A real grasp of affiliate economics: partner payouts, revenue per click, conversion rates, offer mix, traffic quality, ROAS, and margin.
  • A habit of finding the actual constraint. You can tell whether a problem sits in the buying, the creative, the landing page, the offer, the payout, or the measurement, and you go to the team that owns the fix with a clear ask.
  • Clear, direct communication, including short performance updates that say what changed, why it matters, and what you need.

Nice to Have

  • Running across several consumer categories or variable-payout partner programs.
  • Using AI and self-serve creative tools to speed up analysis and asset iteration.
  • Working with competitive intelligence tools and in regulated consumer categories.
  • Building playbooks or mentoring other media buyers.

What You'll Own

  • Strategy and execution across Google Search, Demand Gen, YouTube, and Microsoft audience and native inventory, MSN included.
  • Budget allocation, pacing, forecasting, reporting, and profitability for the portfolio.
  • A prioritized growth plan that names the biggest constraints and the tests most likely to move the business.
  • The case to Sales, Account Management, Yield, Creative, Product, and Analytics for what the campaigns need, and the follow-through until it lands.
  • Campaign architecture, bidding, targeting, conversion signals, exclusions, tracking, and testing discipline.
  • Testing new inventory and platforms with a clear hypothesis and a point where you stop.

What Great Looks Like

  • You run the portfolio on your own and bring your manager recommendations and decisions.
  • Profitable spend and margin grow because of a deliberate, prioritized testing plan.
  • Microsoft grows into a real second source alongside Google.
  • Partner teams know what you need, why it matters, and how their work moves growth, and payouts, offers, or pages change because of the case you made.
  • Your playbooks make the broader paid team better.

jobs.excerpt: Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale.
jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

We’re looking for a Strategic Partnerships Lead to own multi-threaded strategic partnerships and carry those negotiations from structuring through signature and into the field. This is a senior individual contributor role. It is not a program role.

You will work with two kinds of partners: Large, publicly traded ISVs, where one relationship covers the product integration, the commercial agreement, and how both field teams take it to customers. And developer and infrastructure platforms, where you will expand our one-click motion: a customer clicks “Monitor with Grafana Cloud” in the partner product, we create or attach a Grafana Cloud account, and telemetry, dashboards, and alerting are provisioned without a manual setup.

You will recruit partners, work closely with Product and Engineering teams on what gets built, negotiate the terms that make the integration hold, and work with Sales so the partnership shows up in real pursuits.

This role reports to the Senior Director, Corporate Business Development.

What You’ll Be Doing:

- Own the plan for each partner, including which opportunities to pursue and which to pass on

- Scope product integrations with Product and Engineering, including one-click provisioning into Grafana Cloud, the telemetry and dashboards that come with them, and where Grafana shows up inside the partner product

- Lead negotiations through signature, covering revenue share, attribution, placement, co-sell, data and brand terms, and term length

- Run integration, commercial, and field workstreams together on large ISV partnerships, so a term in one workstream still works in the others

- Expand the “one-click” motion to additional partners, and structure the economics around the product surfaces that drive conversion

- Launch partnerships with the field, including enablement, account mapping, and a path for sellers to use the integration in a pursuit

- Coordinate Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Legal from the first structuring conversation through launch

What Makes You a Great Fit:

- You have owned technology partnerships end to end, including the negotiation, with more than one live workstream in the same account

- You have closed integration partnerships that Product and Engineering had to build, and the commercial terms held after signature

- You have taken a partnership into the field, including the launch and seller enablement

- You are comfortable running several significant negotiations at the same time

- You work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Legal, and Finance without needing a team under you

- 8-10+ years in strategic business development, product partnerships, or technology alliances

Bonus Points For:

- Partnerships in developer tools, infrastructure, observability, or API platforms

- Experience with large, publicly traded ISVs, including who owns the roadmap and who owns the field

- In-product distribution: placement, provisioning or marketplace motions, and revenue share tied to conversion

- Enough technical fluency to work with engineers on APIs, telemetry, and account provisioning

- Structuring experience in corporate development, strategy, legal, or finance

In the United States, the OTE (on target earnings) range for this role is $183,857 - $220,629. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.

Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.

For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.

jobs.excerpt: Key Accounts Specialist Location: Colombia, Remote About Furnished Finder: Furnished Finder is the leading two-sided marketplace for monthly furnished rentals, connecting landlords with traveling professionals, remote workers, and relocating families seeking stays of 30 days or more.
jobs.description:
Key Accounts Specialist
Location: Colombia, Remote

About Furnished Finder:
Furnished Finder is the leading two-sided marketplace for monthly furnished rentals, connecting landlords with traveling professionals, remote workers, and relocating families seeking stays of 30 days or more. Trusted by over 7 million travelers each year, the platform offers a growing network of over 300,000 listings and more than 240,000 landlords nationwide — connecting renters to real homes in real communities, without booking fees or hidden costs. Newsweek named Furnished Finder one of America's Best Online Platforms in both 2025 and 2026, ranking it top 5 in the Real Estate category each year. Founded in 2014, the company continues to redefine flexible housing for the modern renter.

Why Join Us
When you join Furnished Finder, you’re joining a leadership team with 70+ years of combined experience across real estate and travel. As we enter our next phase of growth, we’re looking for curious, motivated self-starters who are excited to learn, build, and grow alongside an industry-leading team. With roles based in Austin, TX (our HQ) and remote opportunities available, we’re growing quickly—and we’d love to meet you.

Job Overview:
As a Key Account Specialist, you will manage and grow relationships with a pooled book of SMB landlords -- property owners managing between 5 and 15 listings on Furnished Finder. Your mandate is threefold: drive renewals by keeping landlords engaged and delivering measurable value, grow revenue by identifying and executing upsell opportunities into Furnished Finder's Value-Added Services (VAS) product suite, and identify which accounts in your book show signals of graduating to Tier 1 enterprise-level management.

This is a pooled coverage model, meaning your book is assigned by cohort rotation rather than named accounts. You will execute a defined playbook of proactive outreach, lifecycle interventions, and consultation calls -- and handle escalations from the Tier 3 team when accounts require a higher level of support. Success in this role requires a consultative approach, strong data literacy, and the discipline to work a structured playbook consistently across a high-volume book.

This is a hands-on, results-oriented role that blends relationship management, data-driven decision-making, and commercial acumen.


Responsibilities:

Retention and Landlord Engagement
  • Execute proactive retention strategies to engage landlords at key lifecycle stages and before they become at risk of churning.
  • Conduct consultative calls to diagnose listing performance issues and help landlords improve lead flow, response rates, and overall platform results.
  • Partner with Marketing and Product to coordinate customer engagement initiatives and ensure a consistent, well-timed landlord experience.
  • Identify and act on intervention opportunities throughout the customer journey to increase engagement and renewals.
VAS Upsell and Portfolio Growth
  • Identify and pursue upsell and cross-sell opportunities within your book, with a focus on Furnished Finder's Value-Added Services (VAS) product suite.
  • Introduce VAS products consultatively -- framed as solutions to the landlord's specific needs, not as scripted add-ons.
  • Track and actively work to improve your VAS attach rate as an individual performance metric.
  • Promote new platform features, subscription upgrades, and tools that drive measurable value for landlords.
Tier 1 Graduation Signal Identification
  • Monitor accounts in your book for signals that a landlord is growing toward Tier 1 eligibility -- expanding portfolio size, growing into new markets, or approaching enterprise-level listing volume.
  • Flag and document graduation candidates in HubSpot with supporting data and escalate to the Senior CS Lead for review.
  • Support a smooth account transition by briefing the receiving Tier 1 CSM on relationship context, history, open commitments, and active VAS conversations.
Churn Prevention and Re-engagement
  • Use account health signals and performance data to identify at-risk accounts before they reach the pre-renewal window.
  • Execute targeted re-engagement outreach for accounts showing disengagement signals or who have turned off autorenewal.
  • Conduct structured re-engagement conversations focused on understanding root causes and building a clear path to recovery.
  • Reinforce the value of Furnished Finder through education, consultation, performance data, and success stories.
Playbook Execution and Performance Tracking
  • Work the defined Tier 2 CS playbook consistently across your assigned book -- proactive outreach, lifecycle interventions, and renewal motion are executed at each defined stage.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation of every customer interaction, recommendation, and outcome in HubSpot.
  • Monitor and report on individual KPIs including renewal rate, VAS attach rate, Tier 1 graduation rate, and activity floor metrics.
  • Provide feedback to leadership on recurring landlord trends, product friction points, and opportunities observed across your book.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Sales, or B2B customer support.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume book of accounts against defined playbooks and SLAs.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to read account performance data and translate it into specific landlord recommendations.
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding renewal, retention, or upsell targets.
  • Experience using CRM and customer engagement tools (HubSpot strongly preferred).
  • Excellent consultative communication skills -- written and verbal -- with the ability to run structured, outcome-oriented calls.
  • Highly organized and self-directed; able to prioritize across a pooled book without named account ownership.
Core Skills
  • Playbook discipline: follows a defined outreach cadence consistently without requiring manager direction at each step.
  • Consultative selling: identifies VAS opportunities organically through conversation, not scripted pitching.
  • Signal recognition: spots Tier 1 graduation indicators and at-risk account patterns early from data, not intuition alone.
  • Escalation judgment: knows when to handle an issue in Tier 2 and when to pass it to the Senior CS Lead.
  • HubSpot hygiene: documents every interaction accurately and in real time -- this is how the team tracks performance and avoids attribution disputes.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: works effectively with Marketing, Product, and the Tier 3 team to coordinate outreach and avoid landlord over-contact.
  • Calm under volume: manages a high-volume pooled book without sacrificing quality on any individual account.

What You'll Bring
  • A proactive, playbook-driven approach -- you execute the defined motion consistently and flag gaps, rather than waiting for direction at each stage.
  • The ability to read account data and turn it into a specific, actionable recommendation a landlord can act on during the call.
  • Commercial instinct: you recognize when a landlord is ready for a VAS conversation and how to frame it as a solution, not a sale.
  • Pattern recognition: you notice when an account in your book is growing and proactively surface it as a Tier 1 candidate before the landlord outgrows the SMB model.
  • Comfort managing a high-volume, pooled book where success is measured by cohort outcomes and individual metrics -- not by the depth of any single relationship.
  • A collaborative mindset: you work well with the Tier 3 team on escalations and with Marketing and Product on coordinated outreach.
  • A genuine interest in helping landlords succeed on the platform -- you treat every consultation call as an opportunity to make a real difference in how a property owner's business performs.

Furnished Finder is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Requirements

  • Experience creating short-form videos, product-focused content and social media advertising creatives.
  • Creative and resourceful, with the ability to suggest ideas without going outside the brand’s direction.
  • Detail-oriented and able to check work against the brief before submission.
  • Able to work independently, manage deadlines and communicate clearly.
  • Must have access to a suitable camera, editing equipment and a stable internet connection.

The setup doesn't need to be a professional bar, but should have a bar-like appearance, such as a nice countertop with bottles and relevant props in the background.

This is a remote role that may be set up as either an independent contractor engagement or via an Employer of Record (EOR), depending on client preferences and legal structure.

Join a data and infrastructure team building a platform that turns information from multiple sources into reliable, current company intelligence. You will own the platform across architecture, ingestion, and production operations, helping deliver trusted data for downstream products.

  • Design and build a multi-source data platform for concurrent ingestion, event-driven processing, and orchestrated batch workflows.

  • Develop resilient intake from provider APIs, webhooks, files, and web scraping, including rate limits and failure handling.

  • Orchestrate scheduled workflows and historical backfills using tools such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect.

  • Build event-driven systems with messaging and task queues, including retries, dead-letter handling, and controlled replay.

  • Store original payloads in cloud object storage and transform data with dbt into raw, standardized, and curated layers.

  • Implement idempotent upserts, data contracts, automated validation, pipeline tests, and monitoring for freshness and failures.

  • Design and optimize PostgreSQL schemas and loading patterns, and integrate enrichment and LLM-based structured extraction.

  • Experience with event-driven systems, messaging or task queues, asynchronous processing, retries, and failure recovery.

  • Strong Python skills, including asynchronous HTTP and concurrent processing with tools such as asyncio, aiohttp, or HTTPX.

  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, including data modeling, query optimization, and incremental loading.

  • Experience with data contracts, raw and curated storage, retention policies, automated testing, and pipeline monitoring.

  • Practical use of AI tools, ideally Claude.
  • Organized and adaptable, able to manage several projects at once without losing track of details and to build programs without an existing playbook.

Nice to have

  • Certification in or familiarity with sales methodologies such as Sandler, MEDDIC, or consultative selling.
  • Experience with ChurnZero, Notion, Storylane, or an LMS.
  • Quota-carrying experience.
  • Familiarity with higher education, healthcare philanthropy, or nonprofit fundraising.

What you’ll do:

  • Onboarding and Ongoing training
    • Build, deliver, and coordinate onboarding for GTM teams including new Account Executives, Business Development Representatives, and Customer Success team members, in partnership with managers.
    • In partnership with the Director of Revenue Enablement, you’ll plan and deliver skills training on the sales process and customer journey, along with personas, use cases, and product and competitive positioning.
    • Through metrics and call reviews identify opportunities to level up the teams effectiveness.
    • Work with managers to confirm skill gaps and turn them into targeted training, coaching guides, and role plays.

    • Write and maintain playbooks and sales motions, and document the prospect to customer journey.
    • Partner with teams and marketing to identify content needs, and organize and deliver content back to teams.

    • Train and document processes, ROEs, and workflows for GTM teams. Audit and edit current documentation and ensure teams easily find what they need when they need it.

jobs.description:
We’re hiring an analyst to open first conversations with investors who are new to Pairs, and to book their meetings with the founders we work with.

About Pairs
Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

The role
You help grow the investor side of Pairs. From your first week you’re on calls with investors who are new to Pairs, learning what they invest in and why, and matching them with founders who fit. Family offices and private wealth are the investors we most want more of, and VCs are still a big part of what we do. Pairs has made more than 3,500 investor introductions for founders since we started. You don’t need a network of US startup investors to start; we bring the investors to you and coach you on building relationships with them. Software and AI run the admin, so the role isn’t technical and your time goes to people. Analysts who do well here move up to associate and run their own book of investors.

What you will own
• First conversations every week with investors who are new to Pairs.
• Qualifying each investor: what they invest in, at what stage, and how much.
• Booking meetings between our founders and the investors who fit them.
• Keeping your growing list of investor relationships warm, with the goal of building your own book.
• Support for our associates and senior team on live deals, which means researching investors, writing briefing notes before a meeting and following up after it.

You are a fit if you
• Have worked a job or an internship where you spoke to investors or senior clients yourself, for example at an expert network, consultancy, bank, wealth manager or fund.
• Have built relationships yourself and became someone’s go-to contact, even if the first introduction came through your employer.
• Have found your own way to a first conversation, through alumni, former colleagues or your own outreach.
• Can research a company or an investor quickly and turn it into a clear, short briefing.
• Use AI tools every day to speed up research and repetitive work, while keeping the relationship side human.
• Communicate clearly and with confidence, on calls and in writing.
• Build trust by listening first and respecting an investor’s time.
• Handle confidential deal and investor information with care.
• Have hit a target that was yours alone, at work or in something you started.

Compensation
OTE of $80,000 to $120,000 USD, base plus commission.

Location and working style
Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time. The team works across London, New York, Dubai and San Francisco. You get the best AI tools, paid for, a senior team that coaches you every week, live deal flow from your first week and a clear path to becoming an associate.

How to apply
Apply through our short form. Tell us about the investor or client relationships you’ve built so far, how you built them, and why you want a career in private capital. If you mention investors, describe them by type and leave their names out.

Compensation Range: $80K - $120K

jobs.description:
Manifest Financial | Solutions Engineer

Job Title: Solutions Engineer

Department: Growth

Location: Remote

Status: Full-time Exempt

About Manifest Financial, Inc.

Manifest is an embedded banking platform built for the platforms that power today's entrepreneurs, creators, and micro-businesses. Through our APIs, platforms can embed business banking, payouts, and card acceptance directly into their products, giving their users one place to get paid, manage money, and grow.

What sets Manifest apart is our infrastructure. We operate with direct banking rails and direct acquiring rails, so we can move money both into and out of a platform's ecosystem through a single partner. That positioning lets platforms cut the cost and complexity of paying their users, increase user satisfaction and retention, and create new revenue from payments and payouts—without stitching together multiple processors and third-party banks.

We serve creator platforms, financial institutions, NIL programs, and independent software vendors (ISVs), with a deliberate focus on platform-led businesses and long-term partnerships.

Role Overview

We are hiring a Solutions Engineer to be the technical bridge from first sales conversation to live volume, across both sides of our platform: acquiring (card acceptance) and payouts/embedded banking.

Before the deal closes, you will work alongside Sales to shape the solution, building the sales and implementation roadmap that shows a prospect exactly how they will launch with Manifest. After signature, you will lead onboarding through go-live and a clean handoff. Your goal is that every new platform launches quickly and cleanly, with nothing left unresolved.

Key Responsibilities

Pre-Sales and Solutions Design

  • Partner with Sales to develop account-level sales and implementation roadmaps that align the prospect's goals, technical requirements, timeline, and launch plan.
  • Lead technical discovery: map the prospect's funds flow, tech stack, user onboarding, and integration requirements across acquiring and payouts.
  • Design solutions and produce funds-flow diagrams, integration overviews, and phased rollout plans that help prospects say yes with confidence.
  • Deliver technical demos and API walkthroughs to engineering, product, and finance stakeholders.
  • Answer technical, security, and compliance questions; support RFPs and due diligence questionnaires.
  • Identify implementation risks early and set realistic launch expectations before contract, so deals close cleanly and launch on time.
  • Help Sales build repeatable playbooks, roadmap templates, and technical collateral for target verticals.

Implementation and Onboarding

  • Lead post-sale onboarding end to end for both acquiring and payouts: kickoff, project plans, milestones, sandbox testing, certification, and production go-live.
  • Guide customers' engineering teams through API, SDK, webhook, hosted-page, and reporting integrations.
  • Coordinate merchant and sub-merchant boarding, KYC/KYB documentation, and underwriting handoffs with Risk and banking and processing partners.
  • Configure accounts, pricing, settlement, and payout settings; validate end-to-end transaction, settlement, payout, and reconciliation flows before launch.
  • Troubleshoot integration issues and escalate to Product and Engineering with clear reproduction steps and business impact.
  • Run a structured handoff to Account Management/Support at go-live, including documentation, open items, and success criteria.
  • Build reusable implementation assets (runbooks, checklists, sample code) and feed customer insights back to Product.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years in a sales engineering, solutions engineering, implementation, or technical onboarding role at a payments, fintech, or B2B SaaS company.
  • Demonstrated pre-sales experience: supporting discovery, solution design, and technical sales cycles alongside account executives.
  • Working knowledge of card acquiring: authorization, capture, settlement, chargebacks, interchange, and merchant/sub-merchant onboarding.
  • Familiarity with payouts and money movement: ACH, RTP/FedNow, push-to-card, wires, and virtual accounts or embedded banking.
  • Hands-on comfort with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, and tools such as Postman; able to debug integrations alongside developers.
  • Proven ability to run multiple concurrent pre-sales engagements and implementations with clear timelines and accountability.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical concepts to executives and engineers alike.
  • Understanding of KYC/KYB, PCI DSS, and bank compliance expectations as they relate to onboarding.
  • Self-directed and organized in a fully remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with platform/PayFac or ISV payment models and sub-merchant onboarding.
  • Background with creator platforms, marketplaces, or financial institution partners.
  • Experience working with banks, card networks, or processors.
  • Scripting or light development experience (JavaScript, Python, or SQL) for testing and data validation.
  • Experience with CRM and project tools such as HubSpot, Jira, or Asana.
  • Payments certifications (e.g., ETA CPP) or prior solutions consulting experience.

Compensation

The posted compensation range for this role is a base salary of $95,000 – $135,000, plus variable compensation of approximately 10–20% of base, for a total target compensation of approximately $105,000 – $160,000. Final placement within the range depends on experience and qualifications.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • Dynamic and inclusive work environment.
  • Remote work options and flexible PTO.
  • Direct access to leadership and ownership of meaningful work at a growing company.

Equal Opportunity

Manifest Financial is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Reporting & Insight Delivery

Planning, Delivery & Operational Ownership

Collaboration & Strategic Alignment

  • Contribute positively to team culture through ownership, transparency and high standards.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience with GA4, Google Tag Manager and conversion tracking.
  • Proven experience implementing and troubleshooting Meta Pixel, Google Ads tracking and other marketing tags.

  • Knowledge of data layers, basic JavaScript, HTML and Google Consent Mode.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable business insights.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with strong communication and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts independently and collaborate with cross-functional teams.
