jobs.description:
About Kyra

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Talent Acquisition Partner

Permanent, Full-Time | Remote-First

Internal Recruitment | Kyra | Remote-First

Start date: As soon as possible. Please let us know your notice period.

Contract: Permanent, full-time employment.

Location: Remote-first, based in Europe. If you're near London, we'd be happy to meet in person during onboarding, but it's not a requirement.

Salary: We're open to different levels of experience. Please share your salary expectations and currency in the application form.

👋 The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced in-house recruiter to help us build the team behind Kyra.

We're hiring across different markets, disciplines and specialist skill sets, including priority roles supporting some of our biggest client accounts.

The challenge isn't always finding candidates. It's knowing exactly who to look for.

A hiring brief rarely tells the whole story. We need someone who can get under the bonnet of a team's challenges, question assumptions and identify the skills that will make the biggest difference.

Someone who can find those people, help us test for those skills and make better hiring decisions.

But we also want to think beyond the immediate vacancy. Every search should strengthen our knowledge of the market, our relationships and our ability to hire next time.

The goal? Better hiring decisions, faster searches and a talent network that becomes a competitive advantage.

You'll have ownership of your work, the opportunity to shape how we recruit and the freedom to test new ideas.

🏃 Can You Keep PACE?

Four qualities I look for in a recruiter.

P: People Person

Networking comes naturally. You can strike up a conversation with almost anyone and enjoy meeting people from different backgrounds and professions.

You listen carefully, remember the details and know how to build relationships that last. You're equally comfortable engaging a senior leader or someone taking their first steps into a career.

A: Adaptable

Different personalities, markets, hiring managers and priorities. You read situations well, welcome feedback and know when to change your approach.

You're comfortable working through ambiguity without losing sight of what needs to get done.

C: Curious & Up for a Challenge

You're fascinated by what makes people good at what they do.

You ask questions others miss, challenge assumptions and enjoy getting to grips with unfamiliar subjects.

You understand that the most important skills aren't always obvious from a CV or job title.

E: Effective at Pace

You have at least three years' recruitment experience in a startup, scaleup or similarly fast-paced, high-volume hiring environment.

You're a confident headhunter who can manage multiple searches, prioritise competing demands and move quickly without compromising standards.

Bonus points for experience recruiting across Europe and the US, particularly in creative, marketing, technology or growing businesses.

We also value excellent writing, commercial awareness, confidence with recruitment data and ATS tools, and an appetite for experimenting with AI.

🔎 What You'll Own

You'll take responsibility for priority hiring across the business while helping us build a recruitment approach that improves with every search.

  • Understand the problem: Work closely with hiring managers to understand their commercial challenges and identify the specific skills their teams need.

  • Find the people: Headhunt, research talent markets and build relationships with people we might otherwise miss.

  • Test for skills: Help hiring managers look beyond CVs and assess what candidates can actually do.

  • Follow through: Manage candidate communication, interviews and feedback. Build relationships that continue beyond a single vacancy.

  • Build the network: Turn every search into better market knowledge, stronger relationships and a head start on future hiring.

  • Keep improving: Use recruitment data, maintain accurate ATS records, follow hiring requirements and experiment with AI to make our processes more effective.

🎯 Your First Three Months

Understand the bar. Find the talent. Build momentum.

You'll take ownership of priority searches, develop relationships with hiring managers and learn what makes someone successful at Kyra.

We already have some brilliant creative and innovative people. Your challenge is to help us find more.

Three things matter:

  • Quality of hire: Understand what separates good from great for each role, challenge assumptions and identify people who meet that standard.

  • Speed of hire: Deliver against agreed timelines without compromising quality.

  • Talent network: Build relationships and pipelines that give us a head start on future searches.

Beyond the First Three Months

The ambition is to make recruitment less reactive and more predictable.

You'll help us develop a stronger understanding of the skills we'll need, build relationships before vacancies arise and create a talent network that compounds in value over time.

We want every hiring decision to leave us better equipped for the next one.

👀 Something I'm Curious About...

Where's the most unexpected place you've spotted talent?

Perhaps you've coached a sports team, taught a class, mentored someone or recognised an ability in someone that others hadn't noticed.

I'm interested in what shaped your ability to recognise potential in people. I'd enjoy exploring this at interview.

👩‍🚀 You Bring the PACE. I'll Give You the SPACE.

Hi, I'm Steph!

I've spent almost five years at Kyra. I know the business well, but I don't assume I have all the answers.

Here's what you can expect from working together.

S: Support

You'll have the context, introductions and support to understand our business and make your own judgement calls.

P: Priorities

You'll know what matters most and why. We'll agree on goals, focus on what makes the biggest difference and adapt as priorities change.

A: Autonomy

You'll have ownership of your work and the freedom to bring your experience, judgement and ideas. You'll have a voice in how we recruit.

C: Communication

You'll have open conversations, direct feedback and someone to challenge ideas with. Five minutes of discussion can save days of unnecessary work.

E: Experiment & Learn

You'll have room to experiment with AI, build useful things and challenge established ways of working.

I'm curious where you are with AI. What have you tried? What's delivering real value? And what hasn't lived up to the hype?

I hope we'll learn from each other and build something we're proud of.

🚀 Interested?

Help us find the people who'll shape what Kyra becomes next.

If this sounds like you, I'd love to hear from you.

And if someone comes to mind while reading this, please share it with them!

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.

jobs.excerpt: Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Digital Transformation Director – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Digital Transformation Director is responsible for defining and leading the organization's digital transformation strategy to modernize business operations, enhance customer experience, improve operational efficiency, and drive innovation through technology.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide digital initiatives involving technology modernization, automation, artificial intelligence, data analytics, cloud adoption, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and system integration.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, IT teams, business unit heads, and external technology partners to translate business objectives into digital transformation roadmaps, manage strategic technology investments, and ensure successful implementation of digital solutions that deliver measurable business value.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Digital Transformation Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and execute the organization's digital transformation strategy, vision, and implementation roadmap.
  • Align digital initiatives with corporate strategy, business growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Identify emerging technologies and digital opportunities that can improve business performance and competitiveness.
  • Lead enterprise-wide digital modernization initiatives across insurance, investment, finance, and customer service functions.
  • Advise executive leadership on technology investments, digital innovation, and transformation priorities.

B. Technology Modernization & Enterprise Architecture

  • Lead modernization of legacy systems, enterprise applications, infrastructure, and digital platforms.
  • Oversee the implementation and integration of core business systems, CRM, ERP, policy administration, and investment management platforms.
  • Establish technology architecture standards and ensure interoperability across enterprise systems.
  • Drive cloud migration, application modernization, and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
  • Ensure digital solutions are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with business requirements.

C. Automation, AI & Digital Innovation

  • Identify and implement opportunities for robotic process automation (RPA), artificial intelligence, machine learning, and workflow automation.
  • Drive innovation through digital products, intelligent process automation, and advanced analytics.
  • Promote the use of data-driven insights to improve business decisions and operational performance.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and assess their potential business impact.
  • Lead digital initiatives to automate claims processing, underwriting, customer onboarding, investment reporting, and other business operations.

D. Digital Customer Experience & Business Transformation

  • Lead digital initiatives to improve customer journeys, engagement, and service delivery.
  • Oversee development and enhancement of digital customer platforms, mobile applications, self-service portals, and online service channels.
  • Drive digital distribution strategies and technology-enabled business models.
  • Collaborate with business leaders to redesign processes and improve customer experience.
  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives deliver measurable improvements in customer satisfaction and retention.

E. Data, Analytics & Information Management

  • Establish data-driven transformation strategies and enterprise analytics capabilities.
  • Oversee implementation of business intelligence, reporting, and data analytics platforms.
  • Promote data governance, data quality, and responsible data management practices.
  • Leverage predictive analytics and business intelligence to improve risk assessment, investment decisions, and operational forecasting.
  • Ensure data management practices comply with relevant privacy and regulatory requirements.

F. Cybersecurity, Risk & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure digital transformation initiatives incorporate appropriate cybersecurity and information security controls.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, and IT teams to manage technology-related risks.
  • Ensure digital platforms meet applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and data protection requirements.
  • Oversee technology governance, disaster recovery, business continuity, and operational resilience considerations.
  • Monitor emerging technology risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.

G. Programme Governance & Financial Management

  • Oversee the organization's digital transformation portfolio, programmes, and strategic technology projects.
  • Develop digital transformation budgets, business cases, investment proposals, and financial forecasts.
  • Monitor project milestones, budgets, risks, dependencies, and expected business benefits.
  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, consultants, and strategic implementation partners.
  • Establish governance frameworks, performance dashboards, and benefits realization mechanisms.

H. Change Management & Digital Adoption

  • Lead organizational change management strategies associated with digital transformation.
  • Build digital capabilities through employee training, engagement, and technology adoption programmes.
  • Work with HR and business leaders to develop digital skills and transformation readiness.
  • Address resistance to technology adoption and promote a digital-first organizational culture.
  • Ensure new digital platforms and processes are effectively embedded into daily operations.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree, MBA, or postgraduate qualification in Digital Transformation, Technology Management, or Business Strategy is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT leadership, digital transformation, technology strategy, or enterprise technology management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior technology or digital transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide digital transformation and technology modernization initiatives.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud computing, enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data analytics, AI, automation, and digital platforms.
  • Experience managing large-scale technology budgets, transformation portfolios, vendors, and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong understanding of technology governance, regulatory compliance, data protection, and operational resilience.
  • Certifications such as TOGAF, PMP, PgMP, ITIL, Prosci, AWS, Azure, or relevant digital transformation qualifications are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Achievement of digital transformation strategy and roadmap milestones.
  • Percentage of digital initiatives delivered within approved budgets and timelines.
  • Digital adoption and utilization rates across business functions.
  • Reduction in manual processes through automation and technology implementation.
  • Improvement in operational efficiency and process turnaround times.
  • Return on investment (ROI) from digital transformation initiatives.
  • Customer experience and digital channel satisfaction improvements.
  • Legacy system modernization and integration success rates.
  • Data quality, analytics adoption, and reporting effectiveness.
  • Cybersecurity, technology risk, and regulatory compliance performance.
  • Employee digital capability and change adoption rates.

jobs.description:
Remote Phone Fundraiser - Human Rights & Nonprofit Causes

$19-$24/hour | 40 Hours/Week | Fully Remote

Use Your Voice for Human Rights

Can you take an issue you care about and make someone else understand why it matters?

Public Outreach is building a new U.S. remote fundraising team, and we're looking for full-time Phone Fundraisers.

You'll speak with people who have already shown an interest in nonprofit and human-rights causes and turn that interest into meaningful conversations and long-term monthly support.

Your initial fundraising work may involve issues such as:

  • Refugee and migrant rights

  • Civil liberties and human rights

  • Discrimination and equality

  • Reproductive rights

  • Communities affected by conflict or displacement

  • Humanitarian aid

  • Support for children and families

Campaign assignments can change, so future work may involve different nonprofit causes.

This is not cold calling. Your $19 starting wage is guaranteed - this is not commission-only sales.

What You'll Do

You'll:

  • Speak with nonprofit supporters by phone

  • Discuss serious social and human-rights issues with empathy and confidence

  • Ask questions and build genuine rapport

  • Turn complex issues into understandable, compelling stories

  • Explain how nonprofit organizations are taking action

  • Ask supporters to become long-term monthly donors

  • Respond thoughtfully to questions, concerns and objections

  • Work toward clear fundraising goals

  • Participate in ongoing coaching, workshops and feedback

Fundraising Is Part Advocacy, Part Storytelling and Part Ask

You don't need previous fundraising experience.

But you do need to be comfortable talking about important issues and directly asking someone to support the work financially.

Strong fundraisers can communicate conviction without becoming aggressive.

They listen.

They adapt.

They can have a difficult conversation, hear "no" and approach the next call with the same energy.

We provide paid training and ongoing coaching to help you develop those skills.

This Is a Full-Time Position

We're currently building a small, reliable U.S. team.

You must be able to consistently commit to 40 hours per week.

Fundraising shifts take place Monday-Friday and are scheduled within our calling windows.

This isn't intended as casual remote work or a side job. We're looking for people who want to develop professionally, become strong fundraisers and contribute consistently to the team.

Before You Apply - Check Your Technology

Working remotely requires the right setup.

You must have:

  • A desktop or laptop running Windows 11 or newer

  • Reliable high-speed internet with at least 50 Mbps download / 30 Mbps upload

  • Wired headset with microphone

  • Private, quiet workspace

  • Reliable internet - wired Ethernet strongly preferred

  • Basic technical confidence and ability to troubleshoot simple issues

MacBooks are not compatible with our calling system.

You'll complete a technology check during the hiring process, including an internet speed and voice connection test.

If you don't currently have the required computer and internet setup, you won't be able to move forward.

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

You:

  • Are a confident and engaging communicator

  • Care about human rights, humanitarian issues or social impact

  • Can talk about serious subjects with empathy and maturity

  • Can tell a story that keeps someone's attention

  • Are comfortable making a direct fundraising ask

  • Can persuade without pressuring

  • Are resilient when you hear "no"

  • Like working toward measurable goals

  • Take coaching and feedback seriously

  • Can remain focused and accountable while working remotely

Experience in advocacy, communications, theatre, education, hospitality, customer service, sales, public speaking, community organizing or nonprofit work can translate particularly well.

Your Voice Is Your Tool

You won't have body language or a handshake to help build a connection.

Strong phone fundraisers use their voice to communicate warmth, confidence, urgency, empathy and conviction.

As part of the application process, we'll ask you to submit a short voice or video introduction.

No professional recording is required. We want to hear who you are, how you communicate and what you're passionate about.

Compensation & Growth

Guaranteed hourly wage - not commission.

  • $19-$24/hour

  • Starting rate: $19/hour

  • Opportunities to increase your hourly rate based on hours worked, performance and consistency

  • Performance-based bonuses and incentives

  • Paid training

  • Paid time off

  • Benefits after 3 months of full-time employment

  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement

Strong performers can earn more as they develop their fundraising skills and consistently meet their goals.

Schedule

  • 40 hours per week required

  • Monday-Friday

  • Fundraising shifts scheduled between 11 AM and 9 PM in your local time

  • No weekend work to start

  • Consistent availability required

Why Public Outreach?

You'll join a team where fundraising is treated as a professional skill.

You'll receive paid training, ongoing coaching, workshops and feedback while learning how to turn conversations about important issues into action.

If you're a strong communicator who wants to use your voice for meaningful work - and you're ready for the challenge of asking people to act - we'd love to hear from you.

Public Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants from all backgrounds are welcome, and accommodations are available throughout the hiring process.

Senior Software Engineer - Technical Lead

Job Description

Overview

Location:Pittsburgh preferred, or remote, U.S.-based

Type:Full-time technical leadership role

An Industry Defining Company

Karoo is a venture-backed startup, prior to Series A, on a mission to transform cardiovascular care.   • Strong communication skills with an ability to translate product requirements into technical task breakdowns.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Deep understanding of cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and cloud-native development.
  • Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB) and API design (RESTful, GraphQL).
  • Proven capability in system architecture, scalability, security best practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Why Join Us

  • Competitive salary and equity in an early-stage startup
  • Opportunity to define the technical solution from the ground up
  • Possibly fully remote work environment with flexible hours
  • Health benefits, learning stipends, and professional development support
  • A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership

Karoo Health welcomes all.

About Refold AI

Refold AI is the AI integration platform built for agents, made for modern SaaS companies that need to ship enterprise integrations at scale. We're reimagining integrations with AI agents that work like business consultants and integration engineers, building them 10x faster, in hours instead of days. The payoff: integrations stop being a bottleneck that costs you deals and burns margin, and become a growth engine. You win the enterprise deals that hinge on them, onboard faster, and scale without an army of consultants.

We've grown rapidly, reaching seven-figure ARR and 30+ paying customers, powering the product and professional services teams at modern SaaS companies, from Incorta, Kantata, and Coupa to Highradius, Naehas, and OvationCXM.

Refold AI has raised $6.5M from world-class investors including Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber), Tidal Ventures, and Better Capital.

About this role:

As a Customer Success Engineer, you'll own technical product support for Refold's customers. When an integration fails, a workflow behaves unexpectedly, or a customer is blocked, you're the one who finds out why and gets them running again.

This is a hands-on support role. Most of your time goes into triaging tickets, debugging integrations across customer systems, and working with Engineering on root-cause fixes. You'll also turn what you learn into docs, tooling and product feedback, so the same issue doesn't come back.

What you'll do:

Own the support queue

  • Be the first technical responder for customer issues raised through [ticketing tool], email and shared Slack channels.

  • Triage by severity and business impact, and meet response and resolution SLAs.

  • Keep customers updated with clear, honest status until every issue is closed.

Debug integrations end to end

  • Investigate failed workflow runs, auth errors, rate limits, field-mapping and schema mismatches, webhook failures, and data-sync gaps between systems like SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite and Salesforce.

  • Read logs, API traces, and run history to isolate root causes, and reproduce issues in test environments.

  • Fix configuration and workflow issues yourself; escalate product bugs to Engineering with clear repro steps, impact and evidence.

Handle incidents

  • Act as first responder on high-severity incidents and coordinate between Engineering and the customer.

  • Write post-incident summaries and root-cause analyses that customers can trust.

  • Join an on-call rotation [with partial overlap with US business hours].

Make support scale

  • Write and maintain troubleshooting guides, runbooks, FAQs and help-centre articles.

  • Spot repeat issues and push for product fixes, clearer error messages or self-serve tooling.

  • Use AI agents and automation, including Refold itself, to speed up triage, diagnosis and routine support work.

Be the voice of the customer

  • Tag and trend tickets, and share top issues and feature requests with Product every sprint/month.

  • Help customer teams adopt good support practices and self-serve resources after go-live.

What we're looking for:

  • 2–5 years in technical support, product support, support engineering or integration engineering at a B2B SaaS company.

  • A strong grasp of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and HTTP, plus authentication methods like OAuth 2.0 and API keys.

  • Comfort debugging with Postman, cURL and browser dev tools, and reading application logs.

  • Working knowledge of SQL and a scripting language such as Python or JavaScript; you can read code to follow what a workflow is doing.

  • An understanding of data mapping and transformation between systems with different data models.

  • Experience with a support or ticketing tool such as Zendesk, Intercom, Freshdesk or Jira Service Management.

  • Clear, calm written communication, especially when a customer's production workflow is down.

  • A bias for ownership: you follow an issue through to resolution instead of handing it off.

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise systems such as SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, Salesforce or HubSpot.

  • Experience with iPaaS or embedded integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, Boomi, Paragon or Merge.

  • Familiarity with LLM-based or agentic workflows and how to debug them.

  • Exposure to cloud and observability tools: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Datadog, Grafana or Sentry.

  • Experience at an early-stage startup where you helped build support processes from scratch.

Szukamy Senior Systems Engineera / Senior Systems Engineerki, który/a połączy doświadczenie techniczne z podejściem skoncentrowanym na użytkowniku. Jeśli lubisz rozwiązywać złożone problemy, usprawniać istniejące usługi i wdrażać technologie, które przynoszą konkretną wartość – ta rola jest dla Ciebie.

O roli i zespole

Dołączysz do obszaru Collaboration Services, odpowiedzialnego za rozwój i utrzymanie usług współpracy opartych na ekosystemie Microsoft 365 w międzynarodowym środowisku enterprise.

Twoim głównym obszarem odpowiedzialności będą Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Teams Rooms oraz technologie wykorzystywane w salach konferencyjnych. Będziesz rozwijać rozwiązania zapewniające spójne, niezawodne i intuicyjne doświadczenia podczas spotkań oraz współpracy między zespołami i lokalizacjami.

Na co dzień będziesz:

  • Monitorować usługi, identyfikować potencjalne problemy i wdrażać usprawnienia, zanim wpłyną na użytkowników.

  • Współpracować z lokalnymi zespołami IT, użytkownikami, dostawcami i partnerami technologicznymi.

  • Wspierać adopcję Microsoft Teams i innych narzędzi Microsoft 365, analizując potrzeby użytkowników i przekładając ich feedback na konkretne usprawnienia.

  • Testować nowe funkcjonalności Microsoft 365, w tym rozwiązania AI, Microsoft 365 Copilot i Agents.

W zależności od Twojego doświadczenia i zainteresowań będziesz mieć również możliwość pracy z szerszym ekosystemem Microsoft 365, obejmującym SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange, Planner, Viva, Loop, Stream, Forms, a także Digital Signage, usługi SMTP, rozwiązania Adobe oraz zarządzanie licencjami Microsoft 365.

Nie musisz znać wszystkich tych technologii. Kluczowe jest doświadczenie w obszarze Teams i Teams Rooms oraz gotowość do rozwijania kompetencji w kolejnych usługach.

  • Komunikatywność, otwartość na dzielenie się wiedzą i chęć poznawania nowych technologii.

  • Biegła znajomość języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie.

Dodatkowym atutem będzie:

  • Znajomość PowerShell, Power Automate i Microsoft Graph oraz doświadczenie w automatyzacji procesów administracyjnych.

  • Doświadczenie z SharePoint Online, OneDrive i Exchange Online.

  • Znajomość Microsoft 365 Copilot, M365 Agents i możliwości wykorzystania AI w usługach IT.

  • Doświadczenie w zarządzaniu licencjami Microsoft 365.

  • Znajomość pozostałych usług Microsoft 365, takich jak Planner, Viva, Loop, Stream czy Forms.

  • Doświadczenie z Digital Signage, usługami SMTP, integracjami systemowymi lub rozwiązaniami Adobe.

Co oferujemy naszym konsultantom

  • Współpracę w formule B2B opartą na partnerskich zasadach.

  • Możliwość realizacji ambitnych projektów dla klientów z różnych branż.

  • Udział w projektach technologicznych z obszaru AI, data oraz transformacji cyfrowej.

  • Współpracę z organizacją realnie zaangażowaną w zrównoważony rozwój i odpowiedzialne wykorzystanie technologii.

  • Elastyczność w zakresie organizacji i sposobu realizacji zadań projektowych.

  • Poszerzanie doświadczeń poprzez udział w innowacyjnych przedsięwzięciach i wdrożeniach.

Knowit

Knowit to nordycka firma konsultingowa, która pomaga firmom, instytucjom publicznym i organizacjom odnosić sukcesy w transformacji cyfrowej. Dzięki ekspertyzie w obszarze tworzenia oprogramowania, AI, cyberbezpieczeństwa, usług chmurowych, cyfrowych doświadczeń klienta oraz doradztwa zarządczego, tworzymy rozwiązania, które przyczyniają się do bardziej zrównoważonego i skoncentrowanego na człowieku społeczeństwa.

jobs.excerpt: Estate Planning Paralegal Location: Fully Remote, United States Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.
jobs.description:
Estate Planning Paralegal

Location: Fully Remote, United States

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Eastern Time

Compensation: $60,000 - $70,000 depending on experience + 10% Bonus

About Rosenblum Law

Rosenblum Law is a high-volume estate planning firm experiencing significant growth. Our team includes both in-office and remote employees across the United States, and we make a deliberate effort to ensure our remote staff remains connected, informed, and fully integrated into the firm.

We work closely with our remote team through frequent department meetings, firmwide all-hands meetings, remote happy hours, and regular communication with attorneys, managers, and support staff. Our goal is for remote employees to feel as involved in the firm’s operations and culture as the employees working in our offices.

We value employees who take ownership of their work and are willing to step up when the team needs additional support. We offer performance-based bonus opportunities to recognize team members who consistently perform at a high level and contribute above and beyond the expectations of their role.

About the Role

Rosenblum Law is seeking an experienced Estate Planning Paralegal to join our growing estate planning team. This position is focused primarily on drafting trusts using WealthCounsel.

The right candidate will have substantial hands-on drafting experience and a strong understanding of trust provisions, distribution structures, fiduciary appointments, and customized estate planning language. This is not an entry-level position. Applicants must have at least three years of direct trust drafting experience and be comfortable working independently in a high-volume, client-focused environment.

In addition to drafting, this role involves communicating directly with clients to clarify their wishes, gather missing information, explain next steps, and help move matters through the estate planning process.

Responsibilities

  • Draft revocable living trusts, wills, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, and related estate planning documents using WealthCounsel
  • Review client information, attorney notes, questionnaires, and design documents before drafting
  • Prepare customized trust provisions based on each client’s family structure, assets, goals, and distribution instructions
  • Draft specific clauses and language addressing beneficiary distributions, trusts for children, successor trustees, contingencies, special circumstances, and other client-specific needs
  • Identify missing, inconsistent, or unclear information before documents are finalized
  • Communicate directly with clients to clarify their wishes and obtain information needed for drafting
  • Coordinate with attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and other members of the estate planning team
  • Revise documents based on attorney feedback and client-approved changes
  • Review documents for accuracy, consistency, formatting, spelling, names, dates, and legal instructions
  • Help ensure matters move efficiently from the information-gathering stage through drafting, review, and signing
  • Maintain organized and accurate client records and matter notes
  • Meet drafting deadlines while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail

Required Qualifications

  • At least three years of direct experience drafting trusts and estate planning documents
  • Professional experience using WealthCounsel for trust and estate planning document preparation
  • Experience communicating directly with clients in a client-facing capacity
  • Strong understanding of revocable living trusts, wills, powers of attorney, healthcare directives, and common estate planning structures
  • Demonstrated ability to draft customized clauses and trust language rather than relying only on standard templates
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies or missing information
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple matters and deadlines in a fully remote environment
  • Experience working with clients who have minor children, blended families, special distribution instructions, or complex family circumstances
Salary: $60,000 – $70,000 / year

Senior Business Analyst (Patient Registration, ADT, and EMPI)

We are seeking a Senior Business Analyst with a specialization in Patient Identity, Registration to support a large public sector health system's clinical information system modernization initiative. This role will lead the design, build and implementation of patient identification, registration and encounter management across a multi-site health system transitioning to a unified clinical information platform. The successful candidate will provide senior leadership and strategic advice to registration, patient access, health information management, clinical operations, clinicians, safety and quality, technical build and interface, reporting and finance teams. The focus is on standardizing patient identification and encounter management practices, aligning enterprise master patient index and client registry integration with clinical workflows, and addressing patient safety, patient flow and data quality across all care settings.

This position requires someone who can lead patient identity and enterprise master patient index design, registration and admit/discharge/transfer workflow standardization, and data conversion and interface alignment to support a multi-site health system transformation. The role encompasses planning and design of patient identification approaches including matching algorithms, duplicate and overlay prevention, and integration with provincial healthcare identifiers; standardizing registration, pre-registration and encounter workflows across emergency, inpatient and ambulatory settings; developing data conversion and migration strategies for patient demographic and encounter data from multiple source systems; defining and validating ADT and patient encounter interface requirements including HL7 messaging; leading workflow validation, testing, release readiness and go-live support activities; developing patient identification and encounter management policies and standards across participating organizations; and mentoring program personnel through knowledge transfer in facilitation, processes and documentation to enable long-term sustainment. Some after-hours and weekend work may be required with advance approval.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in health informatics, health information management or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and demonstrated senior experience with patient registration, patient identification and encounter management in EHR/CIS implementations
  • 12+ years - experience in patient identification, patient registration, admit/discharge/transfer or encounter management within EHR/CIS implementation or optimization in a health system, demonstrating progressive responsibility
  • 10+ years - leadership or high-level advisory role leading patient identification and encounter management design, build or implementation in a multi-site health system, including direct work with clinical workflows, clinical safety, quality teams and backoffice functions such as reporting and finance
  • 5+ years - implementing or integrating to a Client Registry or EMPI, demonstrating understanding of patient matching algorithms, corrections, reconciliations and integration to CIS/EHR patient identification workflows

Nice to Have

  • 5+ years - designing and implementing patient identification including enterprise master patient index design, matching rules, duplicate and overlay prevention and resolution, merge/unmerge processes, and integration with provincial or jurisdictional client registries and healthcare identifiers
  • 5+ years - designing and standardizing patient registration and pre-registration workflows including unidentified, newborn and name-change scenarios across large, medium and small facilities
  • 5+ years - designing and implementing encounter management including encounter types, visit numbering, admit/discharge/transfer, patient status and location, and encounter linking across care settings
  • 5+ years - demonstrated understanding of how patient identification and encounter management affect clinical care, patient flow and patient safety, including consequences of misidentification, duplicate or merged records and incorrect encounter assignment on orders, medications, results and blood products, and how registration and ADT workflows differ across emergency, inpatient, ambulatory and downtime settings
  • 3+ years - linking patient identification and encounter design to patient safety and data quality, including prevention of wrong-patient and wrong-encounter errors, and monitoring and remediation of identity data quality, with direct work with clinicians and clinical safety or quality teams and partnership with Health Information Management and Clinical Operations
  • 2 project references - leading or participating in conversion and migration of patient demographic and encounter data including matching and cleansing across multiple source systems and reconciliation before go-live
  • 3+ years - experience with ADT and other patient and encounter-related interfaces including HL7 messaging and feeds to downstream clinical, financial and provincial systems
  • 3+ years - developing patient identification and encounter management policies and standards and chairing or leading working groups or governance forums across multiple organizations
  • 2 project references - leading or participating in workflow validation, testing, release readiness, clinical and technical cutover, and go-live and stabilization support including registration downtime and recovery procedures
  • 3+ years - working with registration, patient access, health information management and clinical staff, and developing and supporting education and adoption for registration and encounter workflows
  • 5+ years - experience with the registration, ADT and master patient index capabilities of a major enterprise EHR/CIS platform with the ability to apply this experience to the platform selected for the program
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; French is an asset

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to assess organizational impacts, improve change readiness, manage resistance, and ensure employees successfully adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement the organization's change management strategy, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate transformation objectives into structured change management plans and implementation roadmaps.
  • Establish change management standards, governance structures, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Assess organizational readiness and identify potential challenges associated with planned changes.
  • Align change management activities with corporate strategy and transformation priorities.

B. Organizational Change & Transformation

  • Lead change initiatives involving organizational restructuring, operating model redesign, business process improvement, and operational transformation.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify effects on employees, departments, workflows, and systems.
  • Develop implementation plans to support smooth transitions across business functions.
  • Coordinate change activities across multiple projects and transformation programmes.
  • Ensure new organizational structures, processes, and procedures are effectively adopted.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop appropriate engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners.
  • Develop and deliver change communication plans, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Address employee concerns, manage resistance, and build commitment to transformation initiatives.
  • Establish feedback channels to monitor stakeholder sentiment and change effectiveness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Adoption

  • Lead change management activities related to digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to assess the organizational impact of technology changes.
  • Develop employee training, awareness, and user adoption programmes.
  • Monitor system adoption and ensure successful transition to new digital working practices.

E. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Partner with HR to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to improve organizational culture, employee engagement, and leadership alignment.
  • Identify employee capability gaps and coordinate training and development activities.
  • Support managers in leading teams through organizational transitions.
  • Promote adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Monitor change readiness, employee adoption, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Ensure change initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Performance Monitoring & Benefits Realization

  • Establish change management KPIs, adoption metrics, and performance dashboards.
  • Track employee engagement, training completion, stakeholder readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Monitor whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for senior management and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 10–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational development, business transformation, or programme management.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or organizational transformation leadership role.

  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.

  • Experience supporting digital transformation, technology adoption, business process redesign, and organizational restructuring.
  • Strong leadership, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of the organization's change management strategy.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Effectiveness of stakeholder communication and engagement.

  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.

NIKI is looking for graduates of Technical University Departments/ Schools of Sciences/ Computer Engineering, or similar disciplines to develop, model and analyze the energy storage systems of the future for the automotive industry.

Become a member of NIKI Digital Engineering!

If you have completed your studies or doctorate and are looking for new challenges, interdisciplinary and diverse teams, and projects, send us your resume.

Our strategy is to transfer the know-how into practice. TWT is our trusted long-term partner, sharing and supporting our vision. Through close, daily collaboration, we design and deliver innovative solutions for clients and partners across the energy, health, and automotive industries. Combining interdisciplinary expertise in IT, digital engineering, and consulting, we turn ideas into impactful results that reflect our shared vision for progress.

What to expect

  • Be a member of a TOP team. Highly qualified, innovative, and interconnected.
  • Get involved with topics at the forefront of technology: Artificial Intelligence, Autonomous Driving, E-Mobility, Model Based Systems Engineering, or Virtual Experience.
  • Acquire social skills and engage with professionals in the field of data science.
  • Collaborate with a group of international professionals on different projects.
  • Advance your knowledge and career towards managerial roles.
  • A dynamic, challenging environment resulting in continuous learning / education /progression.
  • An enjoyable and international work culture.
  • Ability to expand knowledge and responsibilities.
  • An opportunity to influence the direction of a fast-growing area of the business.

Task Description

  • Develop, model and analyze the energy storage systems of the future focusing on performance, safety and sustainability using modern methodologies.
  • Create and optimize simulation technologies to model and understand electrochemical mechanisms in battery systems accurately and efficiently.
  • Combine and advance modern data-analytics methods to support the physical understanding and modelling of aging phenomena in batteries.
  • Analyze closely related E-Mobility applications with a focus on thermo-management.
  • Generate, maintain, and improve internal simulation tools with respect to accuracy and performance.
  • Coordinate our interdisciplinary projects in close cooperation with our customers
  • Creatively catalyze innovative ideas and work with your colleagues from interdisciplinary teams on technological visions, also in the framework of national and international research projects.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master’s degree with top grades in Mathematics, Computer Science, Natural Sciences, Technology or similar discipline, preferably with a PhD.
  • Expertise in electrical energy storage systems and thermodynamics.
  • Know-how in modeling electrochemical phenomena.
  • Experience in the dimensioning and design of battery applications, from the cell level to the pack system.
  • Experience in coding, mathematical modelling, numerical simulation (preferably CFD or FEM).
  • Strong presentation and communication skills combined with excellent technical understanding and a confident demeanor.
  • Excellent command of the English language and technical terminology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Enjoy interaction and direct communication, with a strong customer focus, assertiveness, and a sense of responsibility.
  • Highly self-motivated and a team player -ideally with first experience working in young, dynamic teams.
  • Innovative mindset, initiative, strong analytical and entrepreneurial thinking—and a good sense of humor.
  • Good command of the German language.

What we offer

  • Structured learning on the job, professional feedback, and a mentor open to all your questions.
  • Innovative, highly technically demanding industry and research projects, interdisciplinary teams, and highly qualified colleagues.
  • Open doors, and the chance to take over responsibility quickly – participate, shape, and leave your fingerprint.
  • Discover new talents and shape your career path: Become a specialist, project manager, or manager.
  • Simultaneous, collaborative work using modern digital platforms.
  • Workplace flexibility.
  • Flexible working hours thanks to our attractive flextime model - only compatible projects.
  • Enjoy working with great colleagues in your day-to-day work.

Are you intrigued to find out more about this position? Then apply for a job with us!

Description

Our multi-year, flagship initiative drives business transformation within the Workers Compensation (WC) line of business, powered by modern technology and a product-centric mindset. At its core, the program is about reimagining how we serve our customers—now and into the future—through a fully modernized platform that enables WC Claims to meet evolving expectations with agility and impact.

We’re looking for passionate and strategic Product Owner whose role is critical to shaping the program's success, translating complex technical concepts into meaningful business outcomes, and anticipating stakeholder needs to deliver value at every stage. If you thrive in a space where transformation meets execution, and where leadership means driving clarity, collaboration, and customer-centric innovation—this is your opportunity to make a lasting impact.

As a member of the Agile team, the Product Owner II represents the voice of the customer and the organization through the delivery of business value. This person works closely with stakeholders (business and technology), including LOB leadership, to define and prioritize features and stories, ensuring alignment with customer needs and organizational goals. This person understands customers` problems in detail and ensures the problems are clearly defined, prioritized and the squad/team is focused on the most valuable work. The Product Owner is the team member always communicating with stakeholders to ensure an aligned understanding of how the squad/team can provide the highest value to the customer through the lens of the portfolio. This person collaborates with squads/teams, technologies, and architects across portfolios to develop a deep understanding of the technologies and systems they support.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborates to create product vision and alignment with strategic priorities with stakeholders
  • Contributes to the development of the portfolio vision

  • With the squad/team, collaboratively accountable for developing and achieving product level KPIs
  • Manages product(s) with a moderate degree of strategy, scope, and complexity
  • Owns and maintains the product backlog and is accountable for its contents and prioritization
  • Accountable for clear, actionable user stories.
  • Sets priorities and actively participates in squad/team quarterly planning

jobs.title: Performance Creative Lead
jobs.excerpt: About Rugiet Health Rugiet is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer telemedicine companies in the US, redefining men's health.
jobs.description:
About Rugiet Health

Rugiet is one of the fastest-growing direct-to-consumer telemedicine companies in the US, redefining men's health. We combine clinical rigor, bespoke compounded medications, and a premium digital patient experience to deliver personalized treatments that genuinely work. Our flagship men's health platform has built a loyal patient base that keeps coming back, and we are now expanding into sleep, longevity, and peptide-based therapeutics. We move fast, hold ourselves to a high standard, and care deeply about the patients we serve. If you want to build something that matters, Rugiet is the place to do it.

The role

The Performance Creative Lead will drive creative strategy for Rugiet’s longevity and new product portfolio, from launch through scale. You’ll turn customer insight, product positioning, and performance data into roadmaps, briefs, and tests that find winning messages and drive growth.

This is a hands-on role working across growth, product marketing, creative, paid social, analytics, and compliance. You’ll own briefing and creative reporting for the portfolio, develop product roadmaps for growth leadership approval, and partner with internal and external teams to bring concepts to market.

What you’ll do

  • Maintain a rolling two-month creative roadmap for each live product, broken out by week, with audiences, angles, formats, and target ship dates. Bring roadmaps and the new product launch calendar to growth leadership for approval.
  • Coordinate creative readiness for new product launches and develop an initial creative strategy as part of each go-to-market plan, from demand capture to demand creation. Partner with product marketing on messaging and value propositions.
  • Work with the Head of Growth to set creative volume targets by product based on win rate, scale, and the path to revenue run rate. Balance net-new concepts and iterations as each product matures, and allocate brief volume across partners based on performance.
  • Own creative briefing for the longevity and new product portfolio, including direction on formats, angles, and hooks. Translate product positioning and research into clear, actionable briefs, and identify the initial target persona for each product’s first acquisition push.
  • Write scripts for internal video ads and manage a steady stream of briefs for internal video and static production. Brief external creative partners, guide concept direction, and align them to the roadmap and product-level volume targets.
  • Own portfolio creative performance reporting in Rugiet’s standard format for the weekly performance review and biweekly ad and influencer pipeline leadership review. Explain the trends and insights behind results and use them to direct the next roadmap.
  • Establish product-level win rates appropriate to creative volume and spend, particularly before campaigns mature into a testing and scaling structure. Partner with paid social and analytics to investigate product-specific trends, distinguish weak creative from insufficient data, and decide what to expand, iterate, or stop.
  • Partner with product marketing to define target audiences by product. Conduct regular audience, review, content-trend, and competitive research; determine where audiences differ by SKU; and turn research and survey findings into creative tests.
  • Partner with creative strategy enablement and AI specialists to use AI tools that improve the speed and depth of research.
  • Share upcoming creative strategy and performance insights with the landing page and CRO teams. Recommend messaging, content, or persona tests and flag when a paid social audience or angle needs a dedicated landing page.
  • Partner with clinical and compliance teams on product-specific claims and guardrails so they are clear in the creative brief.
  • Support sexual health creative strategy and briefing during launches, peak demand, or planned absences as prioritized by leadership. Share learnings across product lines while the sexual health lead retains accountability for that portfolio.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years of experience in creative strategy, performance creative, direct-response marketing, or a closely related field, including experience leading strategy across teams or partners.
  • A track record of developing and scaling creative that drives measurable acquisition or revenue outcomes. You can explain the insight, test design, results, and your role in the work.
  • Deep paid social fluency, especially Meta, with experience across channels such as TikTok and YouTube and an understanding of how creative, media, and landing pages work together.
  • Strong consumer psychology, copy, and concepting skills. You can turn a customer objection or data point into a compelling hook, angle, and brief.
  • Experience building high-volume testing programs and managing competing priorities across products, creative teams, and external partners.
  • Comfort using performance data to make decisions, distinguish signal from noise, and translate results into the next round of creative.
  • Experience directing UGC, creators, influencers, or expert-led content, with sound judgment about what feels native and credible.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership and communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders and bring teams together without relying on formal authority.
  • A hands-on, curious approach and comfort moving quickly in a changing DTC environment.

A plus

  • Experience in healthcare, telehealth, men’s health, wellness, or another regulated consumer category.
  • Experience with subscription commerce, advertorial funnels, creator whitelisting, or multiple products and customer segments.
  • Experience developing creative that performs within complex claims, disclosure, and platform-policy constraints.

What success looks like

  • A live two-month roadmap for each product in market, updated weekly and visible to leadership and partners, with clear launch readiness dates and measurable partner adherence.
  • Consistent weekly delivery of internal and partner briefs and creative against product-level volume targets, with a repeatable launch workback schedule.
  • A documented, research-backed target audience, including customer language and pain points, for each product before its first brief; new segments are identified and tested regularly.
  • A repeatable approach to finding and scaling winning messages, with a product-level win-rate baseline established within the first 60 days of launch and measures evolving as spend and volume mature.
  • Clear weekly and biweekly reporting that connects creative decisions to product revenue run-rate objectives, identifies when data is insufficient, and recommends which tests to expand or stop.
  • Product and audience learnings are shared with landing page and CRO partners and applied to subsequent launches.

To Apply

If you’re excited by the opportunity to make a significant impact on a growing healthcare company by building and scaling our creative program, please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you’re a great fit for this role.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for backend engineers to build the core systems behind BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This role is for engineers who can build reliable APIs, workflows and financial product infrastructure that can scale across markets, partners and millions of users.

What You'll Own

  • Build backend services and APIs for onboarding, accounts, payments, cards, transfers, rewards, travel, FX, KYC and risk flows.

  • Design reliable systems that can support real customer transactions, operational workflows and future financial products.

  • Integrate with internal systems, financial partners, payment providers, AI services and third-party platforms.

  • Own backend quality across reliability, security, latency, observability, data integrity and incident handling.

  • Work with product, frontend, mobile and AI teams to launch features quickly and safely.

  • Improve existing systems by simplifying flows, removing manual work and automating repeatable processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong backend engineering experience in production systems.

  • Good understanding of APIs, databases, authentication, authorization, queues, jobs, events and integrations.

  • Experience building services used by real customers or internal operations at meaningful scale.

  • Strong debugging, reliability, security and data quality mindset.

  • Able to make practical trade-offs between speed, correctness, scalability and maintainability.

  • Fintech, payments, banking, wallet, KYC, fraud or risk experience is a strong plus, but not required if fundamentals are strong.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want isolated backend tasks.

  • People who ignore security, data consistency, monitoring or operational risk.

  • Developers who cannot work with fast-changing product requirements.

  • Candidates who talk about scale but have not handled production systems.

  • People who exaggerate impact without being clear on ownership.


The Bar

We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Korea. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Korea.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Technical interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

That foundation — capital, licensing, infrastructure and an established international client base — is what makes the next stage possible: building genuinely new product lines in Stocks, ETFs, Investing, Wealth and Prediction Markets, aimed at a much larger consumer audience than our existing trading business alone.

  • At least 1 year of experience in a Customer Support or Sales role within a regulated financial services company.
  • Fluent in Arabic and English, both written and spoken.

Change Management Director – Insurance & Investments

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Role Summary

The Change Management Director is responsible for developing and leading the organization's change management strategy to ensure successful adoption of business transformation, organizational restructuring, digital initiatives, process improvements, and strategic transformation programmes.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role oversees enterprise-wide change initiatives involving operating model redesign, technology implementation, regulatory changes, organizational culture, workforce transformation, and business process modernization.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to minimize resistance to change, strengthen organizational readiness, engage stakeholders, and ensure transformation initiatives deliver sustainable business outcomes.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop and implement enterprise-wide change management strategies, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate organizational transformation objectives into structured change management plans.
  • Lead change management activities across strategic programmes, projects, and business units.
  • Establish change governance structures, standards, and performance monitoring mechanisms.
  • Advise executive leadership on organizational readiness, change impacts, and adoption strategies.

B. Organizational Transformation & Change Implementation

  • Lead organizational change initiatives involving restructuring, operating model redesign, and business transformation.
  • Assess the impact of strategic changes on employees, processes, systems, and organizational structures.
  • Develop change implementation roadmaps, communication plans, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Coordinate change activities across business functions to ensure consistent implementation.
  • Ensure new processes, systems, and organizational structures are effectively embedded into daily operations.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop targeted engagement strategies.
  • Work closely with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners to build commitment to change.
  • Lead executive communication, employee engagement, and organizational awareness initiatives.
  • Address stakeholder concerns and manage resistance to organizational changes.
  • Establish feedback mechanisms to monitor employee sentiment and change readiness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Management

  • Lead change management activities associated with digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and new business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT and technology teams to assess the organizational impact of system implementations.
  • Develop training programmes, user adoption strategies, and technology transition plans.
  • Monitor technology adoption and ensure employees effectively transition to new digital working practices.

E. Culture, People & Workforce Transformation

  • Partner with HR leadership to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to promote cultural transformation, leadership alignment, and employee engagement.
  • Identify capability gaps and develop workforce training and development strategies.
  • Support leadership teams in managing organizational transitions and behavioral changes.
  • Promote a culture of adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify potential risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and contingency plans to minimize disruption.
  • Monitor change adoption, employee engagement, and operational readiness.
  • Ensure change initiatives align with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Benefits Realization & Performance Monitoring

  • Define change management KPIs and adoption metrics.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of change communication, training, and implementation activities.
  • Measure employee adoption, stakeholder engagement, and organizational readiness.
  • Evaluate whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for executive leadership and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Organizational Psychology, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree or MBA in Business Administration, Organizational Development, or Change Management is preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of progressive experience in change management, organizational transformation, business transformation, or organizational development.
  • At least 5 years in a senior change management or transformation leadership position.
  • Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide change initiatives within complex organizations.
  • Experience in insurance, banking, investment management, or financial services is highly desirable.
  • Strong knowledge of organizational change management, stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, and benefits realization.
  • Experience managing change associated with digital transformation, technology implementation, restructuring, and operating model redesign.
  • Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, and executive stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Professional certifications such as Prosci Change Management, CCMP, APMG Change Management, or equivalent are advantageous.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Successful implementation of enterprise-wide change management strategies.
  • Employee adoption and engagement rates across transformation initiatives.
  • Organizational readiness and change acceptance scores.
  • Effectiveness of change communication and stakeholder engagement.
  • Completion rates of employee training and capability development programmes.
  • Reduction in resistance-related delays and implementation risks.
  • Successful adoption of new systems, processes, and operating models.
  • Achievement of transformation objectives and expected business benefits.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and executive feedback.
  • Compliance with change governance and reporting requirements.

Examples include pipeline and capacity planning, pricing and packaging, and territory and segment strategy.

This role is for someone with a consulting, finance, or BizOps background who likes working with data. You will work closely with executive decision-makers, take on real ownership early, and see a clear line from your work to bookings, retention, and company growth. You will learn directly from our GTM leader. The role reports directly to our GTM leader.

  • Be the GTM Leader’s Thought Partner: Act as a sounding board on revenue topics. Help the GTM leader prepare for executive reviews by building the analysis and materials behind them.

  • Deliver Clarity Through Data: Build the metrics, dashboards, and analyses (funnel conversion, sales velocity, win rates, retention, expansion, unit economics) that tell leadership where the business is working and where it is not. Turn insights into a clear “so what.”

  • Build Scalable Systems: Turn one-off analyses into repeatable processes and playbooks. You may also support comp plan analysis, deal desk and approval workflows, and onboarding and enablement.

  • Strategic operator: You structure ambiguous problems, define the “so what,” and turn recommendations into executed plans with owners and deadlines.

  • Hands-on mindset: You build your own models and also work with the people who need to act on them.

  • Structured communicator: You write concisely, distill complexity into simple, actionable insights, and bring executives along through your reasoning. We communicate heavily in writing.

  • Influencer without authority: You earn trust with sales, CS, and finance leaders and move them to act through credibility, not title.

  • Bias for action: You move fast, iterate, and stay focused on revenue impact. From day one you will have responsibility and access beyond your tenure.

  • Excited about the mission: You want to build at a hypergrowth startup modernizing one of the world’s largest industries.

  • Hybrid in NYC: In office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

  • 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

jobs.excerpt: About the project You will join a long-term support engagement for an enterprise client.
jobs.description:
About the project

You will join a long-term support engagement for an enterprise client. The product is a web platform that runs a formal, multi-stage review process from end to end: organisations submit applications, work through a structured evaluation, exchange supporting documents, answer requests for information and track their progress over a long cycle. It is used daily by the client's own staff, by the organisations going through the process, and by the external specialists who assess them.

The platform is a C# / .NET API with an Angular front end on SQL Server, hosted in Azure. Around it sits a set of connected systems: single sign-on, a secure document store for sensitive data, transactional email, a learning platform and several public websites.

Trinetix supports, maintains and develops the platform. You will be the engineer dedicated to the service desk: the person who owns the queue, keeps the system healthy, and hands the development team work that is already reproduced and understood.

What the work looks like

The queue is steady rather than overwhelming, and more than half of it is not code at all: access and log-in, how-to questions, data corrections, document handling. The rest are defects that need reproducing, then either fixing at configuration level or passing to development with the evidence attached.

Volume is seasonal. Scheduled events and large annual gatherings bring a rush of access requests in real time, and major releases bring periods of hypercare. You will feel both.

Responsibilities

Tickets and escalation

  • Resolve issues escalated from first-level support.
  • Triage the incoming queue: reproduce the reported behaviour, gather evidence, and separate user error, configuration and genuine defects.
  • Communicate and coordinate with L1 support and the L3 / development team. Write bug reports and user stories the development team can act on without going back to the reporter.
  • Correspond directly with the client's staff and with end users in clear, non-technical English, within agreed response and resolution targets.
  • Handle user administration and access issues: account provisioning, single sign-on, two-factor codes, duplicate and orphaned accounts.

System health and incidents

  • Monitor system performance and stability.
  • Sort, filter and analyse system logs.
  • Perform system recovery after failures.
  • Manage incidents end to end: response, analysis and post-mortems.
  • Respond to on-call alerts, investigate issues, and escalate when necessary.

Data and compliance

  • Write diagnostic SQL queries against the production schema, and run approved data-correction scripts with verification and a rollback plan.
  • Handle incidents involving sensitive personal data: delete mistakenly uploaded documents quickly, retrieve access logs, and record who accessed or downloaded the file. The platform operates under a strict regulatory regime.

Knowledge

  • Maintain runbooks and technical documentation, and build them out where they do not yet exist. A good deal of the operational knowledge is not written down yet.
  • Support releases, including hypercare after major launches.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years in application support (L1-L3) for a business-critical web application.
  • Jira and Jira Service Management: service-desk triage, SLA-driven ticket handling, clear bug and story writing.
  • SQL Server: reading a relational schema, writing diagnostic queries, and running prepared data-fix scripts safely.
  • Azure: Application Insights log queries, and a working understanding of App Services and Key Vault. Awareness of Azure DevOps releases.
  • Troubleshooting single sign-on: SAML and OAuth.
  • Incident management: triage, root-cause analysis, post-mortems.
  • Clear written and spoken English, B2-C1. You will write to the client's staff and to end users every day.
  • Daily overlap with the client's working hours, 10:00-19:00 US Central, Monday to Friday.

Nice to have

  • FusionAuth administration, Umbraco CMS, SendGrid, or a managed secure document-storage service.
  • Experience with regulated personal data (HIPAA, GDPR or an equivalent regime).
  • Experience with certification, audit or other regulated compliance systems.

Why this role is worth taking

  • You are the first dedicated support engineer on the account, not the fifth. The queue, the runbooks and the way triage works are yours to shape.
  • A structured onboarding, with time to learn the system from the people who have been running it.
  • A small team, two developers and a QA engineer, and direct contact with the client rather than three layers of process.
  • Work that carries weight: the organisations on this platform cannot do without the process it supports.

What we offer

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities
  • Professional training and English/Spanish language classes
  • Comprehensive medical insurance
  • Mental health support
  • Specialized benefits program with compensation for fitness activities, hobbies, pet care, and more
  • Flexible working hours
  • Inclusive and supportive culture

About Us

Established in 2011, Trinetix is a dynamic tech service provider supporting enterprise clients around the world.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

What You'll Own
