The Opportunity

We’re looking for a bilingual (Spanish/English) Part-Time HR Operations Coordinator to join our growing HR Consulting team. You’ll keep HR processes and payroll accurate and running smoothly for several clients at once, and you’ll build client relationships while contributing to meaningful HR projects.

This is an HR operations and client-facing role supporting small and mid-size organizations across many industries. The focus is on payroll processing, onboarding, HR compliance, HRIS and records management, and policy implementation. Several of our clients have Spanish-speaking employees, and you’ll be their go-to HR contact in both languages. You’ll handle day-to-day HR support, and you’ll also improve the workflows, templates and trackers behind it.

You’ll work with a collaborative team of experienced HR professionals who value knowledge-sharing, mentorship and continuous learning. Our firm is growing, and we offer a positive environment where your contributions matter and your professional growth is supported.

The Schedule

Core hours are 9:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. Eastern, when we need you reachable for clients. The remaining hours each week are yours to place — early mornings, evenings, whatever fits your life. We hold this schedule seriously; it is the reason the role exists as part-time rather than full-time.

We do ask for flexibility to pick up additional hours occasionally when client needs spike — open enrollment, an implementation go-live, an urgent employee relations matter.

A Note on Career Breaks

We welcome applicants returning to the workforce after time away. A gap on your resume is not a mark against you here — we care that you have the experience and that you are ready to use it. If you stepped back from a career in HR and want back in, we would like to hear from you.

  • Serve as a primary HR point of contact for assigned clients, ensuring timely and high-quality HR service delivery

  • Build and maintain onboarding and offboarding workflows, checklists and document templates across client HRIS platforms

  • Provide exceptional customer service to clients with a proactive and solution-oriented approach
  • Support benefits administration as needed

  • You would rather have twelve things on your plate than three, and you have a system for keeping all of them straight
  • You get bored when work gets repetitive, and you look for the next problem to solve
  • You take real pride in being the person a client can count on — responsiveness is part of your professional identity, not a requirement someone imposed on you
  • You are comfortable being the one who does the task, files the form, fixes the record, and sends the email
  • You are steady when three clients need you at once and one of them is upset
  • You are detail-obsessed. A wrong date on a leave notice, a typo in an offer letter, or a missed deduction on a paycheck bothers you

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of HR experience, preferably in a generalist or administrative role
  • Fluency in Spanish and English, both spoken and written (required)
  • Hands-on payroll processing experience, ideally across multiple payrolls or entities (required)
  • Hands-on experience with multiple HRIS/payroll systems (e.g., ADP, Paylocity, BambooHR, Gusto, Rippling)

  • Benefits administration experience is a plus
  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or related field required

Preferred

  • Multi-state payroll experience
  • PHR, SPHR, SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, or Fundamental Payroll Certification (FPC)
  • Proficiency across the Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel

Compensation and Benefits

  • 401(k) with company match
  • Professional development assistance, including certification support

Solutions Engineer

Backblaze (Nasdaq: BLZE) | Remote, US | AI and application storage Solutions Engineering | Reports to the Solutions Engineering Manager (the VP of Solutions Engineering until the manager is hired) | Works with Account Executives, Product, Support, and the Solutions Engineering team

Salary range:$99,000-$108,000 plus variable pay and RSUs.

How We Got Here

We started by building storage servers from scratch in a Palo Alto apartment to save 90% on hardware. Turns out hard constraints make for pretty good engineering. That discipline forged a platform that performs as well or better than competitors, scales to multi-exabyte workloads, and costs a fraction of what AWS or Google charge. AI infrastructure runs on data. Storage gets hard at scale. We've been breaking, rebuilding, and improving that storage layer for 20 years.

Today, the world's leading AI infrastructure providers, neoclouds, and data-intensive businesses run on Backblaze. Our platform includes:

  • B2 Overdrive - high-throughput object storage engineered for AI infrastructure, GPU workloads, and massive-scale data pipelines
  • B2 Neo - white-label enterprise cloud storage powering neocloud platforms for AI, HPC, and media
  • B2 Cloud Storage - S3-compatible object storage with predictable pricing, free egress, and no lock-in
  • Computer Backup - automatic, continuous endpoint backup for Macs and PCs

500,000+ customers. 175 countries. Nasdaq: BLZE. backblaze.com

The Role

Backblaze sells a technical product, so Solutions Engineers join the deal at the first discovery conversation, before it is qualified. You will partner with Account Executives to learn what a customer needs, run the proof of concept that shows Backblaze fits, and stay close after the deal closes. This role focuses on AI and application storage customers.

Nearly every customer is replacing something they already run. Your job is to show where Backblaze slots into what they have already built, not to design their stack from scratch. You will earn trust by being curious, hands-on, and straight with customers about what the test shows.

This is not a demo-and-handoff role. If your instinct is to open a terminal, test a customer's real workload, and write down what you find, keep reading.

What You Will Do

  • Join discovery early. Work with the AE from the first conversation to learn the customer's workload, success criteria, and timeline.
  • Run proofs of concept. Define success with the customer, test Backblaze against what they run today, and report results plainly, including ones they didn't hope for.
  • Show where Backblaze fits. Explain how Backblaze slots into the customer's AI data pipeline alongside the compute, networking, and storage they already use.
  • Hand off cleanly. Take the lead through the technical win, then step back so the AE can carry the deal through negotiation.
  • Stay engaged after the sale. Answer questions in shared customer channels, help customers adopt the platform, and work with the AE on expansion.
  • Carry the field back to Product. Capture gaps and requests with evidence.
  • Share what you learn. Contribute benchmarks, technical content, and events.

What We Are Looking For

  • Curiosity. You dig into technical workflows and pick apart what customers tell you. This is the trait that matters most.
  • Programming fluency. You are comfortable in at least one language, any language, and use it to script tests and automate work.
  • Customer-facing experience. You have worked directly with customers in solutions engineering, support, technical account management, consulting, or a similar role. A sales background is not required.
  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure. You can explain how compute, storage, and networking fit into an AI data pipeline and where a storage layer sits. Experience on any cloud counts, whether AWS, Google, Azure, or CoreWeave. You don't need to have built these systems yourself.
  • Strong communication. You can explain a technical result clearly to an engineer or an executive, and you listen well.
  • Hands-on habits. You test things yourself and write down what you find.

Also True of the Right Person

  • Experience across a whole deal at a smaller company, from discovery through post-sale
  • Experience with object storage or the S3 API, or with AI and GPU workloads such as training, inference, and checkpointing
  • Familiarity with a sales qualification method such as MEDDPICC
  • Experience supporting customers after close, including expansions

This Is Not the Role for You If

  • You want to stay at the demo layer rather than test real workloads
  • You wait for an AE to ask before you engage
  • You see the job as finished at signature rather than after the customer is live

How We Will Interview

You will have four conversations: a recruiter screen, the hiring manager, our principal solutions architect, and a member of the Solutions Engineering team. We will ask you to walk us through a proof of concept you ran, including a result the customer did not hope for and how you reported it. We will ask about a technical problem you dug into yourself, and how you work with customers and Account Executives.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity package
  • Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, and 401(k) with matching
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook to use for work, plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • A collaborative and transparent culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Pay Transparency and Equal Opportunity

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

Salary range:$99,000-$108,000 plus variable pay and RSUs.

We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. Our team of experts is obsessed with the connection between the people, processes, and technology that make healthcare organizations hum. Join us and help build the healthcare experience we want for our communities, our families, and ourselves.

Summary

Responsibilities

About the Role


Solve the billing puzzles that keep claims moving and payments accurate.


As an Epic Professional Billing Analyst at Hummingbird, you’ll support effective service delivery on the claims and remittance side of Professional Billing. You’ll diagnose issues, build and test changes, and partner with the business office to keep billing operations accurate, compliant, and running smoothly. Most of your day is spent troubleshooting real-time issues, evaluating automated credit adjustments, mapping payers, and translating business needs into reliable, well-documented solutions in Epic.


You’ll work with growing autonomy with the support of a team that can mentor you and encourage your growth. This is a role for someone who stays organized, thinks through problems creatively, and can articulate the choices behind a decision with confidence.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyze workflows, data, and reported issues to identify root causes and keep billing running accurately.
  • Troubleshoot real-time claims and remittance issues as they come in, including credit adjustments and new payer mapping.
  • Build, test, and validate configuration and process changes in Epic Professional Billing so they meet requirements without introducing regressions.
  • Build and review work queue changes as needed so claims and follow-up items route to the right teams.
  • Gather and document requirements through conversations with the business office and other stakeholders, translating business needs into clear, testable solutions.
  • Execute changes through defined processes to maintain system compliance, auditability, and accurate documentation.
  • Maintain clear records of what changed, who requested it, and why, so past decisions can be referenced and explained later.
  • Partner with the business office and cross-functional teams to confirm shared understanding before implementing updates.
  • Escalate issues when risk, complexity, or impact exceed defined thresholds, and pull in support when needed.
  • Provide coverage across other areas of the Professional Billing application as team bandwidth requires.
  • Deliver assigned work in line with SLAs, quality standards, and performance expectations.

The Details

  • Employment Eligibility: Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
  • Work Location: Remote. You must work from a location within the United States with consistent Internet service. Pacific or Mountain time zone is preferred, and comfort flexing your schedule to cover Pacific business hours is important.
  • Work Type: Full-time
  • Schedule: Weekdays during core business hours, with some flexibility to support the client’s PST business hours in real time.
  • Compensation: Expected range is $79,000 to $103,000. New hires usually start between $79,000 and $95,000, depending on experience and internal equity.
  • Travel: Up to four times per year for client site visits, system upgrades, or an Epic immersion trip.
  • On-Call: This role includes a paid on-call rotation, typically one to two weeks per quarter. A $200 stipend is provided for each week you are on call.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage; paid time off; 401(k); parental leave; career development support; and more.
  • Training: Paid, structured onboarding and ongoing mentorship.

Required & Desired Skills

What You’ll Bring

  • 2+ years of experience in an analyst, billing, or business office role focused on problem solving, requirements gathering, testing, and solution implementation.
  • Active Epic Professional Billing certification required at time of hire.
  • Strong understanding of the revenue cycle, especially the claims and remittance side, including how payers process, reject, and pay claims and what their requirements are.
  • Background working in or closely with a health system business office, for example as a biller, claims examiner, or auditor.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to investigate root causes, synthesize findings, and recommend solutions.
  • Proficiency documenting requirements, test results, and system changes clearly, with the ability to recall and explain past decisions.
  • Comfort communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including the confidence to express an informed opinion and stand behind it.
  • Able to provide on-call support during scheduled times.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing multiple workstreams or tasks in parallel across systems, stakeholders, or delivery workflows.
  • Exposure to other areas of the Professional Billing application beyond claims and remittance, with the flexibility to cover them when needed.
  • Experience working on a distributed or remote team, ideally in a start-up or fast-paced environment.

What Helps You Shine

  • Please note that we use both your resume and your written and oral communication throughout the hiring process to understand your fit for this role.
  • Thoughtful, clear responses help us see your attention to detail, your professionalism, and your ability to communicate with care, all skills that are essential for success on our team.

Expectations for Focus & Presence

  • To support patients and each other, this role requires your full attention during scheduled work hours. Our Outside Employment Policy doesn’t allow overlapping work or “job stacking,” so any outside work must happen fully outside your Hummingbird schedule.
  • We’re a camera-ready team, and you’ll need to be on camera during training and when needed during the workday after training ends.
  • We value connection, teamwork, and being present, which is what keeps our patients safe and our team supported. If that’s what you’re looking for, you’ll feel at home here. If you’re hoping to hold another job during the same hours, this job won’t be the best match.

Please Note: The seniority level of this position may be adjusted during the recruitment process based on candidate skills and experience.

Job Description Summary

Are you a critical thinker who can analyze complex risk and find insurance solutions that balance customer needs with business goals? If you can take initiative, use both your analytical and creative abilities to make sound decisions and have a desire to help people solve real challenges, we want to hear from you!

Our Excess & Surplus/Specialty (E&S/S) lines allow us to provide insurance that other carriers may not offer. It’s a fast-paced environment in a collaborative, team-oriented culture, working in an always-changing, growing industry.

As an Underwriting Specialist in Contract you determine individual risk acceptability, pricing, coverage, terms and conditions, by developing, analyzing and evaluating information and exposures on risks of a complex technical nature for the assigned line of business. In addition, you’ll achieve production and loss ratio goals with assigned general agents or program managers by reviewing and analyzing claims, loss history and taking appropriate action on accounts. General agent assignments are more complex in terms of coverage and general agent relationships. It’s important to establish and maintain effective relationships with general agents to generate premium dollars and profitability. You will work independently with a high level of authority and judgment. Determining appropriate reinsurance placement, if any, on individual accounts is an important element of this role. We will count on you to foster positive business relationships with co-workers, general agents and reinsurers. You will also assist with research, development and presentation of new products, forms and manuals and have opportunities to assist in the training and mentoring of Underwriters and Underwriting Assistants.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Reviews individual risks with assigned agents or programs within assigned territory and either declines or accepts business based upon information necessary to make the decision. The underwriter analyzes, with a high level of technical expertise, exposures to loss, develops an adequate premium charge for the exposure and determines appropriate endorsements and exclusions to address loss exposures for the insurance contract. Within department guidelines, places reinsurance, if any, for the account.

  • Achieves individual production and loss ratio goals within assigned territory through sound territory management and marketing. Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Works with more complex issues concerning coverage, programs, agents and program managers. The underwriter continually analyzes premium and loss results in their territory or assigned agents by agency, state, major class of business and by program. Continually assess quality of submissions and makes corrective action recommendations. Development and implementation of specific action plans may be required

  • Handles policy maintenance items and other mid-term requests. Reviews endorsement requests and processes necessary changes to the policy. Reviews loss control reports and makes recommendations to the agent and/or changes to the policy. Follows up on outstanding information as required. Reviews claim activity and takes appropriate action. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans.

  • Fosters positive business relationships with general agents through daily contact with assigned agents by developing and maintaining good rapport and resolving agency conflicts. Travels to agency offices as required for audits, training or marketing visits. Entertains agents visiting the Company as required. Assists with development of marketing ideas and strategies for underwriting seminars and other marketing campaigns.

  • Places reinsurance per department guidelines based upon the appropriate use of all reinsurance facilities used by the department, including various treaty semiautomatic and facultative reinsurance. Maintains good working relationship with reinsurers.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Other responsibilities as assigned may include program research and development, form development, rate development, technical assistance to Agents, Underwriting Assistants, and other Underwriters. Proactively develops technical and business knowledge through internal and external venues

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Department Manager

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree preferred. Equivalent work experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.

License/Certification/Designation: Completion of general insurance courses such as CPCU, CIC, AU, ARM, CPIW, CWIS, or ASLI is preferred.

Experience: Six years related experience or five years as an underwriter, excess & surplus lines preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Knowledge of lines underwriting policies, practices and procedures, insurance law and underwriting marketing principles and techniques, rating plans and plan concepts, Treaty & Facultative reinsurance concepts, general agency system and company operations, regulatory issues, the general agency system, market conditions and company operations. Ability to communicate effectively, orally, and in writing, interpersonally with individuals and groups via telephone, fax, e-mail and in person. Demonstrates advanced negotiation skills. Ability to manage the assigned line or lines of business, which may include monitoring of aggregates. Ability to work with the wholesale/general agency distribution system. Ability to analyze insurance risks to determine acceptability including policy language, various commercial rating plans and methodologies, reinsurance. Ability to use/learn job related computer software. Ability to devise business solutions to problems, implement the most appropriate, and monitor its effectiveness. Ability to make decisions with minimal supervision.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office environment. Travel out of state as required several times a year. In-town entertaining required as necessary after 5:00 P.M.

This role is responsible for the administration, analysis, and execution of global compensation, including salary structure, incentive plans, and annual compensation cycles. This role provides compensation analysis, job architecture governance, and supports compensation planning activities to ensure pay practices are competitive, equitable, and aligned with the organization’s compensation philosophy and frameworks.

What you'll do

  • Support the execution and administration of global compensation programs and annual compensation cycles, including merit planning, promotions, and bonus and incentive planning processes.
  • Conduct compensation analysis, including pay equity reviews, market benchmarking, compa-ratio analysis, and compensation modeling to support informed compensation decisions.
  • Review and validate compensation recommendations to ensure alignment with compensation philosophy, structures, internal equity, and budget parameters.
  • Participate external compensation surveys, including job matching, data validation, submission, and interpretation of market results to inform compensation strategies.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and governance of job architecture, including job structures, grades, leveling, and compensation frameworks.
  • Prepare reports and dashboards compensation reports, modeling, and analysis to support annual compensation planning, bonus funding, workforce planning, and leadership decision-making.
  • Ensure compensation data integrity and compliance with compensation policies, guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Identify trends, anomalies, and areas requiring review or escalation.
  • Partner with People Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance and business leaders to provide consultative compensation guidance and analysis.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as required to support business needs.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years of experience in compensation, total rewards, HR, finance, or a related analytical function.
  • Experience working with compensation data, salary structures, incentive plans, or compensation planning processes.
  • Experience working with spreadsheets and data analysis tools, including advanced spreadsheet functionality.
  • Experience supporting compensation cycles such as merit increases, promotions, or bonus planning.
  • Familiarity with compensation benchmarking and market data concepts.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
  • Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information with discretion.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-functional environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • University degree in Human Resources, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting global or multi-country compensation programs.
  • Experience participating in compensation survey submissions and job matching (e.g., Radford, Mercer, Willis Towers Watson).
  • Experience working with job architecture, salary grades, and compensation frameworks.
  • Experience using HRIS and compensation planning tools (e.g., UKG, Workday, SuccessFactors, or similar systems).
  • Experience supporting annual compensation planning cycles, including merit and bonus processes.
  • Professional certification in compensation or human resources (e.g., CCP, GRP, PHR, or equivalent).
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, data-driven, or global organization.

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Department: Sales

Reports To: North America GTM

About Valiantys

Valiantys transforms how organizations work by delivering expert solutions that increase enterprise and team agility. As a leading global Atlassian partner, we help organizations unlock the full value of Atlassian's System of Work through cloud transformation, enterprise service management, agile transformation, and modern software development practices. Valiantys is trusted by enterprises worldwide to deliver measurable business outcomes and accelerate digital transformation initiatives.

Position Summary

Valiantys is seeking a highly motivated Sales Development Representative (SDR) to generate and qualify opportunities within enterprise and mid-market organizations. The SDR serves as the first point of contact for prospective clients, identifying business challenges, engaging key stakeholders, and creating qualified opportunities for the sales team.

Success in this role requires curiosity, resilience, strong communication skills, and a consultative mindset. You will collaborate closely with Marketing, Business Development Managers, Account Executives, and Solution Consultants to build pipeline and support Valiantys' growth across North America.

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Generation & Prospecting

  • Execute outbound prospecting campaigns through email, phone, LinkedIn, Gong, and other channels.

  • Engage decision-makers and influencers within IT, Engineering, Product, PMO, Agile, and Service Management organizations.

  • Generate qualified meetings and opportunities for the sales team.

  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly activity and pipeline targets.

Sales & Marketing Alignment

  • Partner closely with Marketing on campaign follow-up and lead nurturing.

  • Participate in webinars, events, and strategic account campaigns.

  • Provide feedback on lead quality, messaging effectiveness, and market trends.

  • Support account-based marketing initiatives.

CRM & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions and sales activities.

  • Ensure data quality and opportunity tracking within Salesforce and sales engagement tools.

  • Deliver timely reporting on prospecting activities, meetings generated, and pipeline contribution.

Required Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, Lead Generation, Inside Sales, or a similar role.

  • Experience prospecting into B2B technology or professional services organizations.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.

  • Ability to conduct discovery conversations and uncover business needs.

  • Experience using CRM platforms – Salesforce and Hubspot preferred.

  • Highly organized with strong time-management skills.

  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience selling or prospecting around SaaS, cloud, consulting, or enterprise software solutions.

  • Familiarity with Atlassian products including Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management, or related collaboration platforms.

  • Experience with sales engagement tools such as Gong, ZoomInfo, Cognism, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar platforms.

  • Exposure to enterprise-level sales cycles and account-based selling strategies.

Success Metrics

  • Qualified meetings created

  • Sales accepted opportunities (SAOs)

  • Pipeline generated

  • Conversion rates from lead to opportunity

jobs.description:
Video Editor

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a creative and detail-oriented Video Editor to produce engaging, high-quality video content across short-form and long-form formats. You’ll work closely with the design team to transform raw footage and creative briefs into polished videos that align with the company’s visual identity and creative direction.

From pacing and storytelling to motion graphics, color grading, and sound design, you’ll take ownership of the editing process from the first cut through final delivery. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong technical editing skills with creative judgment, takes pride in their craft, and works well in a collaborative environment.

What You’ll Own

Short-Form Content Production

  • Edit engaging short-form videos for social media platforms.
  • Align each video with the company’s visual identity, creative direction, and project goals.
  • Adapt content to suit different platforms and audience needs.

Long-Form Video Editing

  • Edit longer video projects from raw footage through final export.
  • Manage pacing, structure, and storytelling to create cohesive viewing experiences.
  • Refine cuts based on project requirements and creative feedback.

Motion Graphics & Visual Enhancement

  • Apply motion graphics, transitions, and visual effects where appropriate.
  • Perform color grading and sound design to improve overall video quality.
  • Maintain visual and audio consistency across deliverables.

Asset & Project Organization

  • Maintain organized libraries of footage, project files, and final exports.
  • Keep files structured and accessible to support efficient collaboration.
  • Ensure project assets are managed properly throughout the editing process.

Creative Collaboration & Feedback

  • Work closely with the design team to understand briefs and creative expectations.
  • Share progress cuts and incorporate feedback in a timely, professional manner.
  • Contribute creative ideas that improve storytelling and strengthen the final product.

Quality Control & Final Delivery

  • Review edits before submission to identify and correct technical issues.
  • Check audio synchronization, export settings, visual artifacts, and overall presentation.
  • Deliver polished videos in the required formats and aspect ratios.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Demonstrated experience as a video editor, supported by a portfolio showcasing a range of content types and styles.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or equivalent.
  • Solid understanding of color grading, audio mixing, and motion graphics fundamentals.
  • Experience editing videos for vertical, square, and widescreen formats.
  • Strong understanding of pacing, composition, and visual storytelling.
  • Ability to interpret creative briefs and translate them into effective video content.
  • Comfort receiving feedback and making revisions within agreed timelines.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and time management.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You take ownership of projects from the first cut through final delivery.
  • You care about the quality of your work and continuously look for ways to improve your editing skills.
  • You communicate proactively when timelines change or creative direction needs clarification.
  • You respond constructively to feedback and collaborate to achieve the best final result.
  • You balance creativity with technical precision and consistency.
  • You work independently while keeping teammates informed of progress and project status.

What Success Looks Like

  • High-quality short-form and long-form videos that align with the creative direction.
  • Strong pacing, storytelling, and visual consistency across deliverables.
  • Accurate exports that meet platform and project specifications.
  • Organized project files and efficient asset handoffs.
  • Timely delivery of edits and revisions.
  • Consistent collaboration with the design team and proactive communication throughout the editing process.

Typical Day

You’ll start by reviewing new project briefs, footage, and assets shared by the design team. Your primary editing work may involve building a long-form cut, refining a short-form video based on feedback, or preparing final exports in multiple formats.

Throughout the day, you’ll share progress cuts, communicate with teammates asynchronously, incorporate revision notes, and review your work for technical and visual quality before delivery. Most of your time will be dedicated to editing, with regular touchpoints for collaboration and file handoffs.

Interview Process

  • Initial Screening
  • Recruiter Interview
  • Client Interview
  • Offer & Onboarding

As a team member in Finance at Nationwide, a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, the opportunities are endless! Let Nationwide help create your career journey! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This position is part of the AI Risk Governance team — a dedicated advisory function within Enterprise Risk Management.


  • Provide technical depth to assess AI/ML and generative AI systems, and translate technical realities into clear risk language for both practitioners and risk partners.
  • Advise first-line teams on risk management throughout the AI lifecycle, tailoring guidance to each use case's context rather than applying one-size-fits-all rules, so teams can contextualize AI risk and build fit-for-purpose mitigation strategies.
  • Keep risk controls current with rapidly evolving AI technology (including agentic AI), anticipating emerging risks and updating guidance and control expectations ahead of scaled deployment.
  • Serve as a trusted, credible advisor who connects and aligns risk partners across all three lines on AI risk matters.
  • Support the operationalization of AI risk management through agentic AI — designing and building AI agents, automations, or purpose-built tooling that scale risk guidance and embed risk controls into practitioners' workflows.
  • Contribute to shared legal and compliance support, assembling audit-ready evidence and helping produce credible, timely responses to regulator and examiner inquiries.
  • Communicate complex technical and risk concepts in plain language, building practitioner fluency and confidence in managing AI risk through training and education.

Compensation Grade: F5


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.


It is our intention to fill this role in Columbus, OH. However, applications from candidates working remotely who bring critical industry skills and relevant experience may be considered.

Our industry-leading workforce adopts an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to know more about you!

As an Analytic Solutions Advisor, you’ll be responsible for working with Nationwide business leaders and data scientists to design and implement advanced analytics solutions that deliver deep insights, and translate into high business value to our organization. To succeed, you’ll need to use your business knowledge and a solid understanding of advance analytics (e.g., artificial intelligence, machine learning, etc.) to prioritize business problems and convey goals to data science professionals. Bilingual Customer Service & Scheduling Assistant (Healthcare)

Location: Remote – Nicaragua

Employment Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor
Industry: Healthcare / Medical Practice Administration / Patient Services
Compensation: $8–$10 USD/hour, based on experience, qualifications, bilingual proficiency, and EMR knowledge
English Proficiency: Fluent in both English and Spanish (verbal and written communication)
Start Date: December 1, 2026

About the Role

Our client is a U.S.-based healthcare management consulting firm that partners with medical practices to improve operational efficiency, patient services, and sustainable business growth. It supports healthcare organizations across specialties such as neurology, sleep medicine, internal medicine, pathology, and surgical services, and helps practices streamline operations while maintaining a positive patient experience.

We are seeking a compassionate, organized, and highly communicative Customer Service & Scheduling Assistant to support patient communications and appointment scheduling for a U.S. medical practice. As a primary point of contact for patients, you will handle incoming calls, coordinate medical appointments, answer general inquiries, and ensure patient information is documented accurately.

The ideal candidate is fluent in English and Spanish, has strong telephone communication skills, and can deliver professional, empathetic service in a fast-paced healthcare environment. Experience with Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems, particularly eClinicalWorks (eCW), is highly valued.

Why This Opportunity?

  • Work remotely while supporting a U.S. healthcare practice.

  • Help patients access medical services through professional and compassionate communication.

  • Develop experience in patient scheduling, healthcare administration, and EMR systems.

  • Collaborate with medical and administrative teams.

  • Contribute to an organization focused on service quality and long-term patient relationships.

What You'll Do

Patient Communication & Customer Service

  • Answer incoming patient calls promptly, professionally, and courteously.

  • Respond to questions about appointments, referrals, office information, and general procedures.

  • Provide appointment preparation instructions and communicate office policies.

  • Handle challenging patient interactions with patience, empathy, and professionalism.

  • Direct calls to clinical staff, providers, billing, or other appropriate departments.

Appointment Scheduling & Coordination

  • Schedule, reschedule, and cancel medical appointments accurately.

  • Manage provider schedules to support appointment availability and patient access.

  • Conduct appointment reminder calls, patient recalls, and follow-up scheduling.

  • Coordinate scheduling requests while maintaining accurate patient information.

Patient Records & Administrative Support

  • Verify patient demographics, contact information, and insurance details.

  • Document patient communications and scheduling activities in the EMR system.

  • Maintain accurate and confidential patient records.

  • Assist with general administrative tasks as assigned.

Compliance & Operational Efficiency

  • Follow HIPAA requirements and established patient confidentiality procedures.

  • Manage high call volumes while maintaining accuracy and excellent service.

  • Collaborate with the Call Center Supervisor, Practice Manager, and other team members.

  • Support efficient workflows and timely resolution of patient inquiries.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent.

  • Minimum 1 year of experience in customer service, call center operations, or medical office support.

  • Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish.

  • Excellent telephone etiquette, verbal communication, and interpersonal skills.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask effectively.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to handle sensitive patient interactions with empathy and professionalism.

  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and time management.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in healthcare, medical practice administration, or patient access services.

  • Experience using Electronic Medical Record (EMR) systems.

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is strongly preferred.

  • Familiarity with medical terminology, insurance verification, and patient scheduling workflows.

  • Experience managing high call volumes in a healthcare setting.

Candidate Evaluation Considerations

To ensure success in this role, the following factors will be carefully evaluated during the selection process:

  • Fluent written and spoken English and Spanish.

  • At least one year of experience in customer service, call center operations, or medical office support.

  • Ability to handle high call volumes with accuracy, empathy, and professionalism.

  • Hands-on experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW), which is strongly preferred.

  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA requirements.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote, part-time independent contractor role.

  • Strong telephone etiquette and accurate documentation in the EMR system.

How Success Is Measured

  • Professional, empathetic, and timely handling of patient calls.

  • Accuracy of appointment scheduling and patient information.

  • Efficient management of provider schedules and patient inquiries.

  • Quality and completeness of EMR documentation.

  • Consistent compliance with patient confidentiality requirements.

  • Reliability, organization, and effective collaboration with the medical practice team.

Why Join Us

  • Support patient care while building valuable experience in U.S. healthcare administration.

  • Work with a team that values professionalism, compassionate service, accuracy, and operational excellence.

Important Notes

  • Experience with eClinicalWorks (eCW) is strongly preferred but not required.

jobs.excerpt: Head of Change Management – Insurance & Investments 1.
jobs.description:
Head of Change Management – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Head of Change Management is responsible for developing, leading, and implementing the organization's change management framework to support business transformation, organizational development, digital adoption, and operational improvement initiatives.

Within the Insurance & Investments sector, the role manages organizational change activities associated with technology implementation, business process redesign, operating model changes, regulatory initiatives, restructuring, and cultural transformation.

The incumbent works closely with executive leadership, HR, IT, business unit heads, and programme management teams to assess organizational impacts, improve change readiness, manage resistance, and ensure employees successfully adopt new systems, processes, and ways of working.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Change Management Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement the organization's change management strategy, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Translate transformation objectives into structured change management plans and implementation roadmaps.
  • Establish change management standards, governance structures, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Assess organizational readiness and identify potential challenges associated with planned changes.
  • Align change management activities with corporate strategy and transformation priorities.

B. Organizational Change & Transformation

  • Lead change initiatives involving organizational restructuring, operating model redesign, business process improvement, and operational transformation.
  • Conduct change impact assessments to identify effects on employees, departments, workflows, and systems.
  • Develop implementation plans to support smooth transitions across business functions.
  • Coordinate change activities across multiple projects and transformation programmes.
  • Ensure new organizational structures, processes, and procedures are effectively adopted.

C. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Identify key stakeholders and develop appropriate engagement strategies.
  • Collaborate with senior management, department heads, employees, and external partners.
  • Develop and deliver change communication plans, presentations, and employee engagement initiatives.
  • Address employee concerns, manage resistance, and build commitment to transformation initiatives.
  • Establish feedback channels to monitor stakeholder sentiment and change effectiveness.

D. Digital & Technology Change Adoption

  • Lead change management activities related to digital transformation and technology implementation.
  • Support the adoption of enterprise systems, automation platforms, digital tools, and business applications.
  • Coordinate with IT teams to assess the organizational impact of technology changes.
  • Develop employee training, awareness, and user adoption programmes.
  • Monitor system adoption and ensure successful transition to new digital working practices.

E. People, Culture & Capability Development

  • Partner with HR to align change initiatives with workforce planning and organizational development.
  • Lead initiatives to improve organizational culture, employee engagement, and leadership alignment.
  • Identify employee capability gaps and coordinate training and development activities.
  • Support managers in leading teams through organizational transitions.
  • Promote adaptability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

F. Change Impact, Risk & Readiness Management

  • Conduct organizational change impact assessments and readiness evaluations.
  • Identify risks, resistance points, and implementation challenges.
  • Develop mitigation plans to minimize disruption to business operations.
  • Monitor change readiness, employee adoption, and implementation effectiveness.
  • Ensure change initiatives comply with applicable insurance, investment, financial services, and regulatory requirements.

G. Performance Monitoring & Benefits Realization

  • Establish change management KPIs, adoption metrics, and performance dashboards.
  • Track employee engagement, training completion, stakeholder readiness, and adoption rates.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness of change management activities.
  • Monitor whether transformation initiatives achieve their intended business outcomes.
  • Prepare progress reports and recommendations for senior management and programme steering committees.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

Budeš převádět produktová zadání a vlastní nápady do promyšlených návrhů a prototypů, hledat příležitosti ke zjednodušení uživatelských cest a podílet se na tom, jak bude Storyous fungovat v praxi.

  • Budeš navrhovat UX/UI napříč tabletovou aplikací, webovým Adminem, mobilní aplikací, Kioskem a Premium Analytics.

  • Zapojíš se do přípravy a realizace většího redesignu tabletové aplikace.

  • Budeš převádět produktová zadání, zákaznické potřeby a vlastní návrhy do user flow, wireframů, interaktivních prototypů a finálních návrhů ve Figmě.

  • Budeš rozvíjet naše design language, komponenty a šablony a dbát na konzistenci napříč platformami.

  • Budeš úzce spolupracovat s Productem a Engineeringem od prvního nápadu až po implementaci.

  • Budeš řešit designová dilemata, připravovat návrhy včetně potřebných stavů a edge cases a dokumentovat designová rozhodnutí ve Figmě, Jira a Confluence.

  • Budeš využívat AI nástroje, například Claude, pro zrychlení rutinní práce, iteraci návrhů a tvorbu klikacích prototypů.

Koho hledáme

Tahle role je vhodná pro člověka, který už má zkušenost s designem digitálních produktů a chce převzít širší ownership. Nehledáme pouze někoho, kdo umí vytvořit kvalitní obrazovku. Hodit se k nám budeš, pokud:

  • máš alespoň 3 roky zkušeností s designem digitálních produktů a portfolio s projekty, které se skutečně dostaly do používání;

  • dobře ovládáš Figmu včetně komponent, variant, prototypování a sdílených knihoven;

  • máš praktickou zkušenost s user interviews, usability testingem nebo pozorováním uživatelů v terénu;

  • dokážeš pracovat samostatně, nastavovat si priority a přicházet s vlastními návrhy na zlepšení;

  • umíš spolupracovat s Productem a Engineeringem a přijímat i poskytovat věcnou zpětnou vazbu;

  • používáš AI nástroje prakticky a s dobrým úsudkem;

  • domluvíš se plynně česky nebo slovensky a angličtina pro tebe není problém v každodenní práci.

✔ Zkušenost s POS, gastrem, retailem, fintech produktem, dashboardy nebo design systemy je výhodou. Pokud tě láká také front-end, jsme tomu otevření.

Proč může tahle role dávat smysl právě tobě

  5. Ve finálním kole case study společně projdete se Zuzkou a designovým expertem z Teya (online).

Turn scientific requirements into clear, accurate laboratory workflows. You will connect scientific documentation, laboratory operations, project management, and business processes. The quality of your configurations directly supports reliable test execution and a strong client experience.

  • Work with leadership to evaluate assigned requests, identify missing or conflicting information, and proactively resolve questions that could affect quality or timelines.
  • Prioritize work based on deadlines, client needs, and established group priorities while keeping leadership informed of progress, delays, and obstacles.

  • Maintain current knowledge of systems, procedures, GMP/GLP requirements, work aids, and process updates through assigned training and self-directed learning.

What Success Looks Like

  • Develop proficiency in building and reviewing analytical definitions with increasing independence.
  • Consistently produce accurate work, meet assigned deadlines, and learn from feedback to improve first-pass quality.
  • Communicate clearly and professionally with technical teams, project managers, leadership, and internal clients.
  • Take ownership of your workload, ask thoughtful questions, and adapt as priorities, systems, or processes change.
  • Provide prompt, courteous support and build productive relationships with requestors and process stakeholders.

The ideal candidate possesses the following:

  • Familiarity with analytical methodology, specifications, certificates of analysis
  • Strong computer, scientific, organizational and communication skills
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team, self-motivation, adaptability, and a positive attitude
  • Ability to learn new tasks, perform multiple tasks simultaneously, show attention to detail
  • Experience in Laboratory Information Management Systems

Basic Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in science, business, or other related degree concentration, or equivalent directly-related experience (two years of directly related industry experience is equivalent to one full-time year of college in related major)

Position is Full-time, Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m., with additional hours, as needed. Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Lancaster, PA are encouraged to apply.

  • Life and disability insurance,
  • 401(k) with company match,
  • Paid holidays and vacation,
  • Dental and vision options.

Eurofins USA BioPharma Services is a Disabled and Veteran Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.

The Eurofins network of companies is the global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in agroscience Contract Research Organization services. It is one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies, as well as having an emerging global presence in Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialized and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.

In over 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to 58,000 staff across a decentralized and entrepreneurial network of 900 laboratories in over 54 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.

jobs.description:
REPORTS TO: Chief Executive Officer
FLSA STATUS: Exempt
EMPLOYMENT STATUS: Full-Time
LOCATION: Remote (U.S.-based candidates only). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States.
COMPENSATION: $125,000 - $135,000, commensurate with experience.

Since 1999, WomenHeart: The National Coalition for Women with Heart Disease has been the nation’s only patient-centered organization solely devoted advancing women’s heart health through patient support, community education, and advocacy. WomenHeart is both a coalition and a community of thousands of members nationwide, including women heart patients and their families, health care professionals, and health advocates, all committed to helping women live longer, healthier lives. This organization is poised for rapid expansion and leadership in the field.

Position Summary:
Reporting to the CEO and serving as a member of WomenHeart’s senior leadership team, the Sr. Director of Programs and Impact sets the direction for WomenHeart’s program portfolio and leads the department that delivers it. The role provides oversight of major initiatives and funder-supported projects, hospital partnerships through the National Hospital Alliance, and the patient engagement, training, and volunteer programs at the heart of WomenHeart’s work, with project and program managers responsible for day-to-day delivery.

The Sr. Director is accountable for the program portfolio end-to-end: strategy, delivery, and evidence of results. The role builds the infrastructure that allows programs to grow, identifies strategic priorities and positioning opportunities, and shapes how WomenHeart demonstrates the value of its programs to patients, funders, and partners.

Success in this role requires program vision paired with operational discipline, strong cross-departmental coordination, sound judgment, timely communication, and a commitment to measuring what matters to the women we serve.

Duties & Responsibilities:
Strategic Leadership & Infrastructure Development
  • Lead program visioning aligned with WomenHeart’s strategic plan: identify strategic priorities and external positioning opportunities, and translate them into new initiatives and clear programmatic direction for leadership.
  • Monitor research, policy, and practice trends in women’s cardiovascular health and patient support to inform program strategy.
  • Design program structures, processes, and systems that can scale as WomenHeart grows.
  • Use patient voice, evidence, and community input to decide which programs to grow, refine, or retire.
  • Lead the annual program planning process, including department timelines and adaptive adjustments based on feedback, capacity, and funding shifts.
  • Oversee consultant engagements, including infrastructure projects, so they align with WomenHeart’s strategy and deliverables.
Program Portfolio Oversight
  • Oversee WomenHeart’s portfolio of funder-supported initiatives from design through completion and funder reporting, ensuring project and program managers have the direction and resources to meet funding commitments and organizational priorities.
  • Ensure program content, including modules, infographics, and webinars, meets quality standards, and provide final review of key materials for accuracy and alignment.
  • Provide strategic oversight of hospital engagement through the National Hospital Alliance (NHA), including Champion integration within member institutions, peer support and educational efforts, and NHA program strategy.
  • Cultivate clinical, academic, and community partnerships that extend program reach.
Patient Engagement, Training & Volunteer Support
  • Oversee patient engagement and support activities so women living with heart disease and their families have meaningful ways to connect, learn, and lead.
  • Provide leadership and strategic direction for volunteer training and support, including curriculum development, faculty and speaker engagement, and ongoing learning opportunities for WomenHeart Champions.
  • Build and sustain an active volunteer corps, including WomenHeart Champions, with clear pathways for recruitment (in partnership with Communications), engagement, recognition, and retention.
  • Serve as a senior point of contact for WomenHeart Champions, making sure patient support needs and opportunities are followed through.
Impact Measurement & Learning
  • Oversee the development of WomenHeart’s impact framework, including logic models, evaluation frameworks, outcomes, and metrics, working with staff and evaluation partners.
  • Own program goals scorecards and track progress against them.
  • Ensure practical systems are in place for collecting, analyzing, and reporting program data.
  • Turn findings into insights for the board, funders, partners, and the public, working with Communications and Development to share results.
Department Leadership
  • Hire, supervise, coach, and develop program staff, including project and program managers responsible for the day-to-day delivery of funded programs, with regular check-ins, clear roles, and performance oversight.
  • Build a collaborative, values-driven team culture, monitor workload distribution, and address bottlenecks so department priorities stay coordinated and moving forward.
  • Partner with Development on new proposals and funder alignment.
  • Develop and manage program budgets in partnership with Operations, including project budgets, deliverables, and system needs, and participate in the annual budget planning process.
  • Ensure program and funded activities are tracked in MS Planner, with deadlines, clear points of responsibility, and deliverables.
  • Provide regular reports to leadership on program progress, outcomes, risks, and upcoming priorities, escalating delays and risks early.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in public health, social work, nonprofit management, or a related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in program design and management, including at least 5 years leading teams and supervising staff.
  • Demonstrated success building or scaling programs in a nonprofit, public health, or patient advocacy setting.
  • Experience overseeing the development of logic models, evaluation frameworks, and outcome metrics, and using data to make program decisions.
  • Experience overseeing funder-supported projects from design through reporting, including managing consultants and budgets.
  • Experience building partnerships with hospitals, health systems, or clinical institutions.
  • Experience leading patient, community, or volunteer engagement programs, including training or curriculum-based programs with faculty or speaker engagement.
  • Strategic thinking: ability to identify priorities and positioning opportunities and turn them into clear direction.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills, including presenting results to boards and funders.
  • Ability to work collaboratively across departments while also operating independently with limited oversight.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and related workplace technologies, including systems used for project management and reporting.

Preferred Characteristics

  • Background in cardiovascular health, women’s health, chronic disease management, or patient support.
  • Experience with peer-support or community-health-worker models.
  • Experience launching virtual or hybrid programs.
  • Commitment to health equity and to centering the lived experience of patients.
  • Strong judgment, professionalism, discretion, and follow-through.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

With a staff that cares deeply about health equity and the women we serve, we believe diverse perspectives and backgrounds create a strong work environment and enhance our ability to pursue our mission. We value diverse experiences and know that the right candidate may not check every box. If you believe you would excel in this role and have a passion for public health and women’s health, we strongly encourage you to apply.

We are committed to building an organization that is intentional about inclusion in how we show up for women living with heart disease and in how we show up for one another. We hope you will join us as we continue to build a people-centered organization where individuals from all backgrounds are welcomed and valued.

The Mission

The AI Gateway team is on a mission to build the central nervous system for the agentic era, enabling developers to securely and reliably connect, observe, and manage their AI and ML services at scale. Some of the gateway’s more advanced capabilities, such as intelligent model routing, semantic caching, request classification, and content guardrails, work best when backed by small, purpose-built models. In this role you will build those features end to end: the gateway code that runs them in the request path, and the models behind them.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the technical direction for model-backed AI Gateway features, from design to production rollout.

  • Build and maintain high-performance components for Kong’s AI Gateway in Rust and Lua.

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models for specific gateway use cases, such as classifiers for intelligent routing, embeddings for semantic caching, and guardrail models.

  • Curate and maintain the datasets used for training and evaluation, and define the metrics and thresholds that decide whether a model is good enough to ship.

  • Integrate models into the gateway request path, optimizing inference for latency, throughput, and memory footprint.

  • Troubleshoot bugs, tune performance, and do low-level optimizations across both the gateway and the model serving stack.

  • Work with product management and other engineering teams to turn model capabilities into reliable, documented product features.

  • Mentor other engineers on the team on ML practices and model integration.

What You’ll Bring

The Toolkit

  • 3+ years of experience in server-side software development: building and debugging applications that are highly scalable, distributed, reliable and resilient.

  • 2+ years of experience in machine learning: building, training and evaluating models for production or research.

  • Proficiency with tensor-based deep learning frameworks, in Python and beyond.

  • Experience with dataset curation and evaluation methodology.

  • Experience running models in production outside of Python, optimizing inference for latency and memory (e.g. ONNX Runtime, quantization, batching).

  • Working knowledge of embeddings and vector databases.

  • Hands-on expertise with Linux systems.

The Kong DNA

  • Ownership: You take full ownership of your work from concept to production, including the documentation: engineers at Kong write the documentation for their products.

  • Pragmatism: You can tell when a model is the right tool and when a simpler solution is, and you measure before you decide.

  • Collaboration: You communicate clearly in writing and work effectively with a remotely distributed team.

  • Leadership: You make and explain technical trade-offs where there is no established playbook.

Bonus Points

  • Contributions to open-source software projects.

  • Proficiency in Rust, Lua or C.

  • Familiarity with the Rust ML ecosystem (e.g. Candle, Burn, tokenizers).

  • Experience with MLOps tooling and pipelines for training, versioning, and deploying models.

  • Experience with experiment tracking tools (e.g. MLflow, Weights & Biases).

  • Experience with LLM post-training techniques such as LoRA or other parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods.

  • Knowledge of networking fundamentals and protocols on both L4 and L7 (TCP/IP, HTTP/2, gRPC).

  • Hands-on experience with NGINX and OpenResty.

As a Senior Cybersecurity Engineer supporting the Zero Trust and Security Engineering team, you will provide senior-level technical expertise for the design, implementation, integration, operation, sustainment, and modernization of enterprise cybersecurity platforms supporting a large, complex federal environment.


Responsibilities

  • Provide hands-on engineering for next-generation firewalls, secure remote access, segmentation, and related network-security services.
  • Engineer, administer, troubleshoot, optimize, and sustain enterprise firewall technologies. Palo Alto Networks NGFW, PAN-OS, Panorama, Prisma Access, Strata Cloud, or comparable technologies are strongly preferred.
  • Manage the firewall policy lifecycle, including rules, objects, NAT, security profiles, recertification, cyber hygiene, optimization, and removal of obsolete or overly permissive policies.
  • Lead firewall and security-platform changes, including impact analysis, testing, change control, rollback, validation, and documentation.
  • Support Zero Trust and SASE capabilities including ZTNA, Secure Web Gateway, Firewall-as-a-Service, secure remote access, segmentation, device posture, and policy enforcement.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving routing, NAT, VPN, DNS, authentication, PKI/certificates, TLS/SSL inspection, logging, performance, and high availability.
  • Support platform deployments, upgrades, patching, hardening, configuration management, vendor escalation, and platform-specific vulnerability remediation.
  • Engineer and support SOAR, security automation, workflow orchestration, and API-based integrations.
  • Develop automation for alert enrichment, IOC analysis/blocking, incident triage, ticket creation, containment, remediation, policy changes, and reporting using REST APIs, Python, or comparable technologies.
  • Integrate security capabilities and telemetry across SIEM/XDR, endpoint, identity, ITSM, vulnerability management, DLP, NAC, threat intelligence, cloud, and enterprise logging/data platforms.
  • Evaluate AI-assisted security operations that improve detection, investigation, response, administration, and analyst workflows while maintaining appropriate human validation and guardrails.
  • Support greenfield deployments, migrations, environment separation, coexistence, testing, and transition to operations.
  • Collaborate with Security Operations, network engineering, IAM/ICAM, endpoint, NAC, vulnerability management, cloud, and infrastructure teams; serve as a senior technical escalation point as needed.
  • Develop architecture diagrams, SOPs, implementation/test plans, runbooks, troubleshooting guides, configuration baselines, and as-built documentation.
  • Support security assessments, authorization activities, audits, evidence collection, and compliance requirements.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality technical documentation, including architecture and data-flow diagrams, engineering standards, SOPs, implementation plans, test plans, validation procedures, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, configuration baselines, and change documentation.
  • Ensure security-platform configurations and engineering changes align with applicable organizational cybersecurity policies, technical standards, approved architectures, and change-management requirements.
  • May serve as a technical or project lead for assigned initiatives. This position does not require direct personnel-management responsibilities.

In Order to Be Considered

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, IT, Engineering, or related STEM discipline and 10+ years of relevant experience; allowable substitutions may apply per contractual labor-category requirements.
  • Significant hands-on experience engineering and troubleshooting enterprise next-generation firewalls in complex production environments.
  • Strong experience with firewall policy lifecycle management, NAT, zones, segmentation, logging, optimization, and change control.
  • Strong network-engineering fundamentals including TCP/IP, routing, BGP, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPN, TLS/SSL, PKI/certificates, packet analysis, and high availability.
  • Experience with Zero Trust/SASE technologies and working knowledge of NIST SP 800-207 or comparable Zero Trust principles.
  • Working knowledge of SOAR, security automation, APIs, workflow orchestration, and security-platform integration. Python, REST API, JSON, webhooks, or similar experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience integrating enterprise security platforms and telemetry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with greenfield deployments, migrations, environment separation, or independently managed security environments is strongly preferred.
  • Palo Alto Networks or comparable enterprise network-security and SASE experience is strongly preferred, with direct Palo Alto experience highly desirable.
  • Federal, government, or highly regulated enterprise experience is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Must be able to support planned maintenance and change windows, including occasional after-hours activities, and provide senior technical support for priority incidents or service-impacting security-platform issues when required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required federal suitability determination/background investigation for the position.

Preferred Certifications

  • Relevant professional certifications in network security, Zero Trust/SASE, cybersecurity architecture, security automation, cloud security, or network engineering are preferred.

If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:

As a Data Platform Engineer reporting to the Data Platform Engineering Manager in our Data Platform team (part of Data and Strategic Analytics), your purpose will be to help build and run the foundations every data team at Booksy works on.   • Design and build platform components (deployment, monitoring, access, ingestion) and own them end to end in production, runbooks included
  • Develop Terraform/Terragrunt modules for BigQuery, Cloud Composer, GKE, Cloud Run and networking

There's no people management here. A senior engineer and your manager are close by for the bigger calls, and a published seniority matrix shows what the next level looks like.

About Us:

Quartermaster is building the world's most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. With 600+ sensors deployed across 25+ countries and more than 400,000 vessels identified outside of AIS, we are setting a new standard for what ocean surveillance and safety can look like. We are a mission-driven, high-velocity team building dual-use technology for defense agencies, coast guards, and commercial maritime operators.

Job Description:

We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to support our team’s growing production demands and process improvement goals across Quartermaster’s SmartMast™ systems and related marine products. Based out of our Arlington, VA office, this role will play a critical part in onboarding and transitioning production to additional contract manufacturers (CMs), reducing assembly downtime, improving first-pass yield, and freeing up our core R&D engineers to focus on next-generation design and product improvements.

The right candidate brings strong hands-on experience scaling electromechanical hardware production with external contract manufacturers, translating engineering designs into repeatable manufacturing processes, and driving continuous improvements on the production floor.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead manufacturing transfer, line setup, and onboarding activities as Quartermaster expands production across new and existing contract manufacturers (CMs).

  • Develop, optimize, and maintain manufacturing work instructions, assembly procedures, test fixtures, and tooling to reduce build times and prevent assembly errors.

  • Drive continuous process improvements across production lines to reduce downtime, eliminate bottlenecks, and increase first-pass yield and throughput.

  • Partner closely with Mechanical, Electrical, and Quality Engineering teams on Design for Manufacturability and Assembly (DFMA), Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), and New Product Introduction (NPI) builds.

  • Troubleshoot production-line equipment, test station, and assembly issues in real time, implementing durable corrective actions so design engineers can stay focused on future product development.

  • Track production metrics (cycle time, yield, scrap/rework rates, line capacity) and collaborate with Supply Chain and CMs to support scaling production volumes.

Qualifications (Preferred):

  • Bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, or Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering for electromechanical hardware, marine electronics, aerospace/defense, or ruggedized outdoor systems.

  • Proven experience working directly with contract manufacturers (CMs) to transfer, qualify, and scale hardware production lines.

  • Strong command of DFMA principles, assembly tooling/fixture design, process validation (PFMEA, Control Plans), and lean manufacturing methodologies.

  • Hands-on experience writing clear work instructions, managing BOMs/ECOs, and troubleshooting electro-mechanical assembly and test workflows.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate clearly across internal engineering teams, supply chain, and external manufacturing partners.

  • CAD proficiency (e.g., Onshape, SolidWorks) for designing assembly jigs, fixtures, and line layouts is a plus.

Work Environment:

  • Based at Quartermaster’s Arlington, VA office with flexible working hours and occasional intensive sprints aligned to production ramps and CM transitions.

  • Occasional travel (up to ~25%) to contract manufacturers, component suppliers, or integration facilities.

  • Opportunity to work on innovative projects with a global impact.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of our sales team's performance, work directly with our CEO, and make a measurable impact on both our team and the families we serve.

You'll play a key role in coaching sales representatives, improving conversion rates, strengthening processes, and creating a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

We're not looking for someone who simply monitors dashboards and runs meetings. We want someone who recognizes opportunities, solves problems, holds people accountable, and makes the entire team better.

You'll have the opportunity to shape our sales processes, leverage innovative AI tools, and build a high-performing team in a company where your contributions will be visible and meaningful.

  • Establish clear expectations, monitor execution, and follow through to ensure commitments are met.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve efficiency, and strengthen overall sales operations.

  • Lead with ownership, urgency, integrity, and transparency.

  • Recognize when larger performance, compensation, or operational issues require escalation to leadership.

  • Create an environment where sales representatives feel motivated, supported, and challenged to continuously improve.
