Reporting to the Director, Global Sales Excellence, the Solutions Engineer III is the technical sales partner for our European sales team. You will lead discovery, design solutions and deliver compelling demonstrations that turn customer challenges into technical wins – helping leading consumer brands reduce supply chain risk and helping us grow in the UK, Italy and across Europe. You will join a high-performing, global Solutions Engineering team that shares knowledge openly, offers a clearly defined growth path and gives you the tools and training to succeed. This position is fully remote and will be located in the United Kingdom, Italyor Germany


In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Leading discovery sessions with SMB, mid-market and enterprise customers to understand their current state, pain points and requirements.
  • Designing and delivering tailored product demonstrations (several each week), both remotely and on-site at customer locations.
  • Translating business requirements into scalable solutions, including integration strategies and technical roadmaps with customer stakeholders.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Strong technical background, including APIs, integrations, SaaS deployments and web technologies.

It would be a plus if you also possess:

  • Professional proficiency in German and Italian is also valued, as is any additional European language.

jobs.excerpt: Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back.
jobs.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.

We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

The Head of Patient Affairs and Engagement is responsible for shaping how patient perspectives influence decisions across argenx and for building patient experience into a defining strength of how we operate as a company.


This leader will build and lead STEP (Strategy Team for the Experience of the Patient), a global cross-functional community that brings together colleagues across development, clinical operations, medical affairs, patient advocacy, commercial, market access, corporate affairs and regional teams to advance a more connected, intentional and impactful experience for patients.


This is a builder role. The foundations have been established through STEP. The next chapter is to create the vision, strategy, capabilities and ways of working that will help argenx remain deeply connected to patients as we continue to grow. Success will require bringing people together around shared priorities, translating insight into action, and creating approaches that can scale across teams, geographies and stages of the lifecycle.


Rather than owning all patient-facing activities, the Head of Patient Affairs and Engagement serves as a connector, catalyst and strategic thought partner, helping ensure patient perspectives become a trusted and consistent input into the decisions that matter most.


As part of Corporate Affairs, this leader will also partner with colleagues across the company to strengthen how argenx listens, learns and responds to the communities we serve. Over time, they will help shape a broader view of stakeholder experience across argenx, working with Corporate Affairs leaders to connect insights and experiences across patients, healthcare professionals, policymakers, employees and other stakeholders. This direction aligns with the broader vision of experience as a company capability that connects insight, decision-making and stakeholder impact.


Roles and Responsibilities:


Lead the Global Patient Experience Community

  • Lead and evolve STEP, building a capability that brings structure to patient experience across argenx and helps translate patient insight into meaningful action.
  • Bring together expertise from across functions, geographies and stages of the lifecycle to align around shared priorities and drive meaningful action.
  • Create the governance, focus and ways of working needed for STEP to translate ideas into impact.
  • Help define where STEP can uniquely connect, catalyze and deliver, while enabling teams closest to patients to lead execution.

Shape the Future of Patient Experience at argenx

  • Define and champion a vision for patient experience that positions patients as partners in innovation, decision-making and impact.
  • Build the strategies, capabilities and approaches that help patient perspectives consistently shape how argenx operates and grows.
  • Identify the opportunities where patient insight can most meaningfully influence decisions, experiences and outcomes across the lifecycle.
  • Connect insights across teams and geographies, ensuring they are translated into action and meaningful change.
  • Partner with Corporate Affairs leaders to help shape a broader view of stakeholder experience and how argenx shows up to the communities we serve.

Elevate Patient Insight and Influence

  • Build a consistent approach to capturing, synthesizing and activating patient insights across argenx.
  • Ensure patient perspectives are integrated into key decisions across development, clinical operations, commercial strategy and corporate affairs.
  • Create forums, tools and mechanisms that make patient insight accessible, actionable and connected to decision-making.
  • Define how patient influence and impact are measured across the organization.

Advance Trusted Patient Partnerships

  • Shape a global approach to patient engagement grounded in trust, transparency and long-term partnership.
  • Build relationships with patient leaders, advocacy organizations and rare disease communities around the world.
  • Identify opportunities to work alongside patients and communities to advance shared goals and improve outcomes.
  • Partner with Policy and Government Relations on initiatives where patient voices can help shape broader system change.

Accelerate Patient-Centered Development

  • Partner with development and clinical operations leaders to strengthen how patient perspectives inform study design, recruitment and trial experience.
  • Help identify scalable approaches that improve enrollment and reduce barriers to participation.
  • Bring together cross-functional teams around priority opportunities where patient experience can accelerate development outcomes.

Shape How argenx Shows Up for Patients

  • Partner across Corporate Affairs to ensure patient perspectives inform how argenx communicates, engages and builds trust.
  • Bring authentic patient insights and experiences into company narratives, stakeholder engagement and reputation-building efforts.
  • Help ensure the argenx Way is reflected in how we partner with and show up for patients around the world.

Measure and Demonstrate Impact

  • Establish meaningful measures that demonstrate the impact of patient experience on decisions, outcomes and ways of working.
  • Build accountability for patient-centered outcomes across STEP priorities and initiatives.
  • Help create a culture where success is measured not only by engagement, but by the difference patient perspectives make in how argenx operates.

Education, Experience and Qualifications:


  • 15+ years of experience in patient experience, patient engagement, patient advocacy, healthcare strategy, medical affairs, clinical development, corporate affairs, or related disciplines.
  • Deep understanding of the biotech industry and the patient journey, ideally with experience in rare disease or other complex healthcare environments.
  • Demonstrated success defining and leading global patient experience or patient engagement strategies across functions, geographies, and stages of the product lifecycle.
  • Proven ability to translate patient perspectives and insights into meaningful business, development, clinical, commercial, and organizational decisions.
  • Experience building and leading cross-functional communities, governance models, or enterprise-wide capabilities that turn strategy into measurable action.
  • Established credibility and experience partnering with patient leaders, advocacy organizations, and patient communities to build trusted, transparent, and long-term relationships.
  • Strong understanding of patient-centered drug development, including opportunities to influence study design, recruitment, enrollment, and the clinical trial experience.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and serving as a strategic advisor on patient experience, stakeholder engagement, and organizational priorities.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across teams without direct authority, align diverse stakeholders, and create momentum around shared priorities.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, relationship-building, and storytelling skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, global, and evolving environment with a builder mindset, strong judgment, and bias for action.

Project: Graphic Design for Equal Rights Advocates’ 2027 Gala Fundraiser

About ERA

Equal Rights Advocates (ERA) is a 501(c)3 national nonprofit organization that fights for gender justice in workplaces and schools. Since 1974, ERA has led the country in protecting and expanding economic and educational access and opportunities for women, girls, and gender-expansive people. Through litigation, policy advocacy, public education, and community organizing, our work advances gender, racial, and economic equity nationwide.

Project Overview

ERA is seeking a skilled Graphic Designer or Design Team to produce a suite of digital and print materials for our 53nd Annual Gala Luncheon, which will take place in San Francisco in May 2027.

The Designer(s) will closely consult with members of ERA’s staff to produce a cohesive and exciting design theme that will be executed through a variety of digital materials promoting the event, print materials to be displayed at the event, and more. (See Scope below.) The final results should complement event program content to inspire attendees to donate and renew their commitment to ERA and the gender justice movement.

Scope of Work

  • Creative Concept: Following a consultation meeting with ERA team members, designer(s) should present 2-3 creative concepts for ERA to choose from for the event branding. Concepts should complement -- but not directly reflect -- the organization’s brand identity.
  • Digital Promotional Materials: Designer(s) will produce digital promo designs sized for a variety of online platforms including ERA’s website, event microsite, registration page, social media, and e-newsletters. ERA will provide sizing requirements and will post the materials online when they’re complete. Social media content should include video versions of some designs, which may consist of animating elements of existing designs.
  • Print/Live Materials: In line with digital design themes, Designer(s) will produce 2 program presentations that will be projected onto large screens before and during the event, in addition to print materials. Print materials may include ~5 foamboard designs, a program booklet/pamphlet, and small paper signs.
  • Content Integration: Designer(s) should incorporate images/photos and text provided by ERA into digital and print deliverables, such as speaker photos, written copy, and sponsor logos.
  • Revisions: Designer(s) will collaborate with the ERA to make revisions and adjustments as needed, typically consisting of 1-3 rounds of feedback/approvals per deliverable.
  • Final Deliverables: Designer(s) will provide all files in the required formats.

Project Timeline

  • Proposal Submission Deadline: Nov 24, 2026
  • Project Launch: December 2026
  • Round 1 Digital Materials: February 2027
  • Round 2 Digital Materials: March 2027
  • Print Materials Deadline: April, 2027
  • Event Program Presentation: May, 2027
  • Event: May 25, 2027

Submission Requirements

Interested candidates should submit the following:

  1. Cover Letter: Introduce yourself and explain your interest in the project, your connection to our mission, and any similar projects you’ve led
  2. Portfolio: Provide examples of previous design work, particularly event materials and digital promotional materials
  3. Project Approach: Outline your approach to the project
  4. Budget: Provide a detailed cost estimate for the project
  5. References: Include at least two professional references

Evaluation Criteria

Proposals will be evaluated based on:

  • Relevant Experience: Demonstrated experience in designing similar deliverables
  • Design Quality: Visual appeal and professionalism of the portfolio
  • Understanding of ERA’s Mission: Clear understanding of ERA’s mission and how our organization's unique brand could be complemented by your creative concept
  • Cost: Your proposed budget within our stated range
  • Timeline: Confirmation of your ability to meet the project timeline

Submission Instructions

Please submit your proposal by Nov. 24, 2027 via thisLINK. Candidates must reside and be authorized to work in the United States.

For any questions or further information, contact:

Jess Eagle

Associate Director, Strategic Communications

Location: Fully Remote
Experience Required: 3+ Years

Position Overview

We are looking for a Data Engineer with at least 3 years of professional data engineering experience and hands?on experience working with the CentralReach Data Warehouse. The engineer will build and maintain reliable data pipelines and SQL data warehouses, including pipelines that integrate CentralReach data. This role requires someone who can work independently, understand business processes, and translate the needs of analysts, reporting teams, and other data consumers into practical data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines integrating CentralReach and other data sources.
  • Extract, transform, and model data for reporting, analytics, and downstream applications.
  • Develop and optimize SQL queries, data models, and transformations.
  • Use Python for data processing, automation, and integration tasks.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain workflows using tools such as Airflow or SSIS.
  • Implement data quality checks, logging, monitoring, and error handling.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver data solutions.
  • Document data flows, dependencies, and operational processes.
  • Utilize AI tools to improve productivity while validating and maintaining ownership of all deliverables.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional Data Engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience with the CentralReach Data Warehouse (required).
  • Strong SQL and data warehousing experience.
  • Proficiency in Python for data engineering and automation.
  • Experience building and supporting production ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Experience with Apache Airflow, SSIS, or similar orchestration tools.
  • Knowledge of data modeling, relational databases, and warehouse concepts.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure (Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL Database, Azure Synapse Analytics, or Azure Storage).
  • Familiarity with Git and version control.
  • Experience supporting Power BI or other BI platforms.

Important

Applicants must meet both minimum requirements:

  1. 3+ years of Data Engineering experience, and
  2. Prior hands-on experience with the CentralReach Data Warehouse.

jobs.excerpt: OUR STORY TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.
jobs.description:
OUR STORY

TechInsights is the information Platform for the semiconductor industry.

Regarded as the most trusted source of actionable, in-depth intelligence related to semiconductor innovation and surrounding markets, TechInsights’ content informs decision makers and professionals whose success depends on accurate knowledge of the semiconductor industry—past, present, or future.

Over 650 companies and 150,000 users access the TechInsights Platform, the world’s largest vertically integrated collection of unmatched reverse engineering, teardown, and market intelligence in the semiconductor industry. This collection includes detailed circuit analysis, imagery, semiconductor process flows, device teardowns, illustrations, costing and pricing information, forecasts, market analysis, and expert commentary. TechInsights’ customers include the most successful technology companies who rely on TechInsights’ analysis to make informed business, design, and product decisions faster and with greater confidence. For more information, visit .

WHY WORK WITH US
  • Company-sponsored training and development opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits package (health, dental, vision, wellness, RRSP/401K Matching, annual fitness reimbursement)
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Trusted device reimbursement program
  • Community involvement opportunities through charitable alliances:
  • Wellness resources and support
  • Inclusive environment that prioritizes diversity, equity, and accessibility
  • High-growth company driven by high performance
  • Expected salary range: $112,200 – $118,800 USD
THE OPPORTUNITY:
TechInsights is hiring an Analyst, Materials to join our Critical Materials team. You’ll be a subject matter expert in two or more specialty semiconductor materials areas: advanced packaging materials, wet chemicals and specialty cleans, CMP pads and slurries, wafers, and metal-organic (MO) precursors. You’ll lead research and content for your areas within our Critical Materials Reports™. You’ll build and refine demand forecast models and check their assumptions and results with your network of materials suppliers and chipmakers. You’ll also turn your findings into clear, engaging reports that our clients use to make decisions. If you have a strong forecasting background, know the semiconductor materials supply chain well, and enjoy telling a clear story with data, we’d like to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Research, analysis and forecasting
  • Lead content production and expert analysis for Critical Materials Reports™ in one or more semiconductor materials areas
  • Build, refine and stabilize demand forecast models, and keep improving our research methods
  • Act as a principal analyst on custom market research and consulting projects
  • Deliver high-quality reports on schedule, with clear writing, charts and graphics
  • Work with analysts and stakeholders across TechInsights to reconcile overlapping demand forecasts
  • Build a deep understanding of current and emerging application and technology trends in semiconductor materials
  • Find new ideas that strengthen and expand our product offerings
Industry network
  • Maintain and grow an active network of materials suppliers and chip fabricators to gather forecast inputs and validate results
Client and market engagement
  • Support product management and customer engagement by answering questions from new and existing clients
  • Represent TechInsights at industry conferences and customer meetings to stay current on the market and support sales
WHAT YOU’LL BRING
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in materials science, materials physics, electrical engineering, chemistry, chemical engineering or a related technical field with a focus on semiconductors, or equivalent industry experience
  • 7+ years of industry experience with semiconductor materials, including demand forecasting in one or more of: advanced packaging materials, wet chemicals and specialty cleans, CMP pads and slurries, wafers, or MO precursors
  • An established professional network in the semiconductor materials supply chain that you can use for forecast inputs and validation
  • Strong demand forecasting skills in Excel and a solid grounding in market research, including the ability to develop and integrate new methods and modeling techniques
  • Ability to read business and supply chain trends and build them into market assessments
  • Excellent writing and good verbal communication skills, with the ability to write an engaging, actionable story about materials markets and supply chains
  • Comfort explaining complex ideas, anticipating objections and persuading others
  • A problem solver who takes a broad view to find creative solutions
  • A self-starter who works independently and knows when to ask for guidance
  • Deep expertise in your specialty, general knowledge of related areas, and curiosity to keep learning about the materials space
  • Experience leading projects or small teams of moderate scope and complexity
  • An understanding of technical trends as they relate to materials

As part of the recruitment process for this position, you will be required to submit your latest citizenship and/or permanent residency information. This information will be used to comply with U.S. Export Control Laws and Regulations.

WORKING ARRANGEMENT

This is a remote position based in the United States

Technology knows no bounds, and neither does TechInsights. Bringing together talented humans from different perspectives, backgrounds and abilities is something we take seriously. We’re committed to building an inclusive environment that welcomes you to be your authentic self and allows us to push past the boundaries together.

jobs.description:
Content Marketing Coordinator

Location: Remote

Position Type: Part-Time Independent Contractor

Hours: Approximately 20 hours per week

Compensation: $20-$25/hour, depending on experience
Schedule: Flexible, with some required overlap during team working hours (Pacific Time) and a weekly meeting with the Senior Marketing Manager

About the Role

Modern Adventure is looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and AI-savvy Content Marketing Coordinator to support our growing content marketing efforts.

We create extraordinary journeys with extraordinary people. We partner with leading chefs, makers, brands, and organizations to design immersive travel experiences rooted in place, access, and human connection.

We are a Certified B Corp and Climate Neutral company, and we believe travel can be a force for good. We are also a small, entrepreneurial team: ambitious, collaborative, hands-on, and constantly improving how we work.

Our marketing brings those stories to life through compelling editorial content, destination storytelling, and thoughtful marketing campaigns.

As our Content Marketing Coordinator, you'll work directly with the Senior Marketing Manager to turn established strategies, creative briefs, and content plans into polished marketing materials. You'll use AI tools, established prompts, and templates to produce a variety of content, including trip marketing materials, destination guides, website copy, and more.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suited to an early-career marketer who enjoys content creation, is comfortable using AI as part of their creative process, and has a strong eye for writing and detail.

You'll be part of a small, collaborative team, working alongside a Content Virtual Assistant who will support administrative coordination and content organization.

What You'll Do

Content Creation & AI-Assisted Writing

  • Use AI tools, established prompts, and creative briefs to draft and refine high-quality marketing content.
  • Develop long-form website content, including blog posts, destination pages, and trip product pages.
  • Create city guides, destination resources, and other editorial content using AI-assisted workflows and existing templates.
  • Edit and refine AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, readability, and alignment with our brand voice.
  • Research and fact-check destination information, cultural references, and other supporting details.
  • Help improve and optimize existing AI prompts and content workflows to increase efficiency and consistency.

Campaign & Trip Marketing Support

  • Develop trip-specific marketing materials, including website copy, email content, social captions, and informational documents.
  • Adapt existing content into different formats for web, email, and social media using established guidelines.
  • Create and customize basic marketing graphics and assets using existing Canva design templates.
  • Support content production for trip launches, promotional campaigns, and ongoing marketing initiatives.
  • Incorporate feedback and revisions to prepare content for final approval.

Content Publishing & Optimization

  • Upload, format, schedule, and publish approved content across relevant marketing platforms, including website, email, and social media channels.
  • Apply established SEO best practices to website content, including keywords, headings, metadata, and internal links.
  • Format content according to channel-specific best practices and brand standards.
  • Review published content for formatting, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Make routine content updates and revisions as needed.

Workflow & Team Collaboration

  • Work from established briefs, content calendars, and project management workflows to complete assigned deliverables.
  • Manage multiple content assignments while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
  • Communicate proactively with the Senior Marketing Manager regarding progress, questions, and priorities.
  • Coordinate with the Content VA to ensure completed materials are properly organized and ready for publication.
  • Participate in occasional team meetings and collaborative working sessions.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Experience using AI tools for content creation, particularly ChatGPT, Claude, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with writing, refining, and optimizing AI prompts to produce stronger content.
  • Strong writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with an eye for clarity, accuracy, and brand voice.
  • Basic understanding of content marketing and best practices across social media, email, and web.
  • Foundational understanding of SEO and how to implement basic optimization guidelines.
  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple assignments.
  • Ability to follow creative direction, work within established templates, and incorporate feedback.
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a small team.

Nice to Have

  • 1–2 years of experience in content marketing, digital marketing, copywriting, or a related field. Internships, freelance projects, and relevant personal work are welcome.
  • Experience creating content for travel, hospitality, food, or lifestyle brands.
  • Familiarity with Canva, WordPress, Klaviyo, or similar content and marketing platforms.
  • Experience scheduling or publishing content across social media platforms.
  • Familiarity with project management tools and collaborative content workflows.

Who Will Be Successful in This Role

You're someone who enjoys the process of creating content and turning a creative brief into a finished deliverable. You're curious about AI and regularly experiment with ways to make content creation more effective, but you also recognize the importance of human editing, fact-checking, and thoughtful storytelling.

You don't need to be a marketing strategist or an expert in every digital platform. You should, however, be comfortable learning new tools, following established processes, and taking ownership of your assigned work.

You're organized, receptive to feedback, and excited to contribute to a small team where your work will have a direct impact.

Salary: $20-$25 DOE

Our Opportunity:

Building on Purdue University's mission to provide greater access to affordable, high-quality education, Purdue University Global is a public, nonprofit institution offering a world-class education online. Purdue Global delivers personalized online education tailored to the unique needs of adults who have work or life experience beyond the classroom, enabling them to develop essential academic and professional skills with the support and flexibility they need to achieve their career goals.

The Instructional Designer, Senior will provide support to Purdue University Global.

Job Summary:

The Instructional Designer, Senior develops instructional materials and participates in the technology-based redesign of courses and learning products. This position collaborates with faculty to develop instructional assets and course modules. The Instructional Designer, Senior designs digital course content, participates in curriculum development projects, performs course evaluations, and measures learning outcomes. This position may serve on an interdisciplinary team to develop faculty skills for course design and transformation.

What to expect in this role:

  • Instructional Design
    • Collaborate with faculty to design and develop engaging and effective learning content, applying instructional design principles to meet specific learning objectives.
    • Oversee and update the course mapping dashboard to ensure accurate alignment of learning objectives with curriculum and content.
    • Provides instructional design guidance for all stakeholders in developing course content, assessments, outcomes, and grading rubrics aligned to PG curriculum standards.
    • Align instructional design and course development with established theories of adult learning to support engagement, relevance, and learner autonomy.
    • Ensure all instructional materials and course elements adhere to Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) accessibility guidelines and Purdue Global standards.
    • Promptly address and resolve any technical, content, or accessibility issues that arise within deployed courses.
    • Conduct regular quality assurance audits of courses to ensure accuracy, functionality, ADA compliance, and adherence to design standards.
    • Makes decisions that are based on data sourced from in and out of the classroom.
    • Refine instructional content for clarity, accuracy, grammar, formatting, and consistency, leveraging strong editorial skills.
  • Production and Implementation
    • Build content directly in the Learning Management Systems (LMS) throughout the course development.
    • Document accessibility findings, track progress, and provide reports to stakeholders.
    • Evaluate, submit for third-party review and approval, integrate, and manage external learning tools and platforms to augment the core LMS functionality.
    • Design and create low-complexity media assets, using approved technology, aligned to principles that support student learning.
    • Implement technology solutions for courses and learning products.
  • Project Management
    • Collaborate with faculty on course development.
    • Manage participation throughout the curriculum development process for all assigned projects.
    • Systematically organizes and updates all course-related documentation, including design documents, media files, and project plans, in designated repositories.
    • Establish and monitor project timelines and milestones for all instructional initiatives.
  • Innovation
    • Lead or contribute to the conceptualization and strategic planning for courses and learning product redesign.
    • Leverage AI tools to enhance the effectiveness of instructional design processes.
    • Leverage AI tools to enhance content creation, personalize learning paths, and analyze learner data for instructional improvements.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

To support your application, candidates are asked to please submit a cover letter explaining how your experience aligns with the key duties and responsibilities listed. If certain required skills or qualifications are not immediately evident in your résumé, please highlight them in your cover letter.

Experience:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in learning design and technology, curriculum and instruction, or related area. Master’s degree preferred.
  • 4-5 years experience in curriculum, higher education or related area.
  • Over two years of online curriculum development and instructional design experience with a team (e.g., subject-matter-experts, multimedia developers, and developers) is preferred.
  • Strong project and time management skills, e.g., meeting deadlines and handling diverse tasks simultaneously using prioritization required.
  • Advanced knowledge of D2L’s Brightspace or other LMS systems.
  • Experience building content directly in the Learning Management Systems (LMS) is preferred.

What we're looking for:

  • Familiarity with ADA Accessibility Guidelines.
  • Ability to learn and apply knowledge of emerging educational technologies, including Web 3.0, and AI-powered tools.
  • Effective analytical skills with the ability to assess situations, resolve issues or make recommendations as appropriate.
  • Ability to work in a remote environment, across teams, departments, and Schools.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, balance competing demands for time, and prioritize workload to meet deadlines.
  • Strong collaboration, communication, and writing skills for effective partnership across remote teams, departments, and academic Schools.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to effectively communicate with a professional demeanor with people at all levels within the organization.
  • Demonstrates exceptional organizational and teamwork abilities.
  • Advanced proficiency in Google Workspace applications (Mail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, Slides, etc.) including Chat and Google Hangout plus MS Office.

The priority application deadline is Tuesday, December 1. After the priority deadline, the job posting may be closed. Applications submitted after the priority date may or may not be considered.

jobs.excerpt: Who are we?  We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians.
jobs.description:
Who are we?
We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. Most of the time, it is our differences that are celebrated (whether they are in cultures, personalities, preferences or passions). However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

Today is a particularly exciting time to join our team, we closed our Series A financing round in late 2022 and will be starting the Series B rounds in the coming year. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities, so if you are ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

Key Responsibilities

Security and Privacy Operations

Support the day-to-day operation of AltoVita’s information security and privacy activities as well as the mindset transformation. One that scales as the business grows, earns the trust of partners and regulators, and reflects the values we hold around protecting the people we serve.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the maintenance of security, privacy and compliance documentation.

  • Assisting with tracking security and privacy actions, control improvements and remediation activities.

  • Helping maintain registers such as risks, issues, actions, policies, vendors, assets, data processing activities and control evidence.

  • Coordinating updates between internal teams to ensure agreed actions are progressed.

  • Supporting the preparation of security and privacy reports, summaries and updates for internal stakeholders.

  • Helping ensure security and privacy activities are documented, repeatable and easy to evidence.

  • Escalating risks, issues or delays to the CISO or relevant business owner.

Compliance and Audit Support

Assist with internal and external compliance activities, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and client assurance requirements.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting evidence gathering for audits, assessments and control reviews.

  • Helping maintain audit trackers, evidence folders and compliance records.

  • Coordinating with internal teams to obtain required documentation and control evidence.

  • Supporting follow-up actions from audits, assessments or client reviews.

  • Assisting with the maintenance of policies, procedures and standards.

  • Helping ensure compliance activities are well organised and delivered within agreed timelines.

  • Supporting the CISO and relevant control owners with audit preparation and remediation tracking.

Policy and Documentation Support

Help maintain clear, practical and accessible security and privacy documentation.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the review and update of information security and privacy policies.

  • Assisting with the creation of standards, procedures, guidance notes and user-facing materials.

  • Helping ensure documents are version controlled, approved and communicated appropriately.

  • Maintaining policy review schedules and tracking required updates.

  • Drafting practical guidance for employees on security and privacy topics.

  • Supporting the communication of policy changes across the business.

  • Helping ensure documentation is accurate, consistent and aligned to business processes.

Security Awareness and Culture

Support the delivery of security and privacy awareness activities across AltoVita.

Responsibilities include:

  • Carry out security and privacy training administration and responsible for ensuring 100% completion rates across the business.

  • Supporting the development of awareness content, reminders, newsletters, FAQs and guidance.

  • Helping coordinate phishing simulations and follow-up communications.

  • Tracking training completion and awareness participation.

  • Supporting campaigns that promote secure behaviours and good privacy practices.

  • Helping make security and privacy feel practical, accessible and enabling.

  • Escalating recurring behavioural or process issues to the CISO or relevant business owner.

Privacy Support

Support AltoVita’s privacy activities under the direction of the relevant privacy, legal or security lead.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting with the maintenance of privacy records, including data processing registers and related documentation.

  • Supporting the tracking of privacy actions, assessments and improvement activities.

  • Helping gather information for privacy reviews, data mapping or data protection impact assessments.

  • Supporting internal teams with practical privacy guidance, escalating complex matters where needed.

  • Assisting with record keeping for data subject requests, incidents or privacy enquiries.

  • Helping ensure privacy documentation remains organised, accurate and accessible.

Client Assurance and Security Questionnaires

Support the completion of client security and privacy questionnaires, RFP responses and due diligence requests.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting with the preparation of responses to client security and privacy questions.

  • Maintaining a library of approved answers, evidence and supporting materials.

  • Coordinating with internal subject matter experts to obtain accurate information.

  • Ensuring responses are consistent with AltoVita’s current controls, policies and practices.

  • Helping translate technical or compliance information into clear, client-friendly language.

  • Tracking open client assurance requests and supporting timely completion.

  • Escalating complex, high-risk or contractual questions to the CISO, Legal or relevant business owner.

Supplier and Third-Party Support

Support supplier security and privacy processes under the direction of the CISO or relevant business owner.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting with supplier due diligence questionnaires and evidence collection.

  • Helping maintain supplier records, risk ratings and review schedules.

  • Tracking supplier security or privacy actions.

  • Supporting periodic reviews of key suppliers.

  • Helping ensure supplier documentation is complete and up to date.

  • Escalating potential supplier risks or concerns to the appropriate owner.

Incident and Risk Support

Support security, privacy and operational risk processes by helping with coordination, documentation and follow-up.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the logging and tracking of security or privacy incidents.

  • Helping gather relevant information during incident reviews.

  • Maintaining incident notes, timelines and action trackers.

  • Supporting post-incident follow-up and lessons learned activities.

  • Assisting with risk register updates and remediation tracking.

  • Escalating suspected incidents or risks promptly to the CISO or relevant lead.

  • Supporting the documentation of controls, gaps and agreed improvements.

This role does not lead incident response or make final risk acceptance decisions.

IT and Access Control Support

Assist with security-related IT and access control activities where required.

Responsibilities include:

  • Day to day execution of access controls

  • Supporting access review processes by gathering user access information.

  • Helping track joiner, mover and leaver control activities.

  • Supporting evidence collection for account provisioning, deprovisioning and access approvals.

  • Assisting with documentation of access control processes.

  • Helping monitor completion of agreed access management actions.

  • Oversight and support on internal reviews of security tooling usage, adoption and documentation.

  • Escalating access control issues or gaps to IT, system owners or the CISO.

Profile

The successful candidate will be someone who:

  • Takes ownership of tasks and follows through.

  • Communicates clearly and professionally.

  • Can organise information, actions and evidence in a structured way.

  • Is comfortable working with different teams across the business.

  • Has strong attention to detail.

  • Can explain security and privacy topics in simple, practical terms.

  • Is curious and willing to learn.

  • Understands when to escalate issues.

  • Brings a pragmatic and positive approach.

  • Is comfortable operating in a fast-moving scale-up environment.

  • Wants to help build a strong security and privacy culture.

Essential Skills and Experience

  • Experience in information security, privacy, compliance, IT, risk, audit, operations or a related field.

  • Working knowledge of information security and privacy principles.

  • Awareness of GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or similar frameworks.

  • Ability to maintain trackers, registers, documentation and evidence records.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to write clear guidance, summaries and user-facing content.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

  • Confidence working with stakeholders across different business functions.

  • Practical problem-solving approach.

  • Comfortable using collaboration tools, document repositories and workflow trackers.

Desirable Skills and Experience

  • Exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or other compliance environments.

  • Experience supporting audits, assessments or evidence collection.

  • Familiarity with security awareness or training activities.

  • Experience supporting client security questionnaires or RFP responses.

  • Exposure to vendor risk management or supplier due diligence.

  • Familiarity with GRC tools or compliance platforms.

  • Basic understanding of access management, MFA, endpoint protection and cloud security principles.

  • Relevant certification or willingness to work towards one, such as:

    • ISO 27001 Foundation

    • CompTIA Security+

    • CIPP/E

    • CIPM

    • ITIL Foundation

    • SOC 2 or audit-related training

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

Within the first 90 days, the Information Security Analyst will have:

  • Built strong working relationships with the CISO and key internal teams.

  • Understood AltoVita’s core security, privacy and compliance activities.

  • Reviewed existing policies, registers, trackers and evidence repositories.

  • Supported current audit, compliance or client assurance activities.

  • Helped organise key documentation and improve visibility of open actions.

  • Identified areas where tracking, evidence or documentation can be improved.

  • Started supporting awareness, access review or supplier assurance activities.

First 6 Months

Within 6 months, the Information Security Analyst will have:

  • Helped improve the structure and consistency of security and privacy documentation.

  • Supported audit and compliance evidence collection in a timely and organised way.

  • Maintained clear action trackers for control improvements and remediation activities.

  • Helped improve security and privacy awareness materials.

  • Supported client assurance responses with accurate and reusable content.

  • Assisted with supplier due diligence and access review activities.

  • Improved the quality and availability of evidence for security and privacy controls.

  • Become a trusted support point for internal security and privacy coordination.

First 12 Months

Within 12 months, the Information Security and Privacy Analyst will have helped AltoVita operate a more structured, scalable and measurable security and privacy function.

Success will be demonstrated through:

  • Better organised security and privacy records.

  • Improved evidence readiness for audits and client assurance.

  • Clearer policy and procedure documentation.

  • More consistent tracking of risks, actions and remediation activities.

  • Improved support for privacy records and data protection activities.

  • Stronger internal awareness of security and privacy responsibilities.

  • Faster and more consistent support for client security questionnaires.

  • Better visibility of supplier assurance and access review activities.

  • A more mature, well-documented and business-friendly security and privacy operating model.

Critically, success is measured, not assumed. Training completion rates, adoption metrics and observable behavioural shifts are tracked and reported alongside documentation and roadmap delivery. Changing mindsets requires evidence and this role owns that shift and evidence.

Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton's Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

Peraton is looking for a Senior Scrum Master to drive agile delivery across a complex federal data integration program. You will serve as the team's process facilitator and delivery enabler, managing sprint cadence, removing blockers, and ensuring seamless coordination across multiple overlapping workstreams and cross-agency stakeholders. This is a fully remote position supporting a 12-month period of performance with potential for follow-on work and possible placement in other programs across Peraton at the conclusion of the program.

Work Location: Remote

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead the overall system architecture design for the federal data integration, ensuring compliance with IT governance, platform standards, and interoperability conformance requirements
  • Establish and baseline the interoperability conformance framework at project kickoff, defining API standards, protocols, and data exchange requirements for all integration points
  • Design the end-to-end integration architecture spanning cloud data platforms, web applications, authoritative data systems, and decision logic engines
  • Lead workstream management across all project phases, ensuring technical dependencies are identified, sequenced, and resolved
  • Conduct compliance validation from a technical architecture perspective, ensuring the integrated system meets all regulatory requirements
  • Evaluate all proposed technical changes against platform constraints and escalate boundary violations
  • Lead the design of authorized API integration pathways between source systems and the cloud data platform
  • Provide technical oversight of the production migration runbook and cutover execution
  • Lead the development of the Final Operational Playbooks, providing technical architecture documentation covering system maintenance procedures, incident response protocols, and integration sustainability guidance
  • Serve as the technical escalation point for the team, resolving complex integration, compliance, and architecture issues

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree and 8 years experience or High School diploma/equivalent and 12 years’ experience.
  • Candidate must have U.S. Citizenship
  • Must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • 8+ years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile delivery lead
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or equivalent Agile certification
  • Experience facilitating Agile delivery on federal government IT programs
  • Strong understanding of sprint planning, backlog management, and velocity tracking
  • Experience managing risk and defect logs in a compliance-gated delivery environment
  • Experience supporting OMB or executive-level government demonstrations and briefing materials
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAFe Scrum Master (SSM) or SAFe Agilist (SA) certification
  • Familiarity with multi-agency federal programs involving DOI, FWS, or NOAA Fisheries
  • Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar agile project management tools
  • Active Public Trust Clearance

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Marketing Data & AI
jobs.excerpt: Why Valtech?  We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands.
jobs.description:
Why Valtech? We’retheexperience innovation company - a trusted partner to the world’s most recognized brands. To our people we offer growth opportunities, a values-driven culture, international careers and the chance to shape the future of experience.

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.

We are proud of:

  • The work we do and the innovation we drive
  • Our values of share, care and dare
  • A workplace culture that fosters creativity, diversity and autonomy
  • Our borderless, global framework, which enables seamless collaboration

The role

We are looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize a modern, cloud-based marketing data platform that powers analytics, AI, and data products. Beyond technical delivery, we want someone genuinely curious about the business problems behind the data, who applies common sense, detailed analysis, and experience-based recommendations to help shape business requirements, not just implement them as given.

The core objective of this role is to connect the marketing data platform to our existing unified and centralised business intelligence layer. Much of the work is about building bridges to existing models and layers, so we don’t reinvent the wheel each time. You will deliver high-quality curated datasets with robust governance, security, and observability, and prepare marketing data structures for AI consumption, including machine learning and LLM-powered applications such as RAG and agent-based systems.

You are likely to be the only data engineer in the team to begin with. You will have peers to collaborate and share knowledge with, but they sit outside your immediate team (for example, the sister website team with front-end and back-end developers). You will work closely with data analysts, marketing automation specialists, performance marketers, and marketing business owners.

Platforms

Our platform is currently built onGoogle Cloud (BigQuery), with Microsoft Fabric likely in the longer term. We are looking for engineers with deep expertise in one cloud who are T-shaped: comfortable working across clouds and keen to broaden their platform experience.

Role responsibilities

Build & Data Platform Engineering

  • Design and implement scalable data platforms and pipelines on GCP and BigQuery, adapting to Azure/Fabric as our platform evolves.
  • Build ingestion, transformation, and curation workflows for structured and unstructured marketing and sales data (e.g., social media, organic, web, CRM, CMS, email).
  • Implement lakehouse/warehouse patterns and layered data modelling (e.g., medallion: bronze, silver, gold), ensuring reusable, scalable systems aligned with enterprise needs.
  • Build integrations and “bridges” between the marketing data platform and existing centralised BI models, avoiding duplicated logic and rework.

Enable AI, GenAI & Data Products

  • Deliver model-ready, production-grade marketing datasets for analytics, ML, and optimization.
  • Structure data for AI consumption, including pipelines for GenAI use cases (LLMs, RAG, vector-based data flows) and agent-based architectures.
  • Use ML lifecycle and catalog/governance tooling, with an emphasis on equivalent tooling for our platform (e.g., Vertex AI, Dataplex), or Databricks MLflow and Unity Catalog where relevant.

Data Modelling, Orchestration & Automation

  • Design logical and physical data models focused on the marketing problem space, aligned with existing enterprise models.
  • Orchestrate workflows with tools such as Cloud Composer/Airflow, dbt, Dataform, or equivalents (e.g., Azure Data Factory), with a focus on automation, reliability, and maintainability.

Architecture, Governance & Observability

  • Apply event-driven and streaming architecture patterns where they fit the use case.
  • Ensure data governance, lineage, quality, and access control (RBAC/ABAC) using GCP Dataplex or equivalents (Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, AWS Lake Formation).
  • Establish observability: data freshness, pipeline reliability, and SLA adherence.

Data Serving, Integration & Optimization

  • Enable serving layers (APIs, feature inputs, analytical endpoints) for downstreamand upstreamML and AI platforms.
  • Continuously optimize pipelines and infrastructure for performance, scalability, and cost.

Requirements Discovery & Business Partnership

  • Ask the right questions to understand not just what stakeholders want, but why.
  • Bring a growth mindset and a willingness to translate business needs into scope and tasks that achieve objectives.
  • Surface gaps and better alternatives rather than executing a brief as written.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with data analysts, marketing automation specialists, performance marketers, and marketing business owners.
  • Support adoption of data products and contribute to best practices.

Must have qualifications

Technical skills

  • Strong Python and SQL.
  • Proven experience building batch and streaming pipelines and production-grade data platforms.
  • Experience designing data structures for AI consumption.
  • Experience working with marketing and sales data sources (e.g., social media, organic/SEO, web analytics, CRM, CMS, email platforms).
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, data quality, and governance.

Cloud & platforms (key requirement)

  • Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with BigQuery and the GCP data stack (e.g., Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Dataform, Cloud Composer).
  • Deep expertise in at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure/Fabric), plus demonstrable openness and ability to work across clouds. Candidates with strong AWS or Azure/Fabric backgrounds (Data Factory, Synapse, Fabric Lakehouse) are encouraged to apply, provided they are keen to work on GCP and Fabric.

Architecture & systems thinking

  • Experience with modern warehouse/lakehouse architectures and distributed systems.
  • Strong understanding of scalability, reliability, and performance.

Mindset

  • Keen interest or experience in the marketing problem space. You don’t need to be a marketer, but you should enjoy this part of the business and the challenge we are trying to solve.
  • Naturally curious, with strong problem-solving skills and a collaborative approach in cross-functional teams.
  • Comfortable challenging business requirements rather than taking them at face value.
  • Adaptable and eager to work across platforms. Agile or consulting experience is beneficial.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience withSalesforceandMarketodata integration.
  • Hands-on experience across more than one cloud, or cloud migration experience.
  • Experience with Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, or Databricks.
  • GenAI and AI data systems (RAG pipelines, vector databases, LLM data preparation).
  • CI/CD for data pipelines and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform).
  • Streaming technologies (e.g., Kafka), or ML/experimentation platforms.
  • Experience building data products or large-scale analytics platforms.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

Commitment to reaching all kinds of people

We design experiences that work for all kinds of people - and that starts with our own teams. At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

The benefits

This is a Full time position based in Ukraine.

Beyond a competitive compensation package, we offer:

  • Mental and physical health:
    • Medical insurance
    • Sports reimbursement budget
    • Home office support
    • A number of free psychological and legal consultations
    • Maternity and paternity leave support
  • Personal and professional development:
    • Internal workshops and learning initiatives
    • English language classes compensation
    • Professional certifications reimbursement
    • Participation in professional local and global communities
    • Growth Framework to manage expectations and define the steps to move towards the selected career
    • Mentoring program with the ability to become a mentor or a mentee to grow to a higher position

Valtech Ukraine has a system of progressive benefits packages in place — the longer you stay with the company — the more benefits you get.

Your application process

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

About Valtech

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Are you ready to create what’s next? Join us.

jobs.excerpt: Position: Sales and Customer Relationship Executive Salary: Php 50,000 to Php 80,000/monthly Working Hours: Aligned with UK Business Hours Work Type: Full Time Independent Contractor ABOUT THE COMPANY: The company is a prestigious UK specialist joinery and restoration business serving discerning homeowners, alongside commercial clients such as builders and developers.
jobs.description:
Position: Sales and Customer Relationship Executive

Salary: Php 50,000 to Php 80,000/monthly

Working Hours: Aligned with UK Business Hours

Work Type: Full Time Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is a prestigious UK specialist joinery and restoration business serving discerning homeowners, alongside commercial clients such as builders and developers. Renowned for uncompromising quality, heritage restoration, and sustainability—with a client portfolio that even includes the British Royal Family—the company delivers a white-glove, top-tier service from initial enquiry through to project completion.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

We are seeking a consultative, high-ownership Sales and Customer Relationship Executive to take control of warm inbound customer enquiries and a substantial pipeline of outstanding quotations. While the field sales team focuses on large-scale commercial and residential contracts, your primary mission will be driving the consistent conversion of domestic projects—particularly window refurbishment, restoration, and bespoke joinery (typically valued at a few thousand pounds per project). These smaller, high-margin jobs are vital to maintaining steady cash flow and keeping specialist joiners booked between major builds.

Working exclusively with warm leads (enquiry joiner site visit/measure team prepares quote you follow up and close), you will build genuine trust with affluent homeowners, guide them through considered purchasing decisions, and confidently close deals over the phone and email without sounding scripted or pushy.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Inbound Qualification & Triage: Respond promptly to warm incoming enquiries, uncover the customer’s project scope, qualify the opportunity, and determine the appropriate next step.
  • Appointment Coordination: Schedule and manage site visits for specialist joiners to measure, assess, and scope domestic projects.
  • Consultative Quote Follow-Up & Closing: Proactively follow up on prepared quotations by phone and email. Walk homeowners through proposals clearly, articulate the value of bespoke craftsmanship over cheaper alternatives, handle objections, and confidently ask for the sale.
  • Pipeline & Backlog Revival: Systematically re-engage older enquiries and stalled quotations to determine project status, overcome hesitation, and secure a clear next action or confirmed booking.
  • Equal-Opportunity Ownership: Give smaller domestic jobs (e.g., single-window restorations around £2,500) the exact same urgency, care, and attention as larger projects, ensuring no revenue is left on the table.
  • CRM & Pipeline Hygiene: Maintain immaculate CRM records, contact histories, pipeline stages, and follow-up reminders so every live opportunity has a scheduled next step—eliminating guesswork and "it will land next week" updates.
  • Internal Collaboration & Handover: Partner closely with leadership (Gary and Rob) and technical colleagues to escalate complex pricing/technical queries, share customer feedback, and ensure seamless handovers once deposits/bookings are secured.

Requirements

  • Proven track record in telephone sales, warm lead conversion, or consultative B2C sales—specifically demonstrating the ability to chase quotes, overcome hesitation, and close deals rather than just booking appointments.
  • Exceptional spoken and written English with a warm, articulate, and polished communication style suited to affluent, discerning UK homeowners.
  • Strong consultative selling skills: the ability to build rapid, natural rapport, listen actively, ask insightful questions, and ask for a decision calmly and confidently.
  • High levels of personal accountability, self-management, and pipeline discipline, with proven proficiency in using CRM platforms and adapting to new job management systems.
  • A reliable, quiet remote home-office setup with high-speed internet and full availability to work UK business hours.

Preferred

  • Hands-On Trade Background: Practical experience working "on the tools" (e.g., as a joiner, carpenter, decorator, or tradesperson) who has transitioned into a telephone-based sales or customer-facing role.
  • Industry-Specific Sales Experience: Background in home improvements, heritage restoration, bespoke windows/doors, kitchens, decorating, or comparable high-ticket, quoted domestic services.
  • Luxury & High-Net-Worth Client Exposure: Experience representing high-end, prestigious brands and building authentic rapport with wealthy consumers who value quality over the lowest price.
  • Proven experience reviving dormant pipelines and guiding homeowners through multi-stage, considered purchases.

What You’ll Bring

  • Ownership Over Excuses: You don’t blame lead quality or let quotes gather dust; you take personal responsibility for working every warm opportunity through to a definitive yes or no.
  • Value-First Storytelling: An authentic appreciation for traditional craftsmanship and sustainable restoration, enabling you to justify premium pricing with confidence.
  • Consultative Patience Paired with Commercial Drive: You never use high-pressure tactics, yet you are unafraid to address objections head-on and guide a hesitant homeowner across the finish line.
  • Adaptability: Comfort navigating evolving internal systems while learning the nuances of UK joinery and restoration terminology alongside a supportive team.
