jobs.description:
YOUR POSITION WITH TNC

Within TNC´s global program, Provide Food and Water, TNC’s Zero Conversion Commodities (ZCC) is a global and mature strategy with the goal of transforming the food system for soy, cattle, and palm oil, primarily but not limited to, by enabling producers in critical ecosystems of South America to meet growing demand without converting additional land for farming. We work in partnership with value chain actors to halt habitat conversion caused by commodity production in highly biodiverse and threatened biomes, including the Brazilian Amazon, the Brazilian Cerrado, the Gran Chaco of Argentina and Paraguay, and Indonesia.

The ZCC Portfolio Management Specialist helps strengthen strategy management and implementation through two complementary areas: (1) strategy operations, monitoring, evaluation, and learning; and (2) portfolio and project management. The role organizes performance information, management processes, planning, and internal coordination to support accountability, timely delivery, decision-making, knowledge sharing and learning, and adaptive management. The Specialist also provides project management support to selected initiatives based on evolving needs and priorities.

The position is flexible within South America, preferably Brazil, or North America. Fluency in English is required; Portuguese proficiency is highly desired.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

The ZCC Portfolio Management Specialist reports to the ZCC Strategy Associate Director and supports effective management, execution, performance and continuous improvement of the ZCC Strategy across the following areas:


1. Strategy Operations, Performance, and Learning

  • Support effective strategy execution, performance management, learning, and adaptive management across the ZCC Strategy.
  • Maintain the management systems and processes needed for coordination, performance visibility, and leadership decision-making.
  • Support strategy operations and oversee relevant operational and administrative resources.

2. Portfolio and Project Management

  • Provide portfolio and project management support to selected ZCC projects and strategic initiatives.
  • Strengthen consistent and adaptive project management practices and portfolio-level visibility across the Strategy.
  • Coordinate and guide project management resources as portfolio needs evolve.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Translate direction from the ZCC Strategy Associate Director and ZCC Strategy leadership into concrete work plans, milestones, management calendars, processes, and tools that enable coordinated execution across global program staff, functions, and country business units.
  • Establish and maintain systems to track strategic objectives, KPIs, intermediate results, outcomes, annual milestones, and other agreed performance measures; coordinate timely data collection and promote consistency and analytical rigor across teams and regions.
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous refinement of the Strategy’s monitoring, evaluation, and learning (MEL) approach, aligned with the Strategy’s results chain, intermediate results, and assumptions.
  • Manage and maintain the ZCC HUB and related strategy dashboards, ensuring that results, evidence, methodologies, and performance information are current, consistent, accessible, and decision-useful; work with relevant teams to address information and evidence gaps.
  • Synthesize information from the HUB, MEL plan, quarterly milestone reporting, collaboration surveys, and other sources into clear presentations, briefings, dashboards, reports, and recommendations for leadership.
  • Coordinate quarterly milestone reporting and other periodic strategy performance processes; identify and elevate significant progress, emerging issues, dependencies, risks, and critical-path considerations requiring leadership attention.
  • Facilitate periodic learning and adaptive management discussions to assess progress, test assumptions, capture lessons, and inform potential adjustments to implementation.
  • Develop and continuously improve strategy management tools, templates, presentations, dashboards, briefings, decision analyses, reporting processes, and good practices in collaboration with the ZCC Strategy Associate Director and Strategy leadership.
  • Coordinate cross-cutting strategy operations, including annual and periodic work planning, management calendars, internal communications, knowledge sharing, contracts and agreements, and related administrative workflows.
  • For selected projects and initiatives, establish and maintain fit-for-purpose project plans, timelines, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risk registers, governance arrangements, meeting cadences, and reporting processes in collaboration with project leads and teams.
  • Monitor selected projects against agreed plans and internal, donor, and contractual requirements; coordinate narrative reporting and key project management processes while preserving the accountability of project leads for project delivery and results.
  • Support the identification and management of portfolio-level risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and capacity needs, and elevate issues requiring management attention.
  • Promote consistent, adaptive, and collaborative project management practices across selected ZCC initiatives and contribute to strengthening project management capabilities across the portfolio.
  • Provide day-to-day guidance, quality control, mentorship, and coordination for direct reports, particularly in structured thinking, analytical approaches, contracts, and administrative workflows; coordinate with dotted-line supervisors where applicable.
  • Supervise administrative staff and, as the portfolio evolves, potentially supervise or coordinate additional project management resources assigned to selected ZCC initiatives.
  • Build effective working relationships across functions, regions, and business units, communicating complex information clearly and influencing teams without relying solely on formal authority.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive information with appropriate discretion.
  • Travel domestically and internationally on occasion and work flexibly across time zones, as needed.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree and 5 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.·
  • At least 2 years of project management experience or 1 year acting as a project lead.·
  • Completed coursework or other training in project management principles.·
  • Experience managing and tracking projects with cross-functional teams using project management standards and tools such as Microsoft Word, Excel, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Notion, Planner, Mural, or comparable software.·
  • Experience developing management reports and presentation materials.· Experience supervising staff.·
  • Fluency in English.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS


  • Multilingual skills and experience working across cultures.·
  • Portuguese proficiency is highly desired·
  • Experience facilitating virtual team meetings and working across different time zones.·
  • Experience with Power BI.·
  • Proficiency in interpreting guidelines and manipulating, analyzing, and interpreting data.·
  • Project management certification.·
  • Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to negotiate, influence, and persuade.·
  • Demonstrated success implementing strategic program goals.·
  • Ability to work effectively from a home office.

Salary Information:

USA

The starting pay range for a candidate selected for this position in the United States is within the range of $70,000 – $103,785. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA. Where a successful candidate’s actual pay will fall within this range will be based on a variety of factors, including, for example, the candidate's location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. Please note countries outside the USA would have a different pay range in the local currency based on the local labor market, and not tied to USA pay or ranges. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment.


Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers competitive and comprehensive benefits packages tailored to the individual countries where we work. These may include health care benefits, retirement benefits, parental leave, paid time off, life insurance, and disability coverage as well as an employee assistance program and other life and well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

jobs.description:
Patients are at the heart of everything we do. As part of our Medical Affairs team, you’ll foster internal and external collaboration to generate and disseminate evidence-based clinical practices to help impact patient lives and advance the quality of care. Your scientific curiosity and passion for patients will help us grow our reach and develop innovative solutions for people fighting cardiovascular disease.


Patients with mitral and tricuspid heart valve disease often have complex conditions with limited treatment options. Transcatheter Mitral and Tricuspid Therapies (TMTT) business unit is boldly pursuing an innovative portfolio of technologies to address a patient’s unmet clinical needs. It’s our driving force to help patients live longer and healthier lives. Join us and be part of our inspiring journey.


This is an exciting opportunity for an exceptional Clinical Scientist professional to join a team that is boldly designing transcatheter mitral and tricuspid therapies from the ground up. As a key member of the Medical Affairs Clinical Science team, the Senior Manager is responsible for providing scientific expertise throughout the development and implementation of clinical studies and clinical evaluations for a dynamic portfolio of products across TMTT. The Senior Manager will be an experienced medical device professional with strong scientific acumen and a commitment to putting patients first.

This position can be an onsite or a hybrid role based at Edwards Lifesciences’ corporate headquarters in Irvine, California, or can be a remote based role in the U.S.


You will make an impact by:

  • Contribute to strategy and planning of clinical science deliverables.
  • Lead clinical study design and clinical protocol development.
  • Independently author complex documents including clinical study protocols (pre-market and post-market), clinical study reports, annual progress reports, post-approval study reports, clinical evaluation plans, clinical evaluation reports, post-market clinical follow-up plans and reports, and other scientific documents (as appropriate).
  • Independently author complex regulatory responses.
  • Perform systematic literature reviews from initiation to completion (develop search strategies, manage associated documentation, and prepare literature summaries).
  • Independently review raw and summary clinical data for accuracy; resolve potential discrepancies.
  • Interpret safety and effectiveness results from pre-market and post-market data sources; conduct systematic data appraisals to support overall benefit-risk assessments.
  • Independently review and collaborate with cross-functional teams on the review, analysis, and interpretation of study results, including exploratory endpoints and assuring appropriate data review and accurate data reporting.
  • Summarize key data from clinical studies and published literature and provide updates to internal and external stakeholders (as appropriate).
  • Ensure documents comply with regulatory guidelines.
  • May travel up to 15% to attend scientific conferences or to travel to Edwards Lifesciences’ corporate headquarters in Irvine, California if remote.

What you’ll need (Required):

  • Bachelor's Degree in a related field with 10 years of related experience working in clinical science or medical/scientific writing; OR
  • Master's degree in a related field with 8 years of related experience working in clinical science or medical/scientific writing; OR
  • Doctorate degree (PhD, MD, PharmD) with 6 years of related experience working in clinical science or medical/scientific writing.

What else we look for (preferred):

  • Familiarity with the coronary interventional and/or structural heart environments and current treatment options or have other clinical and/or clinical trial experience.
  • Experience in the application of MEDDEV 2.7/1 and EU MDR for clinical evaluations.
  • Experience with FDA PMA applications.
  • Strong knowledge of statistics, study design methodologies, and clinical trial protocol development
  • Familiarity with Real World data analyses methodologies
  • Strong knowledge of scientific research methodology, device development process, GCP, ICH guidelines and Global (US FDA, EU MDR, Japan PMDA, China NMPA) regulations.
  • Experience working in a cross functional, collaborative environment and comfortable interacting with R&D engineers, regulatory specialists, statisticians, physicians, and support personnel.
  • Excellent communication skills and experience influencing and guiding stakeholders.
  • Experience conducting and interpreting statistical analyses of clinical or scientific data preferred.
  • Recognized as an expert in own subject area with specialized depth within current or previous organization(s).
  • Expert understanding of related aspects of clinical science and/or scientific/medical writing.
  • Expert knowledge of regulatory requirements and study execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated experience with maintaining current, in-depth product knowledge including current developments, clinical literature review, as well as therapeutic and product operation knowledge.
  • Strong knowledge of statistical analyses, study design methodologies, and clinical trial protocol development.
  • Advanced working knowledge with the use of MS PowerPoint, MS Word, MS Excel, EndNote, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and scientific writing skills.

Aligning our overall business objectives with performance, we offer competitive salaries, performance-based incentives, and a wide variety of benefits programs to address the diverse individual needs of our employees and their families.

For California (CA), the base pay range for this position is $145,000 to $205,000 (highly experienced).

The pay for the successful candidate will depend on various factors (e.g., qualifications, education, prior experience). Applications will be accepted while this position is posted on our Careers website.

jobs.excerpt: The Role Clearstory is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of general contractor accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth.
jobs.description:
The Role

Clearstory is hiring a Customer Success Manager to own a book of general contractor accounts, from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth. You will report to the Manager of Customer Success and work as an individual contributor with a mixed book of enterprise and mid-market GCs. Our GC customer base is growing and each CSM already carries 20 to 40 accounts, so we need another owner to work every account well.

If you have run change orders as a PM or PE at a general contractor and want to move into tech, this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

  • A book of GC accounts. You inherit existing accounts and implement newly sold logos. The book ramps through your first year and reaches 1 to 3 million in ARR in year two, depending on lifecycle stage.
  • Retention and forecasting. Keep your accounts live and renewing by working each one to our written standards, without reminders, and forecast renewals for your own accounts.
  • New GC implementations. Lead post-sale implementation and Project Team Training for net new GCs, so project teams are live and receiving change orders and T&M tags in Clearstory.
  • Adoption. Run check-ins and trainings so field and office users keep using the platform and see the impact.
  • Customer success tools. Use business reviews and other customer success tools to drive retention, adoption, and growth in your accounts.
  • Referrals and growth. Ask for referrals at the right moments and find expansion inside the accounts you own, such as new projects, offices, and additional users. Hand both to the account executive, so your accounts lead to new projects, offices, and companies.
  • Work with Product. Work cross-functionally with the Product team, bringing customer feedback into feature request reviews so what we build matches how GCs work.

What This Role Is Not

This is an individual contributor role. It is not a people manager role and it is not pre-sales. We already have written standards for working each account. Your job is to run them well and raise the bar.

About You

You have worked the general contractor side of change orders, so you know how contracts, budgets, and owner billing work, and you can meet a customer’s situation with one you have lived. You run our standards and practices without handholding or reminders, then improve on them. As an individual contributor, you inspire and motivate the team through your own success, as we cheer each other on and learn from each other. Moving from the field is a real shift, and you will manage your time across many accounts while you learn the role.

The Company You’ll Join

Clearstory is digitizing and automating the change order process inside the commercial construction industry.

Just as TurboTax did for tax documents and Expensify did for receipts and expense reports, Clearstory is doing the same for change order communication and log management by building first-of-its-kind, category defining software that is revolutionizing the commercial construction industry.

The construction industry is being transformed fast by technology, but the way companies communicate costs hasn’t evolved in decades and still heavily relies on carbon copy paper, spreadsheets and email to track billions of dollars. These arcane manual processes can take days or weeks and include hours of manual office tasks such as scanning, manually transcribing, and tedious data-entry into spreadsheets.

At Clearstory we are changing that and creating a new category “change order communication,” by intelligently digitizing this age-old process. This leads to an increase in profits, more successful contractor to customer relationships, more transparency into a project’s true cost, and less wasted paper!

We are a venture backed 100% SaaS company with impressive credentials for a company at our stage.

  • Blue Chip Clients. We have already landed some of the largest General and Subcontractors in the US and have helped our clients build landmark projects.
  • Significant Growth. We continue to double and triple our revenue and platform usage year over year.
  • Large Volumes Processed. Companies share over $100 million in Change Order Requests on our platform each and every month.
  • Significant and Important Projects. Our customers are trusting us to manage significant projects in the commercial construction industry. We have over $100 Billion worth of projects on our platform to date.

Our values: Be Curious, Keep It Simple, Customer Obsession, Raise the Bar.

The Team You’ll Be Surrounded By

In addition to experienced SaaS and product leaders, our team has over 60 years of combined experience in the commercial construction space. At Clearstory we know our customer’s pain points and challenges first hand and have built a category defining product that serves the user first.

You’ll be part of an ambitious and collaborative company, committed to growing a supportive and diverse team that is passionate about empowering our contractor customers.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5+ years as a project manager or project engineer at a general contractor on the ENR Top 400 (or, as a second choice, a superintendent), with more years preferred. Estimator or preconstruction-only experience does not meet this on its own
  • Owned project financials at a general contractor: budget, contract types, change orders, and pay applications
  • Worked directly with owners or clients on construction projects
  • Worked across multiple markets and projects
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills

Strong plus if you have

  • Business development or sales experience growing client accounts
  • A bachelor’s degree, or equivalent hands-on industry experience
  • Ability to lead strategically and paint a vision that inspires and motivates the team, while also being extremely detail-oriented and getting in the weeds
  • Ability to collaborate with a variety of stakeholders including Senior Post-Sales Leadership and cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance, Legal) across the company
  • Ability to influence and challenge conventional wisdom

Benefits

  • Experience and contribution to the building of our customer success strategy, including how we onboard customers, how we help them grow, how we communicate value to them, and how we gather feedback to improve the product
  • Ability to work with a new product category that has already found product market fit
  • Experience at a venture backed growth startup
  • Unlimited PTO and company holidays
  • Flexible remote work
  • Competitive market-rate salary for a Series B company
  • Subsidized healthcare, vision, and dental
  • 401(k) plan
  • Equity

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: Meta Ads Specialist

  • Job ID: MOHTIA1R

  • Industry: Digital Marketing Industry

  • Location: Lebanon

  • Job Status: Full Time

  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM to 7:00 PM Mountain Time

  • Salary: $5.75 to $8.50 per hour / Monthly Equivalent: $1,000 to $1,500 per month

  • Target Start Date: ASAP

🏢 About the Client

The client is a performance-driven marketing agency that specializes in generating high-quality leads for construction businesses through Facebook advertising. With a strong focus on client results and business growth, the agency helps contractors scale efficiently with proven lead generation systems and expert marketing support.

💼 About the Role

Our client is looking for a proactive, creative-minded Meta Ads Specialist whose core mission is to beat creative fatigue across our clients' ad accounts. Each day, you will log into client ad accounts, identify which creatives are fatiguing, and produce fresh, high-performing replacements from the photos and videos our clients send. You'll be editing videos, editing photos, building collages, and using AI tools to generate new creatives, then upload them to the account and keep backups ready.

Success in this role comes down to two things: understanding Meta ads and understanding creatives. If you know both, you can beat creative fatigue. GoHighLevel experience is a plus—we build our CRMs and landing pages on GHL, but if you don’t have it, we will teach you.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 📈 Campaign Creation & Management: Build and launch Meta campaigns across multiple client accounts, including campaign structure, budgets, location targeting, audiences, ads, and lead forms.

  • ⚙️ Campaign Optimization: Review performance daily and make informed decisions about budgets, targeting, creative testing, pausing underperforming ads, and scaling successful campaigns.

  • 🎨 Creative Production: Write ad copy and produce image and video ads using client-provided photos and footage. Edit videos, edit photos, build collages, and use AI tools to develop fresh creative concepts.

  • 🧪 Creative Testing & Fatigue Monitoring: Identify declining creative performance and prioritize replacements based on account needs. Test different hooks, messages, offers, and formats while maintaining an organized library of ready-to-launch creatives.

  • 💻 GoHighLevel Setup: Create and configure client subaccounts, import and customize snapshots, and set up forms, calendars, pipelines, and integrations.

  • 🌐 Landing Pages & Funnels: Build, update, and troubleshoot GoHighLevel landing pages and funnels. Check mobile layouts, forms, and the complete submission process before launch.

  • 🤖 Automations & Lead Follow-Up: Build and maintain SMS and email workflows, appointment reminders, lead routing, and internal notifications.

  • 🔗 Integrations & Tracking: Connect Meta lead forms and landing pages to the correct GHL subaccounts. Set up and verify Meta Pixel and Conversions API integrations, and confirm that leads and conversion events are recorded correctly.

  • 🛠️ Troubleshooting: Investigate performance and lead-delivery problems across campaigns, landing pages, tracking, and CRM workflows.

  • 🤝 Internal Collaboration: Communicate daily with the Customer Success Manager and internal team. Report campaign changes, flag problems, review lead quality, request assets, and recommend next steps.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • Meta Ads Experience: Proven ability to build, manage, optimize, and scale Meta lead-generation campaigns using real performance data.

  • GoHighLevel Experience: Hands-on experience creating subaccounts, building landing pages, configuring pipelines and calendars, and developing and troubleshooting automation workflows. Prior GHL experience is required.

  • Creative Production Skills: Ability to edit videos and photos, create image ads and collages, and use tools such as Canva, CapCut, and relevant AI software.

  • Performance Analysis: Understanding of cost per lead, click-through rate, landing-page conversion rate, lead quality, and cost per booked appointment. Ability to explain what the numbers mean and what action to take.

  • Tracking & Integrations: Practical experience connecting campaigns to a CRM and verifying that forms, tracking events, notifications, and workflows function correctly.

  • Excellent Communication: Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to write clear ad copy and communicate campaign results.

  • Organization & Ownership: Ability to manage multiple client accounts, prioritize work, follow established processes, and identify problems without waiting to be told.

  • Commitment & Integrity: Full availability during the required schedule, honest representation of experience, and no overlapping work commitments during scheduled hours. The schedule follows U.S. Mountain Time, including daylight saving changes.

🌟 Preferred Pluses:

  • Industry Experience: Past experience running ads for local services and blue-collar contractors (Roofers, Concrete, Flooring, Painting, etc.) is highly preferred but not strictly required.

  • GHL Knowledge: Familiarity with building funnels, landing pages, and CRM automations in GoHighLevel is a strong advantage — but not required. We build our CRMs and landing pages on GHL and will teach you.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!

jobs.excerpt: Principal, Enterprise Implementation At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours.
jobs.description:
Principal, Enterprise Implementation

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers.

The Principal, Enterprise Implementation is the single accountable owner, and the hands-on operator, of Fullbay’s largest implementations, from pre-sale scoping through a stable go-live. These are multi-entity, multi-brand projects with significant technical, data, and project management interlock with senior customer executives. The Principal runs these projects personally rather than directing others to run them, but does not do it alone. The role leads a small direct team (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer and Project Manager), works with Data Services as a shared service, and holds written decision rights over data queue priority, cutover go/no-go, scope changes and the configuration baseline. The role also sets the enterprise standards that high-volume onboarding, which runs as a separate motion, inherits.

Reporting to the CCO, this role partners with Customer Success (commercial and executive relationship), Product and Engineering (platform constraints and fixes), Sales (deal-time scoping), Data Services, Finance, and Support. The ideal candidate combines deep technical credibility in data migration and integrations, the program rigor to run several concurrent cutovers, and the executive presence to be a credible peer to a customer’s CIO and hold them through a hard cutover.

The Right Wrench for the Job

In a heavy-duty shop, the biggest, most complicated job doesn’t go to whoever happens to be free. It goes to the master tech who has rebuilt that system before, knows which bolt will fight back, and keeps the customer informed long before the truck leaves the bay. That is this role. You take Fullbay’s largest and most complex implementations and run them with your own hands, from the first scoping conversation through a stable go-live, with the technical depth to see what will go wrong before it does.

You’re the right fit if you have personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not just managed them, and you can hold your ground with a customer’s CIO when a cutover gets hard. You bring the rigor to run several go-lives at once through clear gates, the honesty to report status as it really is, and the judgment to take the hardest work yourself. You also leave things better than you found them, with the playbooks, decision rights and standards that make the next implementation easier. If you want to own the biggest builds and build the team that will own them next, we’d like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Personally run every large implementation end to end: plan, gates, risk, customer readiness, cutover and post-go-live stabilization. Serve as the single accountable owner and day-to-day operator on each engagement, with a named customer counterpart.
  • Hold written decision rights over data queue priority across accounts, the go/no-go recommendation for each cutover, scope changes and change orders, the configuration baseline and decision log, and feasibility calls against the platform.
  • Lead the direct team (Technical Account Manager, Solutions Engineer and Project Manager) and work with Data Services on each engagement: work alongside them, set dates and escalate conflicts to the CCO. Take the highest-risk work directly rather than delegating it.
  • Maintain a single source of truth for gate status, so customer-facing boards, internal plans and data queues agree before any commitment is made.
  • Define and enforce the data accountability model: what migrates, what has a workaround, who at Fullbay owns each data element, who at the customer validates it, and which gate it sits under.
  • Set the standard for Core 4 data (customers, units, vendors, inventory) and associated elements: customer-approved files and settled metadata before any import, so rework after import is the exception.
  • Own the configuration baseline across multi-entity instances (settings, permissions, rates, tax and mapping) and the release process that keeps instances consistent.
  • Own cutover strategy: data flash timing, soft launch versus hard cutover, parallel-system exposure, reconciliation and invoice parity testing.
  • Lead integration planning with customers (accounting, payments, ERP and HR systems, telematics), including ownership and dependencies for each component.
  • Assess migration feasibility and throughput against platform limits. Partner with Product and Engineering to resolve blockers such as import speed, performance and requirements the product cannot yet meet, and set customer expectations accordingly.
  • Run concurrent cutovers through a defined stage-gate model with explicit entry and exit criteria, and report engagement health (RAG) to executives in a way that reflects technical risk, not only task completion.
  • Own scoping and change control for enterprise engagements: effort estimation, statements of work, change orders and review before commitments are made, working with Sales and Finance.
  • Maintain the RAID log and decision log for each engagement, and run a standing cross-account sequencing review with Data Services.
  • Build the enterprise implementation playbook, templates and tooling, and capture process knowledge now held by individual team members so it is documented and transferable.
  • Act as the technical counterpart to customer executives and technical leaders: lead steering reviews, hold them through hard decisions, defend the plan and escalate early.
  • Partner with the account owner in Customer Success so the technical relationship through go-live and the commercial relationship stay aligned, and co-own the customer outcome at each gate.
  • Define the post-go-live stabilization gate (for example, issue volume below an agreed threshold for a set period) and hand off day-to-day management to Customer Success cleanly.
  • Define the line between enterprise engagements and run-rate onboarding, and set the handoff standard with the onboarding team.
  • Hire, develop and manage the direct team (TAM, SE, PM): set expectations, assess capability and fit, and recommend staffing and role changes to the CCO.
  • Grow the team deliberately: define roles, capacity model and hiring profile as engagement volume grows, and recommend when to add capacity or specialization.
  • Feed lessons from enterprise engagements into onboarding standards so they become repeatable practice for high-volume implementations.
  • Be the voice of enterprise delivery in Product, Engineering and Support planning, escalating platform gaps with evidence (volumes, durations, customer impact).
  • Partner with Sales on deal-time scoping for enterprise opportunities so commitments match deliverable scope and capacity.
  • Work with Finance on engagement economics, capacity planning and any billable services scope.
  • Work with Support and Tier 3 on escalation paths for large customers during and after cutover.
  • Success is measured by on-time, on-scope go-lives with an approved gate record for every cutover; less rework after data import and fewer post-go-live configuration corrections; post-go-live stability, with issue volume and escalations trending down within the stabilization period; customer confidence, with executive sponsors agreeing to the next phase and delivery-dependent expansion realized; and delivery decisions made within the role, with escalation to the CCO by exception.

Additional Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Adhere to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • 5+ years leading complex enterprise software implementations, including data migrations, in B2B SaaS or a comparable technical environment. Recent experience with multi-entity or multi-brand consolidations is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in a PE-backed or investor-reported environment is a plus.
  • Experience in heavy-duty repair, fleet maintenance or commercial vehicle industries, or in vertical SaaS for operations-heavy businesses, is a plus.

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Hands-on technical depth: has personally run complex data migrations and cutovers, not only managed them, with working knowledge of data migration (extract, transform, load, reconciliation), integrations (accounting, payments, ERP) and configuration architecture, sufficient to be credible with a data engineering team and to challenge feasibility and estimates.
  • Program rigor: a proven record running multiple concurrent, high-stakes cutovers through stage gates, with disciplined risk management and honest status reporting.
  • Executive presence: a credible peer to customer CIOs, CFOs and operations leaders, able to lead steering reviews and hold them through difficult cutover decisions.
  • Range and leadership: has led both complex enterprise engagements and higher-volume implementation or onboarding operations, can set standards for both, and has managed a small delivery team while remaining a hands-on operator.
  • Experience establishing decision rights, gates and playbooks where none existed, and influencing without direct authority across Product, Engineering, Support, Sales and Customer Success.
  • Experience with scoping, statements of work and change control for enterprise engagements.
  • Familiarity with project and customer-facing delivery tooling such as Monday.com, Salesforce and ChurnZero, or equivalents.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds.
  • Frequently requires the use of hands and arms for reaching, as well as the ability to walk and communicate effectively through speaking and listening.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus.
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.
  • Type on a computer keyboard and look at a computer monitor, and operate a cell phone or a computer-based phone.

jobs.title: Director, Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning - 2025948
jobs.excerpt: Are you a person of compassion?  An advocate for justice?
jobs.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a Director of Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability, and Learning (MEAL) to provide leadership for measuring, understanding, communicating, and improving the quality, effectiveness, and impact of World Relief’s international programs. The Director leads the implementation and continuous improvement of a unified global MEAL and Impact Strategy and ensures that credible evidence informs executive decision-making, program adaptation, resource allocation, organizational learning, fundraising, and external communications.

The Director serves as International Program’s principal authority on impact measurement, data quality, data governance, evaluation, and evidence-informed learning. The position ensures that organizational, country, sector, and program-level measurement systems demonstrate progress toward strategic outcomes while complying with applicable donor requirements, humanitarian quality standards, data-protection requirements, and organizational policies.

The Director partners closely with international programs and executive leadership to translate complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into actionable intelligence. The role provides regular assessments of organizational performance, impact, emerging trends, and evidence gaps. A core aspect of the position is guiding the modernization of the organization’s MEAL systems. This includes responsible adoption of artificial intelligence, digital data collection, integrated information systems, automation, advanced analytics, geospatial analysis, near-real-time monitoring, and interactive data visualization.

The Director leads the global MEAL team and works collaboratively with country leadership and program teams, technical teams, program operations, information technology, safeguarding, and communications.

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

    Impact Measurement, Executive Reporting and Organizational Performance, 25%

  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor to the International Programs Leadership Team and executive leadership regarding program performance, organizational impact, evidence quality, emerging risks, and opportunities for adaptation.
  • Develop impact and evidence reporting for executive leadership and the Board of Directors, ensuring evidence and impact claims are accurate, appropriately qualified, and transparent about limitations.
  • Translate complex quantitative and qualitative evidence into concise, decision-ready narratives, visualizations, and recommendations.
  • Partner with Communications and Advancement teams to ensure external impact narratives accurately reflect available evidence.
  • Establish systems and dashboards that provide timely and appropriately disaggregated data to program managers, country leadership, technical teams, and executives. Strengthen users’ ability to interpret and apply the information responsibly.

    • Strategic Leadership and Global MEAL Management 20%

  • Provide strategic leadership to the global MEAL team by setting a compelling vision and clear priorities, establishing annual and quarterly goals, and ensuring strong performance through regular supervision, mentorship, technical oversight, and constructive feedback.
  • Develop, implement, and periodically refresh a MEAL Strategy aligned with the organization’s mission, International Programs (IP) strategy, program quality framework, and commitments to core humanitarian standards, locally led development, and evidence-informed practice.
  • Lead development and implementation of multi-year MEAL priorities, work plans, budgets, staffing models, and systems-strengthening initiatives.
  • Foster an organizational culture that values learning, evidence, innovation, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish and maintain MEAL standards, procedures, technical guidance, and quality-assurance mechanisms that promote alignment with applicable donor and regulatory requirements, organizational policies, and humanitarian quality standards.
  • Assess global MEAL capacity and implement targeted strengthening plans for country offices, technical teams, and local partners.
  • Ensure the MEAL function is structured and resourced to provide both independent quality assurance and practical support to program teams.
  • Represent MEAL priorities in strategy development, annual planning, portfolio review, resource allocation, investment prioritization, and organizational risk management.

    • Theory of Change, Program Design and Evidence Generation 20%

  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to strengthen country office alignment with WR DMEAL standards for project ToCs, logical and results frameworks, indicator design, measurement plans, learning agendas, and evaluation frameworks.
  • Ensure execution and continuous improvement of the International Programs outcome and strategy target architecture that supports appropriate aggregation while preserving contextual meaning and avoiding inappropriate standardization.
  • Strengthen evidence-informed program design and monitoring through existing evidence, formative research, gender and inclusion analysis, community perspectives, and testing of causal pathways and assumptions.
  • Contribute to an organization-wide research and evaluation agenda aligned with strategic evidence gaps, program priorities, and learning needs.
  • Oversee research and evaluations as appropriate, including methodological design, sampling, data-collection quality, analysis, validation, reporting, and use.

    • Business Development, Donor Compliance and Strategic Partnerships, 15%

  • Provide MEAL leadership for major funding opportunities, including program logic, indicators, learning and evaluation approaches, data systems, staffing, and budgets.
  • Maintain knowledge of major donor MEAL requirements and support country offices and program teams in aligning systems and responding to donor, auditor, and partner inquiries without creating unnecessary parallel systems or reporting burdens.
  • Strengthen the use of credible evidence in fundraising, donor engagement, positioning, external publications, presentations, and thought leadership.
  • Represent WR in MEAL technical working groups, donor consultations, research partnerships, communities of practice, conferences, and relevant interagency forums.
  • Alongside other members of the Program Quality & Impact department, identify opportunities for joint research, methodological innovation, sector-wide learning, and technology collaboration.

    • Data Quality, Digital Transformation and MEAL Systems 10%

  • Establish and oversee a comprehensive data-quality assurance framework, including standards, validation and verification procedures, periodic assessments, escalation protocols, and corrective actions for significant data-integrity concerns.
  • Ensure data quality is recognized as a shared management responsibility rather than solely the responsibility of the MEAL team.
  • Support a multiyear roadmap for modernizing and integrating global MEAL systems.
  • Guide the selection, design, piloting, deployment, integration, and continuous improvement of MEAL platforms in collaboration with IT, country offices, technical teams, end users, and vendors, ensuring systems are secure, accessible, scalable, maintainable, and appropriate for low-connectivity settings.
  • Alongside other AI Integration Leads, identify and prioritize responsible AI, automation, and analytics applications, and assess whether digital investments improve data quality, timeliness, efficiency, accessibility, evidence use, and decision-making.

    • Accountability and Learning 10%

  • Alongside the Accountability and Safeguarding Director, provide organizational leadership for embedding accountability to affected populations throughout the program cycle.
  • Promote community-led monitoring and participatory evaluation, including community involvement in interpreting findings and communicating results back to affected populations.
  • Ensure program data are responsibly disaggregated and analyzed for differences in access, participation, experience, outcomes, satisfaction, exclusion, and potential harm.
  • In partnership with the Accountability & Safeguarding team, monitor the timeliness, completeness, safety, and quality of organizational responses to community feedback, including transparent communication about how feedback influenced decisions.
  • Advance organizational, portfolio, sector, and program learning agendas and promote the documentation, dissemination, and application of promising practices, adaptations, failures, unintended outcomes, and transferable lessons.

    • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • A relationship with Jesus Christ that serves as the primary motivator and guide in your professional career and clearly informs your perspective in understanding issues related to the work of World Relief.
  • Advanced knowledge of monitoring, evaluation, accountability, research, learning, and impact-measurement methodologies.
  • Proficiency with digital data collection, data management, business intelligence, analytics, and visualization platforms.
  • Working knowledge of platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, Microsoft Power Platform, SurveyCTO, KoboToolbox, CommCare, ODK, DHIS2, Salesforce, GIS platforms, SQL-based systems, APIs, or comparable technologies.
  • Strong experience developing, testing, and refining Theories of Change, results frameworks, indicators, learning agendas, measurement plans, and evaluation strategies.
  • Ability to lead major systems transformation and organizational change processes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading organizational performance, evidence, impact reporting, and learning systems.
  • Demonstrated expertise in data-quality assurance, data governance, indicator standardization, organizational reporting, and evidence integrity.
  • Experience with major institutional donors such as USAID, the U.S. Department of State, FCDO, the European Union, United Nations agencies, Global Affairs Canada, foundations, or multilateral organizations.
  • Experience strengthening the MEAL capacity of country offices and local partners.
  • Strong understanding of accountability to affected populations, feedback and complaints mechanisms, participatory monitoring, inclusion, safeguarding, and humanitarian quality standards.
  • Expertise in organizational performance management, portfolio analysis, executive reporting, dashboard design, data visualization, evidence synthesis, and impact storytelling.
  • Strong understanding of AI capabilities and limitations relevant to monitoring, evaluation, qualitative analysis, anomaly detection, knowledge management, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Strong project management, facilitation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Significant experience supervising, coaching, and developing multidisciplinary and geographically dispersed teams.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly and persuasively to executive, technical, donor, partner, and community audiences.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Masters degree in monitoring and evaluation, statistics, data science, public health, international development, social sciences, economics, information systems, research methods, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 12 to 15 years of progressively responsible experience in international development, humanitarian assistance, monitoring and evaluation, research, accountability, learning, program quality, data systems, or evidence management.
  • Minimum of seven years leading complex MEAL, evidence, impact, or organizational performance functions across multiple countries with at least three years of experience working in fragile or conflict-affected areas or with people on the move as a key target population.
  • Experience designing or overseeing enterprise-level digital data systems, executive dashboards, analytics tools, or reporting platforms.
  • Proficiency in French, Kiswahili or Arabic is highly desirable.
  • Experience deploying cloud-based, mobile, offline-capable, interoperable, or low-connectivity data systems across multiple countries.
  • Experience with GIS, predictive analytics, forecasting, experimental or quasi-experimental evaluation, implementation of research, or cost-effectiveness analysis.
  • Experience collaborating with faith-based organizations, local civil society, research institutions, technology companies, and government systems.
  • Experience publishing or presenting evaluation, research, or program-learning findings.
World Relief offers a competitive benefits package and employee discount program for full-time employees.
World Relief is honored to be recognized with the Gold-level Cigna Healthy Workforce Designation for exceeding the core components of our well-being program including leadership and culture, program foundations and execution, and whole person health.

We are proud to be an EEO/AA employer M/F/D/V. We maintain a drug-free workplace and perform pre-employment substance abuse testing.
For World Relief staff, strong commitment to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief is essential, and Christian faith is a prerequisite for employment, based upon United States federal guidelines provided in Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

Claroty is a global leader in cyber-physical systems (CPS) protection, dedicated to securing the critical infrastructure that keeps the world running. We’re a fast-growing, award-winning team where innovation meets purpose—and we want you to help us define the future of cybersecurity.

As a Product Support Engineer at Claroty, you will play a critical role in supporting enterprise customers who rely on our platform to protect their mission-critical environments. You will act as a trusted technical advisor, troubleshooting complex networking and system-related issues across SaaS and on-prem environments. You will collaborate closely with R&D, Product, Customer Success, and Technical Account Managers to ensure customers achieve maximum value from the Claroty platform.

Claroty is deployed by hundreds of organizations at thousands of sites globally. The company is headquartered in New York City and has a presence in Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. Claroty is widely recognized as the industry leader in CPS protection, backed by the world’s largest investment firms and industrial automation vendors. jobs.excerpt: Your wellbeing, our mission.  Join a company shaping a healthier world.
jobs.description:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally.

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Programs Manager to our Revenue team in Brazil!

This role is to join our global Revenue Growth function, responsible for owning and scaling Wellhub’s expansion agenda across our SMB client base and extending it up-market to larger accounts. As a senior individual contributor, you will run the program end-to-end—using data analysis, A/B experimentation, and monthly waves to drive incremental revenue while building agentic and automated workflows to eliminate manual execution. The position will work closely with SMB Commercial Leadership, Value Management, Sales Operations, and Commercial Finance to design next-generation growth levers and forecast financial impact. This is a great opportunity to own a high-impact global growth engine and take cutting-edge AI automation into production to bring our existing-client revenue to the next level.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Owns the scaled Revenue Growth strategy globally, in partnership with SMB Commercial Leadership, Value Management and Sales Operations, including end-to-end monthly execution: leverage SQL for cohort identification, price-increase, off-waiver and step-up-waiver waves, and tracking against budget and attainment.
  • Defines where and how to expand the Programmatic Agenda up-market to larger clients, including which cohorts, levers and pricing guardrails fit those segments, in partnership with Value Management and Commercial Leadership.
  • Designs and runs A/B experiments, with clear hypotheses and success metrics, to drive incremental growth or improve the operational efficiency of the Revenue Growth strategy.
  • Leads the monthly and quarterly cross-functional Revenue Growth forums with commercial, operations and finance leadership, and independently delivers executive summaries of performance and program health to senior leadership.
  • Drives financial impact analysis with Commercial Finance and Sales Operations so teams understand expected versus actual impact, and forecasts revenue growth from the existing client base.
  • Drives and influences the development and prioritization of new programs with Product, Product Marketing, Client Marketing, CX/CRG, Value Management and Commercial teams, to grow incremental client revenue, improve net revenue margins, and improve client communication and operational efficiency.
  • Builds agentic and automated workflows that automate meaningful parts of the program, evaluating where an agent should replace a manual process and where it should not; provides continuity on in-flight automation and takes it from prototype to production.
  • Analyzes net margins across the SMB base.
  • Owns results dashboards and the retention-guidelines discount calculator used by CS/CRG agents, keeping both aligned to Value Management's current guidance.
  • Scales proven GTM motions globally, supporting Global Programs and the Commercial and Channel Partner teams by sharing learnings and providing operational guidance.
  • Determines the incremental and future development of the Client Console, partnering with Product Development and Analytics to prioritize the features needed to manage Wellhub clients at scale.
  • Analyzes large datasets (SQL) to track program performance (NRR, renewal rate, MRR churn at renewal), and communicates findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A strategic, data-driven professional with proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, growth strategy, or program management, with a proven track record of scaling commercial initiatives.

  • You have extensive experience in SQL and large-dataset analysis, paired with solid in-depth knowledge of Salesforce and BI tools (such as Looker Studio) to build dashboards and track core metrics like NRR, renewal rates, MRR churn, and net margins.

  • An analytical problem-solver with a deep understanding of pricing and renewal mechanics, capable of designing rigorous A/B experiments and partnering with Finance to forecast revenue impact against actuals.

  • You are curious about and hands-on with AI and workflow automation, bringing the ability to take agentic workflows from prototype to production—while exercising sharp judgment on where automation should replace manual work and where human nuance is essential.

  • A true self-starter who thrives on end-to-end ownership, seamlessly collaborating with and influencing cross-functional stakeholders across Commercial Leadership, Product, Marketing, Finance, and CX to turn complex ideas into global motions.

  • A strong communicator, both written and verbal, with the ability to lead monthly and quarterly business forums, deliver clear executive summaries to senior leadership, and translate technical insights for non-technical audiences.

  • You bring fluency in both English and Portuguese, allowing you to navigate global programs and local operations effortlessly.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that proven experience in pricing, revenue operations, or analytical program management, hands-on proficiency in SQL, and fluency in English and Portuguese are mandatory requirements.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life.

Our flexible benefits program allows you to customize some of the benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: Free Gold+ membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

WELLZ: A complete emotional wellbeing program with a unique approach. It offers personalized journeys that combine individual therapy sessions (52 per year) and on-demand content.

HEALTHCARE: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. When you join, use our home office reimbursement to set up your home office.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: It’s important to take time away from work to recharge.Employees receive vacations after 6 months and additional 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + an extra holiday for your birthday!

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions, build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success.

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here.

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Wellhub was named a Top Sales Team of 2025!This is a recognition of the collaboration and impact we create together every day. Ready to be part of a team that’s making a real difference? Read more about the award here.

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

jobs.excerpt: What success looks like in this role: Position Summary The Windows Patching Engineer is responsible for Windows patching activities across enterprise Windows Server environments, including planning, testing, scheduling, deployment, validation, compliance reporting, exception management, and remediation.
jobs.description:
What success looks like in this role:

Position Summary


The Windows Patching Engineer is responsible for Windows patching activities across enterprise Windows Server environments, including planning, testing, scheduling, deployment, validation, compliance reporting, exception management, and remediation.


The engineer ensures Windows and Microsoft infrastructure patches are deployed consistently, safely, and in line with security, operational, and customer requirements, improving audit readiness and reducing exposure to known vulnerabilities.


The engineer works with the Windows Vulnerability Engineer to prioritize patching based on risk and customer requirements, and with the Patching Automation Engineer to automate whatever can be automated. The role also collaborates with Windows systems administrators, identity, cybersecurity, application owners, change management, service delivery, and the Linux and Middleware Patching Engineers. The Windows Patching Engineer owns patching execution and outcomes; the Patching Automation Engineer builds and maintains reusable automation.


Key Responsibilities

  • Be responsible for all Windows server patching activities across on-premises and cloud environments, including monthly cumulative updates, out-of-band releases, servicing stack updates, .NET Framework updates, and server roles and features.
  • Track Microsoft security releases and advisories. Work with the Windows Vulnerability Engineer to prioritize patches by risk (severity, exploitability, system criticality) and customer requirements, and maintain routine and emergency schedules aligned with remediation timelines and SLAs.
  • Review release notes, prerequisites, and known issues; coordinate testing across development, test, staging, disaster recovery, and production, accounting for application compatibility, reboot dependencies, Windows Server Failover Clusters, and SQL Server Always On availability groups.
  • Prepare implementation, validation, communication, and backout plans; maintain change records with risk assessments, approvals, and testing evidence; confirm backup and recovery readiness before deployment.
  • Lead go/no-go reviews; coordinate phased deployments in approved maintenance windows, including domain controllers and other critical infrastructure; verify systems, applications, clusters, and integrations after patching.
  • Troubleshoot Windows Update, Configuration Manager client, and installation failures (failed updates, pending reboots, component store corruption); coordinate rollback or recovery, escalate service-impacting failures, and apply lessons learned.
  • Partner with the Windows Vulnerability Engineer and cybersecurity teams to turn findings into patching plans; reconcile scanner, Configuration Manager, Azure Update Manager, and inventory data to close coverage gaps and drive failed, overdue, or noncompliant systems to closure.
  • Manage patch exceptions, including end-of-support and Extended Security Updates systems; document compensating controls and remediation plans, and retain approval, testing, deployment, and remediation evidence for audits.
  • Work with the Patching Automation Engineer to automate what can be automated, including Configuration Manager automatic deployment rules, WSUS approvals, Azure Update Manager schedules, and Cluster-Aware Updating; define, test, and validate workflows while retaining ownership of patch execution, compliance, and remediation.
  • Maintain patch calendars, runbooks, inventories, and dashboards; report compliance, deployment status, failures, exceptions, aging vulnerabilities, and risks; coordinate shared maintenance windows with the Linux and Middleware Patching Engineers.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent education and experience.
  • Six or more years in Windows systems administration, infrastructure operations, patch management, vulnerability remediation, or a related technical role.
  • Hands-on experience managing patching across enterprise Windows Server environments (physical, virtual, and cloud-hosted).
  • Strong knowledge of supported Windows Server versions, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows servicing (cumulative updates, servicing stack updates, out-of-band releases).
  • Experience planning, testing, deploying, validating, and troubleshooting Windows patches, including production systems, Failover Clusters, SQL Server high availability, domain controllers, and disaster recovery environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Configuration Manager, SCCM, Azure Update Manager, or an equivalent enterprise patching platform.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell for scripting, troubleshooting, and validation.
  • Experience producing patch compliance reports, metrics, executive summaries, and audit evidence.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, organizational, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to support maintenance windows and emergency patching outside normal business hours.
  • U.S. Citizenship and U.S. residency required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Enterprise-scale Configuration Manager and WSUS administration, including automatic deployment rules, software update groups, and maintenance windows.
  • Azure Arc and Azure Update Manager for hybrid and cloud-hosted Windows servers.
  • Patching Windows servers on VMware vSphere or Microsoft Hyper-V.
  • Ansible Automation Platform, GitLab CI/CD, Terraform, HashiCorp Vault, and JFrog Artifactory.
  • Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
  • Power BI or ServiceNow dashboards.
  • Familiarity with NIST guidance, CIS controls, STIGs for Windows Server, or comparable frameworks.
  • Leading patching across multiple customers, business units, or distributed environments.
