jobs.description:
Sphera is a leading global provider of enterprise software and services that enables companies to manage and optimize their environmental, health, safety and sustainability. Our mission is to create a safer, more sustainable and productive world.

Sphera is a portfolio company of Blackstone, a U.S.-based alternative asset investment company that focuses on private equity, technology and innovation, and more. Blackstone businesses succeed through strong partnerships, a personalized approach and a commitment to exceptional performance with uncompromising integrity. Sphera and Blackstone are leaders in the Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) space.

We are guided by our core values of Customer Centricity, Accountability, Bias to Action, Innovation, and Collaboration. These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

You'll be part of the Sphera AI Center of Excellence team building and maturing the AI capabilities that Sphera and its customers depend on. You will design and ship AI agents and AI-powered features used across product families and internal functions, and act as the expert other teams come to when they want to build with AI themselves.


We build on Claude and deploy on Azure AI Foundry, with Claude Code as our primary development environment. The pace is fast, prototype to production in weeks, not quarters, so you'll apply the skills you have while learning new ones constantly. If you have hands-on experience shipping LLM-based systems and enjoy unblocking other engineers, you'll do well here.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain production AI agents and AI-powered features — new builds as well as enhancements to existing solutions.
  • Build and sustain agentic systems end to end: task decomposition, tool design, context and memory strategy, orchestration, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback behavior.
  • Build the retrieval and grounding layer — document processing, chunking, hybrid search, and citation — so agents answer from Sphera's own data.
  • Deploy and operate AI workloads on Azure AI Foundry: model deployments, endpoints, content safety, private networking, and cost and quota management.
  • Use Claude Code as a core engineering tool and set the patterns other teams follow when they do the same.
  • Own evaluation: build eval suites and golden datasets, measure accuracy, latency, cost, and tool-call correctness, and gate changes on results.
  • Implement AI guardrails, prompt-injection defenses, and PII handling, working with Platform Engineering on identity and network controls.
  • Ship through CI/CD with versioned prompts and agent definitions, plus tracing and token/cost observability on every path.
  • Support teams adopting shared AI services — review their designs, troubleshoot integrations, and document reusable patterns.
  • Establish KPIs for adoption, quality, and cost-per-outcome, and use them to drive improvement and make the team's impact visible.
  • Participate fully in the agile process — own your sprint tasks, log time worked, and keep details current.

Required Skills and Experience

AI Engineering

  • 4–6 years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years building with large language models in production.
  • Hands-on experience shipping agentic systems: multi-step tool use, structured outputs, state and memory, error recovery — and the judgment to know when an agent isn't the right answer.
  • Working command of Claude or a comparable frontier model platform, including APIs, tool use, and agent SDKs.
  • Practical daily use of AI-assisted development tooling, Claude Code in particular.
  • Retrieval engineering: embeddings, vector and hybrid search, reranking, and evaluating retrieval quality on its own terms.
  • Evaluation and observability for non-deterministic systems — offline evals, human review loops, tracing, and cost instrumentation.

Software and Cloud

  • Strong Python, plus one of TypeScript, C#, or Java.
  • Azure AI Foundry or Azure OpenAI — model deployment, endpoint configuration, and content safety controls.
  • Azure fundamentals: App Service or Function Apps, Key Vault, Storage, Entra ID managed identities, and Application Insights.
  • CI/CD with Azure DevOps — YAML pipelines, multi-stage deployments, and secret management.
  • REST and async API design, and integration with enterprise systems of record.
  • Databases (SQL and NoSQL) and vector stores; solid Git and code review practice.

Professional

  • Sound security judgment applied to AI — least privilege for tool access, secrets management, data exfiltration risk, and compliance-driven controls.
  • Excellent communication, with the ability to explain AI design decisions and trade-offs to people who are not AI specialists.
  • Experience working in an agile AIDLC (AI-driven software development lifecycle) in a fast-paced environment with high demand and high standards.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Model Context Protocol (MCP) — building tools and connectors that give models governed access to internal systems.
  • AI features in a commercial SaaS product, including multi-tenant and data-isolation concerns.
  • Document AI and unstructured data extraction at volume.
  • Classical ML or fine-tuning background — enough to know when a smaller or non-LLM approach wins.
  • Databricks, Azure Data Factory, or comparable data orchestration tooling.
  • AI governance frameworks — EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, or ISO 42001.
  • Domain exposure to EHS, sustainability, ESG, or industrial risk.
  • Relevant certifications (AI-102, AZ-204, or similar).

About Refold

Refold is building the next-generation AI platform that replaces enterprise integration and consultants. We’re pioneering autonomous AI agents that understand complex enterprise systems, generate production-ready code, and operate at a scale no consulting firm can match. Today, we’re starting with integrations—a $50B market. Tomorrow, we’re building towards a world where AI agents handle any complex cognitive work.

Traction: Serving 20+ enterprise customers with Fortune 500 deployments, processing 10M+ API calls/day. Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia & Abhishek Kumar, who sold their previous startup to Netmeds; they have also been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. They have experience at organisations such as Nomura, JioMart, InstaMojo, IIT Kharagpur, and IIT Roorkee. We are funded by marquee investors, including Eniac Ventures, Tidal Ventures, Karman Ventures, Ahead VC & Better Capital.

The Role:

As a forward-deployed engineer, you turn the hardest enterprise integration problems into production-grade systems on our agentic platform. You’ll take ambiguous, real-world requirements; messy APIs; undocumented systems; and edge cases nobody anticipated and reason from first principles to ship production-grade integrations.

You’re a curious, hands-on builder with a customer-first mindset and a real passion for AI already on the frontier of agentic tooling and vibe coding and eager to point that energy at real customer problems. You think like a solutions engineer: the goal isn’t to build; it’s to solve. Mostly delivery, with time as the technical engine behind our highest-stakes POCs — and the patterns you uncover shape the platform itself.

  • Building: Agentic AI workflows, connectors, and high-throughput integration pipelines.

  • You’ll work with integration leaders and engineering teams at high-growth SaaS companies and Fortune 500 enterprises.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Solve hard integration problems. Take ambiguous, real-world enterprise requirements and reason from first principles to design integrations that work, including the problems for which no playbook exists yet.

  • Build agentic workflows end-to-end. Implement complete integrations on Refold’s AI-native integration platform, orchestration logic, agentic decision-making, data transformations, and system connectivity against live enterprise systems.

  • Drive product direction from the field. You’re one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface gaps, friction, and missing capabilities you hit while building and validate new platform features through real customer workflows.

  • Power high-stakes POCs. Partner with the pre-sales team to execute the technical work behind proofs-of-concept, building and validating integrations that prove value during the sales cycle.

  • Codify what works. Turn hard-won learnings into reference architectures, integration patterns, and runbooks that scale across the delivery team and feed the support knowledge base.

  • Evolve agentic capabilities. Contribute to the evolution of Refold's agentic workflows — decision-making logic, tool invocation, and autonomous execution within integrations — and feed every implementation back into the skills/graph layer so the platform's agents get measurably smarter with each integration you ship.

  • Strong foundation in APIs, distributed systems, and common integration patterns.

  • Hands-on proficiency in Python and/or JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js).

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with enterprise systems such as Salesforce, SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, or ServiceNow.

  • Familiarity with iPaaS or workflow automation platforms (Workato, Boomi, MuleSoft, Zapier, Merge).

  • Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, and Azure) and containerised environments (Docker and Kubernetes).

  • Hands-on experience building with LLMs and agentic frameworks (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, agent orchestration).

  • Background at an early-stage startup where product and engineering responsibilities were tightly coupled.

Why Join Refold AI?

  • Fast-growing seed-stage company (raised $6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures)

  • Founding team opportunity to shape engineering culture and technical direction from day one

  • Cutting-edge AI + infrastructure tech solving complex, high-value enterprise problems

  • Early traction with Fortune 500 clients and high-growth software companies

jobs.excerpt: At Feeld, we are creating a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves.
jobs.description:
At Feeld, we are creating a world where everyone is more intimately connected to each other and themselves. We are building an inclusive, human-centred product and are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to become part of our remote team and our mission to elevate the human experience of sexuality and relationships.

This role owns how Feeld finds, fixes and prevents security issues. You'll run and improve the tooling and programmes that surface vulnerabilities, from penetration tests and our bug bounty to automated scanning. You'll fix issues in our platform and infrastructure alongside our Platform and Infrastructure engineers, and triage findings in product code to the squads that own it. You'll also set the security standards our engineers build to, and make sure they're followed.

To be right for this role, you should have hands-on experience securing cloud-hosted applications, a track record of getting vulnerabilities fixed across several engineering teams, and the engineering skills to ship fixes yourself.

What you will do

  • Own and improve how we find vulnerabilities, from penetration tests and our bug bounty programme to cloud security tooling and code and dependency scanning in CI, so we're looking in the right places and engineers trust what we find.
  • Triage findings from every source: reproduce them, assess real-world risk and set severity.
  • Fix vulnerabilities in our platform and infrastructure, such as cloud configuration, access, CI/CD and shared services, working alongside our Platform and Infrastructure engineers.
  • Route findings in product code to the squad that owns it, with a deadline that matches its risk, and pair with its engineers or review their changes where that helps. Work with squad leads and product managers so security work is planned into roadmaps and sprints, not dropped on teams unannounced.
  • Verify every fix and follow up with whoever reported the issue, including bug bounty researchers.
  • Make sure security standards and policies for areas such as authentication, secrets and access control are followed through secure defaults, automated checks and reviews.
  • Design and run our vulnerability management process: severity model, remediation timelines, exceptions and risk acceptance, and plain-language reporting to Engineering leadership.
  • Take part in security incident response, bringing your investigation and remediation skills.

How you will grow

  • Shape how security works across Feeld Engineering, as one of the people defining it.
  • Gain deep experience protecting a product that handles sensitive personal data, where privacy and safety matter to every Member.
  • Build your influence across teams by partnering with squad leads and Engineering leadership on priorities and trade-offs.
  • Learn our stack end to end: AWS, TypeScript/Node.js services and a React Native mobile app.

Requirements

About you

  • You have hands-on experience in application or cloud security for products running on a major cloud provider, ideally AWS, and you're comfortable shipping fixes yourself, in application code (e.g. TypeScript or Python) or infrastructure configuration.
  • You have driven vulnerabilities to closure across several engineering teams you didn't manage, through clear ownership, deadlines and follow-through rather than reports alone.
  • You have run and improved the ways a company finds vulnerabilities, such as automated scanning, cloud security tooling, pentests or a bug bounty, and you can tell real risk from noise.
  • You have set security standards or processes, for example for authentication or vulnerability management, and got teams to follow them in practice.
  • You are direct and pragmatic: you push for the fix that matters most, make trade-offs openly, and write clearly in a remote, async setting.

Bonus points

  • You have worked on a product that handles sensitive personal data, such as dating, health or finance.
  • You have run, or worked closely with, a bug bounty programme.
  • You have experience with mobile application security (iOS, Android or React Native).
  • You have added security checks to CI/CD (static analysis, dependency or secrets scanning) and tuned them until engineers trusted the results.
  • You have experience securing infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform) or working with cloud security posture tooling.

Benefits

About us:

Feeld is an independent, experimental and fully remote organisation reshaping the dialogue on dating and sexuality. The company was founded in 2014 and has evolved since to become the open, distributed structure it is now. We have a naturally agile and fluid culture. The whole team is fully remote, which means you work where and when helps you perform at your best. We regard autonomy highly and treat our organisation as a product – we iterate, improve and test things internally to see what works best for everyone.

Our culture:

We believe in creating a safe work environment through humanity, fluidity, safety, transparency and progressiveness. When hiring, we look for culture add rather than culture fit.

Because we are a fully remote team, it’s especially important that we create an environment where our colleagues feel included and connected as humans.

Diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging at Feeld:

Feeld promotes open-mindedness, inclusion, diversity and kindness, both in the world and among our own workforce.

We encourage and welcome applications from people with a history of marginalisation, whether because of race, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, neurodivergence, national origin, disability (seen or unseen) or any confluence of intersectional identities.

Our goal is a barrier-free application process and working environment. If you require further details or assistance or have any questions about this process, please let us know at .

Compensation and perks:

We are conscious of how our work and decisions impact other humans and the environment. We design our product and organisation with consideration for the wellbeing of our Members and colleagues. Feeld’s way of working is designed to proactively prevent burnout and an “always on” culture. We believe in technology and working environments that enable people to live a meaningful, fulfilled life.

Therefore, we offer our staff:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • A fully remote working situation
  • Home office budget
  • Learning & development budget
  • On demand therapy sessions and mental health support via Spill
  • In-person meet ups

Our compensation system is one of the ways we work to uphold equity and inclusion at Feeld. Just as we strive to enable honest expression on our platform, we strive for openness of information within the organization. Internally, we keep decision-making transparent to keep each other accountable and make sure all voices are heard. That is why we offer a compensation system that is transparent, honest, and equitable. Additionally, we believe all humans deserve to earn a competitive wage, so we offer a Baseline Freedom Salary of £60,000 GBP per year for any role that indexes below £60,000 GBP per year.

Estimated compensation for this role:

  • Total cash compensation for this role varies by geographic location. We estimate the market-competitive compensation range for this position to be between £100,000 - £125,000 GBP

Our interview process:

  • Your first conversation with Feeld will be a screening call with our recruiter, where you’ll be able to ask - and receive answers - regarding any general questions you have and to confirm the role is a fit for what you’re seeking.
  • Your second conversation will connect you directly with the hiring manager for the role you’re applying to. Here, you’ll have a chance to ask more questions about the work you’ll be doing. This conversation will also focus on your past work experiences.
  • The next step for most of our roles is a candidate challenge. This is an evaluation of the skills relevant to be successful in this role and generally takes about an hour to complete.
  • Your third conversation allows you the opportunity to meet the team members you might be working with on a daily basis. Here, you’ll be able to ask questions about team processes, workflow, and the employee experience at Feeld.
  • We generally make an offer within 2 weeks of our final call, and offer a flexible start date that can begin as early as the next Monday after you sign our offer documentation.
  • Of note: all of our interviews are conducted remotely, and our interviewers will work with you to find an agreeable interview time based on mutual availability.

We understand we're asking you to invest your time and best efforts in our process, and are appreciative of getting the chance to better know who you are as a person and candidate. In return, we’re committed to offering transparent communication and prompt feedback as you navigate this application with us.

To find out more about Feeld, download our app (available on iOS and Android).

About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to design, develop, and deliver the core backend services powering a real-time enterprise operations platform.

The role focuses on building scalable backend services, integrating with enterprise client systems, and developing intelligent, rule-based assignment and resource allocation capabilities.

You will work closely with an existing team of backend engineers, frontend developers, and other technical stakeholders to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions within a fast-paced, delivery-focused engagement.

This opportunity is ideal for a hands-on engineer who combines strong backend development expertise with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, maintainable, and testable systems.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Backend Engineering & Architecture

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.
  • Build and deploy cloud-native services using Azure App Service and Azure Functions.
  • Develop reliable RESTful APIs to support application functionality and enterprise integrations.
  • Ensure backend services are modular, maintainable, performant, and production-ready.

Enterprise Systems Integration

  • Design and implement integrations with enterprise client systems, including Microsoft SQL Server databases and external APIs.
  • Develop incremental data synchronization and change detection mechanisms to efficiently process updates from source systems.
  • Implement reliable data ingestion, transformation, validation, and error-handling processes.

Rule-Based Assignment & Resource Allocation

  • Design and implement configurable, rule-based assignment engines that allocate work based on business-defined eligibility, prioritization, and ranking criteria.
  • Develop logic to automatically reassess and rerun assignments when operational conditions, business rules, or resource availability change.
  • Translate complex operational requirements into efficient, deterministic, and testable backend logic.
  • Support the evolution of assignment and scheduling capabilities as business requirements develop.

Database Design & Data Management

  • Design and maintain relational data models using Azure SQL, Microsoft SQL Server, and Prisma ORM.
  • Implement configurable business data structures, including version-controlled templates, effectivedated configurations, and historical records.
  • Optimize database queries, indexing, and data access patterns for performance and scalability.
  • Maintain data integrity and consistency across services and integrations.

Event-Driven Architecture & Asynchronous Processing

  • Build and maintain event-driven workflows using Azure Service Bus and Redis.
  • Implement asynchronous processing, message queues, and background task execution.
  • Ensure robust message handling through idempotency, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, and failure recovery strategies.
  • Design services that can reliably handle changing operational conditions and high-volume data processing.

Testing, Monitoring & Production Delivery

  • Develop unit, integration, and automated tests to ensure system reliability.
  • Implement application monitoring, logging, and diagnostics using Azure Application Insights.
  • Troubleshoot backend performance, integration failures, and production issues.
  • Collaborate with engineering and QA teams throughout development, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production deployment.
  • Take ownership of deliverables and contribute to successful go-live within agreed timelines.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Tightknit Tightknit is the community platform built for Slack.
jobs.description:
About Tightknit

Tightknit is the community platform built for Slack. We help B2B teams grow engaged communities with events, gamification, SEO, and branded spaces, all with a deep integration into Slack. We believe communities deserve better, and we build alongside the customers, advocates, and partners who use our product.

Engineering Culture

At Tightknit we are committed to only hiring *“Hell yeah!”*s and not “meh”s. We believe an awesome culture is a natural byproduct of an awesome team.

Here are qualities we strive for:

  • Extreme Ownership: Take pride in your work, own features completely, and fix issues even when they fall outside your exact domain.
  • Strong Opinions, Weakly Held: We want opinionated people who will push back on plans they disagree with, but who will commit fully once a decision is made.
  • Thick Skin, Not Thick Skulls: We welcome debate without taking it personally, knowing that critique is a gift.
  • Be a Pioneer: You are comfortable buildings systems around you from scratch.
  • Hustle with Purpose, not Polish: Stay scrappy. Iterate quickly.
  • No Energy Vampires: We have a strict "We > Me" mentality and will not tolerate high-blame mentalities, territorial behavior, or oversized egos.
  • Kaizen (改善): Leave things better than you found them; make incremental improvements.
  • Use AI to disrupt yourself: Otherwise your job, or your company, may not exist soon.

You should be able to speak to how you value the impact of community (being a member of a community group is a major plus).

Overview

Hi 👋 I’m Stephen, Co-Founder and CTO at Tightknit. We are on a mission to revolutionize online communities with an innovative platform built for trust, engagement, and connection, especially meeting members where they are within an app they already love: Slack. Tightknit powers customer and developer communities for teams like Clay, MotherDuck, Mixpanel, Vanta, Gamma, and Stripe.

Our vision is to make communities a bastion of genuine human relationship and the OS for every business’s sales & marketing team. And we are hiring our first Founding Engineer to help us build that future!

As an early engineer, you will:

  • Work directly with the CTO
  • Define architecture, not just implement it
  • Shape product direction, not just execute it
  • Own systems end-to-end (design → implementation → monitoring → iteration)
  • Interact directly with customers
  • Build internal AI workflows to accelerate our velocity
  • Help determine how engineering operates here
  • Wear many hats and operate independently with high accountability

This isn’t just a coding role. It is a seat at the table. In fact, while programming knowledge matters, in the AI age it’s becoming less and less central to our day-to-day work. So who are we really looking for?

  • Engineer with taste - Put away the IDE for a moment and put on your PM hat. We trust in your ability to talk to customers, synthesize their asks, and create excellent products with extreme level of thoughtfulness and detail. You hold yourself and your work to a high bar.
  • Engineer who can design - You don’t need to be a front-end wizard (although we’d love if you are!), but you have a good eye for distinguishing good vs. bad UX. Don’t expect sloppiness in any area of the stack to be fixed by someone else.
  • Engineer who can manage - Everyone now has access to an army of digital employees and the best programmers on earth. Can you effectively use them to multiply yourself and our team? Oh and did we mention, everyone at Tightknit is a community manager! 🙌

What We're Looking For

This is a staff-level role, so we require at least 5+ years of experience as a full-time full-stack engineer. You must possess strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience designing production systems.

Experience at an early-stage startup or working directly with founders is strongly preferred. Experience delivering enterprise products is a bonus.

Smarter, Better, Faster, Stronger

We believe every hire either makes us “smarter” (fills in our weak spots) or “stronger” (adds fuel to our strengths), or both! For this role, we will be honing in especially on candidates whose skills make us smarter.

Here’s a fun visual of where we think our team’s strengths / preferences currently lie:

Front-End  🟪🟪🟪🟪🟪 / 🟦🟦🟦🟦⬜
Back-End   🟪🟪🟪⬜⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦🟦
Infra/Ops  🟪🟪🟪⬜⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦⬜
API        🟪🟪🟪🟪⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦⬜
Perf       🟪🟪🟪⬜⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦⬜
Security   🟪🟪🟪🟪⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦⬜
Database   🟪🟪⬜⬜⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦🟦
Humility   🟪🟪🟪🟪⬜ / 🟦🟦🟦🟦⬜
^us          ^you??

Technology Stack

You do not need to know all of these perfectly on day one, but you must be able to learn quickly.

  • Languages & Frameworks: Javascript / Typescript, React, Next.js, TanStack, Node.js, Tailwind
  • Infrastructure & Cloud: Cloudflare ecosystem (Workers, KV, Durable Objects, Workflows, Queues), Vercel
  • Data: PostgresSQL, Drizzle, Supabase
  • Platforms: Slack platform, OpenAPI APIs, and event-driven architectures
  • Tools: Github, Linear, Slack, OpenAI, Claude, Cursor, Antigravity, Notion, Posthog, Mintlify, Canva, Sentry (suggest something to us!)

Interview Process

  1. Intro Call (30 minutes) - get to know each other, brag about how many LLM tokens you use, we demo Tightknit, etc.
  2. Technical Screen (1 hour)
  3. Open-Ended Technical Exercise (2 hours) - pair programming simulation, open-ended exercises
  4. Founders Call(s) (30 minutes) - hear our vision, make sure you like us and we like you and you are not a sociopath thank you! 🤍
  5. Reach out to References - we may ask you for references, so others may also confirm you are indeed not a sociopath

Compatibility Check

SuperDay (typically 1 day) - paid work trial, designed as a mutual compatibility check so you can see what it’s like to work with us (and we can learn what it’s like to work with you). This is a pragmatic test of fit that ensures everyone is genuinely excited about the partnership. It is not designed as a technical test.

SuperDay

The final stage of our process is what we call a SuperDay. This is typically one paid full day of work with us, which we can flexibly arrange around the candidate's schedule. The goal is a mutual compatibility check so all of us can get a real sense of what it’d be like to work together. The SuperDay may be done remotely or in person if nearby one of our co-working spaces. We are not able to bypass this stage so if the candidate is not interested in doing this final step, unfortunately we will have to part ways and the candidate will no longer be considered for the role.

💡We can be very flexible with scheduling! For example, we can split the SuperDay into half-days, do it in the evenings, or schedule it on a weekend as needed.

The candidate will be working on mock tasks similar to the real-world day-to-day work someone in this role does at Tightknit. They will also have the chance to meet a few of their potential direct team members, and if they haven’t already, our founders. This gives the candidate a chance to show off their skills, and for us to see the quality, speed and communication of the candidate. Overall, the candidate should aim to spend at least 80% of their time and energy on the task and less than 20% on meeting people, as we will base our decision primarily on the output of the day.

We pay all candidates a flat rate of $500 USD for their SuperDay efforts. On rare occasions, if we have to cancel a scheduled SuperDay arrangement because we have filled the role with another candidate who was further advanced in the process, we will pay a $250 USD term fee to the candidate for their efforts up until that point. If the candidate is unable to accept payment for the SuperDay, we will donate the amount to an agreed upon charity of their choice.

As a part of the SuperDay arrangement, you will be asked to sign an NDA / CLA and may be provided with a mocked and/or siloed codebase.

Your First Two Months at Tightknit

Week 1–2

  • Complete your SuperDay.
  • Join the Slack customer community and see how real users think.
  • Form strong opinions about our architecture, product gaps, and velocity constraints.
  • Release a small to medium-sized feature. Improve something meaningful.
  • Ship production code.

Weeks 3–4

  • Own a scoped but consequential project end-to-end.
  • Propose improvements to our systems (engineering, AI workflows, APIs, performance, etc.).
  • Start shaping how engineering should operate here — not just participating in it.

Month 2

  • Lead a cross-cutting initiative (integration, refactor, reliability improvement, new surface area).
  • Have direct customer conversations.
  • Make at least one architectural decision that meaningfully improves our trajectory.

By the end of two months, success looks like this:

  • You’ve taken full ownership of at least one initiative.
  • You’ve earned trust through action and follow-through.
  • You’ve helped us move faster without lowering our standards.
  • You’re clearly operating as a founder-level multiplier — not waiting to be told what to do, but defining what should exist next.
  • You wake up excited to come work alongside this team!

What you might work on

  • Our integrations platform which connects into numerous different applications where customer engagement can happen
  • Our embedding & retrieval architecture, powering our intelligence layer and unified semantic and keyword search
  • Our AI agent for community programming

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Tightknit. Do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO, and we will encourage you to take it.
  • A minimum of 8 weeks of fully paid parental leave.
  • Generous budget for equipment, software, and ergonomics. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month community membership and education budget, with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • Membership to a co-working space if you are located in SF or NYC.
  • If you’re in the US, we offer top-tier health insurance for you and your dependents, with Tightknit covering 100% of the premiums. In other countries, we provide high-quality supplemental health insurance for you and your dependents, also fully covered by us.

We might be a startup, but we do not think that way. Our success hinges on great people and on creating an environment where they can be happy and healthy while feeling challenged to do their best work. We are intentional about the environment we want to create, and we hope this excites you to join us.

Also, we love otters here. 🦦

About the company

Omilia is a leader in Conversational AI. Our cloud platform powers natural, human-like customer conversations over voice and chat for some of the largest enterprises in banking, insurance, telecommunications and hospitality, handling hundreds of millions of interactions a year. We build our own deep tech across the stack, from speech recognition and natural language understanding to dialog management, and we integrate natively with the major CCaaS platforms. We are a company of roughly 500 people, distributed across Europe and North America, in the middle of an ambitious platform modernization program: Kubernetes everywhere, autoscaling for every service, a next generation observability stack, and AI woven through our own engineering lifecycle.

Role Purpose

The Technical Support Engineer provides 24x7x365 tierless support for the Omilia Cloud Platform (OCP), Omilia's fully managed, cloud-native, enterprise conversational AI platform for contact centers. As the single point of entry to Omilia for customers and partners, the role troubleshoots and resolves technical problems, handles user management requests, monitors platform health and alerts, takes part in incident management, and helps keep the platform and customers' services healthy around the clock. The role is based in the United States and the Philippines and works in a follow-the-sun model so that the platform is covered 24x7x365, including evenings, nights, weekends and public holidays as scheduled.

Accountabilities

  • Handle customer and partner cases in the OSD project in Jira Service Management, whether they arrive through the OCP support portal, by email or, for Severity 1 and Severity 2 issues, through the 24x7 support phone line, and through Slack-based direct communication for customers whose Premium Support package includes it.
  • Triage new cases: confirm the issue type (Support, Service Request with Approvals, Bug or Incident), set and validate severity (Severity 1 to Severity 4\) against the OCP severity definitions, and respond within the OCP response Service Level Agreements (SLAs) (10 minutes for Severity 1, 30 minutes for Severity 2, 8 hours for Severity 3 and 2 business days for Severity 4), or the custom response SLAs agreed for a customer.
  • Work cases under the tierless model: pick up cases based on availability during the shift, join the swarm with other engineers on complex investigations, and follow the Follow-the-Sun process for Severity 1 and Severity 2 cases.
  • Keep every case status accurate: In Progress while the team is working it, Waiting for customer only when customer input is actually needed, updated when a case is with another Omilia team, and Resolved with the required fields completed (Assignee, Environment, Customer and Main Reason).
  • Join Severity 1 (SEV1) and Severity 2 (SEV2) PLAT incidents: engage the Incident Response Team and open the incident communication channel within 15 minutes, make sure affected customers and partners are notified within 30 minutes, investigate, and support the Incident Manager (a Technical Support Manager on shift) with regular status updates until the incident is resolved.
  • After incidents, raise follow-up technical tickets with the right teams and projects, and support the post-incident review and the Root Cause Analysis (RCA) report, which is reviewed and approved internally before it is shared with customers and partners, until actions are closed.
  • Support Premium Support customers as needed: hypercare for net new projects (working the technical cases and joining technical calls), open case review reports, alert monitoring and proactive notifications, sessions with a support expert and topic-based training sessions.
  • Hand over open cases and incidents clearly at the end of each shift through Jira and Slack, so the next region can continue without delay.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot on OCP: review dialog logs, Orchestrator apps and flows, critical errors, natural language understanding (NLU) and automatic speech recognition (ASR) behaviour, and telephony and third-party integrations to find the cause of an issue.
  • Gather the evidence needed to reproduce issues (session identifiers, telephone numbers, audio files, error logs, call flows, intents, a clear problem statement and business impact) and guide customers on how to open a complete case, one case per issue.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the right Omilia team (for example software development, network engineering or security) with clear Bug tickets when a fix is required, and assign cases to the appropriate team when assistance outside Technical Support is needed.
  • Handle user management and service requests, including requests that need approval.
  • Monitor health check calls and real-time metrics from the OCP alerting services during the shift, analyse every Severity 1 and Severity 2 alert, and proactively notify a customer by email when an alert relates to an issue on the customer's side.
  • Send customer and partner notifications for upcoming NLU model updates and other platform changes.
  • Create and update knowledge base articles, troubleshooting techniques, frequently asked questions and How-To documents in Confluence.
  • Take part in the weekly case review calls, sharing customer requests, expectations and the severity of business impact, and organise or join conference calls with customers, partners and Omilia teams to resolve issues quickly.
  • Use AI-assisted troubleshooting tools (for example Claude with internal Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors) to speed up investigation, while validating results and following Omilia's data handling policies.
  • Work an 8.5-hour shift on a weekly rota with two days off per calendar week, usually one weekend day per week, and no more than five consecutive days; working hours may fall outside traditional business hours, including evenings, nights, weekends and public holidays as scheduled.

Requirements

Required:

  • Academic degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 2 to 4 years of working experience in technical support for software as a service (SaaS) or cloud platforms, contact center or telephony solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and experience reading application logs.
  • Solid knowledge of web technologies and application programming interfaces (APIs); computer networks (the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP), firewalls); voice and telephony basics (Session Initiation Protocol (SIP), Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), interactive voice response (IVR), call flows); operating systems (Linux) and scripting (bash, Python); and basic Structured Query Language (SQL).
  • Understanding of conversational AI concepts (ASR, NLU, intents, dialog flows).
  • Experience with ticketing systems, preferably Jira Service Management, and with Confluence and Slack.
  • Familiarity with incident management and severity-based SLAs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear status updates to customers.
  • Willingness to work shifts on a rota, including evenings, nights, weekends and public holidays.
  • Verbal and written proficiency in English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with OCP or another conversational AI or virtual agent platform.
  • Experience in a 24x7 follow-the-sun support team.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and monitoring or observability tools.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools for troubleshooting.
  • A service management certification or similar.

Benefits

  • Fixed compensation;
  • Long-term employment with the working days vacation;
  • Development in professional growth (courses, training, etc);
  • Being part of successful cutting-edge technology products that are making a global impact in the service industry;
  • Proficient and fun-to-work-with colleagues;

jobs.title: Senior Agentic Customer Insights Analyst
jobs.excerpt: About Enlighten At Enlighten, we believe AI should expand what people can take on.
jobs.description:
About Enlighten

At Enlighten, we believe AI should expand what people can take on. We build teams of AI agents alongside Fortune 500 companies so they can put their best thinking to work across the business. We want the people closest to the work to be able to ask hard questions and get answers they can trust. Our mission is to give every team the intelligence it needs to make decisions that shape the business.

About the role

You’ll help consumer businesses understand what brings customers in, what keeps them coming back, and where to act next. You’ll direct AI agents through the analysis, design evaluations to test their work, and own the recommendations you bring to senior stakeholders.

What you'll do

  • Turn ambiguous business questions into focused analyses, deciding what to measure and what evidence would support a decision.
  • Analyze customer acquisition, retention, churn, segmentation, pricing, and campaign performance.
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and recurring reports for executive and field teams, using reusable methods that adapt to different audiences.
  • Apply sound statistical and causal methods, check your findings, and explain the limits of what the data supports.
  • Present clear recommendations that connect the analysis to business priorities and the next action.
  • Direct multiple agents in parallel to write SQL and Python, explore the data, and test competing explanations. Build evaluations with expected results and edge cases, independently reproduce critical findings, and turn verified analyses into workflows the team can rerun.

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in customer or marketing analytics.
  • Strong SQL and Python skills, with experience working on modern data platforms and large transactional datasets.
  • Practical knowledge of causal inference, cohort analysis, and customer segmentation.
  • Business judgment: you can recognize when an analysis answers the wrong question, even if the calculations are correct.
  • Curiosity about how a client's business works and the habit of checking whether results make sense in that context.
  • Confidence presenting to senior stakeholders, explaining uncertainty, and constructively challenging assumptions with evidence.
  • Hands-on experience directing AI agents for analysis. You can design evaluations, inspect and debug generated SQL and Python, and independently reproduce material findings.
  • A disciplined approach to documentation and reproducibility, with the ability to deliver when requirements are still taking shape.

Nice to have

  • Experience with consumer, retail, or loyalty analytics.
  • Hands-on use of Claude Code or similar agent tools for analysis, automation, or prototyping.
  • Experience building repeatable workflows that combine human judgment with AI-assisted analysis.

How we work

AI agents are core to how we get work done. You'll spend a substantial part of your day running multiple agents in parallel, building tools and workflows with them, and checking what they produce. You own the result. Verify the facts, calculations, code, and claims before they go into a decision, a customer conversation, or a release.

When working with clients, take initiative within the agreed goals, scope, access permissions, and review process. Bring options and recommendations, and involve the right people before changing a customer commitment or production workflow.

What success looks like

  • You own analyses from the business question to a recommendation that stakeholders can act on.
  • Your findings are credible, reproducible, and clear about assumptions and limitations.
  • Recurring analyses and reports become easier to maintain and adapt to new questions.
  • Clients trust your judgment, and AI improves your efficiency without weakening the quality of the work.

jobs.excerpt: Senior Data Services Analyst At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours.
jobs.description:
Senior Data Services Analyst

At Fullbay, our mission is simple — to create safer roads for our families and yours. As leaders in the heavy-duty repair industry, we power shops with technology that helps them run smarter and more efficiently. As an AI-First company, we invite artificial intelligence to eliminate friction, spark innovation, and drive efficiencies in every conversation— for our teams and our customers.

The Senior Data Services Analyst owns how Fullbay turns a new customer's data set into a fast, accurate, white-glove onboarding. This role builds and runs the automation, validation, and migration tooling that takes a customer from signed contract to live production, using Python, SQL, and AI-assisted automation to replace manual data loading with repeatable, monitored pipelines. Every hour of manual effort removed is time the team can spend on the high-touch moments that make onboarding feel white glove.

This is a hands-on technical role, not a data-entry or file-upload role. The Senior Data Services Analyst writes production-grade Python and SQL, refines and optimizes current internal tooling, designs pipelines with testing and monitoring, and acts as the trusted expert customers rely on during their most important transition. The role also serves as technical lead for Data Services, with a path to leading the team as it scales.

The Right Wrench for the Job

In a heavy-duty shop, a great technician doesn't just replace the part that failed. They find out why it failed, fix the cause, and make sure the truck leaves the bay ready for the road. That's the mindset this role demands. When you see a repeated manual task, your first move is to script it, and you check every output, whether it came from a person or an AI tool, before it touches a customer's production data.

You're the right fit if you write clean, tested Python and SQL, explain a data tradeoff to a shop owner in plain language, and stay composed during a fixed cutover window. You treat every migration as a reputation moment, you anticipate problems before the customer sees them, and you enjoy teaching teammates what works. This isn't the role for someone who wants a queue of file uploads to work through. If you'd rather build the tool that retires the manual step and help our customers go live with confidence, we'd like to talk.

Primary Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain Python pipelines, scheduled data deliveries, and API-based feeds (such as S3 reports and ERP exports) that replace manual data work, with logging, automated tests, monitoring, alerting, and Git version control; host all scripts, tooling, and database restores in shared repositories and cloud environments (such as Git and AWS) rather than on a local computer, so everything is version controlled, maintained, and able to run automatically
  • Apply AI and LLM-assisted techniques to profile and clean messy source data, propose field mappings and crosswalks, flag anomalies, and draft data readiness findings, with human review and validation before any output touches production
  • Evaluate, pilot, and adopt automation and AI tooling, and build reusable libraries, templates, and self-service tools so standard imports run with minimal hands-on effort; measure hours saved and errors avoided, and retire the manual steps they replace
  • Plan and execute production data migrations and cutovers for multi-shop and multi-entity customers, including freeze windows, delta loads, validation gates, go/no-go criteria, and rollback plans
  • Design and maintain data mapping and crosswalk specifications (users, roles, shops, tax locations, part locations, customers, units, vendors) and obtain customer sign-off before loading
  • Run data readiness sessions with customers, give proactive expert advice to head off data problems early, and document customer decisions such as lookback periods, filters, and merge rules
  • Give customers pre-load previews, automated validation reports, and data quality scorecards before go-live, and own data import escalations through go-live
  • Build dry-run, diff, and pre-load snapshot tooling so changes to production data can be previewed, verified, and reversed where possible
  • Reconcile loaded data against source systems (record counts, inventory quantities and value, adjustments, and average cost carryover) and run automated data quality checks on every load, backed by targeted manual inspection
  • Write complex queries and extraction solutions for customer and internal reporting, and identify, document, and record trends across systems in a shared location, then recommend process improvements based on them
  • Maintain and troubleshoot data in Salesforce, keep a version-controlled script inventory and SOPs for each data work type, and log effort and rework against each customer statement of work so scope and change-order decisions rest on evidence
  • Document every stage of every data process (extraction, mapping, transformation, load, validation, and cutover) in a shared location, and lead Data Services toward consistent documentation so process knowledge no longer lives with individuals
  • Serve as technical lead for Data Services: mentor team members on Python, SQL, data quality standards, and AI-assisted development, review scripts, imports, and AI-generated code before anything runs in production, and grow toward leading the team as it scales

Additional Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Follow company guardrails on which AI tools may be used with customer data and how
  • Adhere to all confidentiality and compliance regulations
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Minimum Education & Work Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, data science, business, or a related field, or equivalent related experience
  • 3+ years of experience in data migration, ETL, or data engineering and analytics, including production Python scripting and SQL
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as LLM assistants or AI coding tools) to speed up real data or engineering work, with sound judgment about when to trust the output and when to verify it
  • Preferred: experience migrating customer data between business systems (shop management, ERP, or accounting), building or running workflow automation or orchestration tools in production, and mentoring or leading technical team members

Key Skills and Qualifications:

  • Python (including pandas) for repeatable, testable, logged data loads and transformations, with Git version control, code hosted in shared repositories rather than on local machines, and code review habits
  • SQL (joins, unions, aggregation, inserts, and updates), including reading table schemas, restoring database backups in the shared, automated environment rather than on a local machine, and reasoning about table relationships and query performance
  • Data reconciliation and safe handling of production data: comparing source and loaded data, resolving discrepancies in large datasets, and using dry runs, snapshots, validation checks, and rollback planning
  • REST APIs and cloud storage (such as AWS S3), including scheduled feeds with monitoring and alerting
  • Advanced Excel and CSV handling for data preparation and review (formulas, lookups, quoting, encoding, leading zeros)
  • A builder's instinct: when you see a repeated manual task, your first move is to script, template, or orchestrate it, and you use AI tools to profile messy data, draft mappings, and generate and review code
  • Ability to design human-in-the-loop workflows with clear checkpoints, test data, and measurable accuracy, and awareness of data privacy and security practices when using AI tools with customer information
  • Customer-facing communication with a white-glove mindset: runs data readiness sessions, explains requirements and tradeoffs in plain language, documents customer decisions, holds scope boundaries, and anticipates problems before customers see them
  • Works independently, prioritizes across concurrent projects, stays composed under fixed deadlines and cutover windows, and documents every stage of the work in clear SOPs and runbooks that teammates can follow without you in the room
  • Preferred: heavy-duty repair and fleet data knowledge, including work orders, units, PM schedules, VMRS codes, parts and inventory (locations, adjustments, average cost), and labor and tax rates

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • Regularly required to sit at a desk in front of a computer and use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls (including a computer keyboard and operating a telephone), lift and/or move up to 10 pounds

  • Specific vision abilities required by this position include close vision, color vision, and the ability to adjust focus
  • Noise level in the work environment is usually moderate

jobs.description:
Why Join Intellia?

Our mission is to develop curative genome editing treatments that can positively transform the lives of people living with severe and life-threatening diseases.

Beyond our science, we live our four core values: One, Explore, Disrupt, Deliver and feel strongly that you can achieve more at Intellia. We have a single-minded determination to excel and succeed together. We believe in the power of curiosity and pushing boundaries. We welcome challenging thoughts and imagination to develop innovative solutions. And we know that patients are counting on us to make the promise a reality, so we must maintain high standards and get it done.

We wantall ofour people to go beyond what is possible. We aren’t constrained by typical end rails, and we aren’t out to just “treat” people. We’re all in this for something more. We’re driven to cure and motivated for change. Just imagine the possibilities of what we can do together.

How You Will Achieve More:

The Senior Principal Biostatistician is responsible for leading the statistical activities for one or more clinical studies as part of a cross-functional team.


Responsibilities:

  • Authors/reviews study biostatistics documents (e.g., clinical study protocols, statistical analysis plans, mock Tables, Listings, and Figures shells).
  • Develops and reviews specifications for TLFs and provide statistical input into study-related analyses, publications, posters, and presentations.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional team members throughout study planning, conduct, analysis, and reporting to align deliverables and proactively resolve statistical and data-related issues.
  • Ensures deliverables are completed in a timely delivery and with high quality
  • Contributes to study design including study endpoint and estimand selection, sample size and power calculations and analysis methods to ensure scientifically sound, and efficient and clearly interpretable results.
  • Contributes to interactions with external review boards/ethics committees and other external parties
  • Collaborates with other line functions. Explain statistical concepts in an easily understandable way to non-statisticians and provide adequate statistical justifications for positions.
  • Remains apprised of current/new developments and technological advancements in statistics.

About You:

  • Knowledge in scientific computing/programming (SAS, R or Python), data manipulation, graphing, and simulation.
  • Ability to develop innovative statistical solutions to problems.
  • Ability to identify data or analytical issues and assist with providing solutions by either applying own skills and knowledge or consulting with subject matter experts.
  • Good knowledge of early phase clinical trial designs and study conduct in relevant therapeutic areas.
  • Understanding of ICH GCP as well as general knowledge of industry practices and standards.
  • Able to build strong relationships with peers and cross-functional partners to achieve higher performance.
  • Demonstrate excellent collaboration, organizational/ leadership abilities, and interpersonal skills with the ability to clearly explain statistical considerations to non-statisticians.
  • PhD or MS in Statistics or related field
  • At least 3 years (PhD) or 6 years (MS) of experience in the Pharmaceutical/Biotechnology industry.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.

EEOC Statement: Intellia believes in a diverse environment, and is committed to equal employment opportunity for all its employees and qualified applicants. We do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status. Intellia will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with known disabilities, in accordance with applicable law.

Applications are accepted on a rolling basis, and will continue to be accepted until the position is filled at which point the position will be taken down.

The base salary for this position is expected to range between $159,769.00 - $195,273.00 USD per year.

The salary offered is determined based on a range of factors including, but not limited to, relevant education and training, overall related experience, specialized, rare or in-demand skill sets, internal comparators and other business needs. Upon joining Intellia, your salary will be reviewed periodically and additional factors such as time in role and performance will be considered. Intellia may change the published salary range based on company and market factors.

Additional compensation includes a performance-based annual cash bonus, a new hire equity grant, and eligibility to be considered for annual equity awards the value of which are determined annually at the Company’s discretion.
